tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyagadrug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyagadrug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyagadrug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/

/ oṃ swā sti/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa 'phrin las gter mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje khros pa'i sku/ /ma rung bdud dpung phye mar 'thag mdzad pa/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med zhabs pad la/ /gus pas btud nas sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri/ /rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang ldan pa/ 'di nyid kyi byin brlabs legs par mnos pa zhig gis/ bris sku mchod gtor tsa ka li sogs mtshan nyid tshang ba bshams la/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang nang mchod byin rlabs byas la/ bdag nyid yi dam gyi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ gaṃ dkar po 'od du zhu ba las/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i dbu la spyan gsum pa phyag g.yas sa'i snying po la phug lo ma dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ nyal stabs su gnas pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ skye 'gro'i re ba tshul bzhin du skong ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ rab tu bzhad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/

dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas bar pas thod skam gyi 'phreng ba/ tha mas ḍā ma ru drag tu 'khrol ba/ g.yon gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis srid gsum rnam par gnon pa'i shugs can mnyam pa'i stabs krig krig zhabs kyis bgegs kyi rgyal po mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs la/ dar ljang khu'i ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing*/ dmar po'i snyan cha/ khra bo'i dpung rgyan/ dkar po'i mgul rgyan/ ser po'i lag gdub/ ljang khu'i do shal/ dkar po'i rkang gdub dang ske rags can phyag zhabs thams cad la dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse phran can dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas/ bdud dang bgegs thams cad brlag par mdzad pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ tsan+dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ sku mdog nag mo phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram shing nag po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin pa/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ dri'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ 'khor sha za dang ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sdes bskor ba'o/ /gtso bo'i mdun du hūṃ las gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la/ sku mdog mthing nag kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs nas/ dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung ldang ba/

phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar bas lha dang lha ma yin thams cad skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thod khrag dgra bgegs kyi snying dang bcas pa gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ g.yas su bh+yoḥlas dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdog dmar nagagayas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu dzaḥlas gshin rje ṭāk+ki rā dza sku mdog dmar nagaphyag g.yas zhags pa dgra la 'phen zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub gnod byed la sdigs pa/ g.yon du du las bdud mgon chen po trak+shad sku mdog nag po phyag g.yas ru mtshon mdung dmar rtse gsum pa dgra bo'i snying gar bsnun pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang*/ sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ bzhi ka'ang khro bo las mkhan gyi cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du shar du brgya byin/ shar lhor me lha/ lhor gshin rje/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub tu chu lha/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang shar du 'byung po/ steng du tshangs pa/ 'og tu sa bdag ste phyogs skyong bcu/ gzhan yang lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ sgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rgyal po chen po bzhi ste/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga po thams cad kyang 'khor bye ba bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs sha la dga' ba/ khrag la rol ba/ snying rje med pa/ kha gdangs pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba/ lag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa skad cig la skye 'gro thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud pa/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ bdud dang ma mo'i cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad yongs su gang ba/

thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i re 'dod tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ tsan+dan gyi shing rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ steng na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas na dpa' bo ngar dang bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig nyid la/ ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer ka'i sgra si li li/ khro lo lo/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem/ byon par gyur/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mahā kā la che/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /k+ṣe tra pā la la sogs pa/ /'khor gyi bka' nyan gnod sbyin tshogs/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa dang*/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i rjes su k+ṣiṃ ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ de nas k+ṣiṃ gi gnas su e h+ye hi bcug pa dang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcug pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas/ myur mdzad 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ hūṃ/ bdud 'dul dmag dpon nag po che/ /rab brjid 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas/ /dgra bgegs ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /nag po chen po bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai we te/ shap+ta zhes sbyar ro/ /snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod 'bul/

chos dbyings ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i sku/ /bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / de nas gsol 'debs ni/ na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo gu ru he/ badz+ra bī ra bī re ṇe/ shrī ḍā ka ḍā ki nī/ dzo ga dzo gi ni/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa ya sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tsha mi/ kye kye phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shigayi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig/dpa' bo dang dpa' mor bcas pa rnams kyis byin= sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis= dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs/ ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga' ba/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga' ba/ mthu dang nus pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba/ khyed rnams kyi sku'i sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shigagasung gi sgo nas= thugs kyi sgo nas= sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas= da lta nyid du= myur ba nyid du= 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /bdag ni dad pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang*/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ de nas bshags pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa'i mthar/ rdo rje 'chang dang dpal ldan shā wā ri/ /rgyal ba mai tri grub chen rā hu la/ /a mi de ba lo ke shwa ra dang*/ /ha ya gṛ wa pad+ma 'byung gnas dpal/ khyung po dzo ku rat+na bir+ya dang*/ /dharma sidha dharma pradzñā dang*/ /bir+ya sidha mkhas grub chos rje sogs/ /rin chen brgyud pa'i bla ma dgongs su gsol/ /'gro ba'i re skong yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i/ /brgyud ldan bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas la/

/dag pa gnyis ldan chos skur ma rtogs par/ /'jig rten rtogs bcad dbang gyur 'thol lo bshags/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las dang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag theg mchog sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /rtsa ba yan lag 'gal nyams 'thol lo bshags/ /mthu stobs nus pa 'phrin las phun tshogs shing*/ /skad cig dran pas bar chad thams cad sol/ /'du 'bral med par dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes mgon po phyag drug dgongs su gsol/ /dur khrod nags 'dabs chu gling bas mthar ru/ /phyi nang rten dang dam rdzas tshogs gyur nas/ /bsnyen sgrub bskang bshags tshul bzhin ma grub par/ /le lo g.yeng ba'i dbang gyur mthol lo bshags/ khyad par gsang ba'i rten mchog bla na med/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen sku/ khyod la yid ches mos gus 'bral med kyis/ /rnam dag chos skur ma rtogs 'thol lo bshags/ /bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur te/ /bla ma mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ /gnod zhing 'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas nas kyang*/ /lha mchog khyed gyi spyan sngar 'thol lo bshags/ /ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ /k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*/ /ṭāk+ki rā dza trak+shad re ma tī/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang gtsang rigs dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar khyed kyis khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /bdag gi 'phrin las yengs med sgrub pa la/ /yi chad bgyis shing sha khrag gtor tshogs kyis/ /gtang rag dus su ma thongs 'thol lo bshags/ /mngon shes med pas nyes skyon ma rtogs par/ /bstan pa 'jig dang bla ma'i sku dgra la/ /drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod ma bgyis par/ /gsang ba sgrags shing byams bgyis 'thol lo bshags/ /dam nyams gtam 'dres grib phog zas zos dang*/ /rgyu chung phud nyams 'gal 'khrul nor la sogs/ /nyes skyon 'khrul ba'i tshogs rnams ci mchis pa/

/gnod zhing 'gyod pa'i sgo nas 'thol lo bshags/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams pa 'thol lo bshags/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa= thugs kyi dam tshig= rtsa ba'i dam tshig= yan lag dam tshig= tshor te dam tshig= ma tshor dam tshig= nyams grib dag phyir bshags pa 'di byas pas/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /pha ma bu tsha bzhin du bzod bzhes la/ /dngos grub thams cad bdag la dus 'dir stsol/ /bshags dang bshags par bya ba mi dmigs kyang*/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags dag bya'i phyir/ /rje btsun dam pa yul gyi mchog rnams la/ /rab tu bshags pas bde chen thob gyur cig/ gsol 'debs dang bshags pa'ang mi spro na bor bas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las sngags kyi 'phreng ba rnams kha dog nag po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba 'phreng rdog ltar gnas pa la/ 'od zer sna lnga 'phreng thag gi tshul du brgyus pa rang gi zhal nas 'thon/ mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ mgon po'i thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ yang hūṃ las byung*/ mgon po'i lte ba nas 'thon/ bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ de ltar rtag tu 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi na ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes snying po ci 'grub bzlas/ drag po'i bzlas pa dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la/ shā sa na/ u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣo3 paṣ+tsi ma/ kā lo3.a yaṃ i daṃ/ rat+na trā ya/ a pa ka rī ṇaṃ/ ya ti pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si tā dā/ i daṃ duṣ+taṃ/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ni drag sngags te bod rbad bsad gsum yang 'di la tshang bar bzhed do/ / oṃ shrī de wī hūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo'i mtshan sngags so/ / oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la bi gh+nān hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dzi na mi tra pā shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ ṭāk+ki rā dzā sa ma ya bh+yoḥdu dza hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ du yag dzaṃ mahā kā la trak+shad hūṃ phaṭa/ las mkhan bzhi'i snying po'o/ /de ltar bzlas pa ci 'grub byas nas/ mthar gtor ma yi dam ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje dmar po'i 'od kyi spu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshims nas dgyes par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi nā ya ka traka rag mo bā ling ta maṃ sa rak+ta ru ti ra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ de bzhin du 'khor rnams la snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa btags la lan gsum gsum gyis phul/ oṃ mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nang mchod sngar bzhin phul la/ de nas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa kha dog dri ro reg bya nus mthu dam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kā la legs ldan nag po/ bdud gcod kyi skyes bu/ srog gcod kyi shan pa/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpon/ srin po lang ka pu ri'i grong khyer sum brtsegs brlag par byed pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ rig 'dzin gyi srung ma/ bstan pa'i srog shing*/ dam nyams kyi srog gcod/ mna' zan gyi gshed ma/ 'khor nag po 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ ma mo sha za/ pho rgyud/ mo rgyud kyi tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ sprul pa'i las mkhan bzhi/ phyogs skyong bcu/ gtsang rigs bdun cu/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ khyed la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi chos 'khor skyong par mdzad du gsol/ khyad par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/

bla ma dang slob dpon dang pha ma la sogs pa'i sku la bdo ba/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa rnams dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mi 'tshal na bsad pa dang bskrad pa dang dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmugs pa dang*/ mnan pa dang*/ sdigs shing dpa' skong bar mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang sngon gyi las dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad kyi gdong grogs dang*/ bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas la/ /bdag gis mchod gtor phul ba yis/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod pa dang*/ /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang*/ /bstan pa 'jig dang dbyen byed dang*/ /bla ma'i sku la bdo ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba rnams/ / de dag nag po chen pos sgrol/ /shā trun mā ra ya phaṭa/

zhes brjod/ hūṃ/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gdub dang bcas bi nā ya ka mnan/ /nag po chen po stag gi sham thabs can/ /phyag drug sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa gri gug bar pa 'phreng ba 'dzin/ /tha ma ḍā ma ru ni drag tu 'khrol/ /g.yon pa thod khrag dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /de bzhin zhags pa bzung nas 'ching bar byed/ /drag po'i zhal gdangs mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan gsum drag po dbu skra gyen du 'bar/ /dpral bar sin dhu ra yi thig les byugs/ /spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab brtan/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rin chen thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ / shing las byon nas gtor ma len mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan phyag drug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bh+yo: khrag mtsho chil chil khol ba'i klong dkyil na/ /mtsho chen dre'u'i steng na gzi brjid 'bar/ /mthing nag sku la zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ / bdud kyi khram shing nad kyi rkyal ba bsnams/ /sku yi sprul pas sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*/ /gsung gi sprul pas khams gsum g.yo bar byed/ / thugs ni mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /ma cig re ma tī la phyag 'tshal lo/ / hūṃ/ dpal ldan mgon po'i phyogs bzhi'i bka' gnyan pa/ /ye shes bka' sgrub las kyi pho nya mdzad/ /ma rungs kun 'dus sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /las byed pho nya bzhi la bdag cag bstod/ /dbang po gshin rje chu lha gnod sbyin dang*/ /me lha srin po rlung lha 'byung po dang*/ /steng gi tshangs pa sa'i lha mo ste/ /sprul pa'i phyogs skyong bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs rnams/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol/ /mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/

/ thun gtor yod na/ sgron me btsugs te khang steng la sogs par 'bul zhing*/ dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la dang*/ /ma gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma tī/ /lcam dral khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' ba'i/ /k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*/ /ṭāk+ki rā dzā bdud mgon trak+shad dang*/ /phyogs skyong gtsang rigs mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ / dpal ldan nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/dzam+bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig/dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phung 'di bzhes shig/sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams mang po/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ / bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ / thun gtor med na/ rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs spyi btab 'di bya mi dgos so/ /yig brgya mang du bzlas/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ / zhes sogs dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod par rigs/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ / nyon mongs ma lus sel bar shog/oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim par gyur/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam gdab bo/

/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin/ /byin rlabs chu bos skal ldan tshim mdzad cing*/ /rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i/ /chos rje bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog/sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*/ /mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du/ /dam tshig can la dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog/dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brang zhing*/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi= snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams/ /yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i ngang*/ /bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i= sgrub pa po la brten zhing mchod pa dang*/ /skur ba 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa/ /thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mnyam med byang chub sems kyi= 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis go 'phang ji rnyed yod pa rnams/ /phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du/ /skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu= bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin/ /snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog/ ces bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod do/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod pa 'di/ /dam pa du mas yang yang gsal mdzad kyang*/ /gzhan gyis nan tan bskul ba'i ngor byas so/ /dge des byang chub sgrub pa la/ /gegs med mthun rkyen kun 'grub nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /skad cig tsam gyis tshar bcad de/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi/ /'phrin las phyogs bcur spel bar shog/ces pa'ang mchog tu gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos bskul ba'i ngor rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer bdun la sbyar ba las/

slar yang don gnyer mang po'i don du rang lo so gnyis pa la cung zad 'khyer bde bar byas pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sgrol ma dang*/ /rdo rje phag mos legs brgyan pa/ /byin rlabs mgon po cher btud nas/ /ting 'dzin dbang bskur cho ga bshad/ /bar chad kun sel gyi bka' byed par 'dod pas/ gnas dbyen par nyer dgu la sogs pa'i dus bzang por maṇ+ḍal zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing kha me ri can rtse mo tshur bstan pa/ dbus su nyi gdan drug la tshom bu sku mdog dang mthun par 'god/ phyi rol gru bcad dmar po/ zlum skor gyi phyi la'ang rdo rwa me ri bya/ der mañdzi'i steng du/ thod pa'i snod gang yang rung ba'i nang du/ bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'i gtor ma nor gzugs mche ba re 'god cing*/ 'khor gyi gtor ma bzhengs na/ snod de nyid du gnod sbyin la rtse mo g.yas su bcus pa gru gsum/ las mgon la gru gsum phra mo/ gzhan gsum la zlum po phra mo re bya/ gtor ma chen po la mda' dar dang*/ tsa ka li btsugs/ 'bul gtor rgyas pa bshom na gtor sgrub yin la/ bsdu na zlum gtor che ba zhig mdun du bsham/ nang mchod dang*/ mchod pa gzhan rnams ci bde bar bsgrigs/ de nas slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ spro na bgegs gtor btang la bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ nang mchod byin rlabs/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed rnams yi dam nyid kyi rang gzhung ltar byas nas/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ zhes pa nas/ bcol pa'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod kyi bar gtor chog 'phrin las gter mdzod kyi gzhung bsrang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur nyid dmigs pas bdag 'jug tu blangs/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i don du 'dir yang bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu bya/

slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams sems bskyed gsal 'debs su bcugachos 'di'i che ba cung zad brjod/ spro na mgon pos thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ grub chen khyung pos ji ltar gsan tshul dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis ji ltar nus pa thon pa'i tshul rnams ci rigs par bshad nas/ mthar ye shes kyi mgon po 'di la sgrub thabs kyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs na'ang*/ rtsa bar gyur pa ni/ drag po mthu sgrub dang*/ zhi ba nor sgrub gnyis lags/ de gnyis kyi yang gtso bo drag po mthu sgrub yin zhing*/ 'di la yang bka' rigs mi gcig pa mang du yod na'ang*/ de rnams kyi rtsa ba'i dbang bka' ni/ bar chad kun sel gyi bka' 'di nyid yin pas 'di sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis bya ba rnams sngon du song*/ slob ma'i ngos skal du gyur pa la yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la yang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ste drug yod pa las/ dang po bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i spyan sngar ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces brjod la/ slob mas kyang maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma'am/ de mi shes na spyi 'gro zhig 'bul/ gnyis pa ni/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /de ltar na snod kyi skyon gsum spangs te gsan 'tshal/ bzhi pa ni/ khyad par can gyi skyabs 'gro'i don/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la= phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i chos la= phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun la= yi dam lha tshogs dang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ / lan gsum/ lnga pa ni/ 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs sam/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ / zhes sogs rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa rgyas bsdus gnyis po gang byas kyang 'dra ste/ lan gsum bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pas mchod par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos bla ma dang myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul la/ bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la ye shes dbab pa/ sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ sku dngos kyis byin gyis brlab pa/ sngags gtad pa'i rjes gnang ste bzhi las/ dang po la dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing lha ngo bstan pa'i dod dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa dang*/ ye shes 'pho ba dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa mgon po 'khor bcas gsal 'debs pa yin te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang*/ zhes pa nas/ tshul bzhin du skong bar mdzad pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin las/ sa bon las bskyed pa'i tshig rnams dor/ de lta bu'i bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa la mos gus dung ba byas pas thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phogasdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs/

oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma nas de'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid hūṃ mthing nag las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer nas/ tsan+dan gyi sdong po la rgyab brten pa'o/ /de ltar gsal ba'i dpral par oṃ nas/ hūṃ sngon po slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros nas/ 'ur 'ur chem chem byon te khyed rang rnams kyi lus la gnyis su med par thim zhes brjod cing*/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ dam rdzas spos kyi dud pa btul/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra k+ṣiṃ nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'i bar brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed mgon po dbyer ma mchis pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ mthing ga gsal btab la/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ khyad par du bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol snyam pas yid kyis gsol ba dung dung btab pas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas tshur bsdus te oṃ la bstim/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim pas/ bum dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la rol mo bya/ des rigs bsgres te/ gsang dbang bskur du gsol/ mgrin pa'i āḥ gsung gi byin rlabs/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas/ gsang dbang thob/ rol mo bya shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ thugs ka'i hūṃ/ thugs kyi byin rlabs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer mthing gakhyod rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūṃ la thim pas/ sher dbang thob/ rol mo/ dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum po de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nas byon/

khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūṃ mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ de yang spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ oṃ yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gyur/ des lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag nas dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin pas/ sems spros bral phyag rgya chen po la zhog cig ces brjod la/ rol mo/ gsum pa ni/ gtor ma slob ma'i spyi bor bzung la/ gtor ma 'di nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor bcas su gsal ba la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ 'ur 'ur chem chem rang gi spyi bor byon/ bla mas khyed rang rnams kyi bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub par bka' bsgos pa'i tshe/ khyed rang rnams kyi nad gdon dgra bgegs thams cad mgon po'i zhal du sha chom rus chom du gsol zhing*/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar chad bsrung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub par nges bya'o/ /zhes gsung lhang lhang byon par sgom mdzod/ ces brjod la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bka' bsgo drag tu bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/

bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes slob ma'i don du slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la gsol ba lan gsum btab/ yang 'di skad ces brjod de/ bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pa'i thugs kar pad nyi la hūṃ la snying po dang rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar bsgoms la/ mos gus dung ba dang bcas pas me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ bzlas lung dngos gzhi spyi dang mthun pa la/ rjes zlos lan gsum gyi mthar/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng de nyid rgyangs kyis chad nas byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūṃ la thim pas/ bla ma mgon po'i byin rlabs mtha' dag gis rgyud brlan par mos mdzod/ gsum pa rjes la/ dam tshig bzung ba/ yon dbul ba/ smon lam gdab pa ste gsum las dang po ni deng phyin chad khyed rnams kyis yongs su blangs pa'i bslab pa thams cad rnam par dag pa dang*/ khyad par sems bskyed kyi bslab bya dang*/ sngags kyi dam tshig mtha' dag ma nyams pa gal che/ yang dgos mgon po nyid kyi dam tshig 'bru nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang*/ dam rdzas kyi spos sbyar ma mchod par gyis/ bya nag dang*/ khyi nag la rdo mi brdegayid ches par gyis la bla ma dang dbyer med du ltos/ 'byung po gzhan la zas phud mi 'bul/ sdig can gtum po grogs su mi bsten/ khyad pa chos skyong 'di nyid gsang ba dang*/ sngags dang man ngag gsang ba dang*/ dus rgyun dang khyad par gyi mchod gtor la brtson pa gal che ba lags so/ /de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srung snyam pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gnyis pa ni/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ bdag gis dge ba'i sogs smon lam ci rigs par brjod do/

/bar 'dir tshogs mchod gtong ngo*/ /de nas rjes kyi mchod pa bsham/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ chos dbyings ngang las sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya mang du bzla ba nas/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa bris sku'i thugs kar thim/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyis gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te/ bris sku'i lha la gtor chog bzhin phul nas/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam btab/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma bya'o/ /yang 'di dag la lag len mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ sngon 'gro'i skabs thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab mi byed/ dngos gzhi'i skabs mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa tsam las/ slob ma la mgon po bskyed bstim mi byed/ dbang bzhi pa'i skabs slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas/ yig 'bru gnyis pa chad de bstim/ slob ma'i yig 'bru gsum 'od gsal du bsdu ba mi byed/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo dang*/ dmigs pa la yang khyad par yod/ sngags kyi bzlas lung mi byed pa'am/ byed kyang dkyus mthun tsam byed pa ni/ gtor dbang bar chad kun sel bsdus pa'am/ thun mong ba dkyus ma yin no/ /yang bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las mgon po dkar dmar mthing gsum spro ba dang*/ bzhi pa la sku'i stod smad thams cad nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs spro ba yang lugs shig yin/ yang yi ge 'bru gsum spro bas dbang gsum byed pa'ang yod cing*/ sku spro ba'i dbang bzhi/ gsung yig 'bru'i dbang bzhi/ thugs 'od zer kyi dbang bzhi/ yon tan gtor ma'i dbang bzhi/ 'phrin las phyag mtshan gyi dbang bzhi/ zhes ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang nyi shu bskur ba ni/ zhang sgom chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs yin la/ tshul de bzhin ma shes par gtor dbang dkyus 'gro zhig gi gzhug tu phyag mtshan drug gi rjes gnang tsam byed pa ni snying po med do/

khyad par chos brgyud sel yod pa dang*/ chos sgor ma zhugs pa'i khyim pa la/ gtor dbang zab mo'i lugs su bskur ba ni/ tshe 'dir yang bskur bar bya ba'i yul la mi phan zhing*/ rang la bka' chad rin gyis nyo ba yin pas/ rnyed bkur la sogs pa'i don du gtor dbang tsam byed na'ang*/ mi zab pa'i lugs de nyid la tshig tshogs kyi spros pa dang bcas pa byas nas khu ldog chung ba yin/ spyir gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa la ni khyad cher med do/ /gtso rkyang 'jam zhing 'khor can bka' gnyan pa yin pas gtso rkyang la brten nas gtor dbang byed na'ang de'i 'dor len shes dgos la/ mgon po stod lugs lha dgu ma la/ gnas rnying ba phyi ma 'gas gsar rnying gi cho ga ci rigs la brten nas dbang chog rgyas pa sbyar ba ni rang bzor byas la/ de'i yig rnying khungs ma rnams phal cher 'di nyid dang mthun pas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi cho ga 'di kho nas bya'o/ /rjes chog gi skabs bris 'bur sogs rten ye med na/ gtor ma'i lha dam ye ma phye bar nam mkhar spar la/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te phul nas/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ gtor ma lhar bskyed tshul la yang gtor ma'i steng du mgon po bskyed pa dang*/ gtor ma nyid bskyed pa gnyis yod pa/ gtor dbang gi tshe zab mi zab khyad par chen po yod pa 'dor len gal che'o/ /gtor ma 'dis dper mtshon nas/ slob ma'i khyad par shes pa'ang gal che'o/ /bstan srung kuna~X las ches lhag pa'i/ /phyag drug mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi/ /lag len rab tu dga~X' ba'i tog/snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig gsal bar bkod/ /ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa bar chad kun sel gyi byin rlabs kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med ni/ /dbang gi rgyal po zhes grags pa/ / mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la btud de/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bri/

/mgon bka' gnyis pa mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang byed tshul yang snying du dril ba ni/ mdun du stegs bu'i steng du/ rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal zlum po mu khyud dkar po/ dbus su chos 'byung dkar po/ re kha dmar/ gru bcad ljang khu/ chos 'byung gi dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu dkar po zhig bkod/ de'i steng du madzñi la rten gyi gtor ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig bkod de/ dbyibs gru gsum du byed pa'am/ nor bu'i dbyibs su byed na/ zan zlum po'i steng du/ zan ril gsum 'dzom/ de'i steng du dzaṃ bshos 'dra ba zhig bkod pas/ phyogs gang nas bltas kyang nor bu mig gsum 'dra ba zhig yod pas de ltar byas kyang rung*/ gang ltar na'ang rgyu phye mar la rin po che brdar ba sogs las byas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po zas bzang dgus brgyan pa dang*/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bsham/ rten gtor la tsa ka li yod na 'dzugs shing med kyang chogade nas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ dngos gzhi nyams len ni/ bdag bskyed yi dam la bya ba'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi 'di la bdag mdun dbyer med gtso che zhing*/ phyag len yang bdag mdun dbyer med la mdzad de/ de ltar na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ gaṃ las tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ la phug dang*/ ne'u le 'dzin pa gnyis kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du/ rang sems chos nyid kyi thig le dkar dmar rgya sran tsam/ de'i dbus su hūṃ dngul chu'i mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/

rang dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar zhing brjid pa/ zhal khro la 'dzum gyi rnam pa can rab tu bzhad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ sma ra smin ma/ dbu skra kham ser brdzes pa/ dpral bar sin dhu ra'i thig les byugs pa/ spyi bor mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ bar pas nor bu dbang gi rgyal po thugs kar gtod pa/ tha ma'i seng ldeng gi ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos bum pa nor bus gang ba ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba'i nang du bcug ste brla g.yon pa la brten pa/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ tha ma na zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs 'gro 'chom gyi stabs kyis pad nyi tshogs bdag gi gdan la bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub dang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ glang po che'i lpags pa'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sil khrol dang*/ chun 'phyang sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ 'khor dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'go ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs kyis bskor te me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de'i thugs kar chos nyid kyi thig le/ de'i dbus su hūṃ dkar po'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lhor dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can/ /sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro/ /'gro ba'i dbul 'phongs ma lus zhi mdzad pa/

/'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying ga'i thig le'i mtha' bskor du sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ gu ru mahā kā la ha ri ni sa sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes ci nus su bzla/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nag po'i mngon rtogs su bshad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul zhing*/ shā sa na lan gsum gyis dam can spyi la 'bul ba phyag len la mdzad/ de nas gong bzhin mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ rang nyid sgrub pa nyams len tsam yin na/ skabs 'dir rjes chog bya/ slob ma rjes bzung ni/ rjes chog gi sngon du bya ba yin te/ slob ma rnams la chab btang*/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ rgyas par spro na chos bshad/ mgon po'i thugs bskyed pa'i lo rgyus sogs bshad/ bsdu na sems bskyed gsal btab pa tsam gyis mchogamaṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug cing*/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ zhes sogs lan gsum/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro/ rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab rnams phyag len rgyas pa'i tshe mdzad cing*/ mdor bsdus pa la dga' na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug rjes gnang dngos gzhi la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces brda sprad la/ mdun gyi gtor ma dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu gsal gad ba dgos pa yin pas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa'o 'i bar gong bzhin/

de lta bu'i slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ oṃ shū n+ya nas/ ko3haṃ/ zhes gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis kun rdzob rnam shes kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid thig le hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i skur khrong gis gyur par mos mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ hūṃ dkar po'o/ /slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yin bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ skad cig de nyid la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha sil sil/ khrol khrol/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem byon te/ khyed rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod la rol mo drag tu bya/ snying po'i mthar a be sha ya aḥ zhes drag tu bzla/ rol mo dang sngags bzlas ni 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre/ de sku'i rjes gnang bum dbang gi dod yin no/ /slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i chos nyid kyi thig le'i nang hūṃ gi mtha' skor du sngags kyis bskor bar mos/ slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las sngags 'phreng gnyis pa zhig chad/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le'i nang du spar btab pa bzhin du 'khod par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po lan bcu gsum bzla ba phyag len la mdzad/ de gsung gi rjes gnang gsang dbang yin no/ /yang slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs ma lus pa tshur bsdus te thugs kar thim/

bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las gri gugathod pa/ bum pa/ nor bu/ lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung*/ thams cad 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ rol mo/ de thugs kyi rjes gnang shes rab ye shes kyi dod yin/ yang slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga sku mdog dmar mo ḍā ma ru dang thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ shangs kyi bu ga g.yon pa nas 'thon/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang*/ 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud/ dwangs ma/ tshe srogalongs spyod/ dbang thang thams cad bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur 'dus/ khyed rang rnams kyi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ srog rtsa'i lam nas brgyud de/ snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le la gnyis su med pa thim/ rol mo/ de yon tan gyi rjes gnang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i dod yin no/ /yang slob dpon la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi zhabs 'og gi tshogs bdag bskul bas/ tshogs bdag las rang dang 'dra ba'i tshogs bdag dpag tu med pa sprul/ 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin dregs ldan che dgu thams cad dbang du bsdus/ khyed rang rnams kyi bran du phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi tshogs kyi bdag po'i kha dang bshang lam ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char chen po babs pas/ rang gi bang mdzod gnas khang yul phyogs thams cad zas nor longs spyod/ 'dod dgu sna tshogs pas phyur bur gang bar gyur/

rol mo/ de 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang dbang gi mtha' rten gyi dod yin no/ /'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ mos pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas par gsal btab/ de rnams la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem/ rang gi spyi bor byon/ rang gi yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i don thams cad bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes gsung lhang lhang byon par bsam zhing*/ byin gyis rlob rlob ltar bzhugs par gyur/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod cing*/ bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ mthar bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'od du zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod byas la/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang*/ zhes pa nas/ sbyar du gsol zhes pa'i bar nag po'i rjes gnang gi skabs dang 'dra/ rjes kyi cho ga rnams kyang mgon po nag po dang 'dra zhing*/ 'di nyid kyi rjes chog gi skabs gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar btegs nas/ gtor ma de nyid dbul ba'i lag len yang 'dug mod kyi mgon dkar gyi phyag len dkyus la mi mdzad par snang ngo*/ /nor sgrub kun las ches lhag pa/ /dga~X' bar bsngags pa'i g.yer po che/ /mkha' 'gro'i snyinga~X nas bskul ba'i thabs/ /gsal po~Xr brjod 'di e ma mtshar/ /mgon dkar yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i sgrub thabs kyi le mtshan no// //maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ rgyal ba kun gyi bla ma ni/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /'jig rten mgon la rab btud nas/ /mgon ser sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /mgon bka' gsum pa mgon ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ gtor ma gru gsum ser po'am/ nor bu 'bar ba'i gzugs can zhig bya/ chos 'byung ser po gru gsum gyi steng du mañdzi la 'god pa sogs bshom gzhan dang 'dra/

mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang 'dra/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su pad nyi la tshogs bdag pho mo bsgyel ba'i steng du/ hūṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ser la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ser ba/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa na ut+pal/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na ne'u le dang*/ gsum pa zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis tshogs bdag pho mo mnan pa/ sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa/ yum lha mo drag mo sku mdog dud kha gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gu ru mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ uṣ+ṇi ṣa ya yak+ṣa hūṃ/ rat+na gri sid+dhi hūṃ/ pradzñā warda ni swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/

rang sems zhes pa dang*/ rang nyid zhes pa bor ba ni khyad par ro/ / ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ byad ma zlog cing bsrung ba dang*/ /tshe dang blo gros kun 'phel zhing*/ /zhi dang rgyas pa'i las mdzad pa/ /bla ma mgon po khyod la 'dud/ / zhes pas bstod la/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs nag po'i mngon rtogs dang mtshungs/ oṃ gu ru mahā kā la i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis bya ba'o/ /slob ma rnams kyis yon dbul ba la sogs pa'i sngon 'gro'i bya ba mgon po dkar nag gnyis kyi rjes gnang dang 'dra/ rje gnang dngos la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces byas la/ bla ma mgon ser du gsal ba'i zhal nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes gsungs pa'i rkyen gyis ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar sgrub thabs dang 'dra ba las/ rang sems zhes pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid ces pa dang*/ rang nyid ces pa khyed rang rnams zhes 'don pa spo/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pa'i mthar/ rol chen bya zhing*/ snying po'i mthar a be sha ya aḥ zhes brjod pa rnams ni khyad par ro/ / bla ma'i dpral ba nas oṃ yig dkar po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa nas āḥyig dmar po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ gsang dbang thob/ thugs ka nas hūṃ yig sngon po byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gnas gsum char nas oṃ āḥhūṃ dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob par mos pa mdzod/

'di la sngags kyi bzlas lung mi dgos/ 'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma 'di nyid bla ma mgon po dbyer med du gsal ba'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' tshogs kyis bskor bar mos/ rang gi spyi bor byon/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi sku phra mo dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rol chen dang bcas te bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ rjes kyi bya ba dam tshig bsrung bar khas blang ba sogs dang*/ rjes chog ni/ mgon po nag po'i rjes gnang gi yi ge bris zin pa 'don pa spos la sbyar bar bya'o/ /mgon ser 'di dang*/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa gnyis la mgon ser bka' gnyis zhes zer na'ang*/ mgon ser dngos ni 'di kho na'o/ /nor 'phel bsrung ba kuna~X gyi mchog/shes rab dga~X' ba skyed byed pa/ /mgon ser sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /shin tu dkon pas snyinga~X po~Xr gril/ /mgon ser blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khro bo'i sku/ /dbang sdud lha la gus phyag 'tshal/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'od 'phro ba/ /mgon po'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /mgon bka' bzhi pa mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi rim pa ni/ mdun du stegs bu la/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum mthing nag me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba la/ rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ dang*/ gri gug gi lte bar āḥs mtshan pa/ de tsam 'bri ma thub na tshom bu dmar po bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ me long la sin dhu ra btsugs la bkram/ de la chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs dbus su rdo rje hūṃ dang*/ gri gug āḥs mtshan pa/ zur drug po la g.yas skor gyis ha ri ni sa swāhā/

zhes pa'i yi ge drug po rnams bri/ steng du dar dmar po'i gur phub/ de'i g.yas su dpal gtor nor gzugs ma dmar po sha dang bu ram sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig dang*/ 'bul gtor dang mchod pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ e las chos 'byung mthing ga'i dbus su/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ nyi ma/ bgegs kyi rgyal po kha bub tu bsgyel ba rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing zhal gcig phyag drug dang po gnyis gri thod bzung nas yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis cang te'u rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ tha ma lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams/ /spyan gsum skra ser gyen du brdzais/ /thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /stag lpags grol zhing g.yon brkyang stabs/ /mi rus sbrul dang g.yer khas brgyan/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /yum chen pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ /chags pa'i nyams can sku mdog dmar/ /gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan ma/ /gri gug thod bcas yab la 'khyud/ /gnyis ka'ang me dpung klong na bzhugs/ /gtso bo yab yum gyi mdun du mahā kā la sku mdog nag po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su k+ṣe tra pā la dmar po ḍā ma ru dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rgyab tu dzi na mi tra nag po gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yon du ṭāk+ki rā dzā ser po rtse gsum dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyi skor du dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi thugs kar gri gug aṃ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/

shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis ka la 'od dpag med dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying gar sngags kyi 'phreng ba bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra bigh+nān bi nā ya ka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma gu ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las zhes pa nas/ gtso bos dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las bdag nyid zhes pa'i tshig bor ba ni khyad par ro/ / oṃ gu ru mahā kā la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med bde chen gsung*/ / rgyal ba kun gyi rang bzhin 'od dpag med/ /chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad spyan ras gzigs/ /dbang gi skur ston nag po che la bstod/ / mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub tu bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs nag po'i skabs dang 'dra/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā ling gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces phul/ gong bzhing mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar slob ma byin rlabs ji ltar byed pa thams cad rang gis kyang bdag 'jug gi tshul du dmigs pas blang bar bya'o/ /slob ma rnams kyi sngon 'gro'i bya ba yan chad nag po'i skabs dang*/

de'i rjes su snying gar zla ba'i steng du/ rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gsal btab la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ lan gsum/ gsang sngags 'byung ba dkon par bstan pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag/res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung*/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul 'byung ba ni/ /de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis/ /sems can sangs rgyas byed pa'o/ / zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs te gnyis su med par thim/ rol chen bya/ snying po'i mthar/ a be sha ya a a aḥ zhes lan bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ de'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po/ gri thod ḍā ma ru rtse gsum lcags kyu zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud par gyur/ lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa lags te/ chos 'byung mthing kha'i dbus su nas/ brtsegs pa'i steng du mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po bzhugs pa ni/ pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhes pa nas/ tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ de thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med par mdzod/ dbang gi dngos gzhi ni/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ de'i spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las mgon po sku mdog dkar po/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob par gyur/

rol mo'i sgra bya/ yang mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las mgon po sku mdog dmar po/ sku chung la yan lag rags pa dpag tu med pa chad nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas gsang dbang thob/ rol mo/ de bzhin du sbyar nas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po las/ sngon po snying gar/ rol mo/ yang gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las dkar dmar mthing gsum/ gnas gsum gar du/ tshig dbang rin po che/ rol mo/ de rnams phyi'i dbang bzhi lags/ de nas yang bla ma mgon po dbyer med la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ mgon po yab yum rang gi spyi bor byon/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo 'od zer du zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ smon mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang dbang thob/ lhen sna yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang*/ tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa thob par mos mdzod/ de dag ni nang sku dngos kyi dbang bzhi'o/ /gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ/ gzi brjid dpal 'bar mgon po yab yum sku/ /ngo mtshan lhun grub dam rdzas gtor ma 'dis/ /dam ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la longs spyod shog/

snying po'i mthar/ kā ya badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ des bum pa'i dbang bskur thob par mos mdzod/ thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba mgrin par gtad/ āḥ zab mo gsang sngags mgon po yab yum mtshungs/ /bde chen snod bcud zag med bdud rtsi 'dis/ dam ldan= 'gags med tshangs dbyangs gsung la longs spyod shog/kā ya badz+ra gyi gnas su wāka badz+ra/ gsang dbang*/ sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor snying gar gtad la/ hūṃ/ gzung 'dzin kun bral mgon po yab yum thugs/ /dri med snang stong me long ye shes 'dis/ /dam ldan= rnam dag ye shes thugs la longs spyod shog/tsit+ta badz+ra/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ / 'di skabs su yig rnying las ma bshad kyang*/ slob ma la nang mchod blud pa dang*/ snying gar sin dhu ra'i thig le re mdzad pa phyag len la snang ngo*/ /de nas khyed rang rnams rig pa rten med kyi ngang du mnyam par zhog cigahoḥchos dbyings mtha' bral spros pa rab zhi'i ngang*/ /rang rig ye shes ting 'dzin klong yangs 'dis/ /dam ldan= chos dbyings yang dag don la longs spyod shog/dzñā na badz+ra/ tshig dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin no/ /de dag ni gsang ba dam rdzas kyi dbang bzhi yin no/ /bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba'i tshogs rnams byung/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim par mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ snying po lan gsum/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /slar yang me tog rnams sngags kyi 'phreng bar byin gyis brlabs la/ khyed rang rnams la gtor bas/ sngags nus pa mthu can du mos mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang*/ zhes sogs/ slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni/ bsod pa sogs cung zad 'don pa spos pas/

mgon nag gi skabs su bshad pa kho nas 'grub bo/ /mgon dmar gyi sgrub thabs rtsa ba 'di yin zhing*/ tshe sgrub ni/ 'di'i las kha tshar lha yin par shes par bya'o/ /dbang sdud kuna~X las ches dga~X' ba/ /rmad byung sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X 'di/ /yig rnying ma rtogs phyis byung gi /lag len dkon phyir bris pa yin/ /mgon dmar dbang gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ tshe dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs/ /myur mdzad mgon po zhes bya ba/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir mgon bka' lnga pa mgon ljang tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs ni/ stegs bu'i steng du chos 'byung ljang khu me ri can/ dbus su lha grangs rang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la dpal gtor nor gzugs ma rgyan gyis brgyan la bzhagagayon du mañdzi'i steng du/ nang mchod kā pa la bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ de'i steng du sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor mgon dmar gyi skabs dang 'dra bar bṛs la/ dar ljang gis gur phub/ g.yas su bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mchod gtor bsham tshul spyi dang 'dra/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams bsgom/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang*/ gzhal med khang pho brang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus/ tsan+dan gyi ljon pa'i drung du/ e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas ljang khu/ de'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma dang bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la/ rang sems hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis cang te'u

dang*/ tri shu la 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis bgrang 'phreng dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra gyen du brdzais pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag lpags dang dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba sogs rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ pang du yum rdo rje ḍā ki ma sku mdog sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can gyis 'khyud pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du bud+dhā ḍā ki dkar mo 'khor lo dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lho ru rat+na ḍā ki ser mo/ rin po che dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma ḍā ki dmar mo pad+ma dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ byang du karma ḍā ki ljang khu ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rus pa dang mi mgo'i 'phreng ba can sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du mkha' 'gro ma 'bum sde dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar swā/ gsang gnas su hā/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/ khyad par shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ k+ṣīṃ ring po nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ dpral mgrin thugs lte gsang gnas nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā'i yig 'bru las/ /dkar dmar mthing ser ljang ba yi/ /'od 'phros phyogs bcu kun khyab pas/ /rgyud drug sems can sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /skyabs gsum thugs rje'i mnga' bdag can/ /ye shes spyan drangs ma lus mchod/ /tshe bdag 'phrin las mgon por gyur/ /'phro 'du 'od zer lngas bskul te/ /dbus 'gyur rang bzhin mchog sgrubs nas/

/bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /dpal ldan 'byor bcu tshe yi bdag/phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i tshogs/ /dur khrod brgyad dang nyer bzhi yi/ /dam can 'khor bcas 'dir 'dus la/ /rnal 'byor bdag la mchog stsol cig/ ces spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'am gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lnga rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ bud+dha ḍā ki la rnam snang*/ rat+na ḍā ki la rin 'byung*/ pad+ma ḍā ki la snang mtha'/ karma ḍā ki la don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan/ gtor ma nag po'i mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ ye shes kyi lha la dmigs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ gu ru mahā kā la bī shwa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod pa 'bul/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med 'phrin las sku/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa/ /phyag drug sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la ha ri ni sa sarba ā yur dzñā na sid+dhi dzaḥ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ 'di la bdag mdun dmigs pas tha dad du sgom pa yin na'ang*/ bskyed chog phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa yin pas/ de nyid kyis bdag mdun gnyis char 'grub bo/ / bum pa'i nang du myur mdzad mkha' 'gro lnga dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur/

rang gi snying ga nas sngags 'phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags kyi 'od zer rnams gzungs thag la 'khril zhing*/ bum pa'i nang gi bcud la thim/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs dwangs ma rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam pas bkug ste thim par gyur/ bum pa la dmigs nas snying po brgya tsam bzla'o/ /'og tu slob ma la ji ltar byed pa'i cho ga rnams/ skabs 'dir dmigs pa'i sgo nas bdag 'jug gi tshul du blangs/ slob ma'i sngon 'gro'i bya ba/ phyag 'tshal khrus/ me tog bkye bsdu/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol btab rnams mgon bka' spyi dang 'dra/ rgyas pa la dga' na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnang ba sbyin la/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ yan lag lnga pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams bya la/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa kho nas 'grub/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag/ ces sogs mgon dmar gyi skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin brjod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dbyer ma mchis pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ 'khod par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin brjod/ de lha ngo bstan pa'i dod yin no/ khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis mgon ljang tshe bdag yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar swā/ gsang bar hā/ slob dpon gyis gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ 'ur 'ur/ chem chem byon pa khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ rol chen dang bcas pas snying po'i mthar/ a be sha ya āḥ.āḥ.āḥ zhes btags la drag tu bzla/ de ye shes dbab pa'i dod yin no/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug la/

bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med pas bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol btab lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcugabum bskyed kyi lha'i dpral ba nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus par mos mdzod/ bkra shis tshe brtan rnam rgyal bum bzang na/ /nyon mongs gti mug ye shes dag pa'i lha/ /rgyal ba'i 'od gzugs sgrib bral longs sku bzhugs/ /phyag drug tshe dpag med mgon dbang bskur bas/ /me long ye shes 'phro 'du'i 'od zer can/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i sku yi dbang thob shog/ sngags bzla bzhin pas/ bum pa dpral bar reg ste/ bum chu blud/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs bsgres te/ bum bskyed kyi mgrin pa nas/ bdud rtsi dmar po= nyon mongs 'dod chags dag pa'i ye shes lha/ /rgyal ba'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong bzhugs/ /rtsa sngags stong nyid snying po'i dbang bskur bas/ /sor rtog ye shes 'phro 'du'i 'od zer can/ /gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i dbang thob shog/mgri par reg ste= thugs ka nas bdud rtsi sngon po= nyon mongs zhe sdang dag pa'i ye shes lha/ /rgyal ba'i thugs mchog dpal gyi ye shes bzhugs/ /mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes dga' dbang bskur bas/ /chos dbyings= rnam kun thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbang thob shog/snying gar= lte ba nas bdud rtsi ser po= nyon mongs nga rgyal ye shes dag pa'i lha/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan phan bde mchog stsol bzhugs/ /chos kyi dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med pa/ /mnyam nyid= mthong thos dran reg myur du sangs rgyas shog/lte bar= gsang ba nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun ljang khu= nyon mongs phrag dog ye shes dag pa'i lha/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pas bzhugs/ /lnga ldan gsang rig gzungs sngags dbang bsgyur te/ /bya sgrub ye shes chen po'i dbang bskur

bas/ /lhun grub rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thob shog/ snying po'i sngags bzla bzhin du/ gsang ba'i phyogs su reg pa ltar byas/ bum chu blud/ phyi ma rnams la bum chu 'thor bar mdzad pa'i phyag len yang snang ngo*/ / de dag ni bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ / sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi me long spyi bor gtugs/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba snying gar reg ste/ rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mtsho dbyings brgyud pa'i/ /mtshan ldan thod pa'i bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ /sgrib bral snang stong zung 'jug me long la/ /sin dhur chos 'byung mkha' 'gro'i gzhal yas nas/ /bde stong sa bon phyag mtshan rtsa sngags lhas/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ / rtsa sngags brjod cing sin dhu ras dpral bar thig le bya/ nang mchod bdud rtsi sbyin no/ / de ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas 'di skad ces brjod de/ gsang yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas/ /lha mo spros te bu la gtad/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bas gang*/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med gyur/ /gang 'dul lha sku mtha' yas su/ /sems can don du byed gyur cig/ rtsa sngags brjod la/ de'i don sgom du gzhug go /de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don sgom du bcug ste/ spros pa'i mtha' bral gcer mthong rang rig 'di/ /nam mkha' chos kyi dbyings dang mnyams sbyor ba/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /ma rig 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgyud drug dang*/ /'khrul rtogs nyon mongs dug lnga rtsad chod nas/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus go 'phang mchog thob shog/oṃ dha re dha re dha ra ṇa bha te swāhā/ zhes me tog gtor/ rgyas pa la spro na/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod cing*/ mdor bsdu na/ nyin mo bde legs sogs sho lo ka gcig brjod/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo mgon ser gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bya/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung bya ste/

sngags rang gi khyad ma gtogs mgon dmar gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi cho ga rnams ni mgon nag gi skabs su brjod zin pa ltar ro/ /kuna~X nas zab mo'i tshe sgrub ste/ /bar chad bsrung thabs dga~X' ba'i tog/mgon ljang sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X 'di/ /gzhan la phan phyir sbyar ba yin/ /mgon ljang tshe bdag gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya tsa rā ṇa samyāka dzñā na bha sa na ka rā ya/ dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /mi bzad mtshon cha'i char gyis dgra bgegs 'joms/ /bdud bzhi'i khrag la rol mdzad dpa' bo che/ /nag po chen pos 'gro 'di shes par mdzod/ / kun rtog yid srubs mthar byed gnas mal du/ /lan brgyar 'joms byed 'gyur bral srin po'i sku/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs ma smad yid kyi gnyen/ /dus mthar 'byung ba 'di yang shin tu mtshar/ /'dir bris sku'i man ngag bzhin rje btsun nag po chen po'i bris sku 'bri ste/ shes rab ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i gzugs kyi mchan khung du gnas pa/ g.yas su mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo thod pa khrag gis gang ba thogs pa/ g.yon du sngon mo bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'bul ba'i rnam pa can te lha gsum pa'am/ 'khor rnams kyang ji ltar 'dod pa bris pa zhig mdun du bkrams la/ de'i mdun du dkyil 'khor sogs grub na legs/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la ma grub kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa gnyis/ myos byed dang pā las gang ba'i snod bzhi bzhi bsham/ bdag nyid yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod 'dus byas pa byin gyis brlabs/ thod pa'ang dung phor du/ dri bzang gi chu bdud rtsi lnga dang bsres pa bzhagabadud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs ring ngam/ mdor bsdu na/

na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yaḥ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ des mdun gyi dngos po thams cad la gtor bas bgegs bskrad la/ srin lag gis nang mchod phyogs bcur gtor te yi ge 'bru gsum brjod pas/ skad cig gis dngos po thams cad byin gyis brlabs par mos/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ gnas khang gzhal med khang du gyur pa'i dbus su/ a yig las byung ba'i pad+ma'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhin du/ shap+ta 'i bar du sbyar zhing*/ lan gsum gsum brjod/ chu bzhi dang dri chab la dung chos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ me tog la snyim pas 'thor tshul/ bdug spos la sor mo bzhi brkyang la/ rtse mo sprad gung mo mdung ltar bsgreng ba dang*/ mar me la rdo rje bsdams pa las g.yas kyi mtheb mdzub zlum por byas pa'i dbus su g.yon gyi mthe bong sdong bu ltar bsgreng ba/ zhal zas la rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba/ rol mo la lag mthil gyi pheg rdob pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas brjod do/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal me tog dri bzang gi chu sogs 'dus byas/ oṃ hriḥswāhā/ kha bshal/ oṃ waḥswāhā/ gdong bkru/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shri ye hūṃ/ lus thams cad bkru ba'am/ nye reg bya/ oṃ badz+ra re kha hūṃ/ zhes maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi mahā pra ti sā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mahā kā la sarba bigh+nānu ta sā da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yungs dkar gtor zhing bgegs bskrad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ/ bsrung ba'o/ /ba byung lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ khrag/myos byed rnams bsres pas/

rkyang nul byas pa'am/ byas par mos la/ oṃ gau ma ye pañtsa pañtsa sho ni ta maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ swāhā/ me tog 'bul ba'i gzungs lan gsum gyis me tog byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ tsan+d+ra ar ka bi ma le swāhā/ lan gsum gyis mtha' skor du ri mo bris shing*/ me tog 'bul ba'i gzungs lan gcig gis me tog bkram/ spro na/ ba lci chu bcas sbyin pa ste/ / zhes pa nas/ skye bar 'gyur gyi bar brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad dang*/ chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa nas/ nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ yi dam gyi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ mahā kā la bha ga wān/ sa ha ga na du ta ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ.e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsang chu gtor/ oṃ badz+ra ka ma la ā sa na tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sūr+ya ā sa na tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ oṃ shā ba ā sa na tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ 'khor bcas gdan gyi steng du 'greng ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs/ dung chos kyi chu'am/ rak+ta' ི ar+ghaṃ 'bul te/ oṃ mahā kā la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ de bzhin du/ pad+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ mchod pa'i sngags sbyar te/ mchod yon dang me tog 'bul/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs dang*/ de nas gtor sngags tsam gyis/ gtor ma chung ngu zhig 'bul/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i sho lo ka dang po lta bu zhig gis bstod/ oṃ muḥ zhes pas 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol lo/ /'di la rgyas par na maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa mdzad cing*/ rjes kyi cho ga'ang rgyas par sbyor ba yod mod kyi/ 'bring po'i dbang du byas pa 'di tsam legs par mngon no/ /mdor bsdu na/ de ltar bshad pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga med kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las skyes pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ klu dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ mchod rten dang bcas shing*/ ro dang ro langs/ 'byung po'i tshogs kyis lang long du gang ba/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs rgyu zhing*/ grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dam tshig gis kun du spyod pa dang*/ mchod rdzas thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ sha za dang*/ bran dang pho nya'i tshogs spyod lam sna tshogs pas ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i dbus su gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi nang kun du lha rdzas kyi me toganyams pa'i mgo bo sogs/ sha khrag gi me tog rnam par bkrams pa/ dbus su thod pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ dkyil 'khor dmar po zur gsum pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sngon po zur gsum pa bsnol bas zur drug pa/ de'i lte bar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i zhing chen bsnol ba/ sgo bzhir nyi ma dang ro'i gdan/ grwa bzhir zla ba/ chos 'byung steng ma'i zur gsum la dbugs bral gyi gdan/ 'og ma la so so'i bzhon pa dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du zla ba dang nyi ma kha sbyor la gnas pa'i hūṃ mthing ga las gri gug thod khrag hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'phags pa mchod/ 'phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal nag po chen po dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag cing*/ nyi ma stong gi'i gzi brjid can/ zhal cig phyag bzhi ban+dhu ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzais pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug dang*/

g.yon dang pos thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas sbrul dang bcas pa'i tri shu la rdo rjes mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ stag gi lpags pa rlon pas smad dkris pa/ rdo rje nag po'i rtse phran can gyi mi mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ khrag 'dzag mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal can rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ha ha dang*/ hūṃ hūṃ dang*/ ki li ki li'i gad rgyang drag po sgrog cing*/ sems dpa'i skyil krung sogs sna tshogs pas rol pas bzhugs pa/ mi bzad srin po'i lus can/ bong thung gsus pa 'phyang ba/ thugs rje lhag par khros pa ches cher 'khrugs pa/ rngam pa'i stang stabs khro gnyer bsdus shing ma rungs pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ rab tu dpa' bas gzhan gyis mi thub pa dgyes shing dregs pas rgya cher bzhad pa sogs mtha' yas pa'i nyams dang 'gyur ba mnga' zhing*/ 'jig dus kyi me dpung lta bu'i dbus na dges dgur rol pas 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /de'i pang du hrīḥlas 'byung ba'i nag mo chen mo dam tshig gi dbang mos 'khyud pa ni/ sku mdog nag mo khro zhing sgeg pa/ gcer mo thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang 'phreng ba can/ dbu skra dmar ser grol ba/ phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ lang tsho gsar du bdo zhing*/ lhag ma rgyan spangs pa/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sku las/ bya rog dang*/ khyi dang*/ ce spyang*/ seng ge dang*/ 'dab chags dang*/ bud med/ gdol pa nag po'i tshogs pho nyar 'gyed pa/ chos 'byung steng ma'i gtso bo'i mdun gyi zur la/ tsaṃ las tsa muṇ+ḍi nag mo tri shul dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yas zur du ha las u ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon zur du he las phag mo sngo skya kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang mi mgo 'dzin pa/ chos 'byung 'og ma'i gtso mo'i mdun zur du ya las gshin rje nag po ral gri dang thod khrag thogs pa ma he la zhon pa/

g.yas zur du ra las srin po smug nag gri gug dang thod pa sha chen gyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ khyi nag la gnas pa/ g.yon zur du : bhe ¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ bhi £© las dbang phyug chen po thal skya ḍā ma ru dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ stag la gnas pa/ sgo bzhir hūṃ re re yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du tho ba 'jigs byed dkar po rdo rje tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor dbyug pa 'jigs byed ser po rdo rje be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma 'jigs byed dmar po pad+ma dmar po'i sdong po 'dzin pa/ byang du ral gri 'jigs byed ljang nag ral gri 'dzin pa/ de bzhi char yang phyag g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ grwa bzhir hrīḥyig bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ shar lhor lha mo ku le ser mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu ku ru kul+le dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du phur 'debs ma sngon mo tho ba dang phur bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du 'phrog 'chang ma ljang khu shak+ti dang tho ba 'dzin pa/ de bzhi char yang cung zad zhi zhing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ pho nya thams cad g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ gtso bo dang rnam pa mtshungs shing*/ ma mo rnams ni g.yas brkyang gi gnas shing*/ gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gtso bo'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swāhā hūṃ/ bo ṣaṭa he/ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥ phaṭa haṃ rnams dang*/ yum gyi lte ba la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ mo+o+oṃ/ hreṃ hreṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams kyis rgyas btab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad oṃ mahā kā la nas e h+ye hi bar gyis gong bzhin spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btabs pas oṃ ka la sha a bhi na ya naṃ snā naṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā a dhiṣ+ṭha te swāhā/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs/ chu lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor thams cad la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu rgyan/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ añtsa ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ pād+yaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ zhes sbyar/ de ltar chu bzhi la/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar te brkyang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /me tog sogs phyag rgya spyi dang mthun zhing*/ sngags na maḥ'i mtha' can du bya/ snying po sogs rang sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ lte bar byāṃ gyis mtshan pa dang*/ yum gyi pad+ma hriḥlas byung ba'i chu skyes ze'u 'bru'i sna rtser d+yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde ba chen po sku nyams su bstar bar mdzad/ oṃ badz+ra am+bu dza/ dwa na dwa sa ma yo ga ma hāṃ su kha pū dzi te hūṃ/ rkang pa brgyad pa'am gang yang rung bas bstod/ pad skor gyi mthar/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba nag po chen po'i dam rgya dang*/ rdo rje thal mo bcing ba/ lha mo nag mo'i dam rgya ste phyag rgya de dang ldan pas/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis mgon po 'khor bcas dang*/ oṃ mahā ka li de wī dṛ sh+ya nas/ sa ma ya ho/ oṃ su ra ta sa ma ye shwa ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis nag mo chen mo 'khor bcas dam la bzhag go /de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i phyag mtshan gri gug dang thod pa so so'i lte bar sa bon sngags kyi 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ yum gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/
