de'i 'od zer gsang ba'i lam nas byung*/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bong sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bskul te/ de'i 'od zed zhal nas 'thon te/ bdag gi lte ba nas zhugs snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ yab kyi bzlas pa dang*/ yang 'khor tshul go bzlog pas yum gyis bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ mahākā la hūṃ phaṭa/ bod pa'o/ / oṃ mahā kā la ya na mo hūṃ phaṭa/ mnyes par byed pa ste/ yab kyi sngags so/ / oṃ su ra tā sa ma ye shwa ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi sngags so/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi gzungs sngagasas ni/ shā sa nar yongs su grags pa'o/ /gtor chog tsam gyi tshe/ bzlas pa de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyas pa la mos na/ gzhung las 'byung ba ltar bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i snying pos bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ las rlung me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūṃ bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ las sha lnga baṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ de'i steng du oṃ dang zla phyed/ rdo rje phyed pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ oṃ zla ba hūṃ rnams kyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi mtha' dag bkug ste/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa/ dam rdzas 'bar ba'i gtor ma mkha' dbyings khyab par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros gtor ma'i mgron 'jig rten pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ zhi skyong*/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ ma mo/ ro langs/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ na maḥs man+ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇaṃ/ na mo mahā badz+ra kro dha ya/ mahā daṃ tro t+kaṭa bhi ṣa ṇa bhai ra bā ya/ zhes pa la sogs pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs gsang ba 'dus pa nas 'byung ba ltar/

tshar gcig gis mgor drangs la/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ maṃ maṃ/ haṃ haṃ/ kaṃ kaṃ/ raṃ raṃ/ ra ra/ mā ha mā ha ka la/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gardza gardza/ ke sha brta ma ne/ i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sarba bigh+nān/ bi na ya ka oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta/ oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis gzhal med khang gi nang na bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ lha re re'i mtshan nas smos pa'i mchod pa'am bsdu na spyi khyab tu phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod pa tshar gcig bya/ gtor ma gnyis pa dur khrod kyi 'byung po'i tshogs la dmigs te/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs tshar gcig gi mthar/ oṃ sarba k+ṣe tra pā la sa ha ga ṇa du ti bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa kha kha hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dur khrod brgyad la dmigs te/ lan brgyad kyis 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sha chang dang zas sna tshogs pa dang*/ srog chags kyi gzugs brnyan mang po yod na/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel la/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags rgyas byin/ gong gi gtor sngags tshar gcig gis kyang bsngos la/

oṃ/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*/ /ri dang brag dang phug gi sa/ /yul gyi 'dabs dang lam dang bzhi/ /ma mo'i khyim na gang gnas pa/ /nag po 'byung po ro langs dang*/ /sha za gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma gzhan slar/ /phyogs skyong ba dang zhing skyong ba/ /chung ma sde dang 'khor g.yog bcas/ /me tog spos dang na bza' dang*/ /gtor ma 'di long bdag la ni/ /bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod/ /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang*/ /longs spyod tshe dang bkra shis 'phel/ /dbang dang dgug pa'i las mdzod cig/dgra dang 'byung po nyams byed cing*/ /bsad dang bskrad dang dbye bar mdzod/ /de'i sha khrag za ba dang*/ /lus kyang rdul phran bzhin du bshig/dgra bo sde bcas ni mā ra ya phaṭa/ /gang zhig dam chos bsrung mdzod kye/ /lha min bdud bcas 'joms par mdzod/ /dul zhing dam tshig ldan pa la/ /kun du bsrung zhing rgyas par mdzod/ / ces las bcol/ smon lam btab/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad cig brjod la/ yi ge brgya pa dang bco lnga pa lan gsum gyis phyi rol gyi dur khrod na gnas pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ slar yang phyi'i mchod pas mchod/ de nas mtshan bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pas bstod par byas te/ oṃ thub pa nyi ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ral gri dang thod pas phyag brel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo dur khrod la dges pas/ /pho nyar bcas pa'i tshogs pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsungs/ /'byung po'i tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ /nag po chen po'i mi 'jigs pa/ /'dod sbyin grub pa rab tu ster/ /nad rnams 'phrog par byed pa 'di/ /'gro ba rnams la phan phyir zung*/ /na mo sh+ma sha nra bā si ni/ mahā kā la a nu tsa rā ya/ tad+ya thā/ tsa le pra tsa le/ la la la la ya de ba liṃ ga swāhā/ oṃ/ dge ba can ni dge bsnyen te/ /gtum po kla klo'i rigs kyi nad/ /bdud dang bgegs kyi khrag gsol ba/

/lag pa bzhi pa stobs po che/ /de bzhin bye ba mtha' yas lag/srin po'i lha ste srin po'o/ /'byung pos bskor ba sa 'og 'dul/ /nyi ma'i bu yi mag pa ste/ /rtse gsum 'dzin pa rtse gsum lus/ /klu'i rgyal po rgyan du byas/ /mi gsum lag na gri gug ste/ /cang te'i sgra yis bos byas nas/ /rnal 'byor ma la 'khyud par byed/ /stag dang seng ge glang po dang*/ /ce spyang bye bas gar byed cing*/ /dri ma'i ba mos glu blangs te/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa/ /ro langs rgyal po gdon kyi gdon/ /gshed byed byad ma'i bdag po ste/ /nyi ma zla ba rgyu skar gtso/ /yang dag rig pa chu bo 'grol/ /thig le brgya pa gdol pa'i rgyal/ /nag mo'i bu ste bum pa'i lto/ /sreg byed grong khyer gsum gyi dgra/ /pags pa'i gos can gsus po che/ /ro yi gdan gnas dur khrod dgyes/ /sbrul dang thod pa'i thod 'chang ba/ /dang po'i khyi ste bya rog gzugs/ /ming po gsum gyi pha zhes grags/ /log spyod log 'dren bgegs kyi bdag/lha min mthar byed sring mo'i khyo/ /tshogs bdag chen po lha chen bu/ /hūṃ swāhā/ /gang zhig ming 'di 'chang ba dang*/ /dus gsum du ni 'don byed pa/ /de la 'tshe rnams byed par 'gyur/ /mngon spyod sna tshogs 'jig rten skyong*/ /gshin rje yis kyang mdun nas 'dud/ /grub pa rig 'dzin bu mo rnyed/ /gser dang gter ni thob 'gyur zhing*/ /sngags 'chang ma dang lhan cig rtse/ /drag po dur khrod gnas pa rnams/ /yon tan ldan pa de yin 'gyur/ /'byung po dag gis phyag byas pa/ /srid gsum rdo rje'i gnas thob pa'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rje btsun sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan mang du brjod/ so rtsi/ na bza'/ me tog 'phreng ba rnams phul la/ bzod par gsol te/

badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgya cher brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni nye bsnyen dang 'brel ba yin mod kyi/ bsnyen pa dang po sngon du ma song bas kyang mchod mchog gi lag len 'di kho na bzhin bya ba yin no/ /spyir 'di lugs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gnad ni/ bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ bsnyen pa chen po/ nye bsnyen chen po rnams kyi rnam gzhag legs par phyed cing*/ de dag gi man ngag zhal gyi gdams pa lag len dang*/ bcas pa la 'dres pa gal che ba yin no/ /rjes gnang gi yig chung ni logs su shes so/ /ye shes gcig nyid sna tshogs tha dad sku/ /gang de'i pha mtha' su yis brjod par nus/ /'on kyang 'phags pa'i yul na brgyad kyi grangs/ /rab grags de dag kun gyi snying po ni/ /tshul 'di lags shing sgrub thabs tha dad pa/ /mtha' dag gcig gyur zhi ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad/ /de rjes 'brangs nas mchod chog mdo tsam sbyar/ /'di ni ye shes mgon po nyid sgrub tshul/ /srid gsum ming po gsum gyi sngags rgyud dang*/ /bsres pa'i sgrub thabs mang pos sa steng khyab/ /bod dang ma 'dres 'phags yul mkhas grub gsung*/ /'di ni rgyal ba dges pa'i lam du nges// //zhes pa bla ma dam pa'i bka' stsal spyi bor nos nas/ tā ra nā thas stag lung du smras pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ rje btsun nag po chen po'i rjes gnang gi rim pa'i phyag len ni/ sa phyogs gtsang sar ba byung lnga dang*/ khrag dang bdud rtsi ril bu dang sa bsres pa las maṇ+ḍal gyi dbyibs gru bzhi la nang zlum por bskor ba/ zlum skor la sngon po'i re kha bya zhing*/ nang du chos 'byung dmar po dang sngon po brtsegs pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams kha dog ljang khung bsgyur/ dbus su lha grangs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu 'god cing*/ me tog mdzes tshon du bkram/ de'i steng du mañdzi la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bkod/

steng du sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor/ chos 'byung zur drug pa las/ lte bar nag po chen po yab yum gyi nye snying*/ zur drug la 'khor rnams kyi sa bon/ de'i phyi'i phyogs mtshams rnams su sgo mtshams kyi lha'i sa bon bri/ mgon po'i sku 'dra 'bur dod zhig 'og gzhi'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus sam gang 'os su bzhagamachod pa'i sin dhu ra dang*/ bum pa dang*/ 'og tu dgos pa'i dbang rdzas rnams phyogs ci bder bzhag cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas su chu bzhi/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga/ mdun du rak+ta'i ar+gha'i snod bzhi/ rgyab tu gtor ma gnyis rnams bshams/ phyogs mtshams brgyad char du/ sha dang chang gi snod re re ste bcu drug gam/ phyogs bzhir sha dang*/ mtshams bzhir chang ste brgyad dam snod gnyis las med na/ g.yas su sha dang*/ g.yon du chang bsham mo/ /dung chos sam/ thod pa'i nang du bsang chu ku sha can bzhaganang mchod rdor dril cang te sogs thams cad 'dus byas/ spro na bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga sngon du byed pa'i lugs yod kyang*/ de ma byas na cho ga chad pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba med pas/ thog mar nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bsang chu byin gyis brlabs/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ram phyogs skyong bcu'i gtor chog gi sgo nas sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ 'di'i bsnyen pa dang po dang bsnyen pa chen po tsam las ma song na/ bdag bskyed yi dam gyi mngon rtogs tshang bar bsgoms te/ mdun bskyed gtor chog las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gyi gtor 'bul yan chad rdzogs par bya/ nye bsnyen yan chad song na/ bdag bskyed mgon po gtso rkyang la brten nas byed pa yin pas/ tshad med bzhi yan chad bdag bskyed kyi skabs su song ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ bsrung 'khor bskyed pa yan chad kyis chog go /nye bsnyen chen po'ang song na/ bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom pa yin no/ /bum pa la me tog gi 'phreng ba btags te/

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs lan bdun gyis 'go drangs te gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ sngags gzhan rnams bdun bdun tsam re bzlas la/ mthar a bhi ṣe ka ta ci rigs pa dang*/ 'bru gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzlas so/ /bdag nyid kyi dmigs pa'i sgo nas/ slob ma la ji ltar bya ba'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa rnams bdag 'jug tu len/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol yol bas bcad/ sgron ma lnga btsugs pa'i gtor ma dang*/ gtor chung gzhan zhig dang*/ mig dar me tog gi 'phreng ba rdor dril/ bsang chu sogs yol ba'i phyir 'jogaslob dpon yol ba'i mtshams su 'dug ste/ slob ma dang dkyil 'khor gnyis ka mthong bar byed/ slob ma de sngar yang mgon po 'di'i dbang dang*/ rjes gnang thob pa yin na/ yol ba mi dgos/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ a ho badz+ra mahā tsar+yaṃ da dā tāṃ a bhi ṣik+ta maṃ/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gtor chung de slob ma'i lag nas slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwar bzhag/nang mchod gtor/ byin gyis brlabs la gtor sngags kyis bsngos te/ slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis zhal gyis bzhes par mos/ gtor ma sgron me lnga dang bcas pa de'i sgron me sbar la/ slob ma'i lte ba/ snying gamagrin pa/ spyi bo/ gsang ba rnams su skor zhing*/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru sogs dang*/ oṃ mā ma ki¿ki ri ki ri swāhā/ oṃ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe swā hā/ oṃ ghuṭ+ṭa ghuṭ+ṭa/ ghuṭ+ṭa ni ghuṭ+ṭa ni gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā te tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ bden pa bdar zhing*/ slob ma'i phung po/ 'byung ba/ dbang po/ yul/ las dbang*/ bya ba lnga lnga po rnams la gnas nas dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs rnams gtor ma 'di glud du long la gzhan du songs shig/ ces bgegs bskrad/

yungs kar dang bsang chu gtor/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs dang shā sa na bzlas/ rdo rje gsor zhing rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o/ /mig dar dang me tog spyi dang mthun par gtor/ dbang thob zin la bskyar nas bskur ba yin na mig dar yang mi dgos/ a khaṃ wi ra hūṃ/ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug la/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ sogs kyis phyogs bzhi nas phyag 'tshal du bcug oṃ mahā kā la sarba k+ṣe tra pā la sa hā ga na dū ti/ pra tīts+tsha ku su ma/ añdza li nā tha ho/ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ dharma kuṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes me tog spyi bor bcing*/ mig dar dbye ba spyi dang mthun/ bar 'dir lha ngo bstan par bya/ de nas slob ma la 'di skad ces deng khyod nag po chen po'i dam tshig mtha' dag la gnas par gyis shigades kyang bdag nag po chen po'i dam tshig la gnas par bgyi'o/ /gdams pa dang lan gnyis kar lan gsum bya/ de nas mna' chu blud pa spyi dang mthun/ ye shes dbab pa ni pad nyi ro'i gdan la/ slob ma rnams hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i rtse mo bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pas mtshan pa/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa spros te/ slob ma la bstim la rol mo'i sgra bya/ de bzhin du sngags kyi yig 'bru bstim pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa bstim par bya/ rol mo'i sgra byed pa'i gnas skabs gsum po la rim pa bzhin du/ sku gsung thugs bskul ba'i sngags so so'i mthar/ kā ya a be sha ya āḥ zhes dang de bzhin du wāk+ka dang*/ tsit+ta sogs la'ang 'don pa spo/ de nas bla ma yi dam dbyer med pa yang rdo rje dang dbyer med zhu zhing 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ slob ma rnams mngon rtogs ltar nag po chen por bskyed/ go cha dang 'bru gsum bkod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/

dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi mthar/ mgon po 'khor bcas so so'i sngags la a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes btags la bum chus dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa hoḥ zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhags la/ cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ gri gug gtad la/ oṃ badz+ra karti ka ha na ha na shā trun ā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ ral gri gtad/ oṃ badz+ra kharga mā ra ya mā ra ya sarba bigh+nān hūṃ phaṭa/ rtse gsum gtad la/ oṃ badz+ra tri shu la bhin+dha bhin+dha/ ma na ma tha phaṭa hoḥ thod pa gtad la/ oṃ pad+ma ka pā la/ sarba dha na puṣ+tiṃ ku ra wān+tu oṃ/ ḍā ma ru gtad/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ma ru ke ṇa sarba ḍā kī nī/ ba hā ya ba hā ya hrī dzaḥ nag po chen po'i sku gzugs kyi gnas gsum du mchod pa'i sin dhu ra phul/ sku'i gnas gsum nas 'bru gsum 'byung*/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par mos la sku 'dra'i gnas gsum nas sin dhu ra blangs nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du byugs/ yang slob ma'i gnas phar thim par mos la/ slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi sin dhu ra blangs la/ phar bsku/ 'bru gsum phar bstim pa'i dmigs pa bya/ gtor chung gnyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ gcig thog mar nag po chen po la bsngos nas/ sha chang cung zad dang bcas pa'i lhag ma slob ma/ nag pa chen po'i nga rgyal gyis bza' ru bcugagacig dang por slob mas zos la/ lhag ma dkyil 'khor la bsngo/ de dag ni bum dbang ngo*/ /gsang dbang dmigs pa spyi dang mthun pa la/ thod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang mchod nas slob ma la sbyin/ sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas/ slob ma'i snying gar thig le byas/ thig le de dam tshig dbang mor bskyed la snyoms par zhugs pas/ zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ye shes skyes par mos su bcug/sher dbang ngo*/ /ngag rlung bkagasems phyag rgya chen po'i don sgom du bcug ste/ dbang bzhi pa'o/

/ de nas slob dpon gyis dam tshig bshad/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul yon bzang po dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo med na/ sgrub pa'i tshe bar chad sdang ba yin pas/ slob mas yon dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa rgya cher 'bul bar bya zhing*/ de nas slob dpon gyis gtor chog ltar rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang mgon po'i byin rlabs kyi bya ba/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin te// //tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /mgon po'i sgrub thabs ji snyed pa/ /kuna~X las dga~X' ba 'di bshad kyis/ /bod 'dre'i bsre bslad med pa 'di/ /sgrubs shig snyinga~X gtam drang po yin/ /ye shes mgon po~X phyag bzhi pa grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i bzhed dgongs dang 'brel ba'i le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rab brjid 'jigs byed chen po'i sku/ /gang zhig sgom la dngos grub kun/ /lhun gyis grub cing bgegs 'joms pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /bdag bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang gi mdun du paṃ las pad+ma/ a las nyi ma/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis nag po chen po 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yang hūṃ las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ

nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na rkang brgyad la sogs pas bstod cing*/ bsdu na/ 'dul dka' ma lus 'dul ba po/ /rdzu 'phrul dngos grub bdag nyid can/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa/ /dpal ldan nag po la 'dud do/ / zhes bstod/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ / zhes sogs rgyun bshags bzang spyod bzhin bya/ oṃ aḥhūṃ/ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ 'di ni gzhung gi dgongs pa ji lta ba yin la/ maṇ+ḍal mchod chog rgyas pa la spro na/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags rin gyis slob ma rnams kyi bkod zin pa ltar ro/ /de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma la gnas pa'i zla ba hūṃ yig dkar po dang bcas pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las ral gri'i rtse mor zla ba la hūṃ nag po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thams cad yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal nag po chen po sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na/ ral gri dang*/ gri gugagayon gnyis na rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis nyi ma dang dbugs bral gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs dkris pa/ mi mgo skam po'i lnga dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ sbom thung gsus khyim rgyas shing*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes sems dpa' nag po chen po badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mā ma kī la sogs pa lha mo rnams kyis/

oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang ye shes pa'i tshul gyis thim/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ spyan ma la sogs pa lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod phul/ nang mchod yi dam ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas phul/ gtor ma'ang yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs kyis mgo 'dren pa'am/ ma yin kyang rung ste/ na mas sa man+ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ri ṇaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ maṃ maṃ haṃ haṃ kaṃ kaṃ raṃ raṃ ra ra ma hā ma hā kā la yaṃ/ piṅgor dha/ ke sha war+dhā ma ne/ i maṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sarba bigh+nān bi nā ya kā na/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ āḥmaṃ haṃ raṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla zhing*/ mthar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ 'dod don gsol btab dang*/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ bzod par gsol ba spyi dang mthun par byas la gshegs su gsol lo/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal mthing ga gru gsum tshom bu nag po can zhig bya/ de'i steng du gtor ma bkod/ mchod pa bsham tshul sogs 'og mgon po gur yum can dang 'dra/ bdag bskyed nas bzlas pa'i gong bzhin byas la/ rjes gnang dngos kyi bya ba/ maṇ+ḍal rgyun bshags gsol btab rnams kyang de dang mthun/ slob ma nag po chen por bskyed nas/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar bya/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum du hūṃ dkar dmar mthing gsum bkod de/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du rim pas bstim pa la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang du mdzad cing*/ gtor dbang dang*/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par bya/ lhag ma rnams gzhan dang mtshungs so/

/bstan bsrung kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /'dod don kuna~X gyi dga~X' bskyed pa/ /klu sgrub snyinga~X po~X'i sgrub thabs bzhin/ /mdo tsam yi ger bkod pa'o/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa klu sgrub lugs kyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ma nor lam ston bla ma dang*/ /yi dam lha dang bstan srung ni/ /dngos grub ster ba la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs lag len bri bar bya/ /dpal nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa sgrub par 'dod na/ yi dam gyi mngon rtogs sngon du 'gro bas/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir du nag po chen po sgrub snyam du sems bskyed/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong dang bcas pa tshogs zhing gi tshul du spyan drangs ste yan lag bdun pa bya/ rgyun gyi gtor chog la de rnams mi dgos/ gang ltar yang mchod gtor legs par bshams la/ mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pād+yaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ pro k+ṣa naṃ/ puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs kyis byin dbab/ rten yod na de nyid bskyed dgos shing*/ med na gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bskyed pa yin te/ de yang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur khang me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang*/ rang gi mdun du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/

zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang bcas shing*/ ro dang ro langs dang srin po dang 'byung po dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus kyi sa gzhi la rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ dbus su thod pa 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang zlum po/ steng keng rus kyis phub pa/ phyi nang kun du rin po che dang*/ lha rdzas kyi gos dang*/ me tog dang*/ zhing lpags nang khrol rus 'phreng skra'i rnga yab la sogs pa 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du gyur/ 'di ni las thams cad pa'i gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul rgyas pa yin la/ las re re la las dang mthun pa'i khang pa so so dang*/ bsdu na rgyun 'don la yang dur khrod kyi gzhi kho nas chog pa yin no/ / rang gi snying ga nas hūṃ mthing nag 'bar ba zhig 'phros te gdan steng du 'khod/ hūṃ de nyid kyi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rdo rje gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad de gnas spar/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kā la dpa' bo chen po sku mdog mthing nag dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril zhing*/ ha ha dang hūṃ hūṃ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi gad rgyangs sgrog pa/ sma ra/ smin ma/ dbu skra ser po me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos ka pā la khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ yang na g.yas dang pos 'be ta'i 'bras bu snying dang 'dra ba bzung bar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin

zhing*/ g.yon 'og mas tri shu las mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dar dpyangs dang bcas pa 'phyar stabs su bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rtse phran dang*/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan la dpa' bo rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / 'dir yi ge gsar ba 'ga' na tri shu la kho na yod pa dang*/ yig rnying phal cher na/ phyag mtshan tri shu la'i dod du rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod cing*/ rus rgyan ma bshad pa ltar yang rung ngo*/ / de'i thugs ka nas hūṃ gsum spros te/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon dang*/ mdun gyi grar 'khod pa ni/ las kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nagakhro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mi'u thung gi rnam pa/ rdo rje gnam lcags kyi mchu dang ldan pa'i bya rog gi gdong khro gnyen bsdus shing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin zhing zhal du rngub pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyi dor stabs can/ dug sbrul nag pos brgyan zhing*/ skra mtshams nas rdo rje bya khyung spro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can gsum du gyur/ gtso bo'i g.yas su k+ṣa las legs ldan nag po/ phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi beng chen dang*/ g.yon pas lcags kyi par bu bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber can/ zhabs la sag lham yu ring gsol zhing*/ g.yon brkyang ba/ gser gyi ske rags can/ gtso bo'i g.yon du bh+yoḥlas tsaṇ+ḍi kā dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang thod khragagayon gnyis mi mgo dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ gcer bu khro zhing sgeg pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du hūṃ las sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/

g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can/ dar nag gi na bzas dkris pa'o/ / yang g.yas su bya rog gdong can gcigagayon du lha mo/ mdun du seng gdong*/ rgyab tu beng ma 'god pa'i lugs dang*/ beng ma dang bya rog gdong rgyud cig pas beng mi 'god pa yang shin tu mang ba gang ltar yang rung ngo*/ / de'i phyi rol sgo mtshams brgyad du yi ge ma brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ byang du khyung gi gdong pa can/ nub tu khwa ta'i= lhor 'ug pa'i= shar lhor phag gi= lho nub tu khyi'i= nub byang du spyang ka'i= byang shar du stag gi gdong pa can/ brgyad ka'ang gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i stang stabs sna tshogs pas gnas pa/ 'khor de thams cad kyang dbu skra gyen du brdzais shing spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ mi ro'i gdan la rnam par 'gying ba med dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ dang*/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min dang*/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ na len+d+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mahā kā la'i tshogs/ /bdag gis thugs dam gnyan skong na/ /dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ mgon po'i spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgamathu stobs dang nus mthu la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ ye shes mgon po la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes la byed pa'i dbang ltar byas nas/ rigs bdag bde mchog lhan skyes kyis byed pa man ngag tu 'dod pa'ang snang mod kyi/ man ngag khungs ma rnams nas gong bzhin bshad cing*/ 'di kho na 'thad pa yin no/ / oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ pro k+ṣa naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la ya/ puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi t+ye/ shap+ta/ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod dang*/ hūṃ/ gzi brjid sku yis srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ /gsung gi bzhad sgras sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis 'gro drug dbang du bsdus/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po khyod la bstod/ / bka' yi pho nya nag po'i gtso/ /bya rog gdong can 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ khros pa'i cha lugs rngam pa'i zhal/ /dam nyams srog gcod khyod la 'dud/ / srin po'i tshogs la mnga' bsgyur zhing*/ khams gsum srog bdag chen po ni/ / bdud 'dul tsan+dan beng chen bsnams/ /thugs kyi sprul pa khyod la 'dud/ / dpal ldan lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kā/ /lha min mu stegs tshogs 'joms shing*/ /nad kyi bdag mo drag shul can/ /srog la dbang bsgyur khyod la bstod/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi shing gcig drung*/ /nag po chen po seng ge'i gdong*/ /zhing skyong sha za chen po ste/ /dpal gyi bka' sdod khyod la bstod/

/gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chen po brgyad/ /nag po stong dang sha za 'bum/ /ma mo bye ba sde brgyad bcas/ /kun la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ / rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ mahā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod cing dam la bzhagagator chog tsam gyi skabs yin na/ bstod pa brgyad pa lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bton la/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba la 'jug pa yin zhing*/ bzlas brjod byed par 'dod na skabs 'dir bzlas pa byas la/ de nas bstod pa byas te gtor ma 'bul ba yin no/ /de la bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nye snying dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu ba mahā kā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces khyad par gyi snying po dang*/ shā sa na rtsa ba'i sngags yin la/ oṃ karma ma hā ka la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces las mgon gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hrī da hūṃ phaṭa/ gtso bo las mgon sbrags pa'i snying po dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la ka ka mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/

las mgon gyi mtshan sngags dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la k+ṣeṃ pheṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ legs ldan beng gi sngags dang*/ oṃ mahā kā li de wi waṃ hri hūṃ phaṭa/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ya ma ra dza du tri phu tri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ sha za seng ge gdong gi sngags so/ /dregs pa thams cad kyi thun mong gi sngags ni/ gzhi snying du grags pa yin te/ man ngag gi yi ge rnams su shes par bya'o/ / de nas da lta rkang brgyad du grags pa zhing skyong gi sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa ste/ bstod pa brgyad pas bstod par bya ste/ de yang dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hā hā hūṃ yig sgra dang ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs ro langs 'byung pos bskor/ /hūṃ hūṃ mdzad cing kun nas mi shas zhal dang rgyu ma'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i sku/ /phyag na mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ mi thod 'dzin pa 'dod pa'i gzugs can mi sdug gzugs/ /spyan ni ser zhing skra ser ro yi 'du sa la dgyes zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs/ /zhal nas pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ yig sgra dang so sor bskyed pa'i me chen mchog gi dbus/ /rab gsal 'jigs pa'i sku dang yan lag mgo 'phreng nye bar mdzes pas rgyan du mdzad/ /bsad pa'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag dum bu drag po'i phyag gis 'dzin zhing mchod yon 'thung*/ /mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod ni rol zhing rol pa'i rtsed mos srungs/ /k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ dang ca co sgrog mdzad bzod pas gdug can rnams 'ching bzod pa'i sku/ / char sprin sngo mdog ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad gcig pus sna tshogs gnon zhing gnon/ /k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ shriṃ sngags sku can pa tsa pa tsa bsreg mdzad kun nas sngags kyi rigs/ /sgrub pa rnams kyi bgegs rnams bskrod cig nges par zhi bar mdzod cig zhing skyong kye/ hā hā hār bzhad gad rgyangs phul byung phyugs rnams dus kun 'jigs par mdzad pa gang*/ /'jig rten rnams kyi bgegs 'joms nyin rer dri med rab thob rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsnyes/

/hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyi sgra skad drag po'i nus mthus srid pa gsum khongs gang bar 'gengs/ /srungs shig zhing skyong sma ra ral pa dbu skra kham ser ldan pas nye bar bsgrubs/ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ 'gying sgeg rol lto ba 'phyang ba phyag na ral gri khrag 'thung ba/ /raṃ raṃ raṃ ni spyan dmar gtum shugs phyag gis ru ru'i khrag la spyod par mdzad/ /kruṃ kruṃ kruṃ khros lta stangs mdzod cig ma lus bdud rnams 'khums pa'i khro gnyer mdzod/ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ 'dis 'dul mdzad cang te'u ldan pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod/ /kraṃ kraṃ kraṃ mdzad bdud dang dgra bo nyon mongs bag chags ma lus nges par 'joms/ /kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ gi sku ni nag po'i mchu mtshungs rtsod dang nyes 'phrogs thod 'phreng can/ /tsaṃ tsaṃ tsaṃ cher rab g.yo rmad byung sa gzhi 'jig rten snang byed gtum po'i shugs/ /saṃ saṃ saṃ bdag dge 'dun dam tshig dge bar spyod la zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs/ /yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ 'gro sna tshogs dri med chu bzhin gzigs nas nges par gshin rje 'gog/baṃ baṃ baṃ ni 'jig rten rab spyod skad cig rlung shugs glog ltar rab tu mkhyen/ /bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ 'jigs khro gnyer mchog mdzad sgrub po rnams la 'jigs pa las grol ster/ /k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ ni gnod pa ring du skad cig la bral bde mdzad zhing skyong kye/ /klaṃ klaṃ klaṃ gang rul pa'i lus can srid gsum 'gro ba dus kun nyon mongs rnams/ /paṃ paṃ paṃ mdzad phyag gi zhags pas phyugs rnams 'dzin zhing gdul bya rnams skyong ba/ /sngags bdag sngags kyi lus can zhi bde'i 'bras ster sngags pa rnams la sngags dang mtshungs/ /zhing rnams skyong ba khyod kyis lus can skye bo mtha' dag gang 'dir yun ring skyongs/ /sngags rnams brgyad po thun gsum du ni klog byed nges pa mkhas pa'i blo can gang*/ /slob dpon dang ni sgrub po'ang dam tshig dge ba spyod rnams rgyal 'gyur bsod nams ldan/

/tshe dang dpal dang grags dang 'byor ldan mnyam med stobs 'dzin rnam gnon 'od rgyas te/ /de yis bgegs tshigs nyams shing mtshungs med thams cad shes pa nyin mtshan rtag tu ster/ / zhes pa'o/ /gtor ma a mṛ ta sa sbyangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ thod pa'i steng du zla ba'i kha gcod hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa'i rdo rjes brgyan pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃḥdakar po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa rnams mgo bo thur bstan/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'dres/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ gtor ma'i steng gi 'bru gsum la phog/mas rim gyis gtor ma la thim pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi sngo dmar dkar po'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ rdo rjes bdud rtsi lan gsum du dkrugs/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje yang zhu zhing 'dres pa las/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ 'di ni 'di nyid kyi man ngag las 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa'i lugs yin la/ /yi dam gang byed de'i cho ga las 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs de nyid kyis kyang nges par rung ngo*/ / mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i bu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la i dāṃ bā liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis gtso bo dang*/ 'khor rnams la spro na/ snying po lan gsum gyis dbul zhing*/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thun mong du/

rtsa sngags kyis 'bul ba ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra mahā kā la/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi e ṣo3 paṣ+tsi ma/ kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇaṃ/ ya ti pra tidzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+taṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mo/ /'di ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'bring po ltar na/ shā sa na gcig pus chogabasdus pa ltar na/ gtso bo'i gtor sngags thung ngu des kyang chog go /gtor chog kho na'i skabs/ de rjes 'dod don gsol btab la 'jugabasnyen pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod cing*/ gong bzhin bstod pa 'dus pas bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs sam/ rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ sems can la bde skyid kyi dpal rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ba bdag gi bsam sbyor phun tshogs chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa la sogs pa 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi g.yel ba med par mdzod du gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshigs rang la gnyis su med par thim/ at+ma ka tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/ smon lam btab cing bkra shis bya'o/ /yum tsaṇ+ḍi kā nag mor byed na/ gong du bshad pa'i dmar mo rtsa 'jibs ma dang sku mdog gi khyad par ma gtogs 'dra la/ de nyid bong zhon ma dang*/ dre'u zhon mar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ lo ka shrī 'i lugs kyi 'dod khams ma'am/

dud sol mar grags pa dang*/ re ma tī bong zhon ma dang*/ dre'u zhon ma ci rigs pa dag lcam dral du byed pa'i lugs kyang 'dug mod/ spyi de ltar spyod pa mi 'gal yang*/ 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa yod bzhin du gzhan dang bsre bar mi bya'o/ /dpal chen po rga los 'gro mgon 'tshal ba la gnang ba'i lugs ltar na sku gsung thugs kyi bya rog gdong can gsum gtso bo'i mdun du bzhugs pa dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du seng gdong gsum dang*/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā gsum/ gtso bo'i g.yon du lha mo re ma tī ral gri dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ de'i mdun du e ka dza ṭi dmar nag phyag bzhi pa rtse gsum mi snying thod rlon lcags spyang khra thogs kyi tshul can du bskyed nas/ lha mo la sngags/ ma ma traka ru tra mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad po'ang sku mdog dmar mor mdzad pa ni khyad par ro/ / 'di nyid kyi bstod pa dang*/ mchod 'phreng dang*/ thugs dam bskul ba la sogs pa rgyas par spro na yig rnying rnams las shes par bya la/ sgrub thabs kyi ngo bo 'di kho nas chog shes par bya zhing*/ khrid tshul zab mo ni logs su bzhugs pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ phyag len lugs gnyis las/ dang po dpal phag mo grub pa las brgyud pa ni shom bya tshul/ dkyil 'khor sgom don dang mthun pa'am/ bsdu na zlum skor gyi nang du/ gru gsum mthing nag lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu can dbus su gtor ma snying gzugs ma mañdzi la bkod/ mthar 'bul gtor lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang 'os dang*/ bdud rtsi'i thod pa/ nang mchod sogs dang*/ mchod pa rnams bshams/ shin tu bsdu na/ dkyil 'khor med kyang chog pas/ dpal gyi gtor ma la brten pa kho nas kyang rung ngo*/ /gtor 'bul yan chad gong du bstan pa bzhin byas la/ slob ma rnams la sngon 'gro'i chos bshad la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug

/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ / dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang*/ /log 'dren bgegs rnams tshar gcod phyir/ /mgon po'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed kyis dmigs pa phogs la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhugarjes su gnang ba dngos gzhi ni/ bla ma he ru ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po thog lhung ba ltar byung ste/ slob ma'i lus la g.yon bskor lan gsum byas nas spyo bor thim pas/ ma dag pa'i lus sbyangs te/ 'od zer mthing kha'i phung po chen por gyur/ de las dur khrod rol ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su/ pad nyi'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis mgon po'i skur gsal btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bsil ba tshal/ na len+d+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/ ye shes pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'ur 'ur chem chem gyi sgra dang bcas te byon/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ sngags drag tu bzla/ de nas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ mngon rtogs bzhin dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa phog la/ ka pā la bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku'i rjes gnang sku'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/ / sngags kyi bzlas lung gi dmigs pa phog la/ yi ge bcu pa dang*/ shā sa na 'i rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug bcom ldan bdag la sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par bya/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang bsil ba tshal la sogs pa nas/ sngags kyi yig 'bru dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/

slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la bstim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dgagasung gi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang gsung gi byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bla ma yi dam mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros rang lus la thim/ lus yas mas nas rim pas zhu ste/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor la thim/ de hūṃ la/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ nā da yang mi snang bar gyur pa la mnyam par bzhagayang hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sgras/ slob ma mgon po'i skur skad cig gis gsal btab/ slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ bsil ba tshal la sogs pa nas/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi phyag mtshan so so dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba la sogs pa'i las mdzad/ slob ma'i snying gar thim pas/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dgathugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la rol mo'i sgra bya/ thugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs 'bebs pa'o/ /'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ni/ gtor ma dpal 'bar can slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzung la/ de nyid mgon po 'khor bcas su mos/ de'i steng du slob dpon dang 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa gsal btab/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba sgom du bcugabla ma yi dam gyi tshogs kyis chos skyong srung ma rnams la bka' bsgos pas/ de rnams kyis rdo rje'i bro drag po 'khrabs pas/ dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag par mos pa gyis zhes brjod la/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te/ bstod pa brgyad pa tshar gcig dang*/ shā sa na dang sngags rnams tshar gcig drag tu brjod pa'i rjes la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa lcam dral/ bran g.yog bka' sdod pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/

rdo rje 'chang klu sgrub sogs bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod nas/ de rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'das par slob ma 'di'i srung ma chen po mdzod la/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs sogs bka' bsgo ci rigs pa bya/ mthar bla ma rnams yi dam la thim/ de rnams mgon po 'khor bcas la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim pa dpon slob gnyis char gyis bsgom/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs par brjod/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gtor dbang kho na byed par 'dod na/ gsol btab rgyun bshags song ba'i rjes la/ slob ma'i blo'i ngor gtor ma mgon por bskyed cing spyan drangs/ de nas gong bzhin gtor ma'i bka' bsgo nyid byas pas kyang bar chad sel ba'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur zhing*/ mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs la dbang ba yin no/ /yang chos skyong du mi bsten par bar chad sel ba tsam don du gnyer ba la/ bka' bsgo'i skabs srung ma mdzod ces pa bor/ mgon po slob ma bstim pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos/ rjes gnang 'di bka' yangs shos de yin na'ang*/ byin rlabs kyi bka' shin tu che zhing zab pa yin no/ /bum dbang bcu bzhi par grags pa zab mor bzhed cing*/ phyag len bka' dog por mdzad pa de ni/ dbang chog rin chen 'phreng ba las shes par bya la/ dbang bzhi rdzogs su grags pa 'ga' zhig ni/ byin rlabs kyi sgo cung zad yod srid na'ang*/ khungs dang ldan pa ma yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'tshal lugs kyi phyag len ni/ dkyil 'khor sgo med lha snam phyogs mdog can gyi dbus su/ pad+ma sngon po 'dab brgyad lte ba dmar po la chos 'byung nag po zhig 'bri/ 'dab ma brgyad la tshom bu dmar po brgyad 'god/ chos 'byung la gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa zhig 'bri/ de'i steng du mañdzi la bum pa/ rgyab tu dpa' bshos snying gzugs mda' dar gyis brgyan pa/

mdun du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor ma/ g.yas su ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon du dam tshig gi rdo rje rnams bzhugs/ bdag mdun gnyis song ba'i rjes su/ gtor ma/ bum pa/ thod pa/ rdo rje rnams la/ mgon po lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba bde mchog lhan skyes kyi dbu brgyan can re bskyed nas/

oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha badz+ra ḍā ki nī shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum sbrel gang nus zhig bzla/ slob ma'i bya ba cung zad 'don pa spo ba ma gtogs/ sku'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa yan chad gong du bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ dbang bskur mkhan gyi lha mgon pos mdzad pa dang*/ bdud rtsis 'khor lo bzhi gang ba la dbang bzhi'i brda sprod mdzad/ gong gi sngags gsum sbrel gyi mthar/ a bhi ṣiñtsa btags te bum pas dbang bskur/ de nas gtor ma'i dbang bskur la/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas/ sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs/ /lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas/ /sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dbang thob shog/oṃ mahā kā la kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ bdud rtsi'i dbang ni/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag la/ gong ma'i tshig la 'don pa spos te/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i= gsung gi= ngag gi= gsung mi 'gyur nus mthu'i dbang thob shog/oṃ mahā= wāka= āḥ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ rdo rje snying gar bzung la/ stong nyid rdo rje'i= thugs kyi= yid la= thugs mi 'gyur 'od gsal dbang thob shog/oṃ mahā= tsit+ta= hūṃ/ yon tan phyag mtshan gyi dbang ni/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi/ /'be ta'i 'bras bu'i dbang bskur bas/ /rin chen gter gyi char pa 'bebs/ /longs spyod dngos grub dbang thob shog/oṃ mahā kā la bhe tsa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ hūṃ/ ngo mtshar= shes rab ral gri= nyon mongs= dug gsum rtsad nas bcad/ /dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i= khaḍ+ga hūṃ/ ngo mtshar= ban+dha thod pa'i= /thugs rje zhi bas bdud bzhi 'joms/ /byang chub sems kyi= ka pā la/ hūṃ/ ngo mtshar= rtse gsum kha ṭ+waṃ= sku gsung thugs dang ldan gyur te/ /sku gsung yon tan= tri shul/ 'phrin las kyi dbang ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ hūṃ/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag mthu brnyes nas/

/'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang thob shog/oṃ mahā kā la sarba karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ de nas 'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo gong dang 'dra bar bya/ mgon po sgrub par 'dod pa yin na/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ rjes spyi dang 'dra'o/ /yang brgyud pa lugs gnyis char gcig tu gril ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur khyad par can ni/ mgon po gtso rkyang nyid dam/ 'khor bcas ltar na/ bya rog gdong can gsum dang*/ mkha' 'gro brgyad kho nas bskor bar bya/ gsol gdab ni/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gtso/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mthu stobs 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /dngos grub bdag gis thob par shog/ ces pas byed cing*/ bla ma dang mgon po'i gnas lnga nas mgon po rigs lnga rim pas spros te/ slob ma'i gnas lngar rim pas thim tshul re re bzhin phog pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang lnga thob par bsam/ de nas gtor dbang spyi dang 'dra ba las mthar lha mo brgyad kyi thugs ka nas bya rog gdong can dpag tu med pa sa dang bar snang khengs pa tsam byon/ lha mo brgyad dang*/ de rnams thams cad ba spu'i bu ga nas thim/ gu ṇa hri da 'i sngags drag tu bzla ba dang*/ bya rog gdong can nyid kyi bka' bsgo bya/ slar slob ma lhar bskyed nas bzlas lung sbyin/ 'di khrid dang 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yin pas/ shin tu gces par bzung dgos zhes bla ma gsung la/ shin tu byin rlabs che bar myong ba'i kyang grub bo/ /bstan bsrung kuna~X las che mchog tu/ /rab tu grags shing dga~X' bar bsngags/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X ni/ /rjes gnang lag len dang bcas mtshar/ /ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa rga lo lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/

bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lhar/ /rab tu btud nas rga lo yis/ /lho ba spre'u ston la gnang ba'i/ /mgon po'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa rnams phyag bzhi pa rga lo'i lugs ltar byas la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba mthing kha/ rwa phyogs mdog/lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i lte bar chos 'byung*/ sngon po thig le'i rang bzhin can gyi nang du rang sems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ hūṃ yig byi ru'i mdog can/ de las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs gnyis bu chung gi 'dug stangs bya ba tsog pu'i tshul lam rol pas bzhugs pa/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ g.yas mi rkang gi gling bu der btsugs te bsnams pa/ yum dgra zor dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur zhing bde mchog lhan skyes kyis rgyas gdab bya/ pad+ma'i shar gyi 'dab ma la/ e ka dza ṭi dmar mo/ rtse gsum mi snying thod rlon lcags spyang rnams 'dzin pa/ bong bu gwa dmar la chibs pa/ phyogs kyi rdo rje'i rwa rnams la/ shar du bdud mgon bya rog gdong can gri thod 'dzin pa/ lhor btsan mgon bya rog gdong can/ dgra zor dang mi snying 'dzin pa/ nub tu gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can/ lcags kyu 'dzin zhing rkang gling 'bud pa/ byang du gying mgon bya rog gdong can/ baṃ klad la bskor zhing thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po ral gri'i gshog pa can/ pus btsugs kyis gnas pa'o/ /rkang gling gi nang du bsgrub bya spyi'u tshugs su gnas pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags kyi 'od zer bsgrub bya'i bshang lam nas zhugs shing gzir bas sna bug nas khrag rgyun babs/

thod pa khengs te lud/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bdud rtsir byas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ki ka wu wa pu traṃ kī la wa pa ḍā k-i nī hūṃ phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzla/ gtor chog sogs mgon po nag pos rigs 'gre'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal dmar po gru gsum lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu can gyi dbus su gtor ma zan zlum po nyis rtseg gi ngos bzhir mi mgo re re yod pa steng du bshos bu gru gsum la tsa ka li btsugs/ mtha' mtheb kyus bskor/ bdud rtsi dang rak+ta yang blugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la mchod pa bsham/ gtor ma gzhan mi dgos/ bdag mdun gnyis kar lhan cig tu bskyed/ gtor 'bul byas nas/ bdag mdun gcig tu bsres la bzlas pa bya'o/ /rjes gnang gi ngo bo phyag bzhi pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dang 'dra ba las/ dbang bskur mi dgos/ gtor dbang gi tshe bka' bsgo'i mthar/ mgon po'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'phros nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par mos la/ snying po'i mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes slob ma'i gnas gsum du gtugs pa ni khyad par ro/ /kuna~X tu 'dus shing ngo mtshar ba/ /rga lo'i zhal gzigs yid dga~X'i gnas/ /so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams pa/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig gsungs 'di ko /mgon dmar rkang gling can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bdud dang srin po mu stegs kun/ /'joms byed drag shul rig sngags mchog/lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kār btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /bdag bskyed yi dam mam/ ye shes mgon po la brten nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ keng rus kyi ri rab de'i steng du/ dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad nyi'i gdan/

de'i steng du skad cig gis sam bh+yoḥlas lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kā nag mo sku lus cung zad skem zhing grim pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang tri shu la/ g.yon gnyis na mda' gzhu dang*/ sdang dgra'i mgo bo bcad nas khrag ldag pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal snying gi 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ sbrul nag gis brgyan pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bam chen bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ro langs nag po/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ g.yas dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon bsgrub bya'i rkang lag za ba gnyis dang bcas pa'o/ / ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod bstod rnams ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar bya la/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab/ oṃ mahā kā li de wī gṛh+ṇa bā liṃ sha trun kha kha khā hi khā hi/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ baṃ hri hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ thun gyi mthar gtor ma 'bul tshul yang ye shes mgon po'i sgrub thabs bzhin las/ gtor sngags dngos ni/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ mahā maṃ sa khā hi/ zhes brjod/ 'di'i bsnyen pa'i skabs spyir dam rdzas tshogs pa gal che zhing khyad par thun re bzhin gtor ma rak+ta dang bcas pa med du mi rung ngo*/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi'i dbus su/ gru gsum phyi nang rim pa gsum pa zhig bya/ dbus su gri gug bris la khrag gi thig le 'god/ gnyis pa la mda' gzhu dang*/ gsum pa la tri shu la'i 'phreng pa 'god/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma gru gsum mtheb kyus bskor ba gtor snod chang dang rak+tas bkang bar bzhaga'abul gtor snying spungs pa'i gzugs la khrag blugs pa zhig mdun du bkod/ mchod pa bsham/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa byas la/

slob ma'i bya ba ni/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang nyid 'don pa spos pas rung ba la/ gsol btab kyi tshe/ lha mo'i dbang bskur zhes bsgyur zhing*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab mi dgos/ bka' bsgo'i skabs tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i spyi bor mgon po/ de'i dbu gtsug tu yi dam sogs gsol 'debs/ mthar gtor ma'i cha shas dang*/ rak+ta dang*/ nang mchod bsres pa'i thig le slob ma'i lce la 'jog pa rnams khyad par ro/ /rjes kyi skabs ye shes pa bteg ste gtor ma che ba yang 'bul/ gzhan rnams 'dra'o/ /kuna~X nas srin po 'dul bar grags/ /drag po'i las la rab dga~X' la/ /thogs med mthu ldan 'di'i sgrub thabs/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bsdus pa yin/ /mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i 'khor lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i dgos sgrub dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ phyag bzhi nag po chen po la/ /gus pas btud nas thod nag sogs/ /drag las kun la nyer 'kho ba'i/ /las mgon sgrub thabs gtor dbang bshad/ /bdag nyid yi dam khro bo chen po'i rigs gang yang rung ba'am/ ye shes mgon po'i bdag bskyed la gnas pas kyang rung ste/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang*/ rang gi mdun du zhing gsar rnying thod pa skam rlon keng rus sngo skya sbrul gdug pa rnams brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang zur gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang gi steng sprin nag 'khrigs pa/ glog dang me lce 'bar bas brgyan pa/ 'brug sgra mi bzad pa sgrog pa/ gnam lcags 'bar ba 'char bzhin 'bab pa dang*/ me'i ser ba rdo rje'i dbyibs can 'dres par 'bab pa/ phyogs thams cad kyang bskal pa'i me chen po 'tshub cing 'khyil ba/ 'og gzhi thams cad zhing gi lhu dum dang*/ maṃ sa 'chol ba'i sa gzhi la khrag chen gyi lteng kas brgyan pa/ bya sha zan mchu sder ma rungs pa can dang*/

gcan gzan khrag 'thung mche sder ma rungs pa can gyis gang bas dur khrod kyi gzhal yas khang 'jigs shing kyi g.ya' ba/ de'i dbus su paṃ las chu skyes sngo nag 'dab ma gsum pa/ de'i dbus su hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal las kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mi'u thung gi rnam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis yan lag thung zhing rags pa/ rdo rje gnam lcags kyi mchu dang ldan pa'i bya rog gi gdong khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'bar ba'i me 'dra ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin zhing zhal du rngub pa/ sma ra/ smin ma/ dbu skra/ ag tshom gyen du 'bar ba/ zhal shin tu gdangs pa kha rlangs me rlung du 'tshubs pa/ khrag gi rgyun chen po 'bab pa/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs shing rngam pa'i nga ro sgrog pa/ brkyang bskum gyi dor stabs can du sbrul nag pos brgyan zhing*/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan pa dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ skra mtshams nas rdo rje'i bya khyung spro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ zhabs brdabs pas dgra bo gdug sems can gyi mgo bo 'gems pa/ 'khor nag po bya rog gdong can stong dang*/ sha za 'bum/ lha srin sde brgyad/ sprul pa mgo brnyan/ yang sprul mchu sder can gyi 'dab chags dang*/ gcan gzan gdug pa'i tshogs dang*/ khyad par gdug pa'i klu mthing nag spu gri dang sbrul zhags thogs pa sogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma zur gsum pa la hūṃ sngon po dang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal nas las kyi mgon po nag po stong gi tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ mahā kā la kā ka mu kha ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/

shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing*/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs pas dam la bzhagabazlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā ka la gu ṇa hri da hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas mgo drangs te/ oṃ mahā kā la trak+shad dzaḥ oṃ mahā kā la sid+dhi ya ma du ma dzaḥ oṃ mahā kā la kā ka mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/ sa ma ya srog dun dun breng breng dza dza/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad kyi srog la ya/ ru ru tsa la ya/ mahā kā la traka sarba shā tru na mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas/ gzhi snying gcig tu gril ba'i sngags kyang don gyi las mgon nyid kyi sngags yin/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ ye shes mgon po'i sgrub thabs nyid kyi rigs 'gre zhing bstod pa ni/ rgyas pa/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ / zhes sogs sam/ bstod thung sho lo ka gcig pas bstod kyang rung*/ 'di nyid slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba ni/ sngon 'gro ye shes mgon po'i skabs dang 'dra/ dngos gzhi slob dpon yi dam gyi ngo bo/ slob ma ye shes kyi mgon por bskyed/ mdun gyi gtor ma las kyi mgon por bskyed la spyan 'dren bya/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ gtor ma lag tu gtad nas bka' bsgo byed pa yin/ 'di'i gtor dbang kho na byed na/ ye shes mgon po'i skabs kyi de nyid 'don pa spos kyang rung*/ bca' gzhi ji ltar byed tshul ni/ chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag me ri can/ dbus su lha mtshan gri gug yod pa zhig bya/ de'i steng du dmar gtor gru gsum/ mdun du 'bul gtor gru gsum gsum bsgrigs gcigamatha' mchod pas bskor/ dbus kyi dmar gtor chen po de la mda' dar 'dzugs shing*/ tsa ka li yod na 'dogs/ rjes chog gi tshe/ ye shes pa bteg nas gtor ma de nyid kyang 'bul lo/ /mngon spyod sbyor bas dgra bgegs kuna~X/ /'dzoms mdzad las la dga~X' ba'i lha/
/gang de'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi /man ngag snyinga~X po~X gsal por bkod/ /las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi dgos sgrub dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ khrag 'thung dpal gyi pho nya mchog/gur gyi mgon po lcam dral la/ / btud nas gtor chog rjes gnang gi /cho ga nyung ngu rnams gsal bri/ /mdun du kha zas bzang dgu las grub pa'i gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa bsham/ de'i mdun du mchod pa bkod la/ bdag bskyed he ru ka'i rigs sam/ khro bo'i rgyal po gang yang rung ba zhig bsgoms nas/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma'ang yi dam gang byed de nyid kyi cho ga ltar ram/ bla med spyi 'gro'i byin rlabs bsdus pa gang 'thad bya/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus na dgra bgegs mnan pa'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen por dus kyi mun pa lta bu'i sku mdog can che zhing cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis char gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzais pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pas sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag/g.yon na khyi nagargyab na lcags spyang*/ mdun na mi nag/steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan can/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khor las byed sprul pa yang sprul sde brgyad kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor

ba'o/ /de'i g.yon du trag las e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du traka las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag/zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung*/ gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang po'i ske rags bcings pa spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang*/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris dang thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid cing lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūṃ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa/ lcam dral gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros 'og min nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo spyan drangs par mos/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ mgon po lcam dral gnas 'dir gshegs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā kā li de bī e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma ya s+t+waṃ/

oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ mahā ka li de wi ye/ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba mgon po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ thal mo'i sor mo'i rtse mo bsnol ba lha mo'i dam rgya'o/ / oṃ mahā kā la ya/ mahā ka li de wi ye/ sa ma ya sma ra sa ma ya/ ma ti kra ma ya/ sa ma ya/ rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor ba bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi bas 'dul du ma 'tshal na/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang*/ bskrad cing gzir ba dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ sdigs shing spa skong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa yid bzhin du 'grub cing*/ bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ mahā kā lā ya/ mahā kā li de wi ye/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇa daṃ bā liṃ ta ye swāhā/ gong ltar mchod/ phud gtor zhing*/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri te e ṣa pañtsi ma ka lo/ a yaṃ i daṃ/ rat+na tra yā pa ka ri ṇe/ ya ti pra tidzñaṃ/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+taṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/

ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si kā ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ/ hūṃ/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdugs pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon pa gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod 'phreng can la bdag bstod do/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /mahā de ba'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po mahā kā la ya/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyed sum brtsegs dgra/ /bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma nag po che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po che/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig/sman rag phud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod byed rnams mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs/ / zhes dang*/ bh+yoḥ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo khyod kyi sku/ /ri rab lhun po lta bur brjid/ /dbang po sngon po lta bu 'bar/ /nyi ma'i zer ltar sprul pa 'gyed/

/dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar/ /spyan rtsa dmar po klog ltar 'khyug/mi ro khar bcug mche ba gtsigs/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ /'jigs pa'i mtshon chas phyag rnams brel/ /mi mgo rin chen rus pas spras/ /klu dbang seng ge lcags sgrog dang*/ khrag dang zhag gi thig les brgyan/ /ko rlon re lde gos su gyon/ /bong bu gwa zhon mtshan mo rgyu/ /shin tu rid cing mi sdug ma/ /'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gsung gi nga ro'i dbyangs/ /'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra sgrog pas/ khams gsum ma lus zil mnan nas/ /sa gsum g.yo bar mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zhi la rab gzhol yang*/ /snying rje'i dbang gis srid la bzhugs/ khro dang 'khrugs dang rngam pa yis/ /bdud dpung nges par 'joms la 'dud/ /dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag/ 'dir gshegs sogs kyis bstod cing 'phrin las gzhol/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rjes kyi bya ba rnams bya'o/ /rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ bla med kyi dbang bskur thob pa'i slob ma la/ nyer dgu la sogs pa'i dus khyad par can la yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ mdun du mgon po'i bris sku bkram/ rten gtor gru gsum nor gzugs ma mañdzi'i steng du bkod/ 'bul gtor mdun du bshams/ mchod pa ci bder bsgrigs/ maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbus su gtor ma 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs dang*/ nang mchod byin rlabs byas te/ kyai rdo rje lta bu he ru ka'am/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo gang rung zhig gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bzhin gtor chog rdzogs par byas la/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i don du bzlas pa yang ci 'grub byed/ de yang oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ nye snying dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po/ shā sa na/ rtsa sngags te de ltar gsum dang*/

lha mo'i snying po rnams so/ /de rjes mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs btang*/ de nas rjes gnang dngos kyi bya ba ni/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa phyag mtshan gtad pa gnyis yod cing*/ phyi ma'ang dang po sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas/ thog mar dang po nyid brjod par bya'o/ /de yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma khrus sngon du 'gro bas phyag bya/ gral la 'khod/ mchod g.yog pas me tog bkram zhing phyed bsdus la maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing*/ phyed slob ma'i snyim par me tog dang bcas pas 'dug pa la/ slob dpon gyis sems can gyi don du sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de sgrub pa'i lam gyi bar chad bsal ba'i phyir/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba zhu snyam pa'i 'dun pa sngon du btang 'tshal/ de yang 'phags ma mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i le'u bco lnga pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud rgyas pa las byung zhing*/ bram ze mchog sred la sogs pa'i grub pa thob pa rnams las brgyud de/ dpal sa skya pa khu dbon la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis brgyan te/ phyag len dang thugs dam mdzad pa'i dpal nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa 'di la gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par bya ba/ byin rlabs ldan pa'i rjes gnang dngos/ slob dpon gyi rjes bsdu ba'i rim pa rnams so/ / dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang mchod pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes su gnang ba la/ sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ 'jug gi chos gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro la lnga/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab pa/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba/ byin rlabs kyi lus kyi gzhi sprul pa'o/ /dang po la/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes brjod/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigagang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnams 'joms pa/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bo'i bdag la bka' drin stsol/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la snang bar mdzod/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ gnyis pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa ni/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs byas nas/ gsum pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig byas la/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa lan gsum bya/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma dam pa rin po ches bdag la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ lnga pa byin rlabs kyi lus gzhi sprul pa ni/ slob dpon bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drugazhabs bzhi pa/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba yin snyam du mos/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ bla ma brgyud pa sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mdun na yod pa'i gtor ma dang*/ sku 'di dag dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma ro'i steng na gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa/

dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong*/ zhing skyong*/ mkha' 'gro/ sha za/ lha srin sde brgyad/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ sprul pa 'bum dang yang sprul bye ba/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams sku gzi brjid phun sum tshogs shing*/ gsung hūṃ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs shing*/ thugs bde gsal gyi ngang las bstan pa bsrung ba'i las la brtson par mngon sum du mdun 'di na bzhugs snyam du mos pa byed 'tshal/ de nas bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung*/ mdun bskyed chos skyong gi thugs kar phogathugs brgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas hūṃ sngon po gcig 'phros/ shangs nas thon te khyed rang rnam pa'i lus la g.yas bskor du lan gsum bskor nas kha nas zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i gdan gcig bsams pa'i steng du gnas/ de las 'od 'phros/ las dang nyon mongs pa dang thams cad dang*/ rnam smin gyi phung po chen po ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ hūṃ de yang zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ de me long la has btab pa bzhin yal nas spros pa thams cad dang bral ba stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las dgra bgegs mnan pa'i steng du/

zhes pa sogs gong bzhin gsal btab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ de lta bu'i sngon 'gro sngon du song nas/ rjes gnang dngos la gsum/ sku'i rjes gnang*/ gsung gi= thugs kyi= thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba bdab pa'i rjes zlos mdzod cigasangs rgyas kun gyi sku rdo rje/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/ / zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ mos gus khyad par can byas pas/ bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun gyi chos skyong la phog ste thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku dpag tu med pa dang*/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho'i thugs ka nas kyang chos skyong gi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs pa che ba ri rab tsam dang chung ba til gyi 'bru tsam la 'od zer du ma 'phro zhing hūṃ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa byon/ khyed rang rnam pa'i smin mtshams dang*/ lus kyi stod smad bar gsum du thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs la thim/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs pa/ mgon po lcam dral gyi sku'i rnam par gyur nas char chen po babs pa bzhin lus la thim par mos pa byos shig ces brjod la/ gu gul dang*/ mgon po'i spos kyi dud pa dang*/ aṣ+ta sa thog drangs pa'i snying po dang*/ shā sa na dang*/ ro ru lan gsum gyi bar la rol mo dkrol la/ drag tu byin dbab/ de'i sku'i rjes gnang grub ces brjod/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes zlos mdzod cigasangs rgyas kun gyi gsung rdo rje/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/ zhes lan gsum/ bla ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi gseb na shā sa na la sogs pa sngags gsum yod par bsam/

mdun bskyed kyi nag po chen po'i thugs ka nas pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i mtha' mar oṃ shrī mahā kā la zhes sogs rdzogs par brjod la/ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i snying po dang*/ de'i phyi nas oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ shā sa na sogs rdzogs par brjod la/ phaṭa ces pa'i rtsa sngags dang*/ de'i phyi nas oṃ ro ru nas/ hūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ zhes pa rnams kyis bskor nas yod par bsam/ khyed rang rnams kyang chos skyong du dmigs pa'i snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad ltar kha bye ba'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la hūṃ zhu ba las rdo rje sngon po lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ gis mtshan pa gcig bsam/ de nas mos gus byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi nag po chen po la phog pas/ de'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba sgra dang bcas pa gcig las gcig chad zhal nas 'thon/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi mtha' mar 'khod/ la la hūṃ la thim/ yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho'i thugs ka nas kyang rtsa sngags snying po rab tu 'bar zhing 'brug gi sgra ltar skad sgrog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnam pa'i zhal du zhugs/ gzhan yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung yig 'bru'i rnam pa ā li kā li'i sngags bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs pa'ang khyed rang rnam pa'i thugs ka'i hūṃ dang sngags rnams la thim/ dud pa dang lha sngags kyis thogs drangs pa'i sngags lan gsum gyi bar la rol mo dang*/ dmigs pas drag tu dbab/ da khyed rang rnam pa 'phreng ba'am/ me tog re lag tu bzung*/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung blang ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis/ mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i sngags rnams re re las mar me gcig las gcig chad pa'i tshul du sgra 'od dang bcas pas zhal nas thon/

khyed rang rnam pa'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi mtha' mar snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags/ de'i phyir ro ru/ de'i rim pas sngags snga ma rnams la thim zhing 'khor bar bsams la/ rjes zlos lan gsum bgyid pa'i dang po dam tshig pa'i tshul dang*/ gnyis pa ye shes pa'i rnam pa/ gsum pa dam tshig pa la ye shes pa shin du brtan pa'i tshul gyis thim par bsams la/ rjes zlos mdzod cig/oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i snying po lan gsum dang*/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇaṃ/ e ka paṣ+tsi ma ka lo yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇāṃ/ ya ti pra tidzñāṃ/ sma ra sī ta da/ i daṃ duṣ+tan/ kha kha khā hī/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bhi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si/ ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis lung nod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig mgon po bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /mgon po bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag mgon po 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /mgon po 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes lan gsum/ des gsung gi rjes gnang grub pa lags/ gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba btab pa'i rjes bzlos mdzod cigasangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rdo rje/ /da lta nyid du bdag la stsol/ zhes lan gsum/ mos gus byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nag po chen po lcam dral la phog pas/ de'i thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ gri gugathod khrag/ral gri/ mdung thung*/ rtse gsum la sogs pa phyag mtshan sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer 'bar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa rnams thugs ka'i rdo rje dang sa bon la sib sib thim/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byon/ 'od du zhu nas thugs kar thim/ dud pa dang rtsa sngags kyis thogs drangs pa'i sngags lan gsum gyis bar la rol mo byas la dbab/ de'i thugs kyi rjes gnang grub/ de nas khyed rang rnam pa'i snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad ltar yod pa de dag kha zum nas de'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas rgyas btab pas/ bdag nyid la brtan par bzhugs nas grogs mdzad par soms shig ces byas la/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra lan gnyis brjod/ gsum pa 'jug gi chos la bzhi/ 'phrin las kyi bka' bsgo ba/ sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa/ mi 'bral zhing gsang bar gdams pa/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing dam tshig khas blangs pas bzung ba'o/ /dang po gtor mar dpal 'bar gcig btsugs/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ gtor ma 'di dpal nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod mngag pa dang bcas pa sprin stibs pa bzhin du bsam/ mgon po'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa bzhugs par mos pa mdzod cig ces byas la/ dud pa byas shing*/ snying po dang*/ gzungs ring dang*/ lha mo'i sngags kyi mthar sa ma ye/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dam tshig gi rim pa las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di zhes bgyi ba ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad las srungs shigami mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sol cigamathun rkyen thams cad sgrubs shig/spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i dgra dang bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad thul la bsrung ba dang bskyab par gyis shigarig pa 'dzin pa 'dis chos dang mthun pa'i ji ltar bka' bsgo ba bzhin khyed rnams kyis sgrubs shig

ces brjod/ de nas yul khyad par can de rnams la dad gus byas la/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gror bcas pa 'od du zhu/ nag po chen po la thim/ de las 'od 'phros lha mo bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas 'od du zhu/ tshur 'dus nas nag po chen po la thim/ de'ang 'od du zhu/ khyed rang gi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ khyed rang dang gnyis su med par gyur pas nus mthu phun sum tshogs par bsam/ rol mo mdzad do/ / gnyis pa sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ chos skyong 'di nyid la tshogs bdag gi tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa/ gshin rje ltar sgrub pa/ gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa dang bzhi gdog/ bka' sdod kyi lugs la pho rkyang du sgrub pa/ mo rkyang du sgrub pa/ yab yum sbrags te sgrub pa gsum yod/ de ltar sgrub lugs de dag thams cad la'ang*/ bsnyen pa sgrub pa/ las la sbyor ba gsum gyi man ngag yod pa dag skabs su sbyin gyi nyams su len pa la dbang ba yin no/ /gsum pa mi 'bral zhing gsang bar gdams pa ni/ de ltar rjes gnang lung sbyin pa'i dbang gis bsrung skyob byed/ lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyi 'khor ba chos nyid yin/ khyed rang rnam pa yang dam tshig rnam dag bsrungs te/ gtor ma dang tshogs la brtson par mdzod/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi snod du ma gyur pa rnams la dpal mgon po 'khor bcas kyi mtshan tsam yang bstan par bya ba ma yin no/ /bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing*/ dam tshig khas blangs pa bzung ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du 'jugades maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigagatso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ / lan gsum/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ de rjes gnang grub pa lags/
