zhes brjod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mahā kā la ya kā li de bī gṛh+ṇe daṃ/ ar+ghaṃ sogs phyi mchod dang*/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dang*/ srin po'i gzugs kyi sogs sho lo ka gsum dang*/ gang gi sku gsung thugs sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ bar chad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub stsol ba dang*/ bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan mang du brjod/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes pa'am/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o/ /'di nyid la 'dor len dang rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba byas pas/ lha bcu gnyis ma/ lha brgyad dang mgon po lo rkyang sogs kyi rjes gnang kyang shes par 'gyur zhing*/ 'di lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang dkyus rgyas shos de lcam dral la sbyar ba yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa phyag mtshan sbyin pa la sogs pa'i 'dogs dang bcas pa ni/ dam pa kun dga' grags kyi yi ge las shes par bya'o/ /mgon po kuna~X gyi rtsa bar grags/ /phyogs 'dir bstan pa bsrung ba la/ /dga~X' bar bsngags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X rjes gnang bcas pa bkod/ /dpal gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka dpal la btud nas/ /gur mgon lha brgyad ces grags pa'i/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bya ba'i rim/ khyad par cung zad brjod par bya/ /bshad ma thag pa'i mgon po lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i pu tra lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs blo yul du nges par byas nas/

hūṃ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa zhes pa nas/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas la dang zhes sbyar la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ lcam dral spyan drangs pa'i mthar/ rang gi snying ga nas sogs las mgon spyan 'dren/ mchod pa mnyam du 'bul/ dam bzhag kyang lcam dral gyi rjes la las mgon gyi de bzhin du gtor 'bul dang*/ bstod pa rnams kyang sbrel nas byed/ rjes gnang gi skabs mdun bskyed lha brgyad bskyed/ slob ma mgon rkyang du gsal btab nas/ sku'i rjes gnang gi skabs su lha brgyad ka bstim/ bzlas lung gi skabs/ thog mar mgon po'i sngags/ de'i phyi rol du lha mo'i sngags/ mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis las mgon rnams bskul te/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ sngags 'phreng byung*/ lcam dral gyi sngags kyi mthar 'khod par sgom du bcug la/ gtso bo'i snying po/ nye snying*/ rtsa sngags/ lha mo'i snying po/ las mgon gyi bod rbad gsad gsum rnams rim pas rjes zlos bya/ las mgon gyi sngags bod pa gcig pus kyang chog pa tsam yin/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi phyag mtshan skabs/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi phyag mtshan bsgom/ de rnams mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yin/ gnod sbyin yab yum sogs kyi phyag mtshan las/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par 'byed pa'ang yod mod/ rang lugs ni lcam dral dang lha brgyad gang yin yang rung ste/ rjes gnang gi 'dogs yod med las khyad par byed do/ /deng sang sa skya'i ring lugs pa/ /kuna~X kyang 'di nyid kho nar dga~X'/ /snyinga~X gi thig le lon pa dkon/ /'on kyang mang po~Xs don rtogs shog/gur mgon lha brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ / bla ma dpal chen he ru kar/ /yang yang gus pas rab btud nas/ /gur mgon srog gi spu gri yi/ /sgrub thabs byin rlabs mdo tsam bshad/ /maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi phyi rdo rwa me ris bskor ba nang du zlum skor gyi dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba/

'khyams zla gam la dur khrod dang*/ gru bcad bzhi phyogs mdog/dbus su phur ba phur gdan dang bcas pa bkod/ phyogs bzhi bhan+dha dam rdzas kyis gang ba dang*/ gri gug dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ 'phreng ba rnams bkod/ rgyab tu 'bul gtor/ mdun du sman dang rak+ta bsham/ gzhan mchod pa rnams ci bder bkod/ bdag bskyed rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo gang rung gcig sngon du btang la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ gtor ma byin rlabs kyang spyi dang mthun par byas pa'i rjes su/ oṃ mahā ba liṃ ta/ te dzo ba liṃ ta/ bā la ba te/ gu h+ye sid+dhi sa ma ya hūṃ hri ṭha/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba gnyis kyi nang du/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hriḥkhaṃ las byung ba'i sman bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ raṃ las byung ba'i rak+ta dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gis rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hri ṭha/ oṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ hri ṭha/

zhes lan gsum gsum/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su/ suṃ las rin po che'i brag ri'i steng du/ dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil du sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar e las chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal hūṃ las pad+ma/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal hūṃ las zla ba/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍal hūṃ las nyi ma/ ṇi ljang khu las dgra bo'i baṃ chen rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan du gyur/ de'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ nag po chen po'i skur gyur/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje nag po chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ gri gug dang*/ thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing*/ rdo rje'i gshog pa 'bar pa brdeb pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ mgo rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul dang rus pa dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs/ mi lpags dang glang chen pags pa'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ zhabs phur bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa can dgra bo'i snying gar gzer ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang dang mdun bskyed kyi bar du nyi ma'i gdan la gshin rje gshed du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog mthing nag be con dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ / de nyid kyi phyag mtshan lcags kyur gyur te/ ye shes pa bkug par mos la/ hūṃ/ sngon tshe dpal chen spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /oṃ e h+ye hi shrī mahā kā la ye/ mahā kā ru ṇi ka ya/ sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lcags kyu 'od du zhu ba las bum par gyur te dbang bskur/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ gshin rje gshed nyid dbu rgyan du bzhugs par gyur/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams rim pas phul bar mos la/ rdo rje khro rgyal nag po'i sku/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyi/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum brjod/ rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes te kun du dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ shrī mahā kā la mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhing chen gsar snying ti rar bcas/ /dmar gyi mchod pa rgya mtshor bskyil/ /'khor ba'i dra ba gcod pa'i phyir/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams du gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ shrī mahā kā la mahā ru dhi ra khā hi/ mahā maṃ sa khā hi/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ shrī mahā kā la i daṃ puṣ+pe dhu paṃ gan+dhaṃ bā liṃ ta pra tīts+tsha ho gṛh+ṇa khā hi/ badz+ra mahā kā la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa rnams brjod/ nang mchod rdo rjes dkrugs shing gtor ma la bran/ 'thungs shig 'thungs shig rdo rje'i chu/ / zhes sogs brjod/ rdo rje snying gar gtad la/ hūṃ/ zung zhig zung zhig rdo rje 'di/ / sogs brjod/ dam la bzhag go / oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ bsnyen sngags dang*/ de la mahā kā la tri yaṃ dza dzaḥ mahā kā la tri yaṃ dgra bo mā ra ya/ mahā kā la tri yaṃ thuṃ ril rbad/ kī la ya sha rbad/ dgra bo ṇī mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces btags pa'ang bzlas so/ /mthar e s+pha ṇa phaṭa/ 'grub khung du gyur/

der ṇi dang tri las byung ba'i dgra bgegs shin tu rid pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ mahā kā la'i sprul pa'i dmag tshogs mdun du bsams la/ gtor ma kha gsos la gong bzhin phul/ hūṃ/ khros pa'i gzugs ldan gdug pa gang*/ /ji ltar rgyal bas mi 'dul ba/ /smon lam sems kyi gzugs can de/ /bdag 'dod ji bzhin 'dir khug cig/ zhes gzugs brnyan la phab/ oṃ mahā kā la dgra bgegs gdug pa can mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bskul/ srin gzugs kyis bstod cing*/ 'das dang ma byon sogs kyis kyang bskul/ 'bar ba me yi khron pa ru/ /rab tu bcings nas mgon bral ba'i/ /gzas pa'i spyi bor phur bu che/ /nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa/ /gnam lcags 'bar ba zur gsum dbal/ /rab tu bsnun no mnar ba'i sems/ /rnam par ma rig bral gyur nas/ /dpal gyis rjes su 'dzin par shog /gang gi sngags sham bu can de nyid dang*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān muṅga ra a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes drag tu bzlas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis mchod/ bstod pa dang 'dod don gsol btab spyi dang mthun/ slob dpon gyis kyang 'og gi dbang rnams blang*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /sems can rnams la phan gdags phyir/ / dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags phur pa'i dkyil chog bzhin nam/ gur bzhin bya/ slob ma mgon por bskyed nas dbang bskur ba'i bar yang gong dang mtshungs/ de nas dbus kyi phur bu gtad la/ dpal chen khrag 'thung nag po che/ / phur bu'i gzugs kyis dgra bo dang*/ /bgegs srog dbang du sdud 'di long*/ /lha sku sgom pa'i dbang thob shog/ snying po'i mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ 'phreng ba gtad la/ sgrub pa'i ye shes tshon gang ba/ /gsang ba'i sngags kyis rab bskyed la/ /dus dang rgyun du bzlas bya ba'i/ 'dzab bsnyen 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur

ro/ / snying po'i mthar/ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ gri gug gtad la/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /bsgral phyir gri gug dbang sbyin pas/ /bar chad byed pa'i lha dang bdud/ /sgrol zhing nyon mongs gcod par shog/ snying po'i mthar/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ bhan+dha gtad la/ thod pa byang chub sems kyi rtags/ /sman mchog ye shes lnga yis gang*/ /yon tan rdzogs pa'i dbang bskur bas/ /rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thob par shog/ snying po'i mthar/ gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ gtor ma gtad la/ gtor ma'i dbang bskur 'di sbyin pas/ /dgra bgegs bsad cing bskrad pa dang*/ /rmongs shing rengs pa'i 'phrin las dang*/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i dbang thob shog/ snying po'i mthar/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ de nas slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ slar yang gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ mchod bstod yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ rten la brtan bzhugs/ smon lam bkra shis sogs tshang bar bya'o/ /pad+ma'i zhal lung 'khor rabs kyi/ /rig 'dzin kuna~X gyis dga~X' bar blangs/ /deng sang ming yang nub tu nye/ /phan sems kho nas snyinga~X po~X dril/ /gur mgon phur zhabs can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khro bo'i sku/ /rje btsun nag po chen po la/ /btud nas de'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/ /'dir rtsa ba'i mgon por grags pa nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs shing*/ de'i man ngag slob dpon klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom par 'dod na/ mchod gtor dam rdzas sogs tshang bar bshams nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam/ nag po chen po/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi'i dbus su/ pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang sems hūṃ yig mthing nagade las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad*/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun dpal ldan nag po chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs ka'i thad kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis yum la 'khyud pa/ mchan khung du zung 'jug gi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas dmar chen gyi chu klung 'khrugs pa/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan can/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang*/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o/ /de'i pang du hriḥlas byung ba'i nag mo chen mo gcer bu rgyan spangs pa gri gug dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag dang*/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ yab dang mtshungs shing yid tsam zhi ba gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du kaṃ las nag mo/ lhor kaṃ las gtsigs ma/ nub tu baṃ las ba ra ḍī ma/ byang du beṃ las ro langs ma/ de rnams kyang gcer bu sku mdog nag mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ pad nyi'i ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/

hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de 'dir nag po chen po bdag/dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /'od gsal bar ni rab tu bzhugs/ /bdag ni rnam kun yongs su bskang*/ / zhes brjod/ de nas thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ sa ma ya/ ma ti kra ma ya/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ zhes pa dang*/ spro na/ lha mo lnga la'ang 'don pa spos te brjod/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'gyel ba'i ro la zhabs mchog mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs zhing sbom thung drag la gsus khyim yangs/ /klu chen brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan zhing dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzais gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /phrag par shes rab ma yis 'khyud cing zhal gcig dang ldan dpal ldan chos skyong rtag par dga' rang bzhin/ /shin tu gnag pa'i khyad par 'phags pa sku la spyan gsum ldan pa khyod la rtag tu 'dud/ / ces dang*/ gzhan yang 'di nyid kyi bstod pa ci shes bya/ gang zhig byang chub thob pa'i rgyu phyir rang skyabs song ba'i bgegs rnams ma lus choms/ /gang zhig 'khor bar las kyi zhags las sems can rnams ni snying rje dam pas srungs/ /deng 'dir rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis ni mtha' dag 'gro ba'i sdig min phung po bcom/ /dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po rab dga'i snying gi dge ba bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba drag tu btab/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la'i nang du/ bh+rūṃ? aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ las sha lnga/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu ste/ bdud rtsir gyur pa la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te/

gcig tu 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ oṃ shrīṃ k+ṣiṃ i daṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ mahā maṃ sa/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī pe/ rak+ṣa ta la sā ta le/ uṣ+ta nā gde wa yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ i daṃ bā liṃ ha ha hūṃ hūṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hūṃ dzaḥpheṃ/ mahā aṭ+ṭa ṭ+ṭa ha sa/ gar+dz+dza ya/ gar+dz+dza/ tar+dz+dza ya/ oṃ kriṣ+ṇā ya/ war+ṇa ya/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ snying gar pad nyi la hūṃ gi mthar snying po dang rtsa sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ shā sa na ci 'grub bzlas/ oṃ mahā kā li ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ kā li ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ka ra li ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ba ra ḍī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bai ta li ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyang ci nus bzla'o/ /de nas rjes bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ lha mo lnga po rang gi snying gar thim/ rang yang rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ 'di ni mgon po bdag bskyed du sgrub pa'i lugs yin/ yang mdun bskyed du sgrub na yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du song nas shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyang ba nas bzung*/ bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ rang gi mdun du hūṃ yig las byung ba'i zhes brjod cing*/ rang sems zhes pa dang*/ rang nyid ces pa dor zhing*/ rjes bsdu ba'i skabs/ yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci shes bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ stegs bu la chos 'byung gru gsum me ri dang bcas pa/ nang mthing nag rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu nag po lnga bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma gru gsum gtso 'khor lnga pa'i rnam pa can zhig 'god/

mdun du rak+ta'i mchod yon dang gtor ma/ g.yas su chu bzhi/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga rnams 'god/ rgyab tu bris sku sogs sku gzugs bzhugs su gsol/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed kyi rim pa rnams sngon du song nas/ bzlas pa la 'bad par bya/ gong ltar mchod/ bstod pa brgyad pas bstod de/ de yang*/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba ru/ /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ kha don nag po ro la gnas/ / nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ khro bo'i bcu'i rang bzhin gyi/ /dpa' bo stag lpags sham thabs can/ /nyi ma bcu gnyis gzi brjid ldan/ /zhal ni mche ba cher gtsigs zhing*/ /bskyod pa'i ljags kyis rab 'jigs mdzad/ /kun du dmar la zlum pa'i spyan/ /mi yi mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'chang*/ /klu yi rgyal pos rnam par brgyan/ /ag tshom dang ldan sbom zhing thung*/ /lha dang lha min skrag par mdzad/ /bdud kyi sha dang khrag gsol ba/ /dad dang gus rnams skyob mdzad pa'i/ /spyan gsum smin ma shin tu 'khyog/mgo skyes dmar ser gyen du 'greng*/ /dus mtha'i me dpung lta bu yi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen la/ / sdang ba'i skye bo 'tshams par bsdigs/ /rab gus dbugs 'byin sbyin mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas theg pa'i rjes bgrod rnams/ /'khor ba'i chu gter pha rol du/ /sgrol byed ded dpon du gyur pa/ /nag po chen po'i bstod pa brgyad/ /'di gang snga dro'i dus bklags na/ /'dod pa'i don gang rab tu 'grub/ /'jigs rnams de yis 'joms par 'gyur/ /

zhes pa'o/ /de nas slob ma'i bya ba ni/ rjes gnang gi spyi'i bya ba legs par shes pa'i ngor mdo tsam brjod par bya ste/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhugagur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed nag po chen po lha lnga'i skur sgom du gzhugaslob ma stong par sbyang ba nas/ ye shes pa bstim pas bar bya ste/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /bzlas lung byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin par bya ste/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas phyag mtshan bstim pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las hūṃ dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pas spros nas/ slob mas snying gar bstim pa ni/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams/ /gcod phyir gri gug rnam par 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin brlabs pa/ /dpa' bo'i mtshan ma 'di bzung zhig/ yi ge bcu gnyis pa'i sngags brjod de/ gri gug lag tu gtad/ dngos dang dngos med rnam rtog gi /mgo bo'i pad+ma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag/dngos grub phyir ni btang bar bya/ /oṃ mahā kā li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas thod khrag lag pa g.yon du gtad/ stong pa'i rnam pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/thabs kyi gzugs kyi cang te nyid/ / nag po chen po'i phyag rgya ni/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ / rtsa sngags brjod cing*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung du gtod do/ /grags pa 'byung gnas pas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge ni/ rtse gsum gyi mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zer ba yod kyang*/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nyid do/ /de rnams 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang mthun par bya/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes bsdu ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/

/bstan srung kuna~X gyi rtsa ba ni/ /dga~X' chen he ru ka dpal dngos/ /shes rab mar bcas mgon po yi/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig spel/ /gur yum bcas kyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje nyid/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi bsrung ma'i skur/ /ston mdzad gdug pa ma lus 'dul/ /drag po'i bu khyod phyag gi gnas/ /'dir nā ro mai tri'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar rdo rje gur las 'byung ba'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya ste/ mchod gtor tshang bar bshams/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje la sogs pa yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ rten yod na a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ med na bsang ba mi dgos/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi snying ga nas hūṃ mthing kha gcig spros te/ der 'khod pa yongs su gyur pa gri gug gi lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan nag po chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ stag lpags gsar pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas thams cad mgon po'i rnam par spyan drangs shing*/

dur khrod chen po'i gnas thams cad nas/ nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gtor ma yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ shā sa na 'i mthar/ i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ slar yang bdug spos btul zhing*/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar kyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags bas nang mchod phul/ rol ma'i sgra dang bcas te/ hūṃ/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdugs pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ /gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas/ /g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod/ /thod phreng can la bdag bstod do/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ / de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ mahā kā la ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags shā sa na yang ci 'grub bzla/ de'i tshe mgon po'i thugs kar sa bon sngags 'phreng bkod la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ zhal nas thon/ mgon po'i zhal du zhugs/ sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las 'od zer byung lte ba nas thon nas/ rang gi lte bar zhugs/ snying gar thim par mos/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ rten med na/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la/ gtor ma phyir btang*/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu/ rten yod na/ gtor ma btang ba'i rjes su mchod bstod bya zhing*/ dam ye gnyis ka la rten la brtan bzhugs bya ba'am/ ye shes pa la brtan bzhugs bya zhing*/ dam tshig pa snying gar bsdu ba gang mos bya'o/ /gang ltar yang gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/

dpal ldan mgon po mahā kā la ya/ /lha chen dpal 'bar nag po mthu bo che/ /mahā de ba'i sras po drag shul can/ /tshogs bdag chen po mahā kā la ya/ /legs ldan nag po grong khyer gsum brtsegs dgra/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bsrung ma nag po che/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing nag po che/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra lha nag po che/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di= dzam bu ti ba'i zhal zas 'di= sman rag phud kyi mchod pa 'di= sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan po 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /'khor rnams bsrung zhing rkyen rnams bzlog pa dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnam mang po/ /thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ / zhes brjod/ 'di ni bsnyen pa'i tshul yin la/ sgrub pa dang*/ man ngag ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu nag po can gyi steng du gtor ma 'god/ sha chang 'bru chen 'bul gtor/ rak+ta/ sran btsos/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa sogs lag len bzhin bsham/ bdag bskyed nas mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin bya/ rdza bum nag po zhig tu/ khrag/chang*/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chus bkang ba zhig la/ slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa reg ste/ snying po brgya rtsa dang rtsa sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ slob ma'i bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol btab bya/ sku'i rjes gnang gi sku bstim pa'i skabs/ mgon po'i sku 'dra spyi bor bzhagartsa sngags lan gsum drag tu bzlas/ bzlas lung gi mthar 'phreng ba spyi bor bzhag la/ snying po brgya'am nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan bstim pa spyi dang mtshungs/

mthar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la hūṃ brgya rtsa brjod/ de nas gtor dbang bka' bsgo spyi dang 'dra/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing*/ bum chu 'thung du gzhug sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung*/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ / snying po dang*/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas mchod bstod gtor ma gtong ba sogs gong bzhin bya'o/ /'di ni mar pa lots+tsha ba'i man ngag rngog ston yab sras las brgyud pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'o/ /kuna~X las khyad 'phags rgyud kyi don/ /legs par shes rnams dga~X' bskyed pa/ /gur mgon sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X 'di/ blo ldan sems kyi ngal gso'i gnas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las gsungs pa ji lta ba'i lugs te/ rgyud mgon gyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i le tshan no// //dge'o/ /'di la 'don pa spos na/ ga ya dha ra'i mgon rkyang du grags pa'ang shes par 'gyur mod kyi/ de'i yi ge mang ba'i phyir re zhig bzhag go /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las ye shes sprul pa'i mgon po rnams kyi sgyub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu dgu pa'o/ / //maṅga laṃ/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma dang*/ /yi dam kun dngos khrag 'thung 。la/ /btud nas dpal ldan nag po che/ /stag zhon zhes bya'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi gdams pa yig rnying rnams su shes par bya la/ 'dir gtor chog dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang gi yi ge mdo tsam zhig brjod na/ mdun du bris sku dang mchod gtor bsham/ bdag nyid yi dam he ru ka dang*/ khro bo chen po gang rung gi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhir e las byung ba'i chos 'byung mthing nag 'bar ba'i nang du/

pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po che btsan nag po sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag cing*/ phyag g.yas tsan+dan gyi beng chen nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon gyis lcags kyi par bu khrag chen gyis gang ba bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ spyan gsum 'bar zhing mche ba bzhi zangs yag tu gtsigs pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra me ltar 'bar ba/ dar nag gi ber chen dgu brtsegs gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags bcings shing*/ sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul nag gi thod bcings/ gser gyi rna cha la sogs pas brgyan pa/ chibs su stag chen rngam pa chibs shing*/ seng ge dkar po rol du khrid pa/ lcags kyi bya khra klad la lding zhing*/ ce spyang dom dred phyi nas 'brang ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du bh+yoḥlas lha mo dmar nag spyan gsum dbu skra lan bu gcig tu 'phyang ba/ khram shing dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ lcags kyi dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs shing*/ rlung nag 'khyil ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i sku las sprul pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs ni/ sku'i mon pa srog bdag sngo skya tri shu la'i rtse la mi ro btsugs pa'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ gsung gi mon pa shan pa dmar nagagayas ma he'i rwa dung 'bud pa/ g.yon lcags kyi phur bu 'debs shing nyams pa'i mgul nas bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po 'dzin pa/ thugs kyi mon pa the'u nag po spu gri dang mi snying thogs pa/ gzhan yang sha zan gyi mon pa/ khrag 'thung gi mon pa/ srog gcod kyi mon pa/ bla 'gugs kyi mon pa/ snying 'bying gyi mon pa/ gzer 'debs kyi mon pa/ tshe 'phrog gi mon pa rnams las mkhan gyi cha lugs can/ g.yas ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/

de'i phyi rol du ma mo bdun la sogs pa/ ma mo/ mkha' 'gro sha za grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po u tsa la/ bsil ba tshal/ ri rab kyi khong seng*/ dpal rdo rje gdan la sogs pa nas/ mgon po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra mahā kāka la tri yaṃ dza dzaḥ traka rak+sha sa ma ya maṇ+ḍa la a kad+dh+ya/ a kad+dh+ya/ a be sha ya/ a be sha ya/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ a wa lo ka ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ hūṃ/ sde brgyad dmag dpon dpa' bo chen po ni/ /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams ldan stobs po che/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod sprul pa 'gyed/ lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ yi dam gyi sngags lan bdun tsam drag tu bzlas nas/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ sngar sman dang rak+ta bshams shing byin gyis brlabs na/ skabs 'dir 'bul zhing*/ bsdus pa'i skabs su ma byas kyang chog go /'on kyang gtor ma nang mchod dang*/ rak+tas bran la 'bul ba tsam ni bya dgos te/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang*/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag dmar gyi phung po ri rab tsam du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la tri yaṃ dza dzaḥ dgra bgegs mā ྄ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ traka rak+sha ha la dgra bo mā ra ya dza dzaḥ bā liṃ i daṃ gṛh+ṇa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhuñdza ho/

rak+ta pi pa to sa mā ya swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis bstab/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di/ /mthu chen nag po chen po dang*/ dpal ldan 'dod khams gtso mo dang*/ /dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /las byed mon pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs 'khor bcas la/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob phyir dang*/ /gdug pa thams cad bsgral phyir 'bul/ /thugs dam dbang gis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la kha raṃ kha hi/ tshogs kyang gtor ma bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ lha chen legs ldan nag po chen po 'khor bcas la/ /dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ me tog bzang po bsur chen dri/ / zhag chen mar me sbyar ba'i dri dang zhal zas mchog/brjid pa'i sgra dang snyan pa'i rkang gling mchod pa dang*/ /dri chen rak+ta snying klad dri chu byang chub sems/ /rta sha mi sha glang chen khyi dang ba lang sha /sna tshogs skam rlon nya sha tshil dang la phug sogs/ /nas 'bras dgun 'brum las byung chang dang khur bar bcas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rten dang dam rdzas ma lus 'bul/ /bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod las/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal ba dang*/ /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs kun sgrol zhing*/ /yid la bsam pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /

phud gong gi gtor ma'i sngags kyis 'bul lo/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ru pa hūṃ phaṭa/ sku'i snying po'o/ / oṃ mahā kā la rak+ṣa du beng ṇi dzaḥ gsung gi snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la tri yaṃ dza dzaḥ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ thugs kyi snying po ste bzlas pa'i gtso bo 'di la byed/ traka rak+sha ha la dgra bo mā ra ya dza dzaḥ lha mo'i snying po ste/ mgon po'i brgya brgya la bcu bcu gdags so/ / dun ru tra ru thuṃ bha ti dzaḥ shu la ra tsa tri shaṃ dzaḥ badz+ra tri ni gying sa du kha thuṃ tri sa mā ya dza dzaḥ mon pa gsum gyi sngags so/ / dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dgra bo mā ra ya nan/ mā ra ya sod/ mon pa gsum gyi bsad sngags so/ / nag po dgra bo'i sha rus snying 'di thon thon/ bdud po dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod/ nag po dgra bo'i srog rtsa la dza dzaḥ nag po dgra bo'i bla rtsa la dza dzaḥ nag po dgra bo'i snying rtsa la dza dzaḥ nag po dgra bo'i klad pa'i rtsa la dza dza/ nag po dgra bo'i snying rgyus dbugs kyi rtsa la dza dza/ nag po dgra bo'i rtsa rgyus srog la dza dzaḥ mon pa bdun gyi drag sngags so/ / tsa ti sta tsakra ni hūṃ/ ma ma ti ba bh+yo?ḥtsakra ni hūṃ/ baṃ ni ra hūṃ bh+yo ma ma cho/ las la gra ha la ha la hūṃ phaṭa/ ma mo'i srog sngags so/ /bzlas pa'i 'jug tu'ang gtor ma gsos la gong bzhin phul nas/ tshogs gzhung dang*/ bskang ba dang*/ bshags pa sogs spro na skabs 'dir bya/ bsdu na/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bde chen 'du bral med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yang dag rngam pa'i sku gcig byung ba ni/ /mthing nag me dpung 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /legs ldan dpa' bo che btsan drag shul can/ /sa gsum dbang bsgyur nag po che la bstod/ /bstan dgra 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khrag mtshor rgyug cing khams gsum skad cig nyul/ /ma gcig re ma tī la gus pas 'dud/

/legs ldan nag po'i sku gsung thugs las sprul/ /dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad dregs pa bdud du bstan/ / 'phrin las pho nya dur khrod ma mo bdun/ /ye shes dbyings kyis sprul pa'i 'khor la bstod/ /rnal 'phrul pho nya ma nges sna tshogs pa/ /mche ba can dang bya gcan gdug pa'i tshogs/ /sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas la bstod pa 'bul/ /bdag cag re smon dus 'dir 'grub par mdzod/ / thun gtor yod na skabs 'dir 'bul zhing*/ lha'i ded dpon tshogs kyi bdag/dpal ldan mahā kā la ni/ /lha mo gnyan dang gnyis su med/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di gzhes shig/ ces sogs spyi dang mthun par btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba/ smon lam bkra shis spyi dang mthun no/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed pa 'dod na/ gru gsum mthing nag gi dkyil 'khor la gtor ma 'god/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ beng*/ lcags par/ phur bu rnams kyang tshogs par byas/ gong du bshad pa ltar gtor ma 'dod don gsol btab yan chad rdzogs par byas la/ bar 'dir rjes gnang bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /dri ma mtha' dag sbyang ba'i phyir/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum mo/ /gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ gtor ma mgon po 'khor bcas su bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bya ste/ sku'i dbang bskur ro/ /slob ma mgon por bskyed pa la 'phreng ba gtad de/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin te/ gsung gi dbang bskur ro/ /beng gtad de/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rten/ /gang zhig 'phyar ba tsam gyis ni/ /dgra bgegs rdul du rlog byed pa/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā kā la rak+sha du beng āḥhūṃ/

a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ thugs kyi dbang bskrur ro/ /lcags par gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos grub rten/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /nag po dgyes shing ngom par byed/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā kā la tsit+ta pri ti āḥhūṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ yon tan gyi dbang bskur ro/ /phur bu gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las rten/ /gang zhig sgril ba tsam gyis ni/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'jigs par byed/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ mahā kā la dgra bo'i snying la kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ 'phrin las kyi dbang bskur ro/ /rjes khas blangs maṇ+ḍal yon 'bul ba rnams spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ spyi bstab man chad rjes chog gong bzhin bya'o/ /kuna~X nas drag shul rab che ba/ /snubs kyis dga~X' bar rab bsngags pa'i/ /bstan srung chos skor mtha' yas kyang*/ /nyer mkho snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bris/ /mgon po stag zhon du grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal nas/ /bstan srung legs ldan nag po yi/ /sgrub thabs cung zad bshad bya ste/ /bgegs dang bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas chos 'byung mthing nag phyi rol du zlum skor thod rwa me ri dang bcas pa zhig bri/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis tshang bar bskor/ yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa mgon po spyi dang mthun pa'am/ yi dam ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung bas bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang nang thod mkhar 'bar ba/ de'i dbus su pad nyi dang dgra bgegs kyi bam chen bsnol ba'i steng du k+ṣa yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ legs ldan nag po sred med kyi bu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas tsan+dan gyi beng chen nor bus spras pa 'dzin pa/

beng stod nas me 'bar zhing beng smad nas chu 'brub pa/ beng gi nang nas lha dang lha ma yin gyi dmag tshogs 'gyed pa/ g.yon pas lcags kyi par bu nad sna tshogs kyis gang ba dku la brten pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ za 'og gi ber chen sku la gsol zhing*/ gser gyi ska bo che bcings pa/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham gsol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo re ma tī sku mdog smug nag khram shing dang*/ nad rkyal 'dzin pa drai'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ mtha' skor du/ nag po stong lha ma srin sde brgyad/ ma mo chen mo bdun 'khor dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'o/ / ye shes pa spyan 'dren nam/ mchod bstod gyi mthar thug pa'i bar 'di nyid kyi mchod chog sna tshogs nas 'byung ba bzhin ci rigs bya ba yin mod kyi/ don gyi gtso bo la khyad par med cing*/ cho ga'i ngo bo thams cad gcig pa yin pas/ mgon po stag zhon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ 'don pa spos pa kho nas chog pa yin no/ /snying po ni/ oṃ mahā kā la rak+ṣa du beng ṇi dzaḥ zhes pa'o/ /las sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa de ba mahā kā la kha kro dha hūṃ/ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ thun ka la rak+ṣa/ ṇi dza rbad/ ces pa ste ci nus su bzla'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga yang stag zhon gyi de nyid 'don pa spos pas chogabastod pa rgyas pa shin tu mang na yang*/ mdor bsdu na/ hūṃ/ bde chen 'du 'bral med pa'i klong dkyil nas/ / yang dag ye shes sku gcig byung ba ni/ /mgon po beng ma gsang ba'i skur bstan pa/ /mi 'gyur khro bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/lha mo gshin rje'i lcam gcig bdud kyi yum/ /lha srin sde brgyad gnod sbyin ma mo dang*/ /ded dpon nag po stong gi tshogs bcas la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi/ / zhes pa'o/ /rjes gnang gi cho ga yang stag zhon gyi skabs nyid 'don pa spo ba yin no/ /kuna~X nas gnod sbyin mgon po zhes/ /byang phyogs bstan srung dga~X' bar bsngags/ /las tshogs rgya mtsho sgrub 'dod pas/ / 'jug sgo'i snyinga~X po~X 'di bzhes shig/dpal mgon po beng bka' ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' sdod ni/ /legs ldan nag po mthu rtsal can/ /de la bstod de phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub thabs khyad par mdo tsam bshad/ /mgon po beng ma gter mar grags par sgrub par 'dod na/ sgrub thabs kyi spyi rnams stag zhon dang*/ beng bka' ma dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi mdun du nyi zla bam chen brtsegs pa'i gnas la/ rang gi snying ga nas k+ṣa yig spros/ k+ṣa las gri gug k+ṣas mtshan pa las mgon po bskyed de/ mahā kā la hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ mgon po'i phyag g.yas pa tsan+dan gyi beng chen dang*/ g.yon pa na srin mo'i rkang gi mdung ring bsnams pa/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra ba las 'khor ma mo bdun gyis bskor ba'o/ /spyan 'dren gyi skabs dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ e h+ye hi mahā kā la bi ru ṇi dza dza hūṃ/ zhes pa beng gi phyag rgya bstan zhing lan mang du brjod/ sngags ni mahā kā la gu na hri da hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la ṇi thum laṃ thum ril rbad/ pu ṇi ra dzaḥ dgra bo'i snying la dzaḥ traka rak+sha thuṃ ril rbad/ dgra bo'i snying kha rag dzaḥ zhes pa ste/ bod rbad gnyis so/ / yang 'di la 'khor g.yas su yum dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yon du re ma tī spyi dang mthun pa/ mdun du las mkhan ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa bskyed/ oṃ de ba a su ra bri thi dza ghu ni heñdza ho/ bha hu ra ta tsa hin+da/

kur+bhi dzi dzha hūṃ/ traka rak+ṣa sa ma ya/ daṃ daṃ dza dza hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bzla ba'i lugs kyang yod/ lhag ma rjes gnang gi bya ba yan chad thams cad stag zhon gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /snubs chen legs pa'i blo gro kyis/ /gter nas phyung zhing kuna~X du grags/ /rab dga~X'i sgrub skor cha tshang las/ khyad par snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bkod/ /mgon po beng snubs lugs su grags pa gter ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun dang bde gshegs kyi/ /gtsug tor las byung rigs sngags rgyal/ /de la btud nas legs ldan che/ /mched gsum sgrub thabs bsdus pa bshad/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal nag po gru gsum tshom bu can/ de'i mdun du gtor ma gsum bsgrigs/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ba bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi dang dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan gsum la/ hūṃ gsum las legs ldan nag po mched gsum sku mdog mthing nag tsan+dan gyi beng chen 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dang*/ gser gyi ska po che bcings pa/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol zhing*/ mi mgo dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ drag la rngam pa/ dur khrod kyi dbus na me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur khro bo'i rdo rjes rgyas btab/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten gsum la dbang bsgyur cing*/ /dregs pa gsum gyi lha dang bdud/ /'dul phyir legs ldan nag po che/ /mched gsum sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ mahā kā la sha ri bh+yoḥ oṃ mahā kā la du tri bh+yoḥ oṃ mahā kā la du tri bh+yoḥ zhes bzlas pa bya/ gtor ma spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs te/ sngags gsum gyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phrin bcol rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ legs ldan mched gsum 'khor bcas kyis/

/sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /'gal rkyen thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ / de nas rjes gnang ni/ slob mas rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i tshul du lha sku bstim/ hūṃ hūṃ shrī mahā ka la ya a be sha ya dza dzaḥ sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing rol mo drag tu bya/ de'i rkyen gyis slob ma legs ldan mched gsum du skad cig gis bskyed/ sku spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyis sku yi rtags/ /gang zhig bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /dngos grub myur du thob 'gyur ba/ /de ring khyod la sbyin par bya/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ beng gtad la/ 'don pa spos te/ gsung gi rtags/ bzlas pa tsam gyis ni/ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa= phur pa gtad de/ thugs kyi= bzung ba tsam gyis/ tsit+ta a bhi/ thod pa khrag gang gtad de/ yon tan/ bcangs pa tsam gyis/ gu ṇa a bhi/ gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi don snying bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa lag tu gtad de/ hūṃ/ 'di ni dpal chen he ru kas/ /bdud chen bsgral ba'i snying yin te/ /bu khyod kyis ni 'di la long*/ /bstan pa'i dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /karma a bhi ṣiñtsa/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang 'dra/ rjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang mtshungs so/ /phyir bzlog chen mo'i gzungs sngags las/ /bshad par kuna~X du grags pa yi/ /ming po gsum gyi sgrub thabs ni/ /mdor bsdus rab dga~X'i snyinga~X po~X lags/ mgon po legs ldan mched gsum gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka la btud byas nas/ /de'i bka' gnyan drag gtum mchog/legs ldan mgon la btud byas nas/ /sgrub thabs ngo mtshar cung zad bri/ /mchod gtor bshams la/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod dang bcas pa/

nang gru gsum mthing nag pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ ru tra nag po gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ las beng chen hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po aṃ gho ra sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas tsan+dan gyi beng chen dang*/ g.yon thod khrag dku la brten pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma ral pa kham nag gyen du brdzais pa/ khrag dang rgyu ma zhal du gsol zhing*/ dar nag gi 'jol ber bsnams shing*/ gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ bdud rigs kyi mgo bo'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs la zangs kyi lham bu gsol ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i thugs ka nas hūṃ dang bh+yoḥspros pa las/ g.yas su hūṃ las legs ldan nag po/ g.yas tsan+dan beng chen 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag gtso bo la stob pa/ gtso bo dang cha lugs mtshungs shing*/ mi ro'i steng na 'gying ba'o/ /g.yon du bh+yoḥlas/ dpal ldan lha mo sku mdog sngo nag bong bu gwa dmar la zhon pa/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/

rgyan dang rnam cha re ma tī spyi dang 'dra bar bskyed/ de'i phyi rim la/ g.yas su mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ g.yon du rgyal po chen po bzhi/ shar du drang srong kun du rig/rgyab tu gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po/ de dag gi phyi rol du/ shar du srin po stong*/ shar lhor ma mo stong*/ lho ru gza' bdud stong*/ lho nub tu btsan dmar stong*/ nub tu gying pho stong*/ nub byang du smu bdud stong*/ byang du bdud mo stong*/ byang shar du gshin rje stong*/ de dag gi phyi rol du sde brgyad kyi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod rol pa'i gnas nas/ mgon po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs dpal ldan mgon po'i tshogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa 'dir bzhugs shig/'bar ba'i sku ston mchod pa bzhes/ /oṃ aṃ gho ra mahā kā la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ/ lha min gdug pa'i dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing*/ /stobs ldan lha dmag dkar po 'bum dang bcas/ /bgegs 'dul dpal ldan mgon po 'khos bcas la/ / dad pa'i sems kyis bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ aṃ gho ra mahā kā la ya ti su dza ho pra tiṣa ho/ zhes phyag 'tshal lo/ / mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod phul/ oṃ aṃ gho ra mahā ka la du ri swāhā hūṃ hūṃ/ gtso bo'i sngags so/ / oṃ mahā kā la rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ las mgon gyi'o/ / ma ma ru ru tse rak+mo tsa le bh+yoḥhūṃ phaṭa/ lha mo'i 'o/ /gtor ma spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ snying po'i mthar bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan gsum dang*/ spyi mthun du shā sa na dang*/ a kā ros gtor ma phul/ dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa/ /ma rungs tshogs rnams myur du rlag par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/

/ zhes 'phrin las gzhol/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra la/ rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ chos 'byung gi steng du dpal gtor bzhagade la gri snying dang*/ tsa ka li dang*/ dar nag gi 'phan dang*/ stag ras sogs 'dzugs par bshad kyang*/ tsa ka li dang 'phan tsam gdags/ 'phrin las bcol ba yan chad gong bzhin byas la/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byed/ bgegs gtor btang ste/ sum bha ni sa bgegs bskrad/ mdun bskyed gsal btab/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren bya/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ gtor snod rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /gtor ma ye shes bdud rtsi lnga/ /skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /bum pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog/ snying po'i mthar bā liṃ ta a bh-i ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ gtor ma'i lha slob ma'i tshangs bug nas thim pas slob ma mgon po'i skur gyur/ thod pa bdud rtsi'i gang ba mgrin par gtad de/ ban+dha bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu'i snod/ /rang byung bde skyed dam rdzas bdud rtsi yis/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ /gsang ba'i dbang mchog dam pa thob par shog/ snying po'i mthar a mṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ nang mchod nas kyang sbyin/ gtor ma nas dum cig bcad de slob ma zar bcug la/ bā liṃ ta ni mgon po ste/ /bza' dang rol pa gnyis med pas/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sbyin/ /gsum pa dbang mchog thob par shog/ snying po'i mthar kā ya wāka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ thod 'phreng lag tu gtad de/ bla med rin chen thod skam 'phreng*/ /ma yengs rgyun du bzung ba'i rtags/ /skal ldan skyes bu khyod la sbyin/ /bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog/ ces brjod la bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ lhag ma rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X nas dam pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /bka' srung rab tu dga~X' bar grags/

/'khor bcas sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bris pa yin/ /mgon po aṃ gho ri'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā stī/ sangs rgyas rnams dang bla ma dang*/ /mar me mdzad dpal la btud nas/ /legs ldan nag po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dri bral mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /mdun du bris sku dang*/ mchod gtor rgya cher bsham/ phyag rdor gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun du gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang phyi rol dur khrod chen pos bskor ba'i dbus su/ pad nyi bam ro bsnol ba'i gdan la hūṃ las legs ldan nag po sku mdog smug nag phyag g.yas na beng dang*/ g.yon na mdung 'dzin pa/ dar gyi 'jol ber dang gser gyi ske rags can/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / yang na gcer bu gshin rje chas su bzhugs pa'o/ /yang na gcer bu gshin rje'i chas su bzhugs par bsgom kyang rung*/ mched gsum byed na g.yas su beng ma dang*/ g.yon du gri gug ma bsgom par bya'o/ /gsum sbrag tu thugs kar beng ma dang*/ de'i thugs kar yang gri gug ma sgom mo/ /gang ltar yang*/ rgyab tu gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang*/ mdun du dpal lha mo re ma tī'am/ bde bskyed mkha' 'gro sku mdog smug mo phyag g.yas na gdug pa'i gza' stag gi mgo'i rnam pa can/ g.yon pas sho rde'u dkar nag dang bcas pa 'dzin pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang mthun pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes brjod/ lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing*/ /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/

/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ tri mahā kā la ga ṇa gu ti swāhā/ na maḥtri mahā kā la g+ga ni sha ya na mo yo gi nī nāṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ke ti ke ti ni/ tse ti ni tse ti ni swāhā/ zhes mgon po rnams kyi spyi sngags dang*/ bde bskyed ma la/ oṃ hriḥse li ki prad dza la/ a mo gha hrīḥha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o/ /gtor ma byin rlabs gri gug ma dang 'dra/ sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab bya/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams lho nub mgon po'i skabs su 'chad pa dang*/ 'dra zhing*/ slob ma mgon por bskyed mi dgos/ gtor ma lhar bskyed cing*/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa sku dang*/ gtor dbang thugs dang*/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gsung gi rjes gnang rnams sbyin no/ /rnying ma kuna~X gyi legs ldan dang*/ /ma 'dres jo bo'i lugs dga~X' ba/ /'di la snyinga~X nas yid ches pas/ /mdo tsam gsal po~Xr bkod pa yin/ /rtsis mgon lha chen dpal 'bar ram/ legs ldan jo bo lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ nag po chen po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /nyung gsal byin rlabs bka' babs dang*/ /a ti sha yi man ngag ni/ /bcos slad bral ba 'di ltar lags/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang ste/ stong pa la cung zad mnyam par bzhag oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ mi ro bkan pa'i gdan la/ rang skad cig gis dpal ldan mahā kā la sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gang thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs shing*/ ljags bskyod pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags shing*/ gsus khyim che ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis/ me tshan drag po 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūṃ mthing nagade las 'od zer 'phros/ shar phyogs nas rgyal ba mi bskyod pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rang gi spyi bor rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs par gyur/ yang hūṃ las 'od zer smug nag shin tu tsha ba 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sems can gdug pa can thams cad kyi lus rnams gdungs shing*/ sems ngan pa thams cad bsregs par gyur/ hūṃ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba bsgoms la/ oṃ mahā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ dpal mgon pos bdag gi dgra lha dang srung ma chen po mdzod la/ spyi dang khyad par gyi bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ bdag dang sems can rnams la gnod byed thams cad 'dul zhing*/ 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'grub pa dang*/ bar chad bsrung zhing*/ yid la bsam pa'i don thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ dpal mgon po khyod kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bdag bskyed kyi lha la gsol ba drag tu btab cing*/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /bza' btung nam byed pa'i phud nas mi chung tsam bcad la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mahā kā la badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ khyad par mchod pa ni/ dus bzang thams cad dang*/ khyad par nyer dgu'i mtshan mo/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal nag po gru gsum zhig byas la/ khrag dang chang gis byugs/ tshom bu nag po zhig bkod/ de'i mdun du/ bshos bu'i gtor ma lag len ltar gsum bsham/ mchod pa sna lnga gcig dang*/ mchod yon/ me tog nag po'i phung po/ spos sbyor ram/ gu gul/ dpal 'bar gsum rnams bsham/

bdag bskyed yi dam mam/ gong du bstan pa'i mgon po nyid sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod rdzas rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ stong par gyur/ āḥthod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūṃ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ mgon po nag po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ dpal ldan mahā kā la nas/ hūṃ mthing nag go /mchod yon nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ srin gsugs ma'i sho lo ka dang pos bstod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ la dmigs nas/ bzlas pa cung zad byas/ gtor ma dang po gsol bar dmigs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis bstab/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin gsol ba drag tu btab/ gtor ma gnyis pa'ang sngar dang 'dra ba las/ snying po'i mthar/ a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ 'di la 'dod don mi zhu/ gsum pa yang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam gyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /spos sbyor bsreg cing*/ me tog re re nas gtor ma la 'bul ba dang*/ snying po kho na bzlas par bya'o/ /bstod pa srin gzugs ma yongs rdzogs kyi mthar/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dbu skra kham nag gyen brdzes pas/ /steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed/ /spyan bgrad ljags 'gril mche gtsigs nas/

/bar gyi lha tshogs bsreg par mdzad/ /g.yas na gri gug bsnams pa ni/ /dgra bgegs 'dul zhing bdud mgo gcod/ /g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa ni/ /gnod sems can gyi snying khrag gsol/ khros pas zhabs gnyis brdabs pa yis/ /ma rungs rnams kyi lus la nyed/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang la bya ba rdul du rlog ces sogs 'phrin bcol ci shes bya/ dpal 'bar gsum yang sbar te/ oṃ mahā pra dī pe hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing*/ gtor ma rnams la re re btsugs/ bzod gsol gyi mthar/ gtor ma khang steng ngam dur khrod du bskyal/ oṃ muḥ zhes tshom bu bsdu'o/ /tshul 'dis sngags 'bum phrag gcig gis bsnyen pa 'grub par bshad/ 'bum phrag bcu gsum gyis steng gdon gyis zin pa'ang thar bar the tshom med ces gsung*/ 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ni/ shin du skal ba dman yang las thams cad 'grub ces bshad la/ 'on kyang da ltar 'bum phrag bco brgyad bsnyen tshad du mdzad cing*/ de nas sgrub pa la 'jug par 'dod na/ bris sku mdun du bkram la/ maṇ+ḍal ma gtogs gong gi mchod chog dang 'dra bar bya ba las/ khyad par ni mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa kho na gtso bor byed cing*/ sngar gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi tshab bris sku la byed pa dang*/ sngags 'phreng zhal nas zhal lte ba nas lte bar 'khor ba'i dmigs pa byed/ gtor ma gsum po sgrub pa ma thon par phyir mi gtong zhing*/ thun re re bzhin 'byor pa che na gsar pa re bshams la/ min na kha gso/ thun mtshams su gshegs gsol mi byed par bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ thun thams cad dam srod thun la thun gtor re nges par gtong*/ tshul des 'bum phrag bco brgyad bzlas na/ sgrub pa'i grangs tshad thon par byed do/ /tshub ma shugs drag khang thog 'tsheg/glu len bya rog a tsa ra/ /dar nag thogs te 'o dod 'bod/ /phyi'i rtags su shes par bya/ /slob dpon 'ongs nas gtam smra dang*/

/chos 'chad lung ston gdugs 'bul dang*/ /ban+dha ston pa nang gi rtags/ /mgon po'i sku ston gri gug dang*/ /mkha' 'gro tshogs dang ca co 'don/ /dngos grub ster bar rmi ba dang*/ /stag dang seng ge 'phyong ba dang*/ /shel gyi mchod rten bskor ba dang*/ /gtor chen khyer 'phrad 'grub pa 'i rtags/ / mtshon cha'i char dang a tsa ra/ /'khrugs rgol du ba bzlog rtags so/ /zhes gsung ba ltar ro/ /snying po la badz+re ṇa bdag la srungs shig srungs shig hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshul gyis dmigs pa gsal btab ste bzlas na/ nad gdon thams cad thon cing*/ bsrung ba dang*/ byin rlabs kyi mchog go /yang gdon 'dul na/ badz+re ṇa bdag gam che ge mo la gnod par byed pa'i rgyal 'gong mā ra ya dza dza hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzla/ rgyal 'gong zhes par gang dgos spel/ yang badz+re ṇa ba su puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ bdag gi 'byor ba puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas longs spyod lhag par 'phel bar 'gyur la/ ā yu puṣ+tiṃ tshe puṣ+tiṃ zhes 'don pa spos na/ tshe sgrub kyi mchog yin la/ bsrung ba dang 'dre 'dul gtso bor phyi dro bzla zhing*/ longs spyod dang tshe spel ba gtso bor snga dro bzla'o/ /sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi tshe/ bzlog pa'i rtags byung na/

oṃ mahā kā la bā liṃ hūṃ hūṃ ril rbad/ pu ni dza mahā kā la trak+shad sid+dhi ma ma du ti dzaḥ gling byin tshal/ snying nas dzaḥ dgra bo mā ra ya dza dzaḥ zhes brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas sel bar 'gyur ro/ /drag po'i las sbyor ni/ sgrub pa'i dus kyi cho ga la 'don pa spos nas/ gtor ma dang sbyin bsreg la brten pa'i dgra bsad zhig yod de/ 'dir ma bris so/ /de'i tshe drag tu bskul ba'i tshig ni/ gang zhig dkon mchog gsum gnod dang*/ /bstan pa la gnod mtshams med byed/ /bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di/ /phyi dus 'gyang bar ma 'jog par/ /bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la/ /ling ga 'di la myur du khug/'di'i sha zo khrag la rol/ /rus pa klad pa nang khrol drongs/ /rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog/mdza' ba kun dang khrol la shog/yang na 'di'i phyir 'brangs nas/ /til 'bru tsam du mdzad du gsol/ / zhes brjod pa ste/ 'di jo bo'i gsung yin no/ /zhes sangs rgyas sgom pa gsung ngo*/ /bzlas lung bya ba'i tshul ni/ slob dpon gyi bya ba nyer dgu mchod pa bzhin las/ bzlas pa'i mtshams su lung sbyin te/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod bzhin bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa 'grub na rab/ ma 'grub na sangs rgyas chos dang ma tsam zhig bya/ mngon rtogs phogasngags bzlas lung du sbyin pa tsam gyis don grub pa yin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyis cho ga'i lhag ma rnams bya/ sgrub thabs 'di lhad med shin du yid ches dang ldan pa/ grags chung ba zhig snang bas 'brom ston pa yab sras kyi yig chung gnyis dang*/ sangs rgyas sgom pa'i gsal byed yig chung la brten nas/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i tshul gsal bar bkod pa yin no/ /las sbyor ni de dag tu shes par bya'o/ /nag po chen po'i sgrub pa ni/ /kuna~X dga~X'i nyams len snyinga~X po~X 'di/ /deng dus gzhan la ma grags kyang*/ /bdag gi bsod nams dpal las rnyed/

/gri gug dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs bzlas lung la brten par grags pa'i man ngag bstan pa'i le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpa' bo gang zhig dran tsam gyis/ /phun tshogs dngos grub nyer stsol zhing*/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi mdzad pa'i/ /nag po che la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'dir lho nub mgon po zhal dmar zhes bya ba sgrub pa la/ bris sku'i mdun du mchod gtor rgya cher bsham/ phyag na rdo rje'am mi g.yo ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan la/ oṃ stong par gyur/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥthod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya cher gyur/ gnyis ka bstan te/ hūṃ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi mdun du 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho na/ bh+rūṃ las rdo rje'i brag ri dmar nag bdud brtsegs kyi steng*/ ṇi las mi ro'i gdan steng du/ k+ṣa las gri gug k+ṣas mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mahā kā la sku mdog dmar nag zhal ras kyi dkyil 'khor lhag par dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug me 'bar ba 'phyar bas gshin rje bran du 'khol ba/ g.yon klad khrag dang glo snying gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas sgrub po la dngos grub stsol ba/ zhags pa nag pos dgra bgegs kyi ske nas bcings shing zhags pa'i sne mo phyag g.yon gyi mtheb srin la dkris pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing gad rgyangs drag po sgrog pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bskyod pa skan sgra drag po sgrogs pas sa g.yo bar byed pa/ /sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/

sbrul nag dang dar nag gi thod bcings shing*/ nyi zlas dbu brgyan pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags shing gsus khyim che ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas me tshan drag po 'bar ba'i klong na bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yas su gnod sbyin shan pa ra'i gdong can smug nag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dam nyams kyi srog rtsa zhal du gsol ba/ g.yon du ma ra snying za ma dmar mo dug gi gri khye dang*/ dgra bgegs kyi glo snying 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu gza' bdud dmar nag srin po'i cha lugs can/ mgo lus mig gis gang ba/ mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ mdun du gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma dmar nag gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing skra grol ba/ mgo 'phreng dang rus pas brgyan zhing mi lpags dang stag lpags gsol ba/ de dag la sogs pa mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ srid pa pho rgyud mo rgyud lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ lho nub dur khrod mun pa'i tshal nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mahā kā la gshegs/ /'jigs byed bstan srung yongs kyi gtso/ /zag med dbyings nas gshegs su gsol/ /lho nub mtshams kyi gnas mchog nas/ /mi bsrun zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /rnal 'byor bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs/ /oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ mahā kā la ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje'i thal mo'am/ ral gri thod pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ shrī mahā la kā la sa ma ya ma ti kra ma tha sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/

zhes dam la bzhag cing*/ yid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i bka' bsgo bya/ gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra/ a mṛ ta bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis mgon po dang*/ mahā yak+ṣa bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mahā rak+mo bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor bcas la phul/ gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod phul/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ/ chos kyi dbyings las sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ /grag stong nga ros bdud dpung 'joms pa'i gsung*/ /rtog med ngang nas sgrub mchog skyong ba'i thugs/ /bstan bsrung chen po khyod la bdag bstod do/ / zhes bstod/ thugs kar sngags 'phreng gsal btab la/ oṃ mahā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ thun gyi mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod bsdus pa'am/ phyi mchod nang mchod sngar bzhin phul la/ 'di skad ces/ hūṃ/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas la/ /bdag gis mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi/ /dmar chen khrag gis ar+ghaṃ dang*/ /dbang po lnga yi me tog dang*/ / rus pa rkang klad bsres pa'i spos/ /zhun chen gsal ba'i sgron me dang*/ /rdo rje rang byung dri chab dang*/ /sha chen sna lnga'i zhal zas dang*/ /rkang gling thod rnga snyan pa'i sgra/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mkha' bkang nas/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /gzhan yang mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad dang*/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman/ /dgra bgegs rnam gnyis bsgral ba yi/ /don snying sha rus gtor chen bsham/ /de bzhin tshe 'dzin khrag gi rgyun/ /ban+dha lcang lo khrag gis bkang*/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ mthun pa'i rdzes su bzhes par mdzod/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /zhing chen bla bre 'phan gdugs dang*/

/rgyu rlon lda ldi snying 'phreng dpyangs/ /keng rus sna tshogs ri ltar spungs/ /sha khrag dri bsur rgyun mi 'chad/ /sna tshogs rgyan kyi mchod pa 'di/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /bcol pa'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / de nas bstod pa ni/ hūṃ/ phyogs phyogs bgyi ba phag gi na/ /lho nub srin po'i 'jig rten du/ /mun pa'i lcags mkhar dgu rim na/ /ma 'das 'jig rten bka' sdod gtso/ /nag po mi bsrun 'jigs byed che/ /gri gug 'bar bas nyams pa yi/ /tshe srog rtsad bcad khrag gi rgyun/ /thod par blug cing zhal du gsol/ /'khor ni mi bsrun gdug pa che/ /nag pos dus 'da' 'dul byed pa/ /lha srin ma mo mthu bo che/ /snying rje med par gsod byed pa'i/ /'jig rten ma 'das dam bcas kun/ /sna tshogs gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ khro gtum bka' las ma 'da' bar/ /sna tshogs las 'di thogs med kyis/ /hūṃ/ rdo rje gdan mchod dam pa nas/ /gnod sbyin 'khrugs pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /gnod sbyin shan pa mthu bo che/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag na gnam lcags gri gug bsnams/ dam nyams dgra bo'i tshe srog gcod/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ bh+yoḥ gnod sbyin thugs kyi dgyes bde mo/ /ma ra snying za mthu mo che/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /phyag na dug gi gri khye 'dzin/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i tshe srog gcod/ / sha dang khrag la zas byed ma/ /dam zas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang*/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin rlabs pa'i/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang*/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang cher mtho zhing*/ /bstan 'dzin sku tshe legs brtan nas/

/rnam dkar 'phrin las rgyas par mdzod/ khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad gdon dgra bgegs zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas nas/ /thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzod/ / rjes yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gtor mgron gshegs su gsol ba/ smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga dang bcas pa/ rgyab tu mañdzi'i steng du gtor ma nor gzugs ma kha zas bzang dgus brgyan pa/ maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas su sku rten/ g.yon du thod pa dam rdzas dang bcas pa/ mdun du gri gug rnams bkod la/ de dag gi mdun du mchod pa bsgrigs shing*/ de'i mdun du gtor ma bshams la/ bdag bskyed nas brtsams te mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i bar gong du bshad pa bzhin bya/ rjes gnang gi rim pa rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du dmigs pas len/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod/ chos bshad/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su gzhug sangs rgyas chos dang ma sogs lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags kyis sdom pa bzung*/ slob dpon bdag bskyed kyi yi dam du sgom tshul 'bogs shing*/ mdun du 'jigs rung nas/ bdun brtsegs kyi steng gi ro'i gdan la/ mahā ka la sku mdog dmar nag nas/ tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin mdun bskyed gsal 'debs su gzhug slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed mgon po'i thugs kar phog pas/ thugs brgyud bskul/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ nag po chen po'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam dpag tu med pa spyan drangs lus la thim par mos shig

zhes brjod la/ de nas rol mo'i sgra bya/ maṇ+ḍal gyi g.yas kyi sku rten spyi bor bzhag la/ mi 'bral sku yis byin rlabs pas/ /bstan dang 'khor bzhi skyong ba dang*/ /gdugs pa can rnams tshar gcod phyir/ /nag po chen po'i sku 'di bzung*/ /oṃ mahā kā la ya/ kā ya sa ma ya dhā ra hūṃ/ zhes brjod sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ / yang slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba'i tshogs dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim/ zhes brjod mgon po'i sngags byang dang*/ thod pa lag pa g.yon du gtad/ mi 'bral gsung gis byin rlabs pas/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ /nag po chen po mnyes byed pa/ /gsung gi rig sngags bzung bar bya/ /oṃ mahā kā la ya/ wāka sa ma ya dhā ra hūṃ/ de nas bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par bya ste/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ / slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ mdun bskyed mgon po dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas gri gug thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs 'phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ snying gar thim zhes brjod la rol mo bya/ gri gug lag pa g.yas su gtad de/ mi 'bral thugs kyis byin rlabs pas/ /slob dpon rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du/ / brtse ldan drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /ma rung sems can bsgral bar bya/ /oṃ ma hā ka la ya/ tsit+ta sa ma ya dhā ra hūṃ/ zhes brjod de/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ rdo rje 'chang dang phyag na rdo rje dang*/ /klu sgrub snying po nā ga bo dhi dang*/ /dzñā na bo dhi bir+ya bo dhi dang*/

/rā hu la dpal mar me mdzad dpal zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang ni rin chen gsal/ gru gu kha che lha yi dbang phyug dang*/ /zhang ston rdor 'bar blo gros rgyal mtshan dang*/ /shes rab rin chen shes rab rdo rje dang*/ /dkon rgyal dkon dar bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan dang*/ /brtson 'grus rdo rje nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang*/ /lha dbang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis sogs/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyis/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ /dam tshig srungs la bstan pa skyongs/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang slob ma 'di zhes bya ba'i lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te/ lus ngag yid gsum bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs bka' bsgo rgyas bsdus spyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma'i mtheb kyu nas rdo rje'i rtse mos cung zad blangs ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang sbrags te/ slob ma la cung zad sbyin/ gtor ma la'ang bdud rtsi cung zad bran te/ nag po chen po khyod kyis/ slob ma 'di'i chos skyong gyis la byin pa'i zas zo/ bcol ba'i las kyis zhes brjod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang mthun zhing*/ mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs/ phyi mchod 'bul ba nas bkra shis kyi bar rjes kyi bya ba rnams gong bzhin

no/ /paṇa chen kuna~X las dga~X' ba'i phul/ /mar me mdzad kyi bka' srung mchog/mi'u thung gsod byed sgrub thabs kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X yi ger 'khod 'di'o/ /jo bo rje'i thun mong ba ma yin pa'i chos skyong mgon po gri gug dmar po'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ mtha' dag rgyal ba'i thugs kyi dngos/ /thugs kyi mgon por sku sprul pa/ /nag phyogs mtha' dag pham mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srung mchog des dge bar mdzod/ /nag po chen po gri gug ma sgrub par 'dod pas/ mchod gtor bsham/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du song nas mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ oṃ stong par gyur/ āḥthod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ hūṃ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ hoḥye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi mdun du 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ṇi las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i bam chen brtsegs pa'i gdan la hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mahā kā la sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa snying bcas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags bskyod pa/ sma ra/ smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbom thung yan lag hrags shing gsus khyim che ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas pad nyi mi ro'i gdan la/ me tshan drag po 'bar ba'i klong na bzhengs pa'o/ / yang na stag lpags kyi sham thabs mi mdzad par dar nag gi 'jol ber gser gyi ske rags can dang*/ zhabs las sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol bar byas kyang rung*/

gtso bo'i g.yon du rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ bh+yoḥlas 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma sngon mo ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar gyi steng na btsan dkyil gyis bzhugs pa/ rak+ta'i rgya mtshor rgyug pa'o/ /gtso bo'i mdun gyi 'og phyogs su/ pad nyi dang baṃ chen bsnol ba'i gdan la phaṭa las las kyi mgon po sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas tsan+dan gyi beng chen dang*/ g.yon lcags par bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ beng stod nas me 'bar zhing*/ beng smad nas chu 'khrug pa/ beng gi nang nas lha dang lha ma yin gyi dmag tshogs 'gyed pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gser gyi ske rags can gsol zhing*/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du maṃ las ma gcig e ka dza ṭi sku mdog smug nag ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ phyi rol tu phyogs skyong zhing skyong sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po brgyad dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs mahā kā la gshegs/ /'jigs byed bstan srung yongs kyi gtso/ /zag med dbyings nas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la sa pa ti wā ra dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ mahā kā la ya gṛh+ṇe daṃ/ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa ma ya/ sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma tha/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu zhes dam la bzhag oṃ mahā kā la sa pa ri wā ra a mṛ ta bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi （《dzaṃ》+lan gsum mam ）bdun gyis ye shes mgon po dang*/

'khor rnams la so so'i snying po'i mthar/ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa dang*/ shā sa nas kyang 'bul/ spyi khyab tu/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bstab/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ/ ma lus 'joms mdzad dgra bgegs thal bar rlog/mthar byed gzhon nu 'jigs pa'i gad rgyangs can/ /mnyam nyid thugs mnga' gtum chen me ltar 'bar/ /bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma khyod la bstod/ / ces pa'o/ /thugs kar sngags 'phreng gsal btab la/ oṃ mahā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni snying po'o/ / oṃ mahā kā la gu ṇa hrīḥd hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni las kyi sngags so/ / oṃ shrī de wī hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dod khams ma'i mtshan sngags so/ / oṃ mahā kā la rak+ṣa du beng ṇi dza dzaḥ las mgon gyi sngags so/ / oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yoḥdza dzaḥ e ka dza ṭi'i sngags so/ /slar yang phyi mchod nang mchod 'bul/ hūṃ/ nag po chen po zhes pa nas/ grub par mdzod kyi bar mchod 'phreng ni mgon po lho nub pa dang 'dra'o/ /bstod pa ni/ srin gzugs ma bya zhing*/ jo bos mdzad par grags pa'i bstod pa che chung rnams kyang shes na 'don/ gang gi sku gsung thugs kyi mthus/ /'dod pa'i khams kun zil mnan nas/ /'dod pa'i khams la dbang bsgyur ma/ /'dod khams dbang phyug ma la 'dud/ /drag po mi sdug gtum pa'i sku/ /lha yi dmag dpon chen po ste/ /lha min g.yul du pham mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje bde khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dga' tshal mdzes pa'i lha mo ni/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir srin po'i sku/ /dgra bgegs sha dang khrag la rngam/ /rdzong mo khyod la bstod pa 'bul/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams sogs 'phrin las bcol ba yang lho nub pa dang 'dra'o/ /rjes yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gtor mgron gshegs su gsol ba/ brtan bzhugs/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams kyang spyi dang 'dra'o/

/'di'i rjes gnang gi rim pa ni lho nub pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga la 'don pa spos pa nyid kyis 'grub bo/ /jo bo'i bka' gdams 'dzin pa ni/ /kuna~X gyis dga~X' bar bsngags pa'i phul/ /chos skyong bzhi sbrag ces grags pa'i/ /cho ga'i snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam yin/ /mgon po bzhi sbrag gi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang ba nyid/ /drag gtum mi zad pho nya'i skur/ /ston 'dzin nag po chen po la/ /btud nas sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /bris sku la sogs pa'i drung du mchod gtor bsham/ ye shes khro bo gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ thod pa'i snod du hūṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ maṃ las byung ba'i myos byed dang*/ raṃ las byung ba'i rak+ta sha khrag gi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan mang du brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du skad cig gis nag po chen po dus kyi mun pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal can/ spyan gsum sma ra smin ma dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi'u thung gi rnam pa ches gtum pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ me 'od drag tu 'phro ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar/ mahā kā la ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha zhes brjod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ mahā ka la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa swāhā/ snying po 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pa'i mthar/

oṃ a si mu sa la/ tri shu la/ e h+ye hi/ mahā kā la/ sarba sha trun nir+gha ta ya/ dzā ra ṇa/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ gṛh+na pā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ khri :khrag [ phrag ]gcig bza' ba spangs nas bzla'o/ de ltar lan gsum gyi mthar snying po nyis 'bum bzlas pa bsnyen pa grub pa'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ oṃ mahā kā la ha na ha na/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa ka ra yaṃ ku ru dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ snying po lan gsum gsum gyis rak+ta dang chang bsgrengs/ spos sbyor bsregs/ cang te'u brdungs shing srin gzugs ma 'don no/ /rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ rdul tshon gyi maṇ+ḍal nag po gru gsum la tshom bu nag po bkod/ dzaṃ bu ṭi ka dang sha dang sran chan btab pa'i gtor ma dang*/ myos byed rak+ta'i mchod pa rnams bshams/ bstod pa'i bar gong bzhin nyams su blangs/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /gsol btab skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsum bzlas lung*/ thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa rnams yin la/ phyis kyi lag len la gtor dbang byed pa'ang 'dug pas/ de lta na maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du mañdzi la gtor ma'ang bsham mo/ /chos skyong kuna~X gyi sgrub thabs ni/ /rnying ma'i lugs dang 'dres pa mang*/ /'phags yul mkhas pa'i gsung dri med/ /mchog tu dga~X' ba'i snyinga~X po~X 'di'o/ kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa gri gug ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka dpal las sprul pa/ /legs ldan chen po la btud nas/ /gshin rje'i lugs ltar sgrub pa yi/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa bshad/ /dmigs rten gyi mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ dmigs rten med na mdun gyi nam mkhar bsgoms kyang rung*/ bdag bskyed he ru ka la sogs pa gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa byin rlabs mgon po spyi dang 'dra bar bya/
