mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las rdo rje'i brag ri chen po'i steng du/ hūṃ dang gri gug las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod chen pos bskor ba'i dbus su/ bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang thod mkhar gru gsum pa/ rkang gi ka ba/ rgyu ma'i dra phyed/ keng rus kyi thog phubs sogs 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sgo gcig mdun gyi logs su gtad pa/ dbus su mu khyud gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo/ lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag dang bcas pa/ dbus su pad nyid la dgra bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan bsnol ba/ rtsibs rnams la pad nyi ro gdan dang bcas pa bcu drugarang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis/ dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes ṇi ljang khu dang tri ser po rnam par bkug ste bstim/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal legs ldan nag po chen po rdo rje srin po'i gzugs can/ sku mdog bung ba ltar gnag pa/ thung zhing sbom la nyi ma stong gi gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ zhal gyi grwa nas khrag 'dzag pa/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma kham nag gyen du 'greng ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'bar ba 'phyar stabs dang*/ g.yon gdug pa can gyi khrag gi gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal can/ sbrul gdug pas sku la brgyan pa/ gtum zhing 'khrugs pas rang gi yan lag gi sha yang gcod pa tsam du khros pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi 'gying zhing brjod pas dgra bgegs rnams brdzis pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad la ya brgyad dang ma brgyad las gri gug bcu drug yongs su gyur pa las/

gshin rje brgyad dang*/ ma mo brgyad du gyur pa ni/ shar du ya ba ti dang pho nya mo/ lhor chos kyi rgyal po dang mche ba mo/ nub tu tel ba dang be con nag mo/ byang du a wa glang mgo dang dus mtshan ma/ byang shar du ral pa tshar dgu dang lcags kyu ma/ nub byang du rmigs pa dang zhag pa mo/ lho nub tu phya sangs dang lcags sgrog ma/ shar lhor mig dmar dang 'bebs pa mo/ de ltar gshin rje brgyad ni mdog sngo skya skra gyen du brdzes pa/ ma mo brgyad ni mdog nag mo/ skra dang nu ma 'phyang ba/ thams cad kyang gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan spangs pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ bka' nod pa'i tshul can no/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs nag po che/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ / drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /oṃ mahā ka la dzñā na dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ mgon po'i spyi bor mi bskyod pas rgyas btab par gyur/ badz+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu zhes gdan phul/ oṃ mahā sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dam rgya bstan la dam tshig dran tu gzhugardo rje'i rtse mo'i nang mchod gtor zhing*/ mgon po dang rang gi lce thog tu myangs par bsams la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ / zhes pa nas/ ṭha ṭha ṭha oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes mna' chu 'thung khyod bdag dam tshig bsres pa yi/ /dbang du gyur pa khrag 'thung mgon/ /bdag kyang dam la mi 'da' bar/ /rtag tu nag po khyod mchod kyi/ khyod kyang dam las mi 'da' bar/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun gyis/ / gal te dam las 'da' gyur na/ khyod kyi snying khrag nga la yod/ / zhes dam tshig khas blangs/ bsnyen pa sngon du song na/ skabs 'dir dbang du bsdu ba'i dmigs pa byed/

ma yin na mi dgos/ gtor ma yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mthar/ oṃ mahā kā la dzñā na a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣ+taṃ naṃ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ban+dha ban+dha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun la sogs pas phul/ de nas bla ma dang yi dam gyi bka'i dam bsgrags te 'phrin las bcol/ gong bzhin mna' chu blud la/ lag tu rdo rje gtad par mos te/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dam tshig 'di las 'das gyur na/ /nag po khyod ni nyams par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra mahā sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa dang*/ srog snying brjod de/ bro dam po dgag go / ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ hūṃ/ rnam dag dbyings las mi g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rjes khros pa'i skur ston zhing*/ /bdud dpung 'joms pa'i las mdzad pa/ /legs ldan mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba yi/ /dur khrod chen po'i klong dkyil nas/ /mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa kun/ /sgrol mdzad mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur skyong mdzad cing*/ /gnod byed thams cad pham mdzad pa/ /mthu chen mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /

zhes dang*/ srin gzugs mas bstod/ gzhan yang bstod pa'i rigs mang du yod pa rnams shes na bya/ lha mo bskyed yod na/ rgya mtsho'i klong na sogs kyis bstod pa'i srol yod kyang 'di nyid kyi rang lugs la mi dgos par mngon/ legs ldan nag po chen po ni/ /mi bsrun 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ /las mdzad gshin rje ma mo ni/ /ma rungs sprul pa'i pho nya ste/ khams gsum srog la dbang byed cing*/ /skye 'gro'i dbugs la rngam pa po/ khrag 'thung las kyi srin po dang*/ /srin mo'i tshogs la bdag bstod do/ / zhes 'khor la bstod/ khyod kyis thub pa'i bstan pa srungs/ /rnal 'byor pa yi bar chad bzlog/chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod/ /lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol/ thun gtor 'bul bar spro na skabs 'dir gtong*/ bzlas pa ni skabs 'di'am gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngon gang du byas kyang 'dra ste/ rtsa sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ shrī sogs shā sa na rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la ru pa ru tra sa ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ snying po'o/ / oṃ mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ yang snying ngo*/ / oṃ mahā kā la trak+shad rbad/ srog snying ngo*/ /de la ya ma rā dza btags pa ni las sngags so/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ sgom don dang mthun pa'i dkyil thang bkram/ de'i dbus mañdzi la gtor ma bkod/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i mchod gtor dang nang mchod sogs bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bdag mdun gtor chog dang bcas pa gong bzhin byas la slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bla ma'i ngo bor gsal btab/ slob ma nyid mgon po gtso rkyang du bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren nas rgyas btab kyi bar bya ste/

sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /bzlas lung sbyin te gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /sems spros bral du ngo sprad de/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /dam rdzas ka pā la spyi bor bzhag la/ dam rdzas rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin dam can gyi/ /'phro 'du yon tan dbang thob shog/oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da hūṃ/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / hūṃ las byung ba'i gri gug lag pa g.yas dang*/ a las byung ba'i thod pa lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las dbang*/ /zangs gri 'bar bas dgra srog gcod/ /dbang sdud thod pa'i rang rtags can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thob par shog/ las sngags brjod de 'phrin las kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang mthun par byas te/ de'i mthar dam tshig dran pa mna' chu/ dam tshig khas len bro dgag pa dang bcas pa slob dpon gnyis kas bya/ rjes kyi bya ba thams cad spyi dang mthun no/ /rjes chog gi skabs gtor ma chen po'i lha nam mkhar spar la/ gtor ma de nyid byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba'i lag len yang mdzad/ 'di la rgyas par dbang bskur ba'i lugs dang*/ bsdu na lung tsam gyis chog pa'i skabs kyang 'dug la/ lag len 'bring po'i lugs su rjes gnang byed pa ltar 'dir bkod pa yin te/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khod du dbang bskur ba ma thob pa la 'di'i dbang bzhis kyang smin byed du 'gyur ba dka' la/ de thob pas las tshogs mtha' dag sgrub pa la/ lung mnos pas kyang rung ba tsam yin mod kyi/ byin rlabs kyi sgo rjes gnang nyid mchog yin la/ 'a phrin las kyi lha 'di 'dra ba'i rigs la/ dbang chen mos kyang rjes gnang las lhag pa'i byin rlabs kyi sgo yod pa dka' ba'i phyir/ dbang mchog gi rgya gzhung du grags pa ltar/ dbang de dag thob na'ang legs pa yin mod kyi/ min na'ang rjes gnang thob na de nyid kyis chog shes par bya'o/

/'di ni dur khrod nag po'i rgyud las 'byung la/ de la jo bo rje/ nag po ro 'dzin/ a tsa ra dmar po/ lo chen rin bzang*/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ gru gu ston pa nas brgyud pa ste/ brgyud pa'i lugs srol drug yod par grags na'ang*/ don gyi ngo bo la khyad par cher med/ 'di ni gyi ljang lugs gtso che ba'i dbang du byas so/ /gyi ljang lots+tshas phyogs kuna~X du/ /'phrin las dga~X' bar sgrubs zhes bsgrags/ /jo bo'i man ngag kyang ldan pa'i/ /lag len snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam yin/ /dpal mgon po zangs gri can lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka la gus btud nas/ /mgon po gri gug can sgrub thabs/ /dzñā na'i bzhed gzhung 'phags yul las/ /byung ba'i yid ches ldan pa 'bri/ /chos 'byung gru gsum nag po mañdzi'i steng du gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ mtha' mchod gtor dang phyag mtshan gyis bskor/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ badz+ra ra ba li phaṭa/ rdo rje'i brag ri dang*/ keng rus kyi steng du/ dur khrod dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang 'jigs su rung ba/ dbus su pad nyid la rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bzhi sbrag gi skabs bzhin gtso rkyang bskyed/ khyad par mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can no/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ e h+ye hi mahā kā la kā ru ṇi ka dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ gtso bo'i byang shar du/ lha mo nag mo rtse gsum dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mdun du gsang ba'i las mgon dmar nag gri thod can/ dzam+bu ka'i zhal dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yas su gshin rje ljang nag ral gri dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ g.yon du las mgon bdud bya rog gdong can thod 'dzin pa/ phyi rol kyi shar du mahā ka li nag mo ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dre'u la chibs pa/

lhor bi ka ra li nag mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa bya rog la chibs pa/ nub tu pu ka ra li nag mo rdo rje dang phur bu 'dzin pa ro langs la zhon pa/ byang du kaṅga li nag mo tri shu la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa ro'i gdan can/ thams cad kyang drag po'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi phyi dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bstod pa sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyis/ dpal he ru ka'i bka' las ma 'da' bar/ bdag gi bsam pa'i don thams cad sgrubs shigadam tshig las 'das na/ khyod nyid 'jig par gyur ta re/ nang mchod gtor zhing*/ 'thungs shig 'thungs shig rdo rje'i chu/ /rdo rje'i chu 'di 'thungs nas ni/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'thob/ /dam las 'das na brlag par 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba u da ka ṭha/ dam tshig gi rdo rje gtad par bsam la/ zung shig zung shig rdo rje che/ khyod kyis rtag tu 'di zung shig/gal te bsgo ba ma nyan na/ /nag mo khyod ni nyams par 'gyur/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab spyi dang 'dra ba las/ he ru kas dbu brgyan zhes brjod/ dngos bshams kyi mchod pa rnams bla med spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mon sran rde'u dzaṃ bu ṭi/ /me tog bdug spos sha lnga dang*/ /bdud rtsi lnga sbyar gtor ma 'dis/ /dpal ldan nag po 'khor bcas mchod/ /oṃ mahā kā la sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi khā hi/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bstod pa srin gzugs ma bya/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes snying po dang*/ shā sa na te rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ de wa ha na ha na ban+dha ban+dha k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi sha tsī mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma mahā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la kha ta mu kha hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ mahā ka li hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bi ka ra li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ su ka ra li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ kaṅka li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rnams 'khor gyi sngags so/ /gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ so so'i snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ zhes btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ thun mong du shā sa na sa bstabs/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab pa rnams spyis rigs 'gre/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ bgegs gtor btang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa bya/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di zhes bgyi ba la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gtor ma mgon po 'khor bcas su bskyed/ slob ma'i mgo thog gi nam mkhar bzung*/ 'khor bcas kyis gar mdzad pas bgegs bskrad par bsam/ mgon po'i dpral mgrin snying ga lte ba gsang ba rnams nas/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu rnams spros te/ slob ma'i gnas lnga thim pas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin gyis brlabs par mos/ de nas bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ mgon po 'khor bcas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang*/khri khragabum dbang thob par mos/ de bzhin du mgrin pa/ snying galte ba/ gsang ba rnams gang bas dbang bzhi thob par mos/ slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mgon po gzhan gyis rigs 'gre'o/ /'di'i srol 'dzin rnams/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud mgon yin par bzhed cing*/ de ltar 'dra bar yang mngon no/ /sgrub yig kuna~X du rgyas pa la/ /dga~X' bas yig rnying nang du ltos/ /rjes gnang tsam dang nyer 'brel ba'i/

/sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X 'di yis chog/mgon po gri gug lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma yi dam mgon po la/ /btud nas gur gyi mgon po dang*/ /dbyer med mchog gi las mkhan ni/ /zangs gri can gyi sgrub thabs bshad/ /yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba tshom bu nag po dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su bdud bshos zur gsum bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ gtor ma yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ rdo rje'i brag ri dmar nag gi steng du/ drag po 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang 'jigs su rung ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/ hūṃ las zangs gri hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ las kyi mgon po zangs gri can mthing nag phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa snying khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ sbom thung gzi brjid che ba srin po'i cha lugs can/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham yu ring gsol zhing*/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ dgra bgegs kyi baṃ chen mnan pa/ sha 'gag dkar po dang ljang khu brtsegs shing*/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dgu brtsegs bsnabs pa/ sbrul dang mi mgos brgyan zhing*/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /mahā kā la rū pa sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis dam la bzhag 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu sogs kyis mna' chu blud/ mchod bstod byas te bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/

oṃ mahā ka la ka la rū pa sa ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzlas/ mthar oṃ mahā ka la ru tra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga bh+yo sogs lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ las kyi mgon po mahā kā la ni/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bstan pa srung ba po/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi gzugs can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro'i bya ba dang*/ sku'i rjes gnang yan chad gur mgon lcam dral gyi rjes gnang nyid 'don pa spos pas rung zhing*/ gsung gi rjes gnang bzlas lung dkyus ma dang*/ thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan gri thod lag tu gtad/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rten/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar bzung*/ /dngos grub tshogs la rol pa dang*/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar chod cig/ snying po bzlas la byin/ de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bya/ rjes spyi dang 'dra/ bsnyen sgrub las tshogs ni yig rnying du shes par bya'o/ /sa skya'i lugs la rnams kuna~X du/ /las mkhas yin zhes dga~X' bar bsngags/ /'on kyang gur mgon nyid du nges/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam mo/ /ber nag zangs gri can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal chen rdo rje khro bo dang*/ /mi bzad mgon po nag po yi/ /lha tshogs la yang gus btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bri bar bya/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal gru gsum tshom bu can/ gtor ma dmar nag mtha' mchod gtor gyi bskor ba dang bcas pa bsham/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma byin rlabs/ kyai rdor ram yi dam gang byed bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhir/

nyi ma dang ro gdan la/ saṃ las seng ge dkar po rab tu khros shing nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ las mgon gcer bu zangs gri can/ sku mdog nag la cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag brla'i steng ngos su 'dzin pa/ mig g.yas pa nyi ma/ g.yon zla ba/ dbus ma nas me 'phro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs gsol ba/ mgo 'phreng dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na sha za gnod sbyin ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ mna' chu blud cing*/ mchod bstod kyi bar ber nag zangs gri can dang 'dra/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ mahā kā la rū pa sha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa snying po dang*/ oṃ mahā kā la rū pa ya/ ru ma kā ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa kā ri/ swa ma re/ sha sa pa ye ni/ pri ta mu ki kau ra kau ra/ ha na ha na/ bha ga bha gabha ga ta ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzla'o/ /mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/

oṃ mahā kā la ya bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ hūṃ/ dus gsum dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa/ /las rnams kun byed drag shul che/ /rab tu rngam pa'i zhal dang ldan/ /gcer bu gri thod 'dzin la bstod/ /sha za khrag la rngam pa po/ /drag po dur khrod 'byung pos bskor/ /dpa' bos myur du nyams pa sgrol/ /gnod sbyin klu bdag khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ rjes bsdu bkra shis kyi bar spyi dang 'dra/ rjes gnang sngon 'gro gur dang 'dra zhing*/ sku'i rjes gnang 'don pa spos pa rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god par mdzad/ snying po'i mthar/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sid+dhi a: tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ/ zhes pa rnams so sor btags la bzla bzhin du/ slob ma'i gnas gsum so sor gtor ma gtugs pas/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba'i sku las mgon po dpag tu med pa byung nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par bsam pa ni sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi mthun zhig sbyin te/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /kuna~X du gri gug mar grags pa/ /de nyis las mkhan mgon po'i tshul/ /sgrub thabs zab cing dkon pa 'di/ /dga~X' bas snyinga~X po~Xr gril ba yin/ /gcer bu zangs gri can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ yon tan mgon po ngo mtshar can/ /tshogs bdag chen por mtshan gsol ba/ /ljang nag khros rgyud las byung zhing*/ /jo bo'i zhal gzigs yin par grags/ /'di la 'phrin las kyi gzhung rgyas pa ni/ mgon po trak+shad gnyos lugs dang 'dra bar snang bas/ de'i tshul rnams sngon du shes par byas la/ mdun du rten dgram/ mchod gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs/

mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las bsrung 'khor gyi nang du e ag+ne maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ chos 'byung mthing nag me 'bar ba/ yaṃ karma rak+ṣa hūṃ/ raṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ me'i khor yug go /bh+rūṃ bi shwa bi shud+dhe ban+dha dzñā na tsakra e bh+rūṃ/ gzhal yas khang du gyur/ dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa lte bar siṅga dzaṃ pa la bi ma la sid+dhi hūṃ/ seng ge'i gdan/ rat+na ra ti traṃ/ rin po che'i gdan/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ/ pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan du gyur/ dha ra hriḥ zhes brjod pas baṃ chen bsnol ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du yi ge thaṃ yig ljang nag las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas dngos grub bsdus/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ thaṃ yig la thim/ de las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog smug nag mi zad pa'i mche ba rnon po zangs yag du gtsigs pa/ spyan sdang mig tu gzigs pas gnag pa'i dgra bo zhe la mnan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas rtse gsum mdung dar leb rgan can/ g.yon gyi dang pos khyu mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba/ 'og mas bdud zhags 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rin po che dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ nyi zlas thod byas pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon gyi stod g.yogs dang*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i rtsibs la ma yig bzhi las/ mdun du yum be ta li ljang khu ral pa grol ba/ g.yas rgyu ma gsol zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs bsnol ba'i stabs can/ g.yas su pho nya mo dkar mo skra kham nag can/ phur pa dang*/ zhags pa dmar po 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu bka' sdod ma ljang sngon mi lpags gyon zhing*/ tsan+dan gyi dbyug tho bsnams pa/ de gnyis pus gtsugs sam brkyang bskum gyis bzhugs pa/

g.yon du mngag gzhug ma dmar mo gaṅka'i mgo bo can/ zhing dbyug dang*/ zhing chen tshal pa bsnams pa/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /phyi rol du bh+yoḥbadun las/ tshangs ma dbang mo gzhon nu ma/ /lha chen ma dang rtog 'dod ma/ /rgan byed ma dang sna chen ma/ /ma bdun srin mo'i gzugs can no/ /sku mdog dmar nag rtse gsum dang*/ ban+dha khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ sgo bzhir/ shel gser zangs g.yu'i mig can ma mo bzhi rdo rje dang*/ zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ / spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ e h+ye hi shrī mahā kā la ga ṇa pa ti mahā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ dza dzaḥ zhes dang*/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ lha dmar dkar po'i dbugs 'byin sogs kyis chog oṃ shrī mahā ka la ga ṇa pa ti swāhā/ na maḥshrī mahā kā la ga ṇe sha ya/ na mo yo gi naṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ki te ki te/ tsit+te tsit+te swāhā/ zhes pa nag po chen po'i gzungs kyis kyang bstod/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gnas 'di ru sogs kyis bzhugs gsol bya/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan rdo rje ma gong 'og gnyis kyis mchod pa bsngos shing 'bul/ sman dang rak+ta yang spro na gzhung bzhin phul/ 'od phung bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od sogs kyis spro na bstod/ de yang*/ nyon mongs g.yul las lha chen rgyal ba'i rtags/ khyu mchog dmar mo'i rgyal mtshan phyag na bsnams/ /ral gri rtse gsum yid bzhin zhags pa 'dzin/ / thod pa'i mkhar 'joms spyan lnga brtson pa yi/ /mchod cing bshig ste rnam par 'phrog mdzad pa/ /zhe sdang ro langs rnam par 'joms mdzad pa/ / zhes sogs sbrel/ bzlas pa ni/ nag po chen po'i gzungs gong du bshad pa nyid ci 'grub tu bzla zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa shrī mahā kā la hūṃ dzaḥ gtso bo'i snying po'o/ / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa be tā lī hūṃ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ku li hūṃ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra e ka tsa ti hūṃ dzaḥ

oṃ badz+ra shrī kaṃ ka ri hūṃ dzaḥ yum bzhi'o/ / oṃ badz+ra kro dha bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra mu bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra ngang taṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra ru ti re ma tī bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra ma nu ha raṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ badz+ra a kar puṣ+pa ni bh+yoḥdzaḥ bh+yoḥhūṃ dzaḥ ma mo bdun gyi'o/ / oṃ mahā kā la rak+ṣa mahā kā la/ pe ta li/ ya thu ni dza dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa de ba shrī mahā ka la kro dha pe ta li hūṃ phaṭa/ dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra/ rbad pa'o/ / mahā kā la ṇi thuṃ laṃ/ thuṃ ril rbad su ṇi dzaḥ dgra bo'i snying la ya/ trag rak+sha thuṃ ril rbad/ dgra bo'i snying la kha raka dzaḥ ṇi dza dgra bo'i snying la thuṃ ril/ lus la ya rbad/ pu ṇi shigadagra bo'i snying la ya/ bsad pa'o/ / na ga bi da na ga rā dza ha ha/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa mañtsi/ snying la rak+mo thun bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ rak+mo kha rag tsit+ta la rak+mo bh+yoḥ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags te thun brdeg pa la sogs pa'o/ /mthar mchod bstod byas te/ dam la 'bod kyi dam tshig gshegs sogs kyis gshegs pa'o/ /lhag ma gtor 'bul dang*/ rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ mgon po gnyos lugs kyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba kho na'o/ bka' gdams pa dang rnying ma ba/ /kuna~X la sngon dus rab grags kyang*/ /deng sang ches dkon rnyed par dga~X'/ /de phyir snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bsdus/ mgon po seng zhon zhes bya ba/ tshogs bdag mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mahā ka lā ya/ rab 'jigs dregs pa 'dul mdzad dpa' bo che/ /sgrub la bu gcig ltar brtse dngos grub stsol/ /bla ma dang ni nag po chen po la/ /gus pas btud nas gtor ma'i cho ga bshad/ /'dir bris sku dang mchod gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed dang yi dam gyi mchod gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ 'di skad ces bya'o/ / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi mdun du 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor/

dur khrod chen po'i gnas/ shin du gtum pa'i ljongs/ dregs pa bdud kyi yul/ dug gi na bun 'thul ba/ drag po'i klog 'khyug cing*/ rgyob sod kyi 'brug sgra sgrog pa/ gnam lcags kyi thog dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi ser ba 'bab cing*/ ma mo 'du ba'i gnas/ mtshan mo me 'bar ba/ nyin mo rlung nag 'tshub cing*/ na bun rnag khrag dang zhag tu 'bab pa/ mi ro skam rlon rid gsum sna tshogs gcal du bkram zhing*/ khrag zhag gi rba klong 'khrug pa/ gcan gzan gtum po rnams ngar skad 'bod pa'i dbus na/ rmangs gzhi lcags las grub pa'i steng du/ shar mi'i thod pas brtsigs pa/ lho rta'i thod pas brtsigs pa/ nub spre'u'i thod pas brtsigs pa/ byang lug gi thod pas brtsigs pa'i pho brang chen po/ phyi rin po che'i gzhal yas khang la/ nang thod pa'i mkhar du yod pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa shin du 'jigs shing rab tu 'bar ba/ zur bzhi zangs las byas pa/ sgo bzhi bse las byas pa/ gser gyi re cha gsol ba/ mu men 'phrul gyi g.yag shing can/ rta babs dung las grub pa/ zangs lcags khrag gi bad yod pa/ nang keng rus kyi ka gdung rnams kyis phub pa/ rus pa'i dra ba dra phyed dang*/ mi mgo brtsigs pa'i tog gis mtshan pa/ ngos rnams la khrag gi zar chu 'bab pa/ de'i nang mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram pa/ mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru bskyil pa/ mi lpags rta lpags yol bar bres pa/ gsur chen dud pa phyogs bcur 'thul ba/ phyi rol rmangs gzhi'i stegs bu la ro langs kyi shon byed pa/ keng rus kyi gar mkhan 'khrab pa/ phyogs thams cad du zhing chen gyi bla re/ me ro'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ mgo bo sna tshogs kyi do shal dang*/ skra'i rnga yab la sogs pa nyam nga bag tsha ba'i rgyan dang*/ ldan pa'i pho brang gi lte bar nag po bdun brtsegs lcags mkhar zur drug pa la mthing zangs g.yu'i skas btsugs pa'o/ /de'i dbus su mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du mi ro rta ro la gnas pa'i raṃ las dug sdong raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/

dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ lha chen dpal 'bar mahā kā la srog bdud nag po thod pa'i 'phreng ba can sku mdog smug nagabadud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas shwa na mu kha'i gdong shel mig gyen du phyogs pas dgra bgegs la zug cing bla 'gugs pa/ zhal gnyis ka'ang mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril zhing skan sgra sdeb pa/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi gad mo dang nga ro drag po sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis dug gi sdong po me 'bar ba dang bdud zhags/ g.yon gnyis kyis khram shing dang thod pa snying bcas khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa la/ sbrul nag dang dar nag gi cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba/ dug sbrul stong gi chun pos brgyan pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber gsum brtsegs mun pa'i g.yung drung ris dang gser gyi ske rags can/ de'i steng na dred mo'i bcang slag seng ge sngon po'i gong lag can gsol ba/ zhabs la sag ti'i lham gyon pa/ snyan nas 'brug stong ldir zhing*/ dri 'dzin nas nag po brtsegs pa'i rlung dmar ldang ba/ sdang mig las me 'od 'phro zhing*/ zhal du sha khrag gis rgya mtsho 'khyil ba/ sgo dgu nas nyams pa la drug gi char sprin 'bebs pa/ spyi bo la nyi zlas brgyan pa/ sku che la yan lag rags pa/ khams gsum 'dar zhing skrag par byed pa/ dgra bgegs dang log par lta ba thams cad skad cig gi rdul du rlog pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du bh+yoḥdang ral gri zhu ba las dpal ldan lha mo gnyan gyi re ma tī sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ zhal ras phyi rgyab tu phyogs pas gzigs pa/ mi ro zhal du gsol bzhin pas/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser g.yon ngos su 'khyil ba/

phyag g.yas gnyis kyis zhing chen dang ral gri sdig pa'i yu ba can me 'bar ba/ g.yon gnyis na ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor bu'i char 'bebs pa dang*/ thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can/ snyan g.yas g.yon la dug sbrul dang seng ges brgyan pa/ zhal nas drag sngags kyi 'o dod 'bod cing*/ mig nas khrag gi char ba 'bab pa/ shangs nas nad kyi na bun 'thul ba/ lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi ma 'char zhing*/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu zla ba rgyas pa/ mi lpags kyis stod g.yogs shing*/ re sdes smad dkris pa/ sbrul rigs bzhi'i ske rags bcings pa/ zhabs la dbang gi lcags sgrog 'khrol ba/ srin po'i bong bu gwa dmar la chibs pa/ nad kyi rkyal ba/ mtshon gyi gru gu byang dmar gyi khres po/ sho rde'u dkar nagabadud kyi khram bam ste sprul pa'i mtshon cha lnga dang bcas pa srin po'i ya 'khal la snga ru dang*/ ma 'khal la phyi ru byas pa/ gong rmed sbrul la bgyis shing rak+ta'i rgya mtshor rgyu ba yab yum gnyis ka'ang me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zur drug tu bh+yoḥdrug las sprul pa'i pho nya mon mo shwa na nag mo drug skad cig gis grub pa ni/ gser mig ma/ dngul mig ma/ zangs mig ma/ mkhar mig ma/ g.yu mig ma/ mchong mig ma rnams khyi'i gdong can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog nag mo g.yas rdo rje nam mkha' la gsor zhing*/ g.yon zhags pa nag po 'phen pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can/ ral pa rting par slebs pa/ phyag rgya bsgyur zhing gar byed pa/ khyi skad 'don zhing ri rab bskor ba/ lhang lhang ngu zhing dur khrod nyul ba/ byang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin chen po brgyad ni lcags kyi bya khra brgyad du sprul nas sngon la lding pas/ snga dgra ngar ba rdul du rlog pa/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje chen po brgyad ni/ stagagazigadom/ dred/ 'phar ba/ seng ge ce spyang*/ khyi rnams su sprul nas phyi bzhin du 'brang bas/

phyi dgra sems pa rdul du rlog pa/ phyi skor du sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa bdud po seng ge'i gdong can gsum dang raṃ bdun dang ma bdun las byung ba'i sprul ba'i mon pa pho bdun mo bdun rnams dang*/ gzhan yang sprul pa dang yang sprul kyi tshogs rnams dang*/ bdud kyi dmag nyi khri chig stong*/ lha dmag 'bum sde dang bcas shing*/ lha ma srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad kyang gcer bu 'dab chags thang la bor ba ltar 'dar yed yed 'dug pa thams cad kyang sgrub pa po'i bka' sdod par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan ras gzigs mgon thugs kyi 'phrin las las/ /rnam 'phrul zhi bas 'dul bar mi spyod cing*/ /drag po'i stobs kyis gdug pa tshar gcod pa/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can khyod ni 'dir byon cig/lha chen thugs kyi pho nya mthu bo che/ khyod kyi rnam 'phrul phyogs bcu ma lus khyab/ /yab cig rtag tu 'dod rgyal khang bzang na/ /phal cher u tsa la yi dur khrod na/ /res 'ga' bsil ba'i tshal na srin po'i gzugs/ /da lta tsa ri rong gi pho brang na/ khyod kyis brten sa rtsub mo'i brag phug na/ /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i rjes 'brang zhing*/ /gang gis bcol ba'i las rnams grub mdzad pa/ /drag po dbang phyug gzi ldan 'dir byon cig/sngon tshe phyag na rdo rje'i spyan snga ru/ /trak+shad khyod kyi ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /drag po'i las la gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gy-i/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /e h+ye hi mahā kā la trak+shad sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ

nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ hūṃ/ lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing*/ /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes bstod pa/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod bas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la trak+shad mahā kā la sid+dhi tri yaṃ dun dza dzaḥ zhes dpal mgon po dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shu me ma hūṃ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ ma bod/ ma bod/ ma shod/ ma shod/ giṅga ra giṅga ra/ ma las thams cad grub par mdzod cig ces dpal lha mo'i sngags so/ /de nas gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga bskyed/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis mdun gyi nam mkha' la rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ rlung gis me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge dang bcas pa zhu zhing khol bas lbu ba du oṃ gyur/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pa/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas/ de la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ mgon po yab yum 'khor bcas kyi sngags gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can la reg cing gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ oṃ mahā kā la tri yaṃ dzaḥ sa ma ya sa ma lo ki ni mun bh+yoḥhūṃ phaṭa bā liṃ i daṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi bhuñdza ho/

rak+ta pi pa to sa ma ya swāhā/ oṃ de wi mahā ka li re ma tī mahā bā liṃ ta khā hi/ mahā maṃ sa khā hī tsit+ta khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā kā la/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha bdud 'dul gyi dbang phyugadug gsum gyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin gyi srog shing*/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma/ lha'i ded dpon chen po/ srog bdud nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ bā liṃ rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes zhig kha raṃ khā hi/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ nag mo dre'u la zhon pa/ gcer mo bong bu la zhon pa/ mgyogs ma rlung la zhon pa/ bā liṃ rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/ gzhan yang 'khor gyi ma mo drugabyang phyogs kyi gnod sbyin chen po brgyad/ lho phyogs kyi gshin rje chen po brgyad/ sprul pa yang sprul pho nya/ 'khor gyi dmag nyi khri chig stong sde brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad bā liṃ rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ga na pa ti yak+ṣa bai ta li sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar nas nang mchod 'bul/ hūṃ/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur byon srog bdud ma rungs pa/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs kyi gtso/ /drag po'i zhal la gtum po'i sku/ /rdo rje mahā kā la ste/ /lha chen lcam dral spyan 'dren gyi/ /gnas 'dir mchod phyir gshegs su gsol/ /srog gi bka' sdod mgon po'i sku/ /srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer gsum brtsegs 'jig byed pas/ gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /mdog nag gzugs can brjid pa la/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du 'khyil/ /steng gi lha tshogs dbang du

sdud/ khros pas zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo/ /'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab bsgyel/ /dbang phyug che la bdag bstod do/ /g.yas pa dug sdong bdud zhags bsnams/ /g.yon pa thod pa snying bcas gsol/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /las kyi srog bdud chen po ni/ /bdud rta nag po rting dkar chibs/ /sku che yan lag rags shing brjid/ /spyan dmar zhal gdangs ljags 'gril zhing*/ /sku la ber nag smug po gsol/ /sag ti'i lham la pad nyi'i gdan/ /bskal pa'i me dpung nang na 'gying*/ /mthu stobs can la bdag bstod/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar thugs bskyed pa/ /nag po khyod ni yin pa ste/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ /bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe/ /bdag la gnod byed dgra dang bgegs/ /thams cad khyed kyis gzhom pa dang*/ /bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ /nad dang gnod pa zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*/ thams cad dbang du sdud pa dang*/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams gzhom pa yi/ / 'phrin las rnam bzhi khyod kyis kyis/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ bh+yoḥ ma'i nang nas ma gcig ma/ /sring gi nang nas sring gcig ma/ /dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /lha'i gnas na lha mo nam gru ma/ /klu'i gnas na klu mo glog 'gyu ma/ /srin po'i gnas na srin mo shaṃ shaṃ mo/ /me'i gnas na bdud mo re ma tī/ /mi la bdud du khyod las che ba med/ /gnas ni byang shar mtshams na gnas/ /rgyu ni bar snang khams la rgyu/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi dbugs 'cha' ma/ rkang la lcags kyi lham gyon ma/ /sku la mdzes pa'i re lde gsol/ /mi mgo rta mgo mkhar du brtsigs/ /thod pa dgu brtsegs gzhal yas 'dir/ /ma gcig lha mo spyan 'dren na/ /do nub nam gyi gung stod la/

/ming po rdo rjes las 'chol gyi/ /sring mo dam can las mdzod la/ /brnag pa'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /bsgrubs pa'i tshe na zor ma lci/ /rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung*/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /hūṃ/ srog bdud nag po chen po yi/ /bka' nyan sgrol byed ma mo drugakhyi mo nag mo shes rab gsal/ khro cha'i zhal la rdo rje'i sku/ /ri rab bskor zhing rdzu 'phrul 'gyed/ /lhang lhang ngu zhing dur khrod nyul/ /sdig can sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ /bdud gyi bu mo las la ya/ khyi mo nag mo gser mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo dngul mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo mkhar mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ khyi mo nag mo mchong mig ma/ /bdud kyi bu mo khyed drug kyang*/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /nyams pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol la shog/bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog/bar chad sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod/ /mon mo nag mo shel mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo gser mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo zangs mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo g.yu mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo dngul mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo lcags mig ma/ /mon mo nag mo bse mig ma/ /mon mo chen mo khyed bdun yang*/ /sha khrag sogs gong bzhin/ hūṃ/ mon pa nag po byi la zhon/ /mon pa nag po 'brug la zhon/ /mon pa nag po sbrul la zhon/ /mon pa nag po glog la zhon/ /mon pa nag po stag la zhon/ /mon pa nag po khyung la zhon/ /mon pa nag po rlung la zhon/ /bdud kyi bshan pa khyed bdun yang*/ /sha khrag sogs gong bzhin/ gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul dang*/ /phyogs bzhi'i ru 'dren dmag gi tshogs/ /bdud po nyi khri chig stong dang*/ /lha dmag dkar po 'bum sde'i tshogs/ /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /sha khrag sogs kyis bskul zhing 'phrin las bcol/

thun gyi gtor ma med na 'jug gi cho ga bya'o/ /gal te thun gtor yod na skabs 'di nyid du gtong ste/ hūṃ/ srid gsum dbang sdud mgon po yab yum dang*/ /stobs ldan pho nya mngag gzhug 'khor dang bcas/ /shin du 'jigs khros drag la rngam pa'i gzugs/ /rno ba'i mtshon 'dzin mgyogs pa'i shugs can rnams/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sman raka phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/dza gang dpa' bo'i sman phud 'di bzhes shig/dzaṃ bu ti ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di bzhes shig/sngar bcol las kyi gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol las kyi gsol 'debs chen por bzhes/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad dang gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam tshig bden pa bzhin/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad byed pa yi/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du rlag par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrubs/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ slar yang*/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gong gi bstod thung gis bstod/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa sgrub pa'i gdong grogs dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung zhing bzlog pa dang*/ dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i tshe/ mi zad pa'i longs spyod/ rab tu rgyas pa'i dbang thang*/ thub par dka' ba'i mthu stobs rnams stsal ba dang*/ mdor na bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/

yi ge brgya pa ci 'grub tu bzla zhing*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la bstim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis bdag bsrung*/ slar yang smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par byas la thun mtshams la 'jug go /'dir mon pa pho bdud mo bdun sogs kyis zhal phyag bzhon pa bskyed par 'dod na/ bskul ba rgyas pa so so dag nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed kyang rung la/ man ngag ltar na/ mon pa byi la la zhon pa/ bdud zhags dang nad rkyal/ 'brug la zhon pa ral gri dang thod khragasbrul la zhon pa dug sdong dang be con/ glog la zhon pa phyag gnyis kyi be con nag po/ stag la zhon pa spu gri dang snying zhags 'dzin pa/ khyung la zhon pa sta re dang sbrul zhags/ rlung la zhon pa ral gri dang zhags pa nag po'o/ /hūṃ gsum las sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa 'jigs byed bdud pho gsum khram shing dang nad rkyal/ seng ge'i mgo can seng ge la zhon pa'o/ /mon mo shel mig ma shel gyi ral pa can nas/ bse mig ma bse'i ral pa can gyi bar/ rdo rje dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo'o/ /gzhan yang dpal mgon po sku mdog nag po/ yang rung zhing*/ lha mo phyag dang po gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang*/ ne'u le nad rkyal du bsgyur zhing dre'u rta skang gsum la chibs pa dang phyag gnyis ma sogs sna tshogs yod cing*/ shwa na mo rnams kyang*/ gser/ g.yu/ mchong*/ zangs/ dung*/ 'khar ba/ lcags rnams kyi mig can dang*/ mig dang mthun pa'i ral pa byed pa sogs yod pa 'ga' zhig 'dam ka dang*/ 'ga' zhig bsnyen bsgrub dang las tshogs so so'i yin no/ /shel mig ma'am/ dung mig ma'am/ khyi mo shes rab gsal phyag bzhi mar bskyed par yod do/ /man ngag ni logs su bstan par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa tsam dang nyer 'brel

bar/ /sgrub thabs mchod tshogs 'di byas pas/ /bstan dgra bdud sder bcas bcom nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par shog/lha chen lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms zhes bya ba 'di ni// //'jam dbyangs rdo rje bla ma'i gtor chog la gzhi byas/ yig rnying nas kha bkang ste lhag chad nor ba'i dri ma spangs shing*/ rgyas bsdus mtshams la bklags chog tu byas pa ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer dgu pa la smras pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ seṅga'i gling na rab gnas shing*/ /rdo rje gdan gyi chu lon du/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang mnga' gsol ba/ /lha chen dpal 'bar la 'dud do/ /'dir legs ldan nag po chen po trak+shad la sgrub thabs lugs shin tu mang ba las/ 'dir gnyos lugs yin/ de la slob ma rjes bzung gi bya ba ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ shin tu bsdus pa gtor dbang*/ bsdus pa sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang*/ rgyas pa byin rlabs dbang lnga/ shin tu rgyas pa dbang bzhi rnams yod pa las/ dang po gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal gru gsum mthing nag gtor ma dang bcas pa bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun bskyed kyi bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs dgra bgegs kun 'joms su bshad zin pa nyid yin te/ bstod pa 'phrin bcol yan chad grub pa'i mtshams su/ slob ma rjes 'dzin te/ maṇ+ḍal yan chad spyi dang 'dra/ gsol 'debs ni/ rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi/ /dri ma mtha' dag sbyang ba'i phyir/ /ma smin smin byed dbang bskur stsol/ / zhes lan gsum/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ slob dpon yi dam dang*/ gtor ma mgon por bskyed la/

spyan 'dren pa yan chad bya/ slob mas mos gus byas pas/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor byon/ de'i dbu gtsug tu bla ma yi dam du gsal ba la sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor bar mos/ slob dpon gyis bka' bsgos pa'i tshe/ mgon pa'i gnas gsum nas/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung nas/ slob ma'i lus gang bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bsregs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par rim par sgom du bcug la/ rol mo dang bcas pas bka' bsgo bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ de tsam ni gtor dbang ngo*/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang byed na/ thog mar gtor dbang de nyid rdzogs par bskur te/ de ltar na khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag byang ste/ ye shes kyi skur gyur pa ni zhes mtshams sbyar nas/ yi dam khro bo gang rung zhig gi mngon rtogs phogaye shes pa bstim pa yan chad sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po'i thugs brgyud bskul ba re re bzhin la sngon du 'gro bar sbyar nas/

mdun bskyed las mgon po'i sku mang po byung*/ slob ma'i spyi bor thim/ mgon po'i sku spyi bor gtugs te/ mi 'bral sku yis byin rlabs pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung*/ /sku yi dngos grub thob par shog/oṃ mahā kā la rū pa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ mgrin pa nas yig 'bru byung ste/ mgrin par thim/ 'phreng ba mgrin par gtad de/ gong gi tshigs bcad la/ mi 'bral gsung gi dang*/ gsung gi dngos grub bcas 'don pa bsgyur/ oṃ mahā kā la tri yaṃ dza wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ thugs ka nas phyag mtshan byung snying gar thim/ beng snying gar gtad de/ mi 'bral thugs kyi= thugs kyi dngos grub= oṃ mahā kā la rak+ṣa du tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dam tshig dang ldan zhing chos skyong 'di sgrub pa la spro ba yin la/ gong du yi dam gyi thugs kar mgon po nyid bskyed pa dang*/ skabs 'dir sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin nas slob ma la mchod bstod/ brtan bzhugs/ mgon po dam la bzhag cing dam tshig bsre ba rnams byed/ slob ma dam tshig la the tshom za ba dang*/ 'di'i sgrub pa mi byed pa la/ de rnams mi bya ste/ byas na dpon slob gnyis char la mi shis so/ /rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ gal te gtor dbang la sogs pa 'di dag sgrub pa'i 'os ma yin par gnas min du mi bya ba'i mthu med na/ dmigs pa dang*/ lag len 'di bsgyur te/ rang la nyes pa mi 'byung zhing*/ de nyid mna' la bkar bar 'gyur ba'i thabs yod pa ni man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /kuna~X du 'phrin las mgon po zhes/ /slob dpon rnams kyis dga~X' bar bsngags/ /snyinga~X nas bstan pa bsrung 'dod na/ /drag po~X'i mthar thug 'di sgrubs shig/dpal mgon po trak+shad gnyos lugs kyi rjes gnang gi bya ba bstan pa'i le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ sā sti/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal nas/

/bstan srung mchog zhig sgrub pa'i phyir/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus tsam 'bri na/ /nag po nyid kyis dge legs stsol/ /maṇ+ḍal gtor ma gru gsum dang bcas pa/ mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ sman rag gtor gsum byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod mkhar 'bar ba'i nang du nag po gru gsum gyi gzhal yas khang de'i nang du/ mi ro rta ro brtsegs pa'i gdan la pad nyi'i steng du/ raṃ las dpal mgon po sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rtse gsum gyi mgul du mi mgo dpyangs pa rgyu dar nag po dang bcas pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dgra bgegs kyi glo snying blangs pa bun ne ba zhal du gsol zhing bdud zhags nag po 'dzin pa/ sku la dar nag gi 'jol ber gsum brtsegs su gsol zhing*/ rin po che gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ zhabs la lham yu ring gsol zhing*/ lcags kyi ral pa mun ltar gtibs pa/ mche gtsigs spyan gsum sma ra 'bar zhing*/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon gyi do shal can/ rta nag chibs shing rdzu 'phrul dang drag shul che ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing bka' nyan las byed sprul pa yang sprul gyi 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po u tsa la nas/ nag po chen po 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam/ u tsa la'i dur khrod nas sogs sam/ bsdu na/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /dpal ldan mgon po spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā kā la trak+shad sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra mahā ka la trak+shad sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ sogs kyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ mahā bā liṃ ta khā hi/

mahā rak+ta khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ bstod pa rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ raṃ las byung ba'i stobs po che/ /bdud kyi rgyal po khro gtum can/ /rta nag zhon pa rdzu 'phrul che/ /sdig chen sgrol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'phrin las zhu/ gtor chog tsam yin na rjes chog bya/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin na/ oṃ mahā kā la trak+shad mahā ka la sid+dhi tri yaṃ du dzaḥdzaḥ zhes snying po cung zad bzlas la/ slob ma'i don du bgegs gtor btang*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon phyag na rdo rje dang*/ mdun bskyed mgon por gsal 'debs su bcug la/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ /dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /ma rungs pa rnams bsgral slad du/ /bdag la byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ mgon po'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim pas byung ba/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du rim pas thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang thob par mos/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang mthun par bya/ mgon po'i sku gnyis pa zhig chad de/ spyi bo nas bstim pas/ mgon po'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ des 'di'i chos skor rnams nyams su len pa la dbang ba yin pas dam tshig la gnas par gyis shig ces gdams/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ bstan bsrung kuna~X las ches zab ces/ /rgya ston lcags ris dga~X' bar bsngags/ /spu gri chig zhur rgya mtsho las/ /gtor chog rjes gnang snyinga~X po~Xr gril/ /'di'i lugs kyi lcam dral dang*/ lha gsum ma dang*/ 'khor mang sogs byed kyang 'di nyid 'don pa spos pas chog go /shin tu zab pa trak+shad dwags po lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la gus btud nas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i pho nya mchog/stobs po che las sku sprul pa'i/ /mgon po'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ khro bo'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ dpal bshos bshos phran gsum gyis bskor ba bris sku'i mdun du bsham/ gtor ma byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ mgon po trak+shad kyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa gang yang rung ba shes pa zhig gis 'di la 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bshad na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las raṃ dmar nag gnyis 'phros/ raṃ las beng dbyug dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa'i 'phro 'du las/ ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog dmar nag sku'i rnam pa trak+shad spyi dang 'dra ba las/ phyag g.yas tsan+dan dmar po'i beng chen tri shu las mtshan pa'i mgul du mi mgo 'phyang pa/ g.yon gdug pa'i glo snying srog rtsa dang bcas pa zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas/ seng ge dkar po dregs pa'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su hūṃ las las mgon spu gri chig zhur gyi skabs dang 'dra ba gcig gsal btab/ g.yon du ru las yum be ta li sngon mo/ khro 'dzum rin po che dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa/ mi lpags stag lpags gsol ba gri thod 'dzin zhing bzhengs pa'o/ /hūṃ bdun las dregs pa pho bdun mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ khyung*/ byi la/ staga'abrugarlung nagadug sbrul/ chu bo rnams la zhon pa/ bh+yoḥbadun las dregs pa mo bdun skra 'phyang ba/ rdo rje dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mon pa pho mo de thams cad mun ltar gtib pa'i mdog can no/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ gdan 'bul ba rnams byas la/ sngags bzla ste/ spu gṛ chig zhur dang 'dra'o/ /gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags kyang spyi dang 'dra ba'am/ gung gtor 'bul ba'i sngags des byed/ bstod pa yang cung zad 'don pa spo dgos rnams spos nas/

dad pa dam tshig la sogs kyis bstod/ dregs pa pho mo'i bstod pa rnams/ 'di rang gi lugs la mang du yod pa rnams shes bya/ 'di'i rjes gnang yang spu gri chig zhur dang 'dra ba las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi sngon du gtor dbang byed pa ni khyad par ro/ / seng zhon 'di la sku mdog mthing ka zhig kyang yod pa 'di dang gnyis ka /dpal ldan a ti sha'i man ngag ste/ gri gug ma dmar nag gnyis dang 'brel bar 'phrin las mgon po yang dmar nag gnyis 'byung ba yin pas grags so/ /srung ma kuna~X gyis nang nas kyang*/ /shin du dga~X' bar jo bos bsgrags/ /snga phyi'i yi ge mang yod kyang*/ /snyinga~X po~X khyad par de tsam lags/ /trak+shad jo bo lugs seng zhon gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rnam dag ye shes gcig la yang*/ /sna tshogs du ma'i snang brnyan can/ / nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs 'dir/ /ya mtshan skyes nas bdag gis brjod/ /bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum dbus su nyi gdan gsum la hūṃ gsum bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su chos 'byung gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/ rang gi snying ga nas hūṃ mthing nag spros te/ dbus kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dpal mgon po nag po gri thod can gcer bu'am/ ber nag po gsol ba 'dam ka yin pas gang bskyed kyang chog de'i thugs ka nas raṃ dang bh+yoḥspros te g.yas g.yon du 'khod pa las/ g.yas su las kyi mgon po spu gri chig zhur gyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ g.yon du lha mo nag mo ral gri dang thod khrag thogs pa bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ dam bzhag rnams byas la/ bzlas pa'i tshe/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la gu ṇa hri da hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā kā la trak+shad mahā ka la sid+dhi tri yaṃ du dzaḥdzaḥ

zhes ye shes mgon po dang las mgon gyi sngags sbrel nas bzla/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la ma hūṃ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes lha mo'i sngags kyang bzlas la/ mchod gtor 'bul ba dang*/ rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ spu gri chig zhur gyi skabs dang 'dra zhing*/ bstod pa ye shes mgon po la/ srin gzugs ma byed/ bzlas lung gi skabs sngags gsum char sbrel nas lung ster ro/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las par/ /rgyud sde kuna~X du dga~X' bar bsngags/ /sgrub thabs shin tu rmad byung ba'i/ /snyinga~X po~X la ni nye bar mkho/ /dpal mgon po trak+shad gri gug sngags sgrub mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ /༄༅/ /oṃswā sti/ shākya'i tog la gus btud nas/ /gang de'i bka' yi 'phrin las pa/ / rmad byung nag po la btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /mchod gtor sogs spyi dang mthun par bshams/ gsang bdag gam dpal mgon po gri gug gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed gzhal yas khang bskyed pa spu gri chig zhur dang 'dra ba las/ yaṃ raṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūṃ las rlung*/ khrag mtsho/ keng rung kyi ri rab/ me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng thod mkhar ro/ /sa bon raṃ dmar nag las gtso bor bskyed pa/ seng zhon gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ bam chen bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes brjod/ 'khor bskyed pa ni/ raṃ bdun las mon mo bdun/ sku mdog nag mo dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ sprul pa khyi mo bdun las shes rab gsal khyi gdong rdo rje dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gzhan rnams khyi nag gi gzugs can shel gser zangs g.yu dung bse rnams kyi mig can no/ /oṃ e h+ye hi mahā kā la ka ru ṇi dza dza hūṃ gis ye shes pa spyan 'dren dbang bskur sogs kyang 'dra ba las/ mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe/ bcom ldan rdo rje ma phyi mas byed/ sngags kyi sham bu 'degs tshul mi 'dra yang snying po spu gri chig zhur gyi skabs dang 'dra/

rjes gnang gi rim pa yang de kho na bzhin no/ /bdud dang mu stegs dgra bgegs kuna~X/ /'joms la mchog tu dga~X' ba'i phul/ /rab zab sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas pa/ /de la nyer mkho'i snyinga~X po~X yin/ /mgon po trak+shad rkang thang mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ mchog gyur rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa/ /'phrin las mgon po la btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /lcags khab can du grags pa bri/ /'di la gzhal yas khang dang*/ gtso bo bskyed pa yan spu gri chig zhur gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ stag ral g.yas su bkra ba/ gzig shugs g.yon du 'khyug pa/ lcags gzhu nag po gru mo la gyon pa/ tsan+dan beng chen sked la gzer ba zhes dang*/ g.yon du bh+yoḥlas yum rdo rje re ma tī dre'u nag po rkang gsum la chibs pa/ dra ba mig dgu rgyab tu khur ba/ phyag g.yas bdud kyi khram baṃ dang*/ g.yon nad kyi rkyal ba 'dzin pa/ cha lugs gzhan lha mo spyi dang 'dra/ mtha' skor du lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyi sprul pa'i las mkhan mon pa pho drug mo drug bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur gyi tshogs dang bcas pa/ steng du bya nag lding ba/ 'og tu khyi nag rngam pa/ ce spyang dom dred rol du 'khrid pa zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /sngags ni/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la trak+shad ga na gu ya raṃ sid+dhi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa snying po'o/ /drag sngags ni/ tri yaṃ ru ṭa la sogs pa'o/ /gtor sngags kyi skabs/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ maṃ sa la khā hi/ rak+ta la khā hi/ tsit+ta la khā hi/ ko ro tsa na la khā hi/ pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ de nas bstod pa'i skabs/ srog bdud mahā kā la ni/ /rngam pa'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku/ /gsod dang gcod pa'i las la dgyes/ khyod la 'dud do bsam pa sgrubs/ /ming po rdo rje'i las byed ma/ /dam la gnas shing bstan pa srungs/

khams gsum khrag 'thung re ma tī/ khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /shel g.yu dngul dang dung gi mig/mchong dang zangs kyi mig can ma/ /sngags kyi rang sgra dir ri ri/ /bcol ba'i las rnams rtags byung zhig/srog bdud nag po'i dus la babs/ /legs ldan nag po'i dus la bab/ /ma ning nag po'i= lha chen dpal 'bar= ces brjod/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul yang sbu gri chig zhur gyi skabs dang 'dra ba las dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad la dkar gtor zhig nges par 'bul/ cho ga gang gi lugs dang bstun kyang 'dra/ slob ma'i bya ba'i skabs/ mgon po'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer spro ba'i dod sku gzugs dkar dmar mthing gsum bstim pa yin/ 'di la slob dpon pad+ma nas brgyud pa'i rnying ma dang*/ rgya gar nag chen nas brgyud pa'i lugs gnyis kyi man ngag gung bsgrigs pa yin par grags la/ drags sngags kyi ngo bo shin tu rno zhing stobs chen yin no/ /kuna~X du zab par rab grags pa/ /mngon spyod 'dod rnams dga~X' ba'i gnas/ /mgul khug lcags kyi rgya can gyi/ 'jug sgo'i thabs kyi snyinga~X po~X yin/ /

dpal mgon po trak+shad ma ning mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ nag po chen po'i sku nyid la/ /bdud 'dul dregs pa'i lha sprul pa/ /ma rungs kun 'joms la btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /bdag bskyed yi dam dang mdun bskyed gnya' gnon du dpal mgon po bskyed nas/ de'i mdun du chos 'byung gsum mi ro can gsum brtsegs zur dgu pa'i dbus su/ skad cig gis las mkhan 'brong zhal nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas be con 'bar ba dang*/ g.yon gri gug khrag 'dzag pa 'dzin pa/ stag ral dang gzig shubs can cha lugs mgon po nyid dang 'dra ba las/ dre'u nag po rting dkar la zhon pa/ skad cig gis bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te bstim/ dam la bzhag nas/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la trak+shad tri yaṃ bh+yoḥṇi tshal pa tri yaṃ dza dzaḥ ru ru ru ru tsa pa la a shug me bh+yoḥ zhes bzlas mchod gtor sogs gzhan dang 'dra zhing*/ slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ spu gri chig zhur skabs su bshad pa'i gsol gdab sngon du song nas/ gtor dbang tsam gyis chog pa yin no/ /drag las kun ༵ la ches bsngags pa/ /thal mo brdabs chog rab dga~X' ba'i/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa la/ /yi ge snyinga~X po~X tsam gyis chog/trak+shad 'brong zhal can gyi sgrub thabs gyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /kun gyi thugs las sprul pa yi/ /lha chen dpal 'bar la btud nas/ /gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /'di'i bsnyen pa ni/ las sbyor dang sbrags ma yin pa'i phyir 'dir mi 'bri la/ gtor chog dang rjes su 'brel ba tsam bshad na/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum nag po tshom bu can gyi mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ba/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las gnam lcags kyi thod mkhar gru gsum bsnol ba/

sgo med yangs shing rgya che ba/ me 'bar zhing nad dang dug gi na bun 'thul ba/ mtshon cha'i char 'bebs pa/ de'i nang du e las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi mar ṇi las dgra bgegs kyi zhing chen bsnol ba/ rang gi snying ga nas raṃ dmar nag 'phros te/ gdan de'i steng du 'khod/ raṃ las me dpung dmar nag raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'bar ba'i me dpung gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang*/ dgra bges thams cad bsregs/ slar yang raṃ las rtse gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad bde ba la bkod/ gnod byed rnams tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje mahā kā la srin po'i gzugs can sku dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis shwa na'i zhal rngam zhing gtsigs la/ spyan gsum bgrad pa/ g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum mi mgos mtshan pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon dgra bo'i glo snying bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul dkar khras thod bcings shing*/ nyi zla'i spyi gtsug brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can/ sbrul nag pos brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ yang na dar nag gi 'jol ber gsum brtsegs gsol bar byas kyang rung ste cha lugs lhag ma trak+shad spyi dang 'dra'o/ / de'i mdun du yum khyi mo gser mig ma/ zur drug la g.yas skor gyis/ g.yu/ mchong*/ zangs/ dung*/ 'khar/ lcags mig ma ste/ bdun kar yang rdo rje dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ khyi gdong can/ g.yang gzhi stag lpags rus rgyan sogs kyis brgyan pa/ srin mo'i cha lugs can no/ /dur khrod brgyad nas/ ye shes pa sprin gtibs pa bzhin du spyan drangs par bsams la mahā kā la sa ma ya maṇ+ḍal ma ye/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ a be sha ya a be sha ya/ tiṣ+ṭha ya/ tiṣ+ṭha ya/ a wa lo ka ya hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/

oṃ mahā kā la trak+shad mahā kā la i daṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhuñdza ho rak+ta pi pa to/ sa ma ye hūṃ kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ mahā kā la trak+shad mahā kā la drag po sid+dhi tri yaṃ du dza dzaḥ bod pa'o/ / nag po he he dza dza phaṭa/ rbad pa'o/ / snying kha ragatsit+ta rbad bh+yoḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dha phaṭa/ bsad pa ste gsum char gcig tu gril nas bzlog/rjes spyi dang 'dra la/ slob ma'i bya ba ni/ gsol btab dang*/ yan lag bdun pa trak+shad gnyos lugs kyi skabs bzhin nas sku'i rjes gnang ni/ bla ma mgon por bskyed nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas gtor dbang bskur te/ gtor ma'i mgon po 'od du zhu ste thim pas/ sku'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ dgra bgegs rnams tshar bcad par bsam ste bum dbang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ ka pā la'i bdud rtsi slob ma la byin/ 'jig rten khams kyi dug rnams bsdus te/ zhal gyi sgo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sngags 'phraing gi me 'od dang 'dres pa/ bu ga dgu nas spros dgra bgegs rnams la char bzhin babs par bsams pa ni/ gsang dbang*/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ slob ma mgon po la yum gser mig mas 'khyud pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas/ pho nya dang 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ dgra bgegs rnams bkug ste/ shes rab kyi mkha' nang du chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum gyi nang du bzhagamatshon cha'i char phab ste/ lus sems rdul du brlag par bsam/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ dbang bzhi pa ni de ltar dgra bgegs sgrol byed/ sgrol bya/ sgrol tshul gang yang ma dmigs pa la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ / de ni yon tan gyi rjes gnang du don gyi yong zhing*/ gong ma gsum po nyid drag po'i las kyi bka' gtad yin pas/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang logs pa mi dgos gsung

ngo*/ /dha na siṅk+ra'i sgrub thabs bzhin/ /gsal byed kuna~X du dga~X' ba 'di/ /yig sna'i don bzhin sgrub pa la/ /nyer mkho'i lag len snyinga~X po~X yin/ /trak+shad gsang sgrub shwa na'i zhal can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ legs ldan mahā kā la'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te nyi shu pa'o// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byin brlabs pa'i/ /legs ldan nag po la btud nas/ /zhal bzhi mgon po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /nyer mkho tsam zhig brjod par bya/ /'di'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang gi skabs thams cad du gur lcam dral gyi skabs dang thun mong ba thams cad blang dor shes par bya dgos pas/ thog mar de nyid blo la zin par byas nas 'di la 'jug par bya'o/ /mchod gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ gtor ma byin rlabs bya/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i chos 'byung lnga tshom du gnas pa'i dbus ma'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyis nag po/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nagaphyag bzhi'i g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ dgra bgegs kyi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa snying bcas thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon 'og mas mi rus kyi 'phreng ba 'phyar stabs su bsnabs pa/ skra khams gyen du brdzes shing*/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba rnon po gtsigs la/ mas mchu 'phyang ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dang rus pa dang*/

sbrul dang*/ dril bu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzheng pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me drag tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ phyogs bzhir hūṃ bzhi las/ g.yas su yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du las mdzad gtum po ljang khu/ mdun du dmar nag srin mo chen mo/ rgyab tu ser nag seng ge gling ma ste bzhi kar yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rab khros drag shul pho nya mo'i cha lugs can/ spyan gsum gcer bu rgyan med pa/ rab tu grim zhing*/ gtso bo la sngon du phyogs pa/ phyi rol khor yug tu bdud gcod kyi bshan pa nyer gcigabadud 'dul gyi dmag nyi khri chig stong*/ dregs pa sde brgyad/ lha ma srin zhing gi rdul snyed kyi 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ te se/ bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod rnams nas/ rdo rje nag po chen po zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka la ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pa nas/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol gyi bar/ gur lcam dral gyi gtor chog bzhin las/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la mahā ka li de wi zhes pa'i tshab tu/ oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta/ zhes 'don pa spo/ dam tshig phyag rgya rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya 'ching ba yin no/ /de bzhin du/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta ḍoṃ bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+ṣa si/

sing ga li/ de wi sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi phyi mchod dang*/ nang mchod kyi skabs/ snying po'i mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pas 'bul/ de nas bstod pa gnyan lots+tsha bas mdzad pa sogs rgyas par spro na bya/ mdor bsdu na/ hūṃ/ yon tan myur rdzogs dngos grub mnga' ba'i lha/ /ma lus rmad byung phan pa'i dgongs pa can/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bdud dpung tshar gcod pa'i/ /legs ldan nag po 'khor dang bcas la 'dud/ /mi rtogs dbyings las thugs rje'i skur bzhengs shig/'byung ba gur chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas nas/ /bde gshegs bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can/ /rdo rje nag po chen po dbyings nas bzhengs/ /dpal ldan dbang ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur zhing*/ /mche ba gtsigs zhing mchu 'phyang shugs che ba/ /sgra sgrog dril bu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa yi/ /gdong bzhi ldan khyod te se'i zhing skyong mdzad/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen sring mo bzhi dang bcas/ /sha chen zan dang me tog spos/ /chang phud sha khrag dag gis mchod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / gzhan yang ji ltar 'dod pa'i 'dod don gsol btab rnams byas nas/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams grub bo/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ rten rdo rgya che na/ de la chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag lnga tshom bri/ chung na/ rten rdo'i steng du chos 'byung dbus ma bri/ der 'bru nag gi tshom bu bcu dgu'am/ lnga 'god/ de'i steng ngam/ rgyab tu gtor ma gru gsum lnga tshom pa mañdzi'i steng du 'god pa khyad par yin/ mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs/ oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa gtso bo'i snying po dang*/ oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi ṇi/

tsaṇ+d+ra li/ rak+ṣa si/ siṅga li/ dwi si hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ 'khor dang bcas pa'i snying po'o/ /'di la rtsa sngags bzla ba'ang gal che bas/ ci rigs par bzla'o/ /rjes gnang gi thog mar/ chos kyi byung khungs bshad pa'i skabs de yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'ga' zhig las gsungs par grags shing*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang sgrub pa'i thabs mdzad/ khyad par slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs nas nye bar brgyud de/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta'i sgrub thabs kyi rjes su 'brang ba 'di/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma las brgyud/ mgon po 'di bran bzhin du 'khol pa'i lots+tsha ba gnyan dar ma grags kyis bod du dar bar mdzad pa lags/ de ltar na zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi pa 'di'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa 'di la gsum ste/ zhes sogs ji ltar 'os 'os su 'don pa spo/ gzhan maṇ+ḍal/ gsol btab/ rgyun bshags/ sdom bzung rnams 'dra zhing*/ de nas slob dpon nyid bdag bskyed gang byas kyi lha'i mngon rtogs dang mthun par sgom du bcugamadun gyi bskyed gzhi 'di yang nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa zhes sogs gtor chog ltar dmigs pa spo/ slob dpon dang*/ mdun bskyed la mos gus dung pa byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la phogade las 'od zer byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phogalus kyi phyi nang bar gsum thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad dgalus 'od kyi phung po chen po hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de nas sku'i rjes gnang dngos kyi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ bdag la nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang rnams thig le hūṃ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ pad nyi mi ro'i gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du nag po chen po/

zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gi bar gtor chog bzhin/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ mdun gyi chos skyong la phog ste/ thugs rgyud bskul bas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las/ mgon po'i sku dpag tu med pa byung*/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ te se bsil ba'i tshal/ po ta la/ ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas/ chos skyong gi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi gsol 'debs kyang*/ gong ma de nyid las/ gsung gi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ zhes bsgyur zhing*/ sngags rnams go brje/ rnam snang gi thugs ka nas/ sngags 'bru spyan 'dren pa mi dgos/ gzhan gsung gi rjes gnang gur dang 'dra/ de bzhin du/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la yang*/ thugs kyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ zhes bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ lhag ma bka' bsgo rdzogs kyi bar gur lcam dral gyi rjes gnang dang 'dra ba las/ snga phyi thams cad du nag po chen po lcam dral zhes pa rnams/ zhal bzhi pa zhes mtshan spo/ lha mo spyan 'dren dang*/ lha mo'i sngags bkod tshul sogs mi dgos/ sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa 'di la med/ mi 'bral zhing gsang bar sba ba man chad/ slob ma'i rjes kyi cho ga dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog kyang*/ gur lcam dral gyi skabs nyid 'don pa spos pas 'grub bo/ /dregs pa kuna~X gyi gtso bo 'di'i/ /

sgrub yig rnam mang rab dga~X' ba/ /de las slob ma rjes bzung gi /lag len snying po tsam zhig bris/ / dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ zhing skyong dregs pa mthu stsal can/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po la btud nas/ /sgrub dus dang ni las sbyor gyi/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang cung zad bshad/ /de yang bsnyen dus kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang nges par byas la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad ni/ rtsa zhal nag po mi ro za ba/ cher khros shing rngam pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po rgya cher bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po 'dzum zhing 'jigs pa/ steng zhal dud kha mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje gri gug dang*/ g.yon gyi dang po thod pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gis bkang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas 'bar ba'i ral gri dang*/ g.yon 'og ma rus 'phreng 'gag thabs su 'phyar zhing*/ rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mchan khung du gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bcug pa/ zhes dang*/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ rtsa sngags sham bu can de bzla/ rjes gnang yang thun mong ba ni/ bsnyen dus nyid 'don pa spos pas chog la/ thun mong ma yin par grags pa ni/ rjes gnang dkyus ma song mtshams su/ phyag mtshan dang rten gtod pa yin te/ hūṃ/ gdug can g.yul ngor bsgral ba'i lcags/ /gri gug dug gis ngar blud pa'i/ /mtshon chen mi bzad 'bar ba 'di/ /rnam rtog dgra bo'i gshed du sbyin/ /oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ra tri ta karta ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gri gug gtad/ keng rus yu ba spros bral te/ /sku gsum rab gnod rtse mo can/ /dar nag 'phyang phrul 'phrin las te/ /dug gsum gnyen por khyod la sbyin/ karta ri zhes pa'i dod du tri shu la zhes brjod la rtse gsum gtad/ stong nyid rdo rje'i yu bas mtshan/ /sems nyid ngar ldan ral gri che/ /ye shes me 'bar g.yul bzlog pa'i/

/ma rig gcod byed mtshon 'di sbyin/ kha khaṅga/ zhes ral gri gtad do/ / rang bzhin gnas lugs mdung ring ni/ /chos sku rno dbal rtse mo can/ /snying rtse ba dan lhab lhub ste/ /ma rungs 'bigs pa'i mtshon 'di sbyin/ /shu la/ zhes mdung ring gtad/ rab dkar stong nyid ka pā la/ /bde chen rak+tas gtams pa 'di/ /dbyer med zung 'jug bcud chen po/ /mkha' 'gro rol pa'i sbrang rtsi sbyin/ /ka pā la/ zhes thod pa gtad/ gtum chen bsad pa'i ni rang su/ /mtshon gyis bsrubs pa'i dung can 'phreng*/ /rdo rje sngags kyi grangs 'dzin pa/ /shun chen srad bus brgyus 'di sbyin/ /ni rang su mā las/ zhes thod 'phreng gtad/ dzam bu na da'i bum bzang ni/ /lha rdzas mgul chings nyer mdzes shing*/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gtams/ /mi bzad longs spyod gter 'di sbyin/ /gha ṭa/ zhes bum pa gtad/ mi dbang rkang gling nga ro can/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i sgra/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung 'gyed pa'i brda'/ /dam tshig bskul phyir khyod la sbyin/ /mahā waṃ se/ zhes rkang gling gtad/ mtshan ldan skyes bus btsal ba yis/ /rang byung rdo nag mgo gsum pa/ /zhing skyong bla rdo rten pa'i rdzas/ /rang bzhin pho brang dam pa sbyin/ /sha la maṇ+ḍal/ zhes rten rdo gtad/ gsung gi ngo bo yig 'bru'i gzugs/ /gsang ba'i ngo bo srog gi rten/ /bdud dpung 'khor tshogs zil gnon pa/ /'bral med bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bzung*/ /tsit+ta tsakra gu h+ya/ zhes srog 'khor gtad/ dpa' bo g.yul du bsgral ba'i snying*/ /rtse gsum dam tshig rdzas kyi bkang*/ /bskyed cing byin rlabs gsang ba'i rten/ /snod ldan bu yis snying gar bzung*/ /bi ra gu h+ya tsit+ta/ zhes gri snying gtad do/ /phyag mtshan gtod pa rnams la bla ma gnyan gyis mdzad pa'i phyag mtshan 'bul ba'i tshig gis gtod pa'i lugs kyang yod de/ legs par yang sems so/ /lhag ma ni bsnyen dus dang 'dra'o/

/las sbyor mgon po ni/ g.yas zhal brtsegs ma gnyis sngon po/ g.yon zhal brtsegs ma gnyis ljang khu/ phyag g.yon 'og mas gser gyi bum pa myos byed kyis gang ba 'dzin pa zhes 'don pa spo/ kha cig rnam 'gyur bzhi pa zhes las sbyor mgon po zhal bzhi 'khor zhal dang 'di la spogs chog mgon po zer na'ang spogs chog las sbyor gyi nang tshan yin pas las sbyor mgon po zer las sbyor phal pa la rnam 'gyur logs pa mi byed pa nyid mang ngo*/ /rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams bsnyen dus dang 'dra/ dang po gtor dbang snying zhugs dang bcas pa bskur nas/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang byed pa yin no/ /spyir bsnyen sgrub gang rung zhig gi rjes gnang thob pas thams cad nyams su blang du nges par rung ba yin na'ang*/ bla ma snga rabs pa rnams phyag len gyi dus nas so sor bka' re mdzad pa'i phyir/ thams cad thob na shin tu legs pa yin no/ /kuna~X du gnyan lo mthu che zhes/ /dga~X' bar grags pa'ang chos skyong ba/ /'di las yin zhes snyinga~X nas sgrogs/ /te po~Xr bsgrubs na kun kyang 'dra/ /zhal bzhi pa sgrub dus dang*/ las sbyor mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ khro bo'i rgyal la phyag btsal nas/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi myur sgrub pa/ /dpal ldan nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi/ khyad par 'ga' zhig bshad par bya/ /'dir dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa las bzhi mgon po rnams kyi sgrub thabs ni/ bsnyen dus kyi sgrub thabs de nyid 'don pa spos pas chog ste/ dkar po tshe 'phel la/ bdag bskyed rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lto ba dang*/ mdun bskyed gnyis char gyi gnas su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ dkar po las/ zhing skyong stobs 'phrog dbang po tshe 'phel sku mdog dkar po rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas sngo g.yon dmar steng zhal dud kha/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang*/

thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang rtse gsum 'dzin pas tshe'i bar chad bsrung ba zhes dang*/ g.yas su g.yung mo/ g.yon du gtum mo/ mdun du srin mo/ rgyab tu siṅga li ma te yum bzhi kar yang sku mdog dkar mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang*/ nor bu 'dzin pa/ zhes dang*/ sngags kyis skabs su/ oṃ mahā ka la ka la bi ka la ri tri ta ma ma ā yur puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /ser po nor spel ni/ cho ga snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ sku mdog ser po rtsal zhal ser ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis mi rus kyi 'phreng ba dang*/ thod pa rin po ches gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang*/ bum pa nor bus gang ba bsnams pa/ zhes dang*/ yum chen bzhi kar sku mdog ser mo rus 'phreng dang thod pa rin po ches gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhes dang*/ sngags kyi sham bur/ ma ma pu ṇ+ya sarba ba su puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /dmar po dbang sdud la yang*/ mgon po sku mdog dmar po/ rtsa zhal dmar ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon sngo/ steng zhal dud kha/ phyag dang po gnyis lcags kyus snying la 'bigs shing zhags pas ske nas 'ching ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rus 'phreng dang chang bum 'dzin pa/ zhes dang*/ yum chen bzhi char yang sku mdog dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhes dang*/ sngags kyi sham bu/ che ge mo'am sarba lo ka wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pa'o/ / sngon po nyams pa sgrol ba la/ sku mdog sngon po/ rtsal zhal sngo ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang rtse gsum/ zhes dang*/ yum chen bzhi char yang sku mdog bsngo ba/ ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhes dang*/ sngags kyi sham bur/ dgra bo ma ra ya rbad/ zhes pa'o/ /'di rnams la bstod pa ni/ mi rtog ma kho na bya zhing*/ bstod rnying rgyas pa rnams sku'i rnam pa'i sgo nas mi sgrig cing*/
