bstod pa gsar pa 'phran bu yod kyang nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /rjes gnang gi cho ga yang bsnyen dus kyi cho ga nyid 'don pa spos pas chogarnam 'gyur sna tshogs kuna~X tu ston/ /ngo bo gcig tu gnas dga~X' bas/ /las bzhi mgon po'i sgrub thabs la/ khyad par snyinga~X po~X tsam 'dis chog/las bzhi dang 'brel ba'i zhal bzhi mgon po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rab 'bar stobs 'phrog dbang po ni/ /dregs pa bzhi ldan la btud nas/ /rab 'jigs gdong brnyan can gyi ni/ /sgrub thabs khyad par cung zad bshad/ /'di yang bsnyen dus nyid la 'don pa spos pas chog ste/ dpal nag po chen po sku mdog nag po 'jigs su rung ba/ khams gsum za bar byed cing lha dang lha ma yin sdigs par byed pa'i zhal bzhi ste/ rtsa zhal mgon po'i zhal gshin rje ltar khros pa/ g.yas zhal lha khros pa glang po che'i gdong dkar po/ g.yon zhal srin po khros pa ma he'i gdong dmar po/ rgyab zhal rgyal po khros pa seng ge'i gdong sngon po/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang*/ thod khrag thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na dbyug tho/ gsum pa na dgra sta/ g.yon gnyis pas rang gi stod g.yogs glang po'i pags pa'i rkang pa g.yon pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ rngam pa'i sgo nas zhabs sa la rdeb pa/ zhes dang*/ de'i g.yas su gtum mo sngon mo/ g.yas thod pa dang*/ g.yon dar nag thogs pa/ g.yon du g.yung mo dmar mo lug gu rgyud dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mdun du srin mo dang*/ rgyab tu siṅga gling ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa zhes bya/ snying po'i sngags ni/ oṃ mahā ka la ka la gu ṇa hri da e ka dza ṭi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /lhag ma gtor chog nyams su blang tshul dang*/ slob ma la rjes gnang byed tshul thams cad bsnyen dus kyi skabs nyid la 'don pa spo ba yin la/ 'on kyang 'di nyid la thun mong ma yin pa'i las tshogs rnams ni mang du yod do/

/'bum phrag gsum pa'i man ngag ni/ /kuna~X du gab cing rab dga~X' ba/ /klu sgrub kyis mdzad gzhung gi don/ /yang snyinga~X khyad par gsal po~Xr brjod/ /zhal bzhi gdong brnyan can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma yi dam mgon po la/ /btud nas gsang ba'i las mgon ni/ / stobs 'phrog dbang dang dbyer med pa/ /sha za drag po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /yi dam dang mgon chen gang rung zhig gi bsnyen pa song bas mdun du gri khrag gis maṇ+ḍal tshom bu can rten gtor mchod gtor dang bcas pa bsham/ yi dam mam mgon po gang rung gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ skad cig gis sha za ce spyang gdong sku mdog dmar nag mi bzad pa'i mche ba gtsigs shing*/ spyan gsum las me stag 'phro ba/ ral pa kham nag gyen du 'bar zhing*/ lto ba 'phyang la lhu tshigs thung ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon srin po'i thod pa mi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams nas zhal du rngub pa/ zhabs g.yas gyen du bskyod cing*/ g.yon thur du brdabs pas nyams pa'i baṃ chen mgo bo ltab ste brdzis pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ sbrul gyi chun po dang rgyu ma'i ga zha can/ ba spu'i bu ga nas sha za dang ce spyang gi tshogs spro ba/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas spyan drangs la bstim/ rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ mahā ka la bi ka la ha ri hūṃ phaṭa/ ces cung zad cig bzlas la/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ/ mgo med gar dang sha 'tshol ce spyang sgra sgrog pa/ /'jigs pa'i ro langs thod pa 'khrugs byed pa/ /'khor bcas dur khrod gnas na gar mdzad gang yin pa/ /sha za ce spyang gdong can khyod la bstod/ / dam la bzhag pa mna' chu blud pa/ dam tshig gi rdo rje bzhag pa/

mchod pa bstab pa rnams gri gug lha dgu bzhin bya/ de nas gong gi snying po ci 'grub tu bzlas shing*/ las sbyor gyi sngags kyang spro na ci rigs par bzla'o/ /gtor ma spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu dmigs la/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ btags pas 'bul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab bya/ 'di'i bka' gtad ni/ slob ma mgon po'i bsnyen pa song ba yin na/ mgon po'i sku'i rjes gnang yan chad byas la/ gtor ma lag tu gtad de bka' sdod kyi sgo nas bka' bsgo bya/ de rjes bzlas lung sbyin no/ /mgon bsnyen ma song na/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams song ba'i rjes su gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur nas bzlas lung ster ba yin no/ /mgon po yang gri gugagur phyag bzhi drug rnams gang la brten kyang 'dra'o/ /rwa gnyan gnyis ka'i gdams par yang/ /kuna~X du grags shing rab dga~X' ba/ /drags sngags rno myur tshig shur gyi/ /bka' gtad snyinga~X po~X'i yi ge'o/ /sha za ce spyang gdong gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ snga ma las 'phros pa'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te nyer gcig pa'o// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ yum gyur rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ma mo gtso mo'i tshul bzung nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bstan pa skyong*/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /dpal ldan dud gsol mar grags pa 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /de la stegs bu gru bzhi la 'brub khung gru gsum/ de'i dbus kyi thod pa'i zlum skor nang zur gsum du rdo rje phyed pa gsum gyis mtshan pa/ dbus su nas nag gi tshom bu bkod/ mdun du mañdzi la/ ra nag dang bya nag gi sha gtso bor gyur pa'i sha khrag sna tshogs pas sbags pa'i gtor ma che ba zhig bsham/ mchod pa sna tshogs pas mtha' bskor/

bdag bskyed brgyud pa 'di nyid dang mtshungs pa'i dges rdor ma ya gdan bzhi la sogs pa'am/ khro bo gang yang rung ba'i mngon rtogs sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du skad cig gis lha mo dud gsol ma bzhugs pa'i snying gar/ oṃ dkar po la gnas pa'i ra yig dmar po/ ra las me 'od 'phro ba/ sku lus skad cig gis bsreg/oṃ de'i steng du baṃ yongs su gyur pa las bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba/ de las bdud rtsi lud de/ oṃ bkrus pas 'od zer dkar po rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ aṃ mahā ka li/ di wī ka ra li/ bi kran+ta tsaṇ+ḍa ru pi ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ de nyid skad cig gis dpal ldan lha mo'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog nag mo/ keng rus ltar skem pa'i lus can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na pañdza dmar chen gyis bskyil ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shak+ti/ gnyis pa tri shu la dar dpyangs can 'dzin pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser gyen brdzes lan bu g.yon du 'khyil ba/ sbrul dang thod 'phreng gis brgyan pa/ snyan g.yas na dril bu'i mgul rgyan can gyi sbrul dang*/ g.yon na seng ges brgyan pa/ me tog dang dar nag gi cod pan can/ lha ma yin gyi mgo bo'i do shal byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba glang gi pags pa re lde ser po'i sham bu can gyis smad dkris pa la/ klu'i rgyal po bshigs pas ske rags byas pa/ lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa'i zhabs gnyis bong bu gwa pa'i steng na btsan bskyil gyis bzhugs pa/ dur khrod kyi dbus na sgra drag po sgrog cing*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar thugs kyi ye shes mar me ltar 'bar ba sgo nga'i dbyibs can sor bzhi pa/ de'i dbus su hūṃ/ mtha' skor du oṃ hūṃ shrī ya/

de wī ka li mahā ka li hūṃ bh+yoḥ zhes pas bskor bar gyur/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las hūṃ gcig chad de bha gar thim/ badz+ra lā s+ya rā ga ya mi/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i lha mo dpal nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ shrī ya de wī ka li ka li mahā ka li hūṃ bh+yoḥ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ho/ zhes pas gnyis su med par thim/ 'khor nag mo 'bum sde thams cad kyang gcer bu ral pa can/ g.yas mi snying dang*/ g.yon ban+dha skra can thogs pa'o/ /thams cad kyi thugs kar yang bh+yoḥyig gis mtshan pa/ dud pa'i gsol ba ma khyod kyi sku myur du ston cigasku mi ston na yang yid la gang 'dod pa de grub par gyis shig nang mchod gtor la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma naṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dam la bzhag oṃ hūṃ shri ya sogs snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ gan+dhe/ nai we te/ ā lo ke/ zhes sbyar/ gtor ma'i nang du ha ser po ho dkar po hrīḥsngon po de rnams kyi 'od kyis kha dog dri ro ngan pa bcom ste bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ha ho hriḥswāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ hūṃ sogs kyis mthar/ oṃ mahā maṃ sa khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ i daṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul bas 'khor dang bcas pas gsol bar bsam/ bar 'dir bstod pa til mar me dang*/ gzhan yang bstod pa'i bye brag ci shes kyis bstod pa yin la/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag/rang don sgrub phyir rnam thar la gzhol yang*/ /snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yi/ /shes rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don mdzad/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas/ khams gsum skad cig tsam gyis skor bar byed/ /gzhan la dbang bsgyur 'dod khams ya mthar phyin/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dgyes 'khril ma/

/lha dbang brgya byin lha min dbang po dang*/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po sa 'og dbang po dang*/ /rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pas phyag byas ma/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud/ /mtshan mo nag mo shin du gtum pa'i gzugs/ /ma mo srin mo'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dngangs //phyogs bcu'i dug bsdus nyi ma tshims par mdzad/ /nad rnams slong byed nad bdag dam la 'du/ /bdud rtsi'i bdud bsdus zla bar thim mdzad ma/ /nad yams gcod mdzad sman mo dam la 'du/ /gang zhig khyod la dad na ma bas byams/ /lha mo khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod/ / rak+ta dang chang gtor ma la gtor zhing*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba to si/ ka ma la rak+ṣa si hūṃ bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ sngags de nyid dam/ oṃ hūṃ shri sogs gang 'grub bzla/ mche ba'i phyag rgya kha'i grwar bcas la/ oṃ bh+yaḥbarta li brta li tshe/ kha phrus btab la/ hūṃ/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal/ /gtum mo brtsigs byed yi dwags kha/ /dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' mo/ /ka li'i sgra sgrogs sbyor zin ma/ /dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus su/ /tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru/ /gtsigs byed lha mo dud gsol ma/ /gsol zhig bzhes shig dam tshig lha/ /gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol/ /bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa/ /de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis/ /bdag gis las ni ci byed kyang*/ /de la kun gyi grogs gyis shig/gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sarba duṣ+taṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ phreṃ phruṃ phriṃ phroṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod la se gol gdab/ 'phrin las bcol/ 'dod don gsol btab gang 'os bya/ de ltar bgyi'o/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ gtor ma gtsang sar btang*/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum gyi steng du/ rten gtor bcas la/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gong du bshad pa ltar byas la/ slob ma rnams kyis/

dpal ldan mgon po brtse ba can/ /ye shes lha mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'phrin las kyi/ /rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags sam yan lag lnga pa bya/ gtor ma lha mor bskyed/ mdun bskyed dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer spyan drangs te bstim pas/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ yang lha mo'i sku dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ spos bdugasnying po'i mthar/ a be shā ya/ a be shā ya/ ra ra/ ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūṃ a ha dzhoḥ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ slob ma lha mo'i skur bsgom du gzhugadapral bar dri bzang gis thig le byas la/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ kā ya badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ/ zhes brjod de brtan par bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin la/ mgrin par thig le byas la/ wāka badz+ra zhes brjod/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /phyag mtshan snying gar bstim ste/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ snying gar thig le byas la/ tsit+ta badz+ra sogs/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ hūṃ las byung ba'i ral gri la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/ ral gri slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /gdug pa can kun tshar gcod dang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa yi/ /'phrin las rab 'byams spyod par gyis/ /oṃ badz+ra khaṅga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ thod pa gtad la/ gdug pa can kun tshar gcod dang*/ zhes pa'i tshab tu/ skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ / zhes pa dang*/ khaṅga'i tshab tu/ badz+ra ka pā la zhes 'don pa spo/ shak+ti gtad la/ nad dang bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /badz+ra shak+ti/ rtse gsum gtad la/ 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa dang*/ /badz+ra tri shu la/ zhes 'don pa spo/ lte bar thig le byas la/

karma badz+ra sogs/ slob ma'i snying gar yi dam/ de'i thugs kar bh+yoḥyig gi steng du hūṃ gi mtha' skor du/ yi dam gyis bskor ba/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyi dra ba dam pos bh+yoḥyig bcings par bsam/ de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang 'dra ba las/ mthar gtor ma la/ nang mchod rdo rje'i rtse mos gtor la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i nas/ kra ma hūṃ/ lha mo dam la gnas par bsam/ gtor ma dang nang mchod nas cung zad gcig slob ma la sbyin la/ oṃ ro ru ro ru sogs brjod de/ dam tshig bsre ba'o/ /mchod gtor la brtson pa sogs dam tshig la gnas par gdams/ slob ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog pa rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /ma mo kuna~X gyi gtsor gyur pa/ /dga~X' chen lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos/ /bstan srung brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis/ /snyinga~X po~X yin zhes mar pas mngags/ /dpal ldan lha mo dud gsol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan gshin rje gshed po la/ /btud nas bka' gnyan bsrung ba'i mchog/dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mdo tsam shin tu gsal por bri/ /sman raka gtor gsum/ g.yab dar/ thod rnga/ tshil chen/ gu gul rang byung*/ cong zhi bsres pa'i spos rnams 'dzoms par bya/ gtor ma yi dam gang byed ltar byin gyis brlabs/ bsdu na bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis kyang chog bh+yoḥ bdun ma lan gsum brjod/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung 'tshub ma'i gur sngon dang*/ raṃ las me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su paṃ las khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho/ bh+ruṃ las bse mkhar smug po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi rol dur khrod chen po'i bskor ba'i dbus su/ k+ṣa yig nag po las/ dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo dre'u rta la chibs pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tsan+dan gyi beng chen 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/

g.yon na la thod thun khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ dar nag gi lhab lhub dang*/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang*/ re lde'i sham bu can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ sbrul gyi ske rags/ thal chen gyi tshom bu sogs dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs dbu skra gyen du brdzais pa/ khram shing sked la gzer zhing*/ sga'i snga sha la nad rkyal dang sho rde'u bcas pa/ phyi sha la mtshon gyi gru gu dang byang dmar khras po can/ dus bzhi'i rgyal mos dbu la brgyan pa/ dbu'i steng du rma bya'i gdugs dang bcas pa/ bdud phrug dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ bya nag khyi nag lug nag rjes su 'brang ba/ de'i mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna bar dz+riṃ/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gaṃ dpral bar skaṃ/ lte bar saṃ/ thugs kar hūṃ/ mgrin par āḥ spyi bor oṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta wāka kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ rang dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ byang shar mu le sdings nas/ lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bh+yoḥ rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho nas/ /zhe sdang me dpung gzhal yas nas/ /dpal ldan lha mo gshegs su gsol/ /'phrin las kun gyi bdag mo ste/ /dpal ldan dmag zor re ma tī/ /nag mo 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas/ /'gro ba 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol/ /e a ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ bh+yoḥ nag mo gdug can dregs pa can/ /kun du khyab pa'i gzugs ston ma/ /nag mo gtso mo dre'u rta chibs/ /'dir byon dre'u rta'i gdan la bzhugs/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ sh+ya ho/ zhes dam ye bsre/ bh+yoḥ za byed nag mo mche ba can/ /rgod byed ha ha nag mo khyod/ /gsod la dga' bar byed pa mo/ /bdag gi brda'i phyag 'bul lo/ /a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/

zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ dbang rtags gshin rje gshed kyis dbu brgyan/ sman gyis mchod pa ni/ phra mo sbom po las byung ba/ /bdud rtsis bran pa'i dza gad 'di/ /dmag zor nag mo la 'bul gyis/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol/ /mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rak+ta sbreng zhing*/ chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag/dwangs ma yi ni khrag chen po/ /dmag zor nag mo sogs gong bzhin/ mahā rak+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rang gshin rje gshed dang lha mo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas/ thig le dkar dmar blangs nas/ bdag mdun gyi ljags la bzhags par mos la bdud rtsi myangs shing gtor/ dam tshig bsre ba'o/ /gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ sha khrag bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar/ /'bru lnga sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'di/ /dmar zor sogs gong bzhin/ bh+yoḥ bdun ma la/ mahā bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan bdun/ yang rak+ta sbreng la/ sha chen tshogs ni ri ltar spungs/ /rak+ta'i tshogs ni mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i dgra bgegs dang*/ /gnod byed 'byung po'i tshogs rnams choms/ /bdud kyi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs/ /dmag dpon rgyal mo dmag sna drongs/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor/ /sarba bigh+nān sha truṃ ma ra ya/ i daṃ bā liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sgrub pa'i skabs yin na bar 'dir bshags pa bya/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ bh+yo raka mo bh+yoḥ raka mo bh+yo bh+yoḥ raka mo thun bh+yoḥ kha la raka chen mo/ raka mo a bya ta bya thun bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yoḥhūṃ/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla/ mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan gzugs ma 'dod khams gtso mo khyod/ /dre'u rta zhon nas dpag tshad lnga brgyar rgyug/be con thod pa dam pa rang rtags 'dzin/ /re ldes stod g.yogs sbrul gyi sham bu can/

/lte bar nyi shar gtsug na zla rgyas ma/ khrag nad bdag mo dbyings phyug dpal 'bar ma/ /lha mo re ma tī la bstod par bgyi/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /'dod don gsol btab ni/ bdag cag dus 'dir tshe ring zhing*/ /bu dang tsha bo rgyas pa dang*/ /'khor dang longs spyod 'phel bar mdzod/ /log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar chad rnams mang po/ /thams cad gtan nas brlag par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /chos 'khor gnyan po da skyongs shig/ ces brjod/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal zlum skor dmar po me ri dang bcas pa la/ chos 'byung nag po tshom bu dang bcas pa zhig bya/ der mañdzi'i khar thod pa'i nang du gtor ma sha chen dang gri khrag gis brgyan pa la/ mda' dar nag po dang*/ tsa ka li btsugs/ sman rag phud gsum dang*/ mchod pas bskor/ gshin rje gshed kyi bdag bskyed gong du bshad pa'i bzlas pa yan chad song mtshams/ bshags pa dang tshogs 'khor bya/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyi sogs dang*/ gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs la skyabs su mchi/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang gi /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tsan+dan gyi be con yon du phul te/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /sems can kun la phan slad du/ /mthu dang dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /dam tshig can de bdag la stsol/ / lan gsum/ slob ma gshin rje gshed la lha mos 'khyud pa'i skur sgom du bcugasangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dpag tu med pa bstim ste/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ 'i mthar lha mo'i drag sngags mang du bzla zhing*/ spos dang rol mos byin dbab/ lag tu be con dang thod pa gtad/ mgo bor gtor ma bzhag la/ ma mo mkha' 'gro dam tshig can/

/ma bas byams shing sring pas brtse/ /grogs pas dungs shing bran pas nyan/ /bka' sdod srung ma'i dbang thob shog/hrīḥṣ+tīḥdang bh+yoḥ bdun gyi mthar/ ma ma traka rak+ṣa si sa ma ya/ zhes brjod/ phun gsum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis brjod pas/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa yin/ gtor ma mgrin par bzhag la/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas/ /ngag gi 'phrin las lhun grub nas/ /dam can 'du zhing 'khol ba dang*/ / dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang thob shog/ thod pa nas bdud rtsi blud/ sngags kyi mthar/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ de yis nye bar bstan par sogs brjod/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas sngags 'phreng dngul chu'i rgyun ltar byung*/ khar zhugs/ mgrin par thim/ bzlas lung bya/ gtor ma snying gar gtad/ ngag gi zhes par/ thugs kyi zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ bdud rtsi snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ shel ltar dwangs pa'i 'od kyi snang pas khengs par bsam/

sngags kyi mthar/ bo dhi tsit+ta mahā su kha dzñā na dha tu hūṃ/ dge 'dun dam pa sogs/ de nas gtor ma lag tu gtad nas/ bka' sdod kyi tshul gyis bka' bsgo bya/ sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du gnas bya'i phyir/ /sngon tshe ji ltar khas blangs dam bca' bzhin/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog/ sngags la/ ma ma sat+ta ka sarba karma sid+dhi ku ru hūṃ/ nyin mo bde legs sogs bya/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun/ 'dod don gsol btab man chad kyang 'dir bya'o/ /rjes gnang 'di'i lugs bka' gnyan pas/ thun mong du byed dgos na/ sku gsung thugs gtor dbang dang bcas pa spyi 'gro'i byed cing*/ yang lag len mdzes khrigs la dga' ba'i mig ngor mdun bskyed kyi lha spyan drangs nas spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad/ bzhugs gsol/ brda' phyagasman rag 'bul ba sogs gong bzhin byed pa dang*/ sku'i rjes gnang gi mthar/ chu dbang bskur ba sogs kyi lag len yang snang ngo*/ /thun mong gi slob ma la/ thun mong gi rjes gnang dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa la yang de bzhin te/ de las bzlog na tshe thung ba dang*/ nad mang ba dang*/ 'khor dang*/ longs spyod rnams la god kha yong ba'i nyes dmigs yod pas gong du bshad pa de la bka' dog par bya'o/ /shes rab gsang ba'i slob ma ni/ kuna~X gyis ming yang ma shes pa/ /bstan bsrung sgrub thabs dga~X' ba'i phul/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i snyinga~X po~X lags/ /dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ yum gcig shes rab pha rol phyin/ /srin mo chen mo'i tshul bzung nas/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad re ma tī/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo chen po'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa zhig gis 'di sgrub ste/ lha mo'i sgrub thabs kyi spyi'i go ba chags pa zhig gis/ mdun bskyed kho na'am/

bdag mdun gnyis kar rung bar bshad mod/ gtso bor snga ma ltar bya ba yin pas/ bris sku mchod gtor sogs tshogs par byas la/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed song nas/ 'di skad ces/ rang gi mdun du 'od kyi gur khang sngon po rgya khyon mtha' yas pa'i nang du/ me rlung 'tshub ma 'khyil ba'i dbus/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i nang du phyi gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi nang du thod mkhar gru gsum/ rmangs rdo rje pha lam las grub pa/ de'i dbus su rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i ti yig yongs su gyur pa las/ lcags kyi dre'u rta rkang gsum rdzu 'phrul rlung gi gshog pa can/ de'i sga gong du pad+ma sngon po dang nyi ma la/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i ma yig sngo skya las byung ba'i rtse gsum mas mtshan pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las lha mor gyur/ oṃ nag mo ting laṃ ma ma/ dun tiṃ ma bh+yoḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī sku mdog nag mo dar nag gi go zu 'ja' tshon ris can/ sbrul nag gi sgrog zung can gsol ba/ phyag bzhi g.yas kyi dang po 'phrul gyi me long*/ gnyis pa na sbrul zhags/ g.yon dang pos rtse gsum/ gnyis pas lcags kyi phur bu sgril ba/ dpal lha mo re ma tī'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ ye shes kyi ma mo/ las kyi ma mo/ 'jig rten gyi ma mo/ lha mo/ klu mo/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ grul bum/ srin mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ thugs kar pad zla la ma yig ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' 'o/ /de las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma tī/ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rum nas/ /zla ba nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro/ /nag mo mi bzad cho 'phrul can/ / dus la bab kyi da tshur byon/ /e h+ye hi dza e aral+li ho/ zhes pa tshar gcig dang*/ ma mo nag mo tiṃ la/ ma mo nag mo dun tiṃ bh+yoḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ nag mo dun bh+yoḥ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas shing spyan drangs/

thor rus dmar po gtams pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /lha srin dgu brgya bsnol ba'i bag rtse la/ /rdo rje ral gcig srid pa kun gyi yum/ /brjid cing 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ /traka rak+ṣa ma he gu la pad+ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ tsan+d+ra sur+ya ti ra maṃ hūṃ/ bskal pa mang por rang rgyud cher sbyangs pas/ /snying rje'i stobs kyis phan pa'i gzugs ston pa/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / mchod pa ni/ chos skyong spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ rak+mo dun ting ma ma ya ha hi/ nag mo dun ting ma ma ya ha hi/ zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar nas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bdag gi dam tshig 'gal ba ci bgyis pa/ /'thol lo bshags so ye shes lha mo'i tshogs/ /bshags so bshags so 'jig rten ma mo rnams/ /thugs rje chen pos tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas spro na/ ma mo'i mchod 'phreng*/ sman raka 'bul ba sogs rgyas bsdus gang 'os re bya zhing*/ shin tu bsdu na/ mi dbang 'bras bu smin pa skam/ /tshal gyi shing thog skam po dang*/ /shing lo rlung khyer sar ma lhung*/ /'chi kha'i tshal thig gri snying dang*/ /nal bu'i sha khrag rgyal mtshan dang*/ /bya lug smug nag la sogs pa/ /dam rdzas thams cad bu la yod/ khyod kyi thugs dam bskang bar bgyi/ /sman sna bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /rak+ta'i chu klung 'bum phrag 'bab/ /gtor ma'i tshogs ni ri ltar brtsigs/ /a la la te bzhes su gsol/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ traka rak+ṣa ma ma mahā dun bh+yoḥ mahā yak+ṣa/ mahā tika sna nag mo dun ting thun bh+yoḥ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ gtor ma bla med spyi'i gtor chog bsdus pa ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po'i mthar/ ma mo nag mo be ta li ku lu ku lu/ ha ha mahā maṃ sa la kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi/

mahā tsit+ta la kha= mahā ko ro tsa na la= mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta la= zhes bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo chen mo ni/ /srin po'i chung ma ral pa can/ /skye gnas rnam bzhi sgrol ba mo/ /nag mo 'bum gyi dbus na bzhugs/ /dbang phyug kun gyi gtso mo ste/ khro mo kun gyi sprul pa yin/ / sangs rgyas kun dang sbyor ba'i yum/ /srid gsum za bar byed la 'dud/ khyod kyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas/ /'dod khams ma mo stong stong 'gyed/ khyod kyi gsang ba bha ga nas/ /las kyi ma mo stong stong 'gyed/ khyod kyi g.yas g.yon zhabs dag nas/ /pho nya stong phrag drug cu 'gyed/ /bdud dang lha 'dre ngan sems can/ /dgra bo ma lus 'dul bar mdzod/ /rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston/ /gang la bya ba nor ra re/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas rnams/ /sgrub po bdag la dngos grub stsol/ /ma ma snying khrag tshal pa dun dun ma bh+yoḥ zhes gtor ma gtsang sar btang ngo*/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang nyid 'don pa spos pas rung zhing*/ be con thod khrag lag tu gtod pa'i tshab tu/ phyag mtshan bzhi char gtod dgos so/ /rang byung rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs ltar na/ phyag g.yas g.yon gyi phyag mtshan go bzlog pa'i khyad par kho na yin no/ /ma mo kuna~X las ches dga~X' ba'i/ /srog sgrub snyinga~X gi thig le las/ /brgyud pa bzang po~X'i man ngag bzhin/ /nyung ngur bsdus pa ngo mtshar che/ /lha mo srog sgrub lcags phur mar grags pa rang byung rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rdzong gi lha mor mtshan gsol ba'i/ /kun gyi sprul gzhi yin par grags/ /dpal gyi ma mo dung skyong ma'i/ /sgrub thabs cung zad tsam zhig bri/ /lho mo srog sgrub nyid la 'don pa spos pas 'grub ste/ rang gi mdun du 'od kyi gur khang zhes pa nas/ ti yig yongs su gyur pa las/

dre'u ser skya rdzu 'phrul rlung gi gshog pa can/ de'i steng du yi ge ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal lha mo dung skyong ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhi khro'i rnam pa can phyag g.yas shel gyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs pa/ dbu skra nag po cung zad bcings shing grol ba/ dar dkar gyi go zu 'ja' tshon ris can sku la gsol ba/ dpal lha mo re ma tī rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhes pa nas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ byang shar mtshams kyi dung skyong ma/ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rum zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar srog sgrub kyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ nag mo mi bzad cho 'phrul can/ / zhes par/ zhi ba'i lha mo cho 'phrul can/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ bh+yoḥdzaḥ.oṃ tsa pa la a shug me bh+yoḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug ma bh+yoḥ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bzla'o/ /yang 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed par 'dod na/ g.yog mo chu srin gdong can dmar mo smad phur bu'i dbyibs can gyis dre'u'i sna khrid pa/ bram ze mchog sred sngo skyas logs nas shis pa brjod pa/ seng ge gdong can nag mo rtse gsum dang gtor ma 'dzin pa/ phyi nas 'brang ma zhes brjod/ yang drag mo la mos na/ sku mdog nag mo dbu skra kham pa dar nag gi gos can du bsgyur ro/ / de nas gtor sngags ni/ ma mo nag mo be ta li zhes pa/ oṃ shrī de wī zhes 'don pa spo/ bstod pa'i skabs/ dpal gyi lha mo chen mo ni/ /klu rgyal kun gyis zhabs la btud/ /gying chen thams cad bran du 'khol/ /klu bran grangs med mang por bcas/ /dbang phyug kun gyi gtso mo ste/ /ma bh+yoḥ'i bar gong bzhin gtor ma btang*/ 'di la rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po la/ zlum skor dkar po sha chang dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs zas bzang rgus sbags pa la tsa ka li zhig btsugs/

mchod gtor bzang du bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas gong bzhin gtor chog rgyas par btang*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyun bshags spyi dang mthun par bya/ gtor ma lha mor bskyed cing spyan 'dren yan chad sngon 'gro dang 'dra/ de nas gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa tsam bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang mthun no/ /'di rkang thang du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ rjes gnang thad du mi dgos so/ /ma mo kuna~X gyi bskyed byed yum/ /chos 'khor mtha' dag dga~X' bas sbyongs/ /snyinga~X nas lha mo khyod bsgrubs na/ /bkra shis 'byor pa bzang po~Xr gyur/ /lha mo dung skyong ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten 'das kyang 'jig rten tshul/ /bdag gi mtshun gyi lha mo ni/ /nag mo re ma tīr btud nas/ /sgrub thabs shin tu mdor bsdus bri/ /mdun du khrag gi maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor sman rag dang bcas bshams la/ bdag bskyed khro bo'i mngon rtogs dang bcas pa sngon du btang nas/ mdun bskyed swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las bse mkhar gru gsum gyi nang du thod mkhar gru bzhi/ zhing chen gyi 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan la sogs pa 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rgya dpangs tshad med pa'i dbus su/ gtad pa hūṃ las srin po'i bong bu gā dmar rlung gi shugs can/ zhing gi sga dang sga g.yogs can/ de'i steng du/ bh+yoḥlas dpal lha mo nag mo ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs spyi dang mthun pa'i thugs kar bh+yoḥ bh+yoḥlas bh+yoḥdapag tu med pa spros/ bdud mo ral gri thod khrag thogs pa 'bum gyis bskor bar gyur/ 'dod chags khrag mtsho zhe sdang me dpung*/ gti mug rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dbus su dgyes par rol par bsams la/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dang*/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas re ma tī 'khor dang bcas pa ā kar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces dam rgya bstan la dam la bzhag oṃ mahā ka li re ma tī ma ma ru lu rak+sha re ma tī ru lu ru lu bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes snying po lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ gtor ma bla med spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ thod rlon gyi phyag rgya bcas te snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pas 'bul/ sman dang rak+ta byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul tshul yang spyi dang mthun/ de nas bzlas pa gang 'grub byed cing*/ mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha la dbang bskur sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba drag tu btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di'i bka' gtad ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du gtor ma spungs gtor la tsa ka li btsugs pa'am/ med na sngags byang 'dzugs/ gtor ma dam rdzas su byin gyis brlabs/ tsa ka li'am sngags byang lhar bskyed pa yin/ gong bzhin las bzlas pa yan chad byas la/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol btab rgyun bshags spyi dang mthun par bya/ mdun bskyed lha mo gsal btab la/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ de nas gtor dbang bka' bsgo dang bcas pa byas la/ de'i gnas gsum nas/ lha mo dkar dmar mthing gsum slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par bsam/ tsa ka li reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung tsam byin pas slob ma'i bya ba 'grub pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir spungs gtor phul la mchod bstod man chad rjes chog gi tshul du bya'o/ /kun tu zab pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rab tu dga~X' yang shin tu dkon/ /snyinga~X nas bshes gnyen gshed sgrub na/ /te po~Xr lha 'dis bsrung skyobs mdzad/ /bdud mo re ma tī'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang gi zhabs pad klu rnams kyis/ /gus pas bsten pa'i lha mo la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs kyi/ khyad par cung zad bri bar bya/ /klu mo re ma tī phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ bdud mo re ma tī dang 'dra ba las/ sa bon ma las bskyed cing*/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pas thod skam gyi 'phreng ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag/gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ srin mo na la rtse/ dmar mo chu srin gyi mgo can lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can gyis chibs kyi snga nas 'khrid pa/ 'khor klu chen brgyad bung ba ltar gnag pa spu gri dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ klu bran bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ zhes dang*/ snying po ni/ ma ma traka rak+sha snying kha raka tsit+ta srog dung dung*/ dzaḥdzaḥ nā ga dun+ti bh+yoḥbh+yoḥ zhes bzla/ gtor chog gi gzhug tu klu gtor re gtong ba lag len yin/ gzhan thams cad 'dra'o/ /chu srin bya gdong can gyi sngags bye brag tu bzla ba'ang yod mod kyi man ngag yin pa'i phyir dkyus su ma bkod do/ /kuna~X tu grags pa min na yang*/ /sngags mkhan mang pos dga~X' bar bsgrubs/ /rgyud dang las tshogs ches mang ba'i/ /rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~Xr gril/ /klu mo re ma tī'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bya dkar can gyi gnas mchog ni/ /rol zhing dgyes pa'i lha mo ni/ /gnod sbyin rgyal mo la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs khyad par brjod/ /maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi'i dbus su/ khrag gi maṇ+ḍal gru gsum/ dbus su dri bzang gi thig le zlum po rnams bkod/ sa bon k+ṣa las bskyed/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le nor bu'i char 'bebs pa 'dzin pa dang*/ 'khor gnod sby-in brgyad nag po be con dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin mo brgyad nag mo ral gri dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin mo 'bum sde lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba/ zhes pa dang*/ snying po ni/ bh+yoḥdzaḥ oṃ tsa pa la a shug me bh+yoḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la a shug ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes dang*/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe rin po che'i phyag rgya bcas nas 'bul ba rnams khyad par ro/ /lhag ma rjes gnang sogs thams cad bdud mo re ma tī'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X khyab sgrub thabs yin na'ang*/ / da lta dkon phyir thob na dga~X'/ /nor sgrub snyinga~X po~Xr byed rnams kyang*/ /'di sgrub thogs med mthu ldan 'gyur/ /hūṃ/ gnod sbyin re ma tī'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrin las ma/ /smug nag chen mo dpal ldan ma/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam zhig/brjod kyi 'di la sgrub pa bya/ /rang yi dam du gsal ba'i gtor ma spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ cho ga'i gzhi yang lha mo'i spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi mdun du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ nang me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su kaṃ las lha mo rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal/ smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri dang thod pa 'dzin pa mchan khung du ne'u le bsnams pa mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can/ sku stod mtshon cha 'bar ba'i gshog pa can/ gzhan lha mo dre'u zhon spyi dang 'dra/

spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ rag mo du ra dun+ting bh+yoḥ kha kha du ra dun+ting bh+yoḥ he ra du ra dun+ting bh+yoḥ zhes spyan 'dren gtor sngags ni/ oṃ bā liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ yo ki nī kha raṃ khā hi/ ḍā gi nī kha raṃ khā hi/ staṃ pa bha ga ta a ka sa la ho/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ snying po ni/ tad+ya thā/ ru ru bi tiṣ+ṭha bad dho ma mo rag mo tsit+ta kha rag ma bh+yoḥbh+yoḥswā hā/ zhes pa'o/ /'dod gsol gyi skabs/ lha mo rdo rje dbang sgrub ma/ /'phrin las bcol ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /nyin gsum khra ltar 'khyug cing byon/ /mtshan gsum glog ltar 'khyug cing byon/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i dus la bab/ /ma gcig rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal/ /dgra bo 'joms pa'i dus la bab/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma/ /rak+ta'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes shigakhyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bdag gi bsam pa thams cad sgrubs/ / 'di yi rjes gnang ni sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dkyus ma byed pa'i srol yod na'ang*/ bdud mo re ma tī'i skabs su bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /kuna~X nas mtshan mang ldan na yang*/ khol mo re ma tī ru grags/ /rab dga~X' sgrub thabs nyer mkho yi/ /snyinga~X po~X khol phyung yi ge'o/ /re ma tī rdo rje gshog rgod mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/ de bzhin gshegs la rtag gus pa/ /srin po 'bum phrag bdun 'khor bcas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong mdzad pa'i/ /ma mo che la gus pas 'dud/ /'dir srin mo chen mo e ka dza ṭi'i sgrub thabs ni/ re ma tī'i sgrub thabs gang yang rung ba zhig dang mthun par gzhung bsrang*/ khyad par rnams bshad par bya ste/ de la bzhon pa can du byed na srin po'i bong bu gā dmar ram/ dre'u nag po'am/ dre'u mo rkang gsum ma gang rung la/ de'i rgyab tu pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/

zhes dang*/ rkang thang du byed na/ pad nyi'i gdan kho na la bskyed pa yin te/ gang ltar yang brag ri dmag nag gis bskor ba'i nang rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su bskyed/ de yang traka las lha mo e ka dza ṭi sku mdog smug nag ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur pa/ g.yon ngos su 'phyang ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mdung rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon mi snying zhags pa dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ stag sham dang*/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs can/ sbrul dang mi mgos brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ g.yu'i spyang mo mang po pho nyar 'gyed pa/ 'khor las kyi pho nya dang srin po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ / spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ mahā khwa dag khwa dag hūṃ hūṃ rding rding*/ zhes sngags kyis spyan 'dren/ ro ru ro ru tsa pa la na mo zhes phyag 'tshal/ traka rak+sha ma ma sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes gdan 'bul/ traka rak+sha kur lan ser ser dug dug/ ces dam la bzhag cing dbang bskur ro/ / e ka tsa ti ti li ti li raṃ ba raṃ ba khā hi/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di mchod pa'i sngags re re'i 'gor btags te mchod pa 'bul/ gtor sngags kyang de nyid kyi mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā hi/ zhes pa'o/ / rang gi snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa'i 'og tu yang lha mo gcig bsgom la mdun bskyed dang spro bsdu'i dmigs pa byed cing*/ traka rak+sha kha mu tra mu ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yoḥ zhes dang*/ rak+mo te keṃ dza dza kha la bh+yoḥ zhes dang*/ ru lu ru lu ma hi ma bh+yoḥ zhes pa rnams sbrel nas bzla/ bzlas pa'i mthar/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ/ zhes pa gsum po spel te dngos grub len/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ thod rlon gyi nang du gtor ma khrag dang*/ dug dang*/ chang gis sbags pa bshams la/ byin brlabs dkyus ma song ba'i gzhug tu/

oṃ ā we sha ya/ kha be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ bhe sha rū pe/ sha kha thun bh+yoḥ zhes lan bdun bzlas nas/ khams gsum gyi dug thams cad 'bebs pa'i mos pa bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ bdud mo re ma tī'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ slob ma yi dam gyi nga rgyal du gnas pa la/ gtor ma lag tu gtad la bka' bsgo byed/ gzhan thams cad 'dra'o/ /drags sngags kun las rno ba'i mchog/ral gcig sgrub thabs dga~X' ba'i phul/ /ma mo snyinga~X thig las byung bzhin/ /lag len bde zhing gsal po~Xr bkod/ /lha mo e ka dza ṭi'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'dod khams dbang phyug ngo bo nyid/ /nam mkha'i gos can zhes grags pa/ /sha za chen mo la btud nas/ /gtor chog rjes gnang byed tshul bshad/ /mdun du mchod gtor bsham/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas gtor ma spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ snying po lan gsum gyi mthar sa ma ya s+t+waṃ gyis dam la bzhag sku mdog mthing nag gam sngo skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gtum mo skra grol ba/ zhing lpags dang*/ rin po che dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal gyis brgyan pa/ sku la til dmar gyis byugs pa/ mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs shing lce glog ltar 'khyug pa/ khrag ltar dmar ba'i spyan dgra la phur tshugs su gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis baṃ chen gyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'khor las kyi ma mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba'o/ /ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra/ yak+mo mahā kā li traka rak+sha ra ra ro ru ro ru ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha/ bā liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi pra tīts+tsha haṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ dam bsgrags la 'dod don gsol ba btab/

bh+yoḥ smon lam dbang gi lha mo'i tshul 'dzin zhing*/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /gcer bu yid 'phrog ma la bdag bstod do/ /sha za chen mo rdo rje dam can ma/ /rgyob cig rgyob cig dgra bgegs srog rtsa chod/ /sod cig sod cig dam nyams khrag la gsol/ kha raṃ khā hi las la mthu ma chung*/ / zhes sogs drag tu bskul/ thugs kar nyi ma k+ṣa yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ mahā ka li traka rak+sha ra ra ro ru ro ru tsa pa li mahā ka ru ṇi ka swāhā/ zhes bzlas/ 'jug tu zan ril nyi shu rtsa gcig gtor ma la btab ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yak+mo bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes nyer gcig brjod/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams bya'o/ /'di yi rjes gnang ni/ gtor ma tsa ka li sgron ma'i mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ gtor ma gnyis ka byin rlabs mnyam du bya/ tsa ka li skad cig gis lhar bskyed/ gzhan gtor chog bzhin las/ bstab gtor song mtshams su/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las sgrub mdzad slob dpon mchog/bdag la nam mkha'i gos can gyis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa stsal du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ skyabs sems dang rgyun bshags bya/ mdun bskyed la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas gsal 'debs su bcug/slob ma yi dam du gsal btab nas bzlas lung sbyin/ gtor ma lag tu gtad la bka' nyan du bka' bsgo drag tu bya'o/ /rjes spyi dang 'dra/ rjes chog gi thog mar tsa ka li btsugs pa'i gtor ma de yang 'bul lo/ /jo bo'i slob ma kuna~X gyi phul/ gsang phu ba la gnang bas dga~X'/ /bstan srung kun gyi snyinga~X po~Xr mdzad/ /'di 'dra rnyed pa ngo mtshar che/ /lha mo nam mkha'i gos can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ dpal lha mo'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te nyer gnyis pa'o//

//maṅga laṃ// ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso/ /'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed/ /de la gus pas btud byas nas/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa dang*/ nya sha'i spos sogs dam rdzas tshang bar byas te/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod gtor yi dam ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang keng rus kyis thog phub pa/ de'i dbus su me rlung 'tshub ma'i nang na pad nyi la gnas pa'i ma he nag po dregs shing khros pa dgra bgegs kyi baṃ chen brdzis pa'i steng du/ ya las dbyug pa yas mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod dbyug nag po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon zhags pa nag po dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du bsgreng ba/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i nyams can rgyan spangs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me rlung 'tshub ma'i klong na ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du tsaṃ las yum tsa muṇ+ḍi nag mo skra dmar ser sil bur grol zhing nu ma 'phyang ba/ ba lang gi pags pa dang*/ gos nag gyon zhing*/ tri shu la dang*/ thod pa thogs pa cher khros pa'o/ /mtha' skor du ya ba ti be con 'dzin pa/ phya sangs 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ dmigs pa gsal zhing 'dzin pa/ ral pa tshar dgu mdung thung 'dzin pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dus kyi zhags pa bdud zhags 'dzin pa/ ya ma daṇ+ḍi be con 'dzin pa/ ya ma daṃ ṣ+ti mche ba 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ dus mtshan mo dang*/ gsod pa mo dang*/ nag mo dang*/ nam gru sha ka lī la sogs pa gshin rje dang*/ ma mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer sgo med lcags kyi mun khang bcu drug nas/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rus sbal gyi 'dug stangs bcas la/ rdo rje bsdams pa las srin lag brkyang ba'i gshin rje'i dam rgya g.yab cing*/ hūṃ/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na/ /thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ /yi dwags kun gyi sde dpon pa/ /ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje'o/ /gson gshin kun gyi zam kha ba/ /gson po bkos la 'debs pa po/ /shi ba kun gyi gshin bu rje/ /dge ba can gyi btangs 'dzin pa/ /sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po/ /chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /hrīḥṣ+tiḥ'i mthar/ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ gong gi dam rgya de nyid dam/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi gung mo brkyang ba dbyug pa'i phyag rgya 'phyar bas kyang rung ste/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥ'i mthar ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod pa bsdus pa zhig 'bul/ gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dir brtan bzhugs/ /mchod pa tshul bzhin bzhes nas kyang*/ /las grub bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ lag pa g.yas be con gyi phyag rgya bcas/ g.yon pas so so'i phyag rgya bca' ba'am/ gtor snod dam bzed zhal du mchod pa bstabs la/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥ'i mthar ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas nai wi d+ya 'i bar rigs 'gre/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags shing*/

oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangs spyan snga ru/ /bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /las kyi gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /'byung po ro langs ci bgyi bka' nyan sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can ma lus la/ /bdag gi re ba'i sems kyis 'dud cing mchis/ / zhes bstod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ ka la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa/ shin tu nye snying*/ oṃ ka la rū pa ya ma rā dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nye snying dang*/ oṃ ka la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūṃ mahā ro ṣa ṇa ra sid+dhi ye ya ma rā dza ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i snying po rnams ci 'grub tu bzlas/ oṃ hrīḥtsa muṇ+ḍi hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi sngags kyang bzla/ mthar oṃ ka la rū pa sarba bigh+nān sha tru na mā ra ya i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis mchod/ 'chi bdag dam can gshin rje ni/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi phyag brnyan te/ /ma gshin 'byung po'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs kyi sras/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bsam pa byang chub sems kyis brlan/ /rgyud ni ye shes rdo rje 'chang*/ /gzi byin sku gsung thugs kyis bskyed/ /don ni 'gro ba yongs kyi don/ /las ni sangs rgyas kun gyi las/ /bka' ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /

nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ gi bar brjod/ drag po'i las kyi don yin na/ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ / sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ gang ltar yang gtor ma lho phyogs su gtong*/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ bdag bsrung*/ bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /las gshin ma he'i gdong dang*/ liṅga gyen bsgreng du byed pa ni/ 'jigs byed kho na dang sbrel ba'i dbang du byas pa rwa ba'i man ngag khyad par can yin la/ gzhan du khro zhal du yang bya zhing*/ mi mgo'i phreng ba tsam gyi rgyan dang*/ rus 'phreng tsam dang*/ dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa sogs ci rigs su 'byung ba rnams ni 'dam ka dang*/ las so so'i gnas skabs yin pas/ de dang de'i man ngag shes par bya'o/ /bcu gsum mar byed na/ drag po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa/ lte ba la gtso bo yab yum/ rtsibs bzhi la ya las gshed po bzhi nag po/ sgo bzhir gshin rje pho nya sogs gying chen bzhi dkar po/ grwa bzhir ka la ra tri la sogs pa ma mo bzhi dmar mo/ phyag mtshan dang*/ bzhon pa bskul zhing bskyod/ nyang stod ār+ya'i lugs kyi bcu gsum ma la ni/ ya wa ti sogs/ chu srin/ seng ge 'brug dang*/ bya khyung rnams la chibs pa/ gying chen bzhi stag gzig dom rnams la chibs par byas yod/ lho phyogs kyi las gshin la/ shar du ya ba ti/ lhor chos kyi rgyal po zhes sogs gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad kyis bskor bar byed pa ni/ mi legs te/ pho brgyad kyi nang tshan chos kyi rgyal po nyid gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ gtso rkyang la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gtor dbang dang bcas pa dkyus ma re mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod cing*/ 'khor bcas kyi dbang du byas nas/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum mthing nag tshom bu nag po can gyi steng du/ rten gtor snying gzugs ma'am gru gsum bkod/

mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ gtor ma gnyis kar la ba dan nag po btsugs/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ bdag bskyed nas mdun bskyed kyi 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar gong bzhin byas la/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ slob ma gshin rje gshed du bskyed/ mdun gyi gtor ma chos rgyal 'khor bcas su bskyed cing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas spyan drangs/ dam bzhag mchod bstod dgug gzhug rnams bya/ slob ma'i snying gar pad nyi la ya dang hūṃ brtsegs pa'am/ snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ yig 'bar ba/ lte 'og tu nyi ma la ya yig gsal btab kyang rung ste/ slob dpon gshin rje gshed kyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gnyis pa zhig chad de/ snying ga'am lte ba'i ya la thim par bsams la/ sku 'dra tsa ka li gtad de/ gti mug khros pa ya ma rā dza ni/ /gti mug can gyi rgyud la khyab par 'jug/sems can gti mug yongs su sbyong ba'i phyir/ /me long ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin/ /hrīḥṣ+tiḥ 'i mthar ka la rū pa ya ma rā dza kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ / de nyid dang 'dra ba las sngags 'phreng byung ste/ lte ba'i ya la thim/ sngags byang lag tu gtad/ gong gi tshigs bcad la gti mug ces pa'i gnas su 'dod chags zhes pa dang*/ me long ye shes kyi gnas su sor rtog ye shes dang*/ kā ya'i gnas su wāka zhes pa bcug ste/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de bzhin du phyag mtshan bstim pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ dbyug zhags lag tu gtad de/ zhe sdang dang*/ chos dbyings/ tsit+ta zhes 'don pa spos te thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de bzhin du 'od zer sna lnga bstim zhing*/ chos kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa'i dpe lag tu gtad de/

nga rgyal/ mnyam nyid/ gu ṇa/ zhes 'don pa spos/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /lte ba'i ya yig gi 'od kyis 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgrub par bsams la/ bshan pa pho mo'i 'khor lo lag tu gtad/ phrag dogabya grub/ karma/ zhes 'don pa spos te/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas gtor ma lag tu gtad de bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ slob ma de bsnyen pa byed pa yin na bzlas lung yang spyi dang mthun par sbyin no/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog ni spyis rigs 'gre'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' gnyan mchogadregs pa kuna~X gyi mthar thug pa'i/ /sgrub thabs rab dga~X' 'di spel bas/ /snyinga~X po~X'i bstan pa rgyas par shog/chos rgyal las kyi gshin rje mthing ga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gshin rje 'joms pa la btud nas/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ khyad par rnam dbye mdor bsdus tsam/ /brjod 'gyur 'di la mnyan par gyis/ /las kyi gshin rje mthing ga'i sgrub thabs shes pas 'di la 'jug par bya ste/ rang gi mdun du me rlung gi rang bzhin dmar nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ skad cig gis las kyi gshin rje dmar po rab tu 'jigs pa/ g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon rlung gi 'khor lo 'bar ba skor ba/ kha gdangs shing ljags 'gril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ sma ra ag tshom kham ser gyen du g.yengs pa/ zhing pags kyi stod g.yogs can/ ma he'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ g.yon du yum e ka dza ṭi sku mdog nag mo ral pa mun ltar gtibs pa/ lcags kyu dang*/ thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mi lpags gyon zhing rgyu mas thod byas pa/ yab yum gnyis la 'khor gshin rje dang bdud mo 'bum 'bum gyis bskor ba'o/ /de'i thugs ka nas dza bzhi spros pa las shar du srin po ma ru rtse/ lho ru gshin rje ma ru rtse/

nub tu bdud po ma ru rtse/ byang du gnod sbyin ma ru rtse rnams dmar po spu gri dang*/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ bse bya'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ / spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad kyi rjes la/ snying po mthar ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu zhes brjod/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ya ma rā dza e ka dza ṭi ya ho phaṭa/ ma ho phaṭa/ shu ho phaṭa/ ma ru rtse phaṭa/ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ phaṭa/ nyi phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /gtor sngags snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pas 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ khrag mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil nas/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i dbus/ /gshin rje'i dbang po ma ru rtse/ /gshin rje 'bum dang bcas la bstod/ /rlung nag 'tshub ma'i dkyil 'khor na/ /e ka dza ṭi ma mo 'bum/ /las byed bzhi dang 'khor g.yog ni/ /grangs las 'das pa rnams la bstod/ / ces pa rnams 'don pa spos la/ lhag ma mthing ga'i skabs bzhin gzhung bsrang ngo*/ /rjes gnang la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs/ sku'i rjes gnang nag po dang 'dra/ gsung bzlas lung*/ thugs gtor dbang rnams so/ /chos skor kuna~X las ches dkon pa/ /rwa lugs gshin rje dmar po yi/ /yig sna mdor bsdus yid dga~X'i gnas/ /'di yang snyinga~X po~Xr dgos pas bris/ / las gshin ma ru rtse bzhi skor du grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jam dpal ya man+ta ka la/ /btud nas las kyi gshin rje ni/ /srin po dmar nag khros tshul gyi/ /sgrub thabs cung zad brjod par bya/ /'dir cho ga'i spyi rnams las gshin rje mthing ga kho na bzhin sbyar la khyad par ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas ya yig mdun du spros pa las las kyi gshin rje dmar nag cher khros shing 'khrugs pa/ lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang mi snying 'phyar ba/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i bzhugs

pa'o/ / de'i g.yon du ma spros pa las/ dus mtshan ma dmar nag ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ tre'u la chibs pa/ sprin dang glog dmar gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o/ / spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ 'di nyid kyi sgrub yig nas brjod pa'i tshigs bcad rnams brjod kyang rung la/ mthar snying po'i sngags drag tu brjod/ bzlas pa'i skabs/ dpa' bo chen po bdag ci bgyi/ / zhes bka' nos par bsams la/ traka rak+sha ya/ snying kha la traka /rak+sha ya/ badz+ra dun ti baṃ/ badz+ra dun ti rbad/ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bzla/ gtor sngags ni/ snying po'i mthar/ thun a dza dzaḥgo sha/ oṃ ru lu ru lu bh+yo bh+yo hūṃ dza dzaḥ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa'o/ /sgos kyi bstod pa bsdus pa ni/ hūṃ/ shar phyogs dkar po dung gi gzhal yas nas/ khrag mdog dmar po bse'i lan phran can/ /shin tu mi bzad gtum po chen po'i sku/ /lcam dral 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do/ / rgyas par ni sgrub yig tu blta'o/ /rjes gnang ni 'di dang ma ru rtse bzhi skor gnyis ka la/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po la gtor ma zur dgu pa 'god par mthun/ rjes gnang dngos kyang 'dra ba la/ 'di la gsol btab ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /mgon po chen po lcam dral gyi/ /rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa lan gsum mdzad do/ /dgra bgegs kuna~X la drag shul gyi/ /las rnams sgrub la ches dga~X' ba/ /gang de'i sgrub yig rnams las ni/ /snyinga~X po~X khol byung tsam zhig bris/ /las gshin dmar mo khrag mdog tu grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan he ru kar btud nas/ /dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /gtor chog rjes gnang dang 'brel ba/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bshad par bya/ /mchod gtor bshams la/ bde mchog gam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/

mchod pa dang gtor ma yi dam gyi cho ga ltar byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hūṃ yig las e chad pa las yaṃ gyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raṃ las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ suṃ las zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ suṃ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang*/ de'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ gis pad+ma'i gdan/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ gis zla ba'i gdan te/ gdan gnyis su gyur/ gdan gnyis kyi steng du sa bon hūṃ dang aṃ las dung dang mgron bu hūṃ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa las/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po yab yum sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba/ keng rus shin du 'jigs pa'i gzugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bgrad pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi brla la g.yas bskum pa'i sor mo rnams bstad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ snyan chas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba gnyis su gyur/ de gnyis kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ nub phyogs u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po yab yum gnyis la 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i don mdzad pa/ /dad dang dam tshig chen po yi/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/

/shri sma sha na a dhi pa ta ye/ e h+ye hi pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ shri sma sha na a dhi pa ti mahā pi shā tsi ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ gṛ rā dza gṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swāhā/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po lcam dral gyi zhil du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi 'phrin las kun/ /ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa re res dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang chom rkun thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ oṃ gṝ rā dza gṝ rā dza/ ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swāhā/ shri sma sha na a dhi pa ti mahā pi shā tsi bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ shri sma sha na a dhi pa ti mahā pi shā tsi ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ gṝ rā dza gṝ rā dza/ ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swāhā/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po lcam dral gyi zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi 'phrin las kun/ /ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster/ /dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod/ /rnam dkar keng rus dag pa'i gzugs/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med pa/ /gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun/ /nye bar stsol mdzad khyod la bstod/ /yang dag lam la nyer gnas

kyang*/ /lus can bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyobs/ /phan bde kun stsol khyod la bstod/ /gang gis khyod bsgrubs khyod mchod na/ /dam rdzas ji bzhin nyer dgongs nas/ /ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ /bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho dang*/ /dngos grub kun 'byung dam rdzas kyis/ /dpal ldan bstan srung 'khor bcas rnams/ /'phrin las gang bcol sgrub par mdzod/ / rjes yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ bdag bsrung*/ smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ gtor ma stod zur gsum/ smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba mar la sogs pa'i rgyan kyis brgyan pa/ dar dkar po'i cod pan dang*/ yab yum gyi tsa ka li gzugs/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril bzhagayi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi gtor ma phul/ bzlas pa cung zad byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing*/ /yi dam lha'i ngo bo nyid/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yis/ /byin gyis brlabs pa stsal du gsol/ /

zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum byed du bcugade nas rjes gnang gi gzhi bkod pa'i don du/ slob ma rnams gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar gyi chos skyong yab yum du bskyed do/ /dngos gzhi la/ sku'i rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos skyong yab yum bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkugaslob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du bzhu nas/ yum gyi mkhar chos skyong yab yum dpag tu med pa'i skur gyur nas/ khyed rang gi lus la thim par mos pa mdzod byas la gu gul gyis bdugadril bu sil/ yab yum gyi sngags kyi rjes su/ pra be sha ya hūṃ/ a be sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa mang du bzlas/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /gsung la yang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phro ba nas/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i bar 'dra la/ de nas yi ge ā li kā li dang*/ yab yum gyi sngags su gyur pa khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim par mos/ sngar ltar sngags dang dril bu sil/ yab yum gyi sngags lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs kyang byed du bcugaslob dpon gyis kyang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs bya/ thugs la yang yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i bar 'dra la/ de nas phyag mtshan gri gug dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dbyug tho dang*/ dgra sta la sogs pa dpag tu med par gyur nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar thim par mos pa mdzod byas la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūṃ āḥtiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/ rol mo dang bcas/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan smos nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/

dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas slob ma 'di dag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas ma thob bar du/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang gi las/ /bsad bskrad dbye rmongs rengs pa sogs/ /ji ltar bsgo ba'i las sgrub cing*/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig rjes dran mdzod/ /ces bka' bsgo/ 'phrin las thams cad sgrub par bsam/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyi rjes la maṇ+ḍal phul / deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod la/ slob ma rnams dang*/ slob dpon gyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gshegs gsol bya/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyis rgyas gdab bo/ /kuna~X nas grags che sa skya ba'i/ /mgon dkar zhes grags dga~X' bar bsngags/ /gang de'i man ngag dang 'brel ba'i/ /rjes gnang snyinga~X po~X tho yig go /dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka dpal nag po che'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun btud nas/ /gur gyi mgon po'i las byed ni/ /mchog tu grags pa'i sgrub thabs bshad/ / rang gi mdun du yi dam dang*/ chos skyong chen po'i gtor ma stegs bu mtho bar bsham/ rtag gtor zur brgyad pa/ 'bul gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa de'i mdun stegs bu dma' ba zhig la bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed dang*/ gtor bsngo sngon du song mtshams/ dpal gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor bsngo dang bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de mtshams mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang*/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las/ ya las nag po gnod sbyin g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sbar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas nyi ma 'char ba/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon zhing gser gyi rna cha can/ de'i g.yon du maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/ g.yon sbar ba gdengs pa'i lag mthil nas zla ba 'char ba/

dar nag gi na bza' dang*/ byi ru'i lan tshar can/ de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas yab las tri gnyis dang*/ yum las bh+yoḥgacig spros pa las/ pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ de dag gi mdun du 'khod pa ni/ tri las pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shang lang gi gri ring 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa klad khrag dron mos gang ba 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ mon kri'i ga zha dang*/ dar nag gi na bza' can/ tri las bha tra nag po dar gyi ga zha dang*/ stag slog gyon pa/ g.yas dam shing dang*/ g.yon mi snying 'dzin zhing gsol ba/ bh+yoḥlas sring mo ral gcig ma/ g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang*/ g.yon rgyu ma 'dzin zhing*/ mig nas khrag 'dzag pa/ kha nas me 'bar ba/ lnga char yang sku mdog mthing nagamon bu pho mo'i cha lugs can/ mi mgo'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ rab tu khros la rngam zhing 'khrugs pas/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na 'gying ba'o/ /de'i mtha' skor du/ g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa'i skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong gi gzugs can brgya/ slad kyi rjes su 'brang ba ban+dhe nag po phur thogs brgya/ bdun gyi bshul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag ce spyang la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi spo dang*/ bla ma gong ma'i gdan sa khyad par can rnams nas/ las mgon pu tra 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ las mgon sku gshegs gdan la bzhugs sogs dang*/ pho mo'i bod sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ e h+ye hi/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ yang bod sngags gnyis kyi mthar sa ma ya sogs btags la dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan la dam bzhag 'phrin bcol byed tshul lcam dral gyi skabs dang 'dra/

de nas rbod rbad bsad gsum char ram/ bod sngags gnyis ci rigs par bzla/ sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dang*/ gnod sbyin yab yum 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /rngam zhing 'khrugs pa'i cha lugs kyis/ /bdud dang dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bstan srung yab yum che la bstod/ /mon bu pu tra nag po bskyod/ /mon kri'i ga zha sku la gsol/ /sher shing seg shing phyag na bsnams/ /pu tra nag po khyod la bstod/ /mon bu bha tra stag slog bkra/ /dar gyi ga zha sku la gsol/ /phyag na dam shing rnon po bsnams/ /mon bu bha tra khyod la bstod/ /mon mo gser gyi sbu gri ma/ /nag mo chen mo kha 'bar ma/ /phyag na gser gyi spu gri bsnams/ /nag mo khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bud med nag mo chen mo brgya/ /gshegs kyi de ni bshul yang 'dren/ /g.yas kyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa/ /skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ /g.yon gyi phyogs nas ru 'dren pa/ /dge slong nyan thos dgra bcom brgya/ /slad kyi rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba/ /ban+dhe nag po phur thogs brgya/ /'khor bcas rnams la bstod pa 'bul/ /skabs gsum bdag kyang bstod pa 'bul/ / zhes pa'am/ spro na bstod pa rgyas pa bya zhing*/ shin tu bsdu na/ dpal ldan 'phrin las kun rdzogs pu tra khyod/ /sku mdog mthing nag me yi 'phro 'du can/ /rngam pa'i stobs kyis 'gying zhing shang lang bsnams/ /gying chen gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ / ces pa gcig pus kyang chog go / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'phrin las bcol/ 'dir rjes gnang ni/ pu tra ming sring gsum gyi rjes gnang byas pas/ gnod sbyin yab yum gyi rjes gnang yang zhar la thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rjes gnang skabs ming sring gsum po kho na'i lugs su mdzad/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab/

rgyun bshags sdom bzung rnams gur lcam dral gyi skabs dang 'dra/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol btab ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pas bdag la/ las kyi mgon po pu tra ming sring gsum gyi byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon yi dam/ mdun bskyed steng gi nam mkha' la yang yi dam/ de'i 'og tu gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ de'i bka' sdod kyi tshul du ming sring gsum gsal btab/ slob ma gur mgon nyid du skad cig gis bskyed/ thugs kar hūṃ yig mthing nag me 'bar ba chen po zhig bsgom/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de thams cad kyi sku'i cha thams cad nas pu tra ming sring gsum gyi sku dpag tu med par byung*/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab/ dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa la sogs pa'i 'phrin las mdzad/ mdun bskyed ming sring gsum nyid kyi thugs kar thim/ yang de'i thugs ka nas byung*/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la thim par bsgoms la/ shā sa na dang bod sngags brjod/ gu gul bdug cing rol mo bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ gi mtha' mar shā sa na/ de'i mtha' mar bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ 'od zer dang sngags 'bru gong bzhin spro bsdu byas la/ snying ga'i bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags la thim par mos la rjes zlos bya'o/ /a li a li ma dzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded a shwa de/ mu smugs pu tra a li ma dza dzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dza dzaḥ pho'i bod pa'o/ / dh+rig dh+rigaya du pa sha ni sod/ dum shig ā gats+tsha/ mon bu ā gats+tsha/ ya ṇir ya ṇir mon bu dzaḥ mon bu khrag 'jibs/ dza rbad pa'o/ /ṇir na rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/ shag shig rbad/ tri ta rbad/ tri na rbad/ mon bu pu tra shaṃ rbad/

yaṃ rmugs liṃ 'dus/ khaṃ shod pa ya mo dzaḥ a mu ka'i rus pa la khrol khrol rbad/ gser gyi spu gri yaṃ rbad/ bsad pa'o/ / oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shug+me ma hūṃ ma bh+yoḥdza dzaḥ mo'i bod pa'o/ / traka rak+sha kha mun tra ru lu ru lu/ rak+sha snying khrag snying bh+yoḥ spu ta sbu ta bh+yoḥ sha sha traka trak+mo tra pa snying khragatrak+mu tra che ge mo ma ra ya/ rbad pa'o/ / oṃ mahā rak+sha tsit+ta/ srog tuṃ tuṃ/ ka ma la rak+sha tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ gu h+ye rak+sha tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ hri baṃ rak+sha tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ ma ma tsa bur tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ pu ru tsa lhuṃ tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ bsad pa'o/ / suṃ trig rak+sha bh+yoḥ thibs thibs tsakra bh+yoḥ rbad rbad trin shig shigase na tubs/ kha raka rbad/ duṃ bo bh+yoḥ badz+ra tsi tri rak+sha/ tsa ti maṃ ra ya/ thun mong gis bsad pa'o/ /thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ 'od zer phyag mtshan spro bsdu gong bzhin byas la/ slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la bstim/ gtor ma lag tu gtad la/ bka' nyan du bka' bsgo drag tu bya tshul spyi dang 'dra ba las/ mthar gtor ma nam mkhar bteg nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i mtshan bgrangs shing*/ bka' bsgo bsdus pa zhig byas la/ bod rbad bsad gsum drag tu bzlas pas/ bla ma yi dam 'khor bcas 'od du zhu nas/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ de'i ngang der spros bral la mnyam par 'jog tu bcugarjes lcam dral gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /pu tra sku mdog sngo skya byed pa'i lugs yod pa'ang shin du legs shing*/ phyag na'ang sher shing gi 'khar bsil bsnams pa yod do/ /bha tra'i dam shing phur pa yin par 'dod cing*/ las tshogs kyi yi ge rnying pa 'ga' na'ang de bzhin snang mod/ phur pa dam shing du byin brlabs zhes 'byung bas/ dam shing du mos dgos pa'i don yin/ dngos ni 'ba' khram lta bu la rtsa rtse rnon por yod pa'o zhes bla ma gsung ngo*/ /lha khang kuna~X gyi srung ma zhes/

/drag shul che zhing dga~X' bar bsngags/ /zur bka'i rjes gnang byed tshul gyi/ /snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam bkod pa lags/ /pu tra lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ khyad par nag po cher btud nas/ /bran bdud gshin rje nag po yi/ /rjes gnang byed tshul mdo tsam bshad/ /mchod gtor tshang bar bshams nas/ khro bo'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ rten rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus su/ bdud rta bra nag rus pa'i rgyan can/ gong rmed dug sbrul gyis byas pa/ sga la mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi g.yogs pa'i steng du/ ya yig nag po'i 'phro 'du las bran bdud gshin rje nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ /me stag 'khrugs pa'i spyan gsum pa/ dar nag gser ris can gyi 'jol ber gsol zhing*/ sbrul gyi ske rags dang*/ sag ti'i lham gsol ba/ khram shing sked la gzer ba/ g.yas ru mtshon rtse gsum nag po mgo rlon bzhi 'phyang ba 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon dgra snying khrag 'dzag pa la dug sbrul nag po gnyis kyis 'jib pa dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ lha mo spu gri ma thal skya kha nas me 'bar ba lag gnyis gyen du gdengs pa me dpung re thogs pa/ gcer mo rgyan med skra grol ba/ tsog pu'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing gtso bo la blta ba'o/ / gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas/ lcam dral la sde brgyad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs te bstim/ dbang bskur te/ rdo rje phyed pa res dbu brgyan/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha trun/ bigh+nān mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang sa/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ hūṃ/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i pha rol na/

/dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /gshin rje nag po phyag gnyis pa/ /mtshon chas dgra bgegs sgrol la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs/ /'dod don gsol ba btab/ oṃ mahā ka la yak+ṣa muñtsa kro dha/ ya ma rā dza/ ma ri sham/ muts+tsha ya bh+yo/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ rjes gnang byed na/ lag len la gur mgon gyi gtor chog gi rjes su mdzad na'ang gcig tu nges pa mi dgos shing*/ de ltar byed na gur mgon gyi gtor ma'i mdun dma' ba'i phyogs su 'di'i bshoms rnams byed do/ /gang ltar yang*/ chos 'byung nag po gru gsum gyi dbus su/ til nag khrag gis sbags pa'i tshom bu zur gsum che chung gnyis bkod/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma snying gzugs ma dang*/ bshos bu zur gsum gnyis snod gcig tu bkod/ gtor ma'i g.yas su ru mtshon dang*/ khram shing dngos su yod na 'god cing*/ med na tsa ka li tshun chad kyang bsham/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bdag mdun gong du bshad pa bzhin bsgrubs pa'i rjes su/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bla ma dpal ldan nag po che/ /de ring bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bran bdud nag po'i bka' gtad stsol/ /

zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags bya/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du/ nag po chen po bran bdud yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes khyad par gyi gsol btab lan gsum bya/ de nas gur mgon lcam dral gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi slob ma gur gyi mgon por bskyed/ mdun du sngar bshad pa ltar bran bdud yab yum bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed gur mgon gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas bran bdud dpag tu med pa sprul/ mdun gyi bran bdud kyi thugs kar thim/ de'i thugs ka nas kyang sku dpag tu med par byung nas slob ma'i snying ga'i hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la thim/ spos rol dang bcas/ snying po'i mthar/ a be sha ya a be sha ya/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ / yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ mdun gyi bran bdud kyi zhal nas sngags phreng bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ hūṃ gi zhabs kyu la thim pa sogs snga ma bzhin gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ / yang 'od 'phros sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bran bdud yab yum gnyis slob ma'i pang du byon/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas gur gyi mgon po sku che ba gzi brjid ldan pa byon/ slob ma dang bran bdud kyi spyi bor zhabs bzhag ste bzhugs pa la/ mos gus dung byas pas sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung*/ lus thams cad khyab pas bar chad zhi zhing*/ nus mthu ma lus pa thob/ mthar de nyid 'od du zhu nas/ rang la thim/ spos rol sogs gong bzhin/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /ru mtshon dang*/ khram shing bran bdud bskyed/ zhu ba las phyag mtshan du gyur/ snying po 'don zhing lag tu gtad/ ru mtshon g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ mi mgo bzhi bdud bzhi bcom pa dang*/ khram shing dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i brda' yin

no/ / zhes bshad/ yon tan gyi rdzas gnang ngo*/ /de nas sngar gur mgon gyi gtor ma bshams yod na/ de'i mtheb kyu gcig bran bdud kyi gtor ma la gsos nas/ nang mchod bran/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la gong bzhin phul/ phyi nang gi mchod de/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa'i lag len yang gda'/ gang ltar gtor ma lag tu gtad/ de dang*/ rang gi spyi bor gur mgon dang*/ de'i steng du bla ma yi dam du gsal ba sogs bzhugs par bsams nas/ dam bzhag sngon du 'gro ba'i bka' bsgo spyi dang mthun par byed de/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /slob ma dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjais kyi bya ba rnams ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /drag po'i las la mos pa'i mi/ /kuna~X gyis dga~X' zhing bsgrags pa'i chos/ /snyinga~X nas 'grub par 'dod na ni/ /gsang ste bsgrubs na zab po~Xr 'gyur/ /bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang ni che ba'i lha/ /dpal chen he ru ka la'ang 'dud/ /phur bu'i srung ma yin par grags/ /'khon rab srung ma'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /sha khrag gtsang ma dang dkar gsum sogs kyi brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'brang rgyas dkar po gcig dang*/ bshos bu nag po zhig bshams/ spang spos dang*/ spos dkar gyis bdug pa sogs mchod pa'i yo byad gzhan thams cad kyang 'dzom par byas/ rang nyid dpal chen po'am/ ye shes khro bo gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod gtor rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun du pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bh+yoḥdakar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las dkar mo nyi zla stong gi 'phreng ba can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas ri rab sgong du rtse ba/ g.yon gling bzhi byo yol mdzad cing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ nyi zla spel ba dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i do shal byas pa/ nyi zla gcig dang thod pa'i 'phreng ba thod du bcings pa/

sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan zhing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs can/ mkha' 'gro ma bye bas bskor ba'o/ /de'i g.yas su hūṃ yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ bdud rgyal dpa' bo thod 'phreng can/ sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mdung ring ba dan dang bcas pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon mi mgo'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ gos rgyan nag po can/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ bdud bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur te/ he ru kas dbu brgyan/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ snying po'i sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba bigh+nān sha truṃ mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul la/ oṃ badz+ra shin+taṃ pad+ma ku ru tiṃ bh+yoḥ zhes gtso mo dang*/ oṃ sarba ma ra kriṣ+ṇa kā pa la mā la dha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bdud rgyal gyi snying po'o/ / mā ra ya thum shigamā ra ya a mo baṃ/ mā ra ya snying hrul/ staṃ bha ya sod sod/ ces bdud rgyal gyi srog sngags rnams kyang drag tu bzla/ mthar ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ hūṃ ma bh+yoḥ dpal ldan dkar mo chen mo ni/ /nyi zla stong gi 'phreng ba can/ /ye shes dbyings kyi rje mo ste/ /gzhan don 'jig rten pa ru sprul/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /'das dang ma 'das mtshams na bzhugs/ khyod la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /dgra bo'i srog la mnga' mdzad pa/ khyod ni srog bdag chen po ste/ khyod la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ / ces brjod la mthar rjes bsdu ba ni spyi dang 'dra/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung gru gsum dkar po'i dbus su 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ steng du 'brang rgyas dkar po phug ron gyi gzugs dang bcas pa bsham/
