de'i g.yas su chos 'byung gru gsum nag po la 'bru nag gi tshom bu dang*/ steng du dmar gtor bkod/ mtha' la mchod pa ci bder bsgrigs/ de nas gong du bshad pa ltar nyams su blangs rjes/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis nas/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ bdag la dkar mo nyi zla stong gi 'phreng ba can dang*/ bdud rgyal nag po thod pa'i 'phreng ba can gyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dngos gzhi la/ lcam dral gyi rjes gnang lhan cig tu mdzad pa'i lugs la yi ge snga phyi mang du snang ba rnams ni/ slob ma yi dam du bskyed pa la bka' sdod kyi tshul du sku dang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang dang*/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo tsam la thugs kyi rjes gnang du mdzad do/ /'on kyang bla ma'i phyag len 'di ltar mdzad pa mthong ste/ dkar mo nyi zla la sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par mdzad nas thugs gtor dbang gi tshe/ gtor ma lha mor gsal ba spyi bor bzhag pa la/ mos gus dung ba byas pas/ lha mo'i sprul pa phug ron des rang gi nad gdon chags che nyams nga thams cad skad cig la khyer te rgya mtsho'i mthar song bar bsams la/ phug ron gyi gzugs de slob ma la g.yas skor du lan gsum bskor nas phyir gtong*/ de rjes bka' bsgo spyi dang mthun par mdzad/ de'i rjes thogs nyid la/ bdud rgyal la bka' sdod kyi tshul du sku dang gsung gi rjes gnang dang*/ gtor ma lag tu gtad la bka' bsgo ba thugs kyi rjes gnang du mdzad de/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun no/ /sa skya'i ring lugs 'dzin pa kuna~X/ /mos zhen dbang gis dga~X' bar sgrog/snyi~Xng nas mos pa thob dkon na'ang*/ /deng 'dir yid ches brtan po~Xs sbyar/ /dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/

mgon po lcam dral dang rigs mthun gyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te nyer gsum pa'o// //gcig zhus dag/dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rnam dag legs lam ston pa yi/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /bstan pa 'di yi chos skyong ba/ /thun mong min pa'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /'og nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma rgyas pa'am/ dkar gtor chen po bzhi'am/ bzhi sgril gyi gtor ma bsham/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i mchod pa tshar gcig dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i mchod pa ji ltar 'os pa bsham/ yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis gsang ba'i bdag po'am/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can sogs brjod/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dbus su rin po che'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ slar yang mchod bstod tshar gcig byas la snying po cung zad bzlas/ yi dam gzhan gyi mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i tshe 'di mi dgos so/ /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su/ bai las rgyal po rnam thos sras gser mdog nor bus mtshan pa'i be con dang*/ gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku lus sbom zhing rab tu bzhad pa/ g.yas g.yon na gter gyi bum pa dang*/ rin po che'i chu bo 'bab pa/ rin po che'i khri dang seng ge la bzhugs pa/ shar du dh+ri las rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung sku mdog dkar la ljang ba'i mdangs can/ pi wang brdung zhing zhi ba'i tshul/ rin po che'i khri dang glang po'i gdan la gnas pa/ lho ru bi las rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po sku mdog sngo sangs ral gri 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ cung zad khro ba'i nyams can rin po che'i khri dang ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ nub tu k+ṣa la rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang sku mdog dmar po 'dzum pa/

phyag g.yas pas sbrul zhags dang*/ g.yon pas rin po che'i mchod rten 'dzin zhing de la gzigs pa/ spyan dmar zhing lta zer 'bar ba sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i khri dang klu'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan zhing*/ dpa' zhing brjid la bzod par dka' ba'i gzi 'od can rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan zlum po gdangs pa/ rin po che'i ya lad gsol ba/ yid bzhin nor bu'i cod pan dang bcas pa'i ze'u kha la sogs pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi bang rim nas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa bskul zhing spyan drangs par gyur/ rgyas par spro na re re zhing spyan drangs/ mchod bstod/ dam bzhagabazhugs gsol rnams rim pas bya/ bsdu na/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ya/ dh+ri ta raṣ+ta ya/ bi ru ḍha ka ya/ bi ru pak+ṣa ya/ sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ mtshan sngags de nyid la ar+ghaṃ sogs sbyar bas mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa sogs kyis bstod do/ / las kun sgrub pa'i mthu bo che/ /rgyas mdzad ngal gsos po la bstod/ /zhi zhing bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa/ /gnas srung po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yams kun zhi zhing 'chi ba bzlog/dgra 'joms lus 'phags po la'ang bstod/ /sman dang lo tog rgyas mdzad cing*/ /dbang byed mig mi bzang la 'dud/ /ces pa'am/ bsdu na dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' sdod sogs kyis bstod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan te dam la bzhagamatshan sngags kyi mthar pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ slar yang mchod bstod gcig byas la so so'i mtshan sngags sam/ oṃ bai swāhā/ oṃ dh+ri swāhā/ oṃ bi swāhā/ oṃ k+ṣa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla ba dang*/ las re re sgrub pa'i tshe/ zhi ba la swāhā

'i mtha' can dang*/ rgyas pa la na maḥ dang*/ dbang la wa ṣaṭa dang*/ drag po la hūṃ gi mtha' can du byed/ bzhi char cha mnyam du sgrub na/ oṃ bai na maḥbo ṣaṭa/ oṃ dh+ri swāhā oṃ/ oṃ bi ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣa wa ṣaṭa ho/ zhes pa rnams bzla'o/ /gtor ma bdag bskyed dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs la/ mthar re re bzhin sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis rgyas 'debs pa'am/ bsdu na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs re re'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa ṇi gṛ ha ta swāhā/ oṃ ma tha ma tha badz+ra gan+dhar+bha hri da ye swāhā/ oṃ khu khu ṇi ghi ha bā liṃ swāhā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra nā ga badz+ra swāhā/ zhes pa rnams la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis 'khor rnams la phul/ oṃ bha wa khā hi khā hi/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ sarba bhu ta bā liṃ swāhā/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'khor 'byung po spyi la phul/ oṃ sarba a mi shi bh+yaḥ wa ha ri ṇe swāhā/ zhes pas 'chol ba'i rigs rnams la rme gtor sbyin/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu smon lam bkra shis rnams spyi dang 'dra/ lag len gyi snying po 'di kho nas chog la/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ mchod 'phreng*/ bstod pa/ 'phrin bcol rnams rgyas pa la dga' na gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i bka' gtad bya bar 'dod na/ gtor ma rgyas pa'i lugs byed de/ dbus su stegs bu mtho ba la maṇ+ḍal tshom bur bcas pa mchod pas bskor ba zhig bsham/ byang du gtor ma ri rab gling bzhi'i rnam pa can shing thog dang nor snas brgyan pa/ shar du zlum gtor dri sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing*/ khrag sna'i mchod yon can/ lho ru gru gsum nya dang sha khrag can/ nub tu zla gam 'o ma dang me tog can so so'i mtheb kyu mang pos bskor ba/

'byung po spyi'i gtor ma dang*/ rme gtor chang bu'i tshul can kyang bsham/ re re bzhin mchod pa cha tshang re las mi nyung bar byed/ gtor ma'i rtse mo la so so'i tsa ka li rnams 'dzugs/ bgegs gtor btang*/ srung 'khor bsgom/ gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ de nas gong du bshad pa bzhin 'dod don gsol btab yan chad slob dpon gyis rdzogs par sgrubs/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung re 'bogs/ rgyun bshags yan lag bdun pa'ang gang rung re byar bcugaslob ma'i blo ngor mdun bskyed rdzogs par gsal 'debs/ slob ma nyid yi dam gang rung gi ngo bor gsal btab/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas rgyal chen bzhi spyan 'dren pa nas/ mchod bstod/ gdan 'bul/ dam ye bsre ba'i bar gong bzhin/ slob ma'i snying gar yi dam gyi sa bon la snying pos bskor ba/ de'i mthar sngags 'phreng 'khor ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ slob mas phul bar mos te/ gtor ma kha gsos so sor 'bul/ mchod pa'ang kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs la mchod bstod bya/ re re bzhin gtor ma lag tu rim pas gtad la bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang mthun/ dge bsnyen sngags pa ma yin pa'i khyim pa phal ba la byed na/ slob ma yi dam du ma bskyed par gtor ma mgo bor bzhag ste gtor dbang bskur na legs par gsung ste/ spyir de 'dra ba la sngags sby-in pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa min yang*/ yul chos kyi deng sang thams cad byed pa ltar na/ de ltar shis pa yin te/ 'dis gzhan thams cad la'ang rigs

'gre'o/ /yang 'di la bum pa bcas te lha mi bskyed par so so'i sngags bzlas la/ bzlas lung gi sngon du bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/ sngags dbang bskur ba'i tha snyad du mdzad pa'i phyag len yang gda' ba shin tu legs par mngon no/ /des sang mthu dang dpal 'dod kuna~X/ /yul 'dre gdugs can sgrub la dga~X'/ /snyinga~X nas chos 'byor rgyas 'dod na/ /bzang po~X'i lha ni sgrubs shig kye/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la/ /btud nas sngags rig thams cad kyi/ /legs par sgrub la nyer mkho ba'i/ /sgrub thabs cung zad tsam zhig bri/ /bdag nyid gsang sngags nang gi yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed la gnas pas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hūṃ las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor dang*/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su gzhal med khang dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i gdan lnga tshom/ dbus su zla ba la oṃ las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ zhi ba'i nyams ldan/ shar du nyi ma la hūṃ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ khro ba'i nyams ldan/ lho ru zla ba ser po la traṃ las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo rin chen 'byung gnas gyi dbu rgyan can/ dgyes pa'i nyams ldan/ nub tu nyi ma dmar po zer dang bral ba la hrīḥlas pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ chags pa'i nyams ldan/ byang du sna tshogs rdo rje la a las sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ khro zhing bzhad pa sogs nyams sna tshogs pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas cang te 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang bcas pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings su gnas pa/

mchan khung g.yon du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭāṃ ga la rim pa bzhin du 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che pad+ma ral gri rnams kyis mtshan pa/ 'od zer sna lnga 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ rang mtshungs kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo 'bum 'bum dang 'khor mkha' 'gro grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang phyogs mtshams thams cad nas gtso mo ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro grangs med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya g.yab cing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka mahā badz+ra a kar+dha ya/ a kar+dha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya/ ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nāṃ/ hri da yaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan lnga/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.a/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī āḥhri oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhri traṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhri hrīḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī āḥhri a hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ spyi dril gyi sngags ni/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ swā a hā hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa rnams bzlas pa bya'o/ /mchod gtor bdag bskyed dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ phud kyi dang po'i gtor ma/ oṃ shrī he ru ka mahā badz+ra pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā ling hūṃ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis phul/ de nas mkha' 'gro la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ oṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā ling hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ traṃ phaṭa/

oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ hri phaṭa/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ a phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ bā liṃ ho phaṭa/ ces lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ rgyas par na tshigs bcad dang bcas pa dang*/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod rnams phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ / nas/ sangs rgyas rigs su skye zhes pa'i bar brjod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ bdag bsrung smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /gong gi gtor chog de nyid kyis lan brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul ba dang*/ lnga tshan lnga pa'i gtor ma thun bzhir 'bul ba gtor ma brgya pa dang*/ bzhi tshan bcu drug tu 'bul ba dbyu gu'i gtor ma ste/ rgyas pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ dbang drag gi las la bsngags so/ /de dag gi lag len dang*/ las byang gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i gtor dbang ni/ chos 'byung gi dngos su tshom bu lnga bkod/ de'i steng du gtor ma lnga la mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gzugs sam/ sngags byang 'dzugs/ stegs bu mtho ba zhig la phud gtor chung ba zhig bsham/ mchod pa rnams spyi bder bsgrigs nas gong bzhin nyams su blangs pas slob dpon gyi bya ba grub pa yin/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ / sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa'am bdun pa gang rung bya/ slob ma'i snying gar mkha' 'gro sde lnga bskyed cing mchod bstod bya ba'i bar gong bzhin dmigs pa phogade nas gtor ma kha gsos la/ gtor chog bzhin bsngos nas/ gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur ba yin/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ / kun nas nyams chags bskang pa dang*/ /las sgrub gang la'ang shis shing dga~X'/

/sgrub po kun la mkho ba 'di/ /snyinga~X nas brtse ba'i myur po~Xr bris/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sgrub thabs gyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma mchog dang rje btsun ma/ /rnal 'byor ma dpal zhabs btud nas/ /skye bo 'ga' la phan gdags phyir/ /tshe ring mched lnga'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /lhan cig skyes ma la sogs pa gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ swa bhā wa sa snod bcud stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma sku mdog dkar mo 'dzum zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar ba/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dung gi thor tshugs can seng ge dkar mo la chibs pa/ mdun du mthing gi zhal bzang ma sngon mo 'phrul gyi me long dang*/ kha nang du g.yob pa'i ba dan dkar po 'dzin pa/ in+d+ra nī la'i thor tshugs can rkyang bu kha dkar la zhon pa/ g.yas su mi g.yo glang bzang ma ser mo g.yon zas mchog gis gang ba'i snod 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis gzhan la ster ba'i tshul can/ gser gyi thor tshugs can stag mo brus ma la zhon pa/ rgyab tu cod pan mgrin bzang ma dmar mo/ nor bu'i sgrom bu nor sna tshogs kyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ byi ru'i thor tshugs can shwa ba yu mo la zhon pa/ g.yon du gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma ljang khu dur ba'i chun po dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ g.yu'i thor tshugs can g.yu 'brug sngon mo la zhon pa/ gtso 'khor gsum lha mo dang*/ gnyis mi mo'i rnam pa dar dang men tri sna tshogs brtsegs pa'i na bza' can/ gser g.yu sogs rin po che sna tshogs pa'i pho rgyud dang*/ 'gying thod sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/

tshe ring mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngon tshe dur khrod bsil tshal du/ /mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can dang*/ /bar du kha la rong sgo ru/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ /tha ma sman lung chu bar du/ /dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje yi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /mkha' 'gro lnga po gnas 'dir gshegs/ /phyi ltar lha sman chen mo lnga/ /nang ltar zhing skyong mkha' 'gro lnga/ /gsang ltar rigs kyi yum chen lnga/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /e a rall̥ hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ de nas 'dod don gsol btab drag tu bya zhing*/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bca'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na/ /gangs dkar dgung du rtse mtho ba/ /mtho la gnyan no tshe ring ma/ /de la brten pa'i lha mo ni/ /gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /'khor du 'jig rten dman mo bzhi/ /cod pan mgrin bzang ma dang ni/ / mthing gi zhal bzang ma dang bcas/ /mi g.yo glang bzang ma dang ni/ /gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma dang bcas/ /gtso mo 'khor bcas thams cad ni/ /sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po mnga' ba rnams/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /de ring gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /mchod gtor 'di bzhes dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya ḍā ki nī pañtsa ma ma sarba karma sid+dhi dzñā na i daṃ bā liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis 'bul/ hūṃ/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /bal bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams na/ /gangs dkar shel gyi cod pan can/ /phu chu snyan pa'i rgyun sgra can/ /nags la me tog sham bu can/ /g.ya' spang gser g.yu'i sked bcings can/ /gnas mchog de 'dra'i g.yon mgul na/ /dar dkar gur gyi nang shed na/ /sman mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /gdung ba drag pos khyod 'bod na/ /de ring sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /lhab lhub na bza' rgyan dang bcas/ /sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/

/nam mkha'i mthongs nas spyan 'dren na/ /'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ khyod kyi cho dang 'brang smos na/ /yab ni lho lha 'theng po yin/ /yum ni 'brang yum sman gcig ma/ /ming po bdun la sring mo lnga/ /lnga tshigs dbus kyi gtso mo ste/ /zhal bzang zla ba nya gang 'dra/ /lha mo rnams kyang zil gyis gnon/ /mgrin pa gcig la glu rta stong*/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyang zil gyis gnon/ /dbu skra nyag ma re re la/ /g.yu phran stong stong lan tshar bcas/ /na bza' dar dkar go zu gsol/ /nyin gsum gangs dkar rtse la bzhugs/ /sman mo rnams dang lhan cig rol/ /mtshan gsum rgya gar yul du bzhugs/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod du/ /ḍā ki rnams dang tshogs la rol/ khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi rtse phud dang*/ /me tog yid 'ong mdzes pa'i tshal/ /dri zhim phun tshogs bdug spos dang*/ /'od dang dri mchog bshos gtsang dang*/ /sgra snyan gsang ba'i rnge'u chung rnams/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes nas kyang*/ /yid la 'dod pa'i don grub stsol/ /sngon tshe dben gnas yang rdzong du/ /dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje la/ /rang rtags srog gi snying po phul/ /bka' 'bangs bgyid par rtsis la phab/ /dngos grub ster bar g.yar dam bcas/ /de ring mo btsun rgyal mo la/ /ming bos gsol ba 'debs lags na/ /srid bsrung rigs brgyud dngos grub dang*/ /bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub dang*/ /snang gsal pra'i dngos grub dang*/ /rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub dang*/ /rkang bzhi dud 'gro'i dngos grub dang*/ /gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsol/ /gzhan yang gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi lus mdangs bskyed/ /nang gi rlung sems dbang du bsdus/ /phyi'i snang ba dbang du gyis/ /'phrin las thabs kyi bstan pa spel/ /tshe ring dpal bskyed 'khor g.yog skyongs/ /bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo rnams/

/gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes/ /bcol ba'i las kyi 'bras bu de/ /mchis par mdzod cig mthu rtsal can/ / zhes brjod de/ bstod pa mchod 'phreng*/ 'phrin bcol thugs rgyud bskul ba rnams de la tshang ba yin no/ /bzlas pa mi byed na/ der rjes gshegs gsol bya/ bzlas pa byed na/ oṃ ma ma ru ru zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bzlas pa'i mthar/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mkha' 'gro chen mo lnga po ni/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston mdzad pa/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub mdzad ma/ /'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod nas/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas yi dam dang 'di nyid kyi bris sku yod na bkram/ de'i mdun du gtor ma so so'i gangs ri'i gzugs can nam/ zlum gtor bshos bu rtse ring ngam/ 'brang rgyas lnga tshom gyi rnam par byas kyang rung ngo*/ /so so'i tsa ka li yod na'ang 'dzugs/ ras dkar po'i steng 'bras dkar gyi g.yung drung ris zhig bris/ de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma bkod/ 'di nyid kyi sgrub pa'i skabs kyi mchod rdzas rnams 'byor na legs/ min na mchod gtor spyi dang mthun par bsham/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi bdag bskyed nas brtsams/ 'phrin las bcol zhing bskul ba'i bar du byas la/ snying po ci 'grub bzla'o/ /de yang*/ oṃ ma ma ru ru tsit+ta dha ra me dzu ti hūṃ bh+yoḥdzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhi kyai mu ta hūṃ bh+yoḥdzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ya tra sing sing hūṃ bh+yoḥdzaḥ oṃ a wi ra ni hūṃ bh+yoḥdzaḥ oṃ sa ri ting ting kha ti dzña na hūṃ bh+yoḥdzaḥ zhes pa rnams so/ /tshe ring mched lnga gnad la 'bod pa'i srog sngags rnams bzla bar kha cig 'dod kyang*/ slob ma la bka' gtad byed pa'i tshe/ de dag bzla dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan med la/ gnyan cha che zhing mi shes par 'gyur ba'i nyen yod pas mi bzla'o/

/de ltar bzlas pa zin pa'i rjes su bum pa mtshan dang ldan pa bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba kha rgyan can zhig dang*/ g.yas su tshe ril dang*/ g.yon du tshe chang rnams bshams/ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i bum pa'i nang du rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bzhugs par gyur/ de la dmigs te/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wan+tī ye swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ tshe dpag med kyi sku las byung ba'i bdud rtsis bum pa khengs shing chil chil lud pa ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe dzñā na a ma ra ṇi dzī wan+tī ye swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa'am/ nyer gcig tsam bzlas/ tshe ril sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gnas pa/ maṃ aṃ tsaṃ a taṃ zhes pa rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan mang du bzlas/ 'og tu dgos pa'i dbang rdzas so so'i bris sku tsa ka li dang*/ rdo rje/ me long*/ zas mchog gi snod/ nor bus gang ba'i gzhong pa/ rtswa ran pa myu gu dang bcas pa rnams tshang bar byas la/ slob ma rnams la chos bshad dang*/ 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus cung zad bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/

phun tshogs dngos grub ma lus pa/ /myur du thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag la tshe ring mched lnga yi/ /rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod de/ khyed rang rnams skad cig tsam gyis rje btsun ma lhan cig skyes ma sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum skra grol ba/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar gtod pa/ mchan khung du thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi dang mi ro'i gdan la 'gying ba/ gcer bu thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun mi la bzhad pa rdo rje sku sha sngo sangs/ ras dkar gyi shar bu gsol ba/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can skyil krung du bzhugs pa zhig gsal btab zer yang*/ rje btsun bzhad pa dang kho rang gi yi dam dbyer med pa dgyes rdor phag mo gang rung bsgom na legs/ de'i spyi bor bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig bzhugs par mos/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba zhig mos/ de rnams la mos gus dung ba byas pas sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ma lus pa thams cad dang*/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud mi shigs pa thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur bsdus/ phyag gi bdud rtsi'i bum par zhugs/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa gzhir gnas kyi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/

bun chil gyis lud pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs sku lus gang*/ bla ma yi dam mtha' dag gi byin rlabs kyi ngo bo bdud rtsi gsang ba'i sgo nas byung*/ khyed rang rnams dang mdun bskyed lha mo'i lnga'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bar mos par mdzod/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bzhin du/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sku khrus gsol/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi 'i mthar ā yur puṇ+ye dzñā na sid+dhi twaṃ me bha wa hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ bkra shis tshe zan dpal gyi zas/ / zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ maṃ aṃ tsaṃ a taṃ zhes brjod la tshe ril sbyin/ a ma ra ṇi 'i sngags kyis tshe chang sbyin/ de ltar khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur bas dregs pa mtha' dag dbang du 'dus pa'i nus pa thob/ mdun bskyed lha mo lnga la dbang bskur bas dam la gnas shing*/ khyed rang rnams la sems shin du 'dun par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas gtso mo'i gtor ma tsa ka li dang bcas pa'am/ tsa ka li kho na gtad de/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che/ /mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma/ /srid bsrung tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ / zhes bka' bsgos shing*/ dam tshig gi lag sbrel bas dbus kyi lha mo de nyid bzhengs te/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo lhan cig skyes mar gsal ba la gus pa chen pos g.yas skor du bskor ba lan gsum du byas nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lag tu rang rtags gser gyi rdo rje gtad cing dngos grub 'bul bar g.yar dam bcas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ bzhad pa rdo rje'i spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bca' bzhin/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /srid bsrung tshe yi dngos grub 'bul/ /oṃ maṅga la ā yur puṇ+ye a dzi dha ra swāhā/ zhes brjod/ rim pa de kho nas 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre ste/ shar gyi tsa ka li gtad la/

jo mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ / dpal 'bar bkra shis zhes pa nas/ kun rdzogs ma/ /snang gsal pra'i dngos grub stsol/ / zhes dang*/ shar gyi lha mo bzhengs nas/ zhes dang*/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /snang gsal pra'i dngos grub 'bul/ /oṃ aṃ in+d+ra nī la mu kha bha dra a dzi dha ra swāhā/ zhes 'don pa spo zhing*/ me long lag tu gtod pa rnams khyad par ro/ /de bzhin du/ jo mo mi g.yo glang bzang ma/ / zhes dang*/ rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol/ / zhes dang*/ rma g.yang zas= oṃ a a tsa la ha sa a dzi dha ra swāhā/ zhes 'don pa spo zhing*/ lho'i tsa ka li dang zas mchog gi snod gtad/ de bzhin du/ mkha' 'gro cod pan mgrin bzang ma/ zhes dang*/ bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ / zhes dang*/ bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub 'bul/ /oṃ tsa mu ku ṭa ma dhu ra bha dra a dzi dha ra swāhā/ nub kyi tsa ka li dang nor gzhong gtad/ de bzhin du/ lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma/ / zhes dang*/ rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol/ / zhes dang*/ rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i dngos grub 'bul/ oṃ taṃ gtad bha wa dza gad bha dra a dzi dha ra swāhā/ byang gi tsa ka li dang ran pa'i chun po gtad/ de nas gtor ma lag tu gtad la/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// zhes pa nas/ de ring gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ /slob bu 'di yi phyi bzhin 'brongs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen sol/ /spyi dang khyad par dngos grub stsol/ /bcol ba'i las rnams thams cad sgrubs/ / zhes bka' bsgo byas pa'i mthar/ oṃ ma ma ru ru sogs snying po mang du bzla/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i gtor chog gi tshig cha rnams 'di las bsdus par sbyar kyang rung zhing*/ 'di las ches mang por spel ba ni/ tshegs che ba ma gtogs don med pa'i phyir mi dgos la/ tshigs bcad kyang phyis kyi mkhas par grags pas sbyar ba'i legs legs ltar snang ba rnams las/

'di rnams kho na snang srid kyi dam can mgu ba'i nus pa che ba yin la/ 'di dag 'jig rten dregs pa pho mo'i bka' gtad kyi lugs yin pas zab pa ltar bcos pa'i dmigs pa dang cho ga'i khyad par gzhan mang po spel ba la dgos pa gcig kyang med do/ /de nas 'di'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub pa dang*/ spyi dang so so'i las tshogs la zhib mor nges pa zhig don du gnyer na rung gi gtor chog dang bka' gtad kyi cho ga 'di tsam kho nas chog par shes par bya'o/ /kuna~X las zab mor bya'o zhes/ /dga~X' bar bsngags pa'i yi ge yang*/ /mang mod dal ba'i rgyur shes nas/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig sbyar ba lags/ /tshe ring mched lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ tha mar dge ba'i don du nyer mkho'i sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig bshad pa'i skabs te nyer bzhi pa'o// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sgrub thabs kun las btus pa rin po che'i 'byung gnas kyi brgyud yigadakon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrub thabs sna tshogs dpag par dka' ba ni/ /dam pa 'ga' yis phyogs bcur 'gyed mdzad la/ /slar yang gzhan 'gas kun las gcig tu bsdus/ /mang thos skyes mchog 'ga' las dngos kyis 'khums/ /de ltar gyi slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i lugs kyi/ sgrol dkar gyi ring brgyud ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag gi dbang phyugagaser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ 'chad ka ba/ skyer sgang ba/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon tshul/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/ 'dul 'dzin nyi ma/ mchims blo bzang ba/ gro ston kun rgyal/ mkhan chen grub she/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen rin po che shākya mchog ldan/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchogayang sgam po lugs ltar na/ kar lugs gcig kyang thob mod kyi/ 'dir dgon pa pa/

spyan snga ba/ sgre ba sle nagasgam po pa/ rmog lcog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ sprul sku rin chen blo gros/ bla ma kun 'od pa/ gshen sgom sangs rgyas dar/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal pa/ chos sku shākya rin chen/ kun bzang ngag dbang blo gros/ rgya sgom legs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /nye brgyud paṇa chen nags rin lugs ltar na/ sgrol ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchoga'ajam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan no/ /ba ri lugs la/ sgrol ma/ dze tā re/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lo ts+tsha ba sa chen sogs 'og gi thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra/ gnyan lugs la/ ngag gi dbang phyug 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo/ kha'u pa chos rgyal mtshan/ kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun grags pa/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ ston pa pad+ma seng ge dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ yar lung pa seng rgyal/ rong chen/ legs pa'i shes rab/ yig drug sher dpal/ rje grol mchog sogs so/ /༈ dbyangs can ma dkar mo'i ring brgyud ni/ lha ma he shwa ra/ mkhar ba'i mgar ba/ bram ze shi ku/ gtum po'i sde/ nyi ma seng ge dpe med mtsho/ rgya mtsho chen po/ sum pa lots+tsha ba/ bzang ring*/ bo dong rin rtse/ stag sde pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ spang lo/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen grags rgyal/ paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po shākya mchog ldan/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rje dbon shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i drung du bdag gis mnos so/ /nye brgyud ni/ lha mo dbyangs can mas bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal nyid la gnang ba yin no/

/༈ gnyan sgrol la/ sgrol ma/ gnyan lo ts+tsha ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa/ sa paṇa/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi ba grags pa gzhon nu/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/ bla ma shes rab rdo rje/ rgyal bzang ba/ byang seng ba/ shar chen ye rgyal/ ngor pa rdo rje 'chang*/ de nas rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ byang sems kun dga' mchog grub bam/ yang na/ mus chen/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ de nas rje btsun grol mchogarje rdo rings pa dang*/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ de gnyis kas bdag la'o/ /ku ru kul+le'i brgyud pa ni/ ku ru kul+le/ rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ gong ma lnga/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan ba kun bsod/ nam za brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ de nas theg chen chos rje/ spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen chos rje'am/ yang na/ byang seng ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ chu mig bdag chen/ paṇa chen chos rje/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ rje btsun grol mchogarje kun dga' rgyal mtshan no/ /༈ 'dod rgyal la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje gdan pa/ spa wī ra/ ba ri ba/ lugs lcags thang pa/ gong ma lnga/ gzhon nu 'bum/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ spang ston pa/ sher rgyam pa/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang*/ rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen man ku ru kul+le bzhin/ /༈ tshogs bdag dmar chen la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phag mo/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha wā ri/ had du dkar po/ mal lo/ sa chen sogs gong ma bzhi/ skyob pa dpal/ rong ba sher seng*/ bag ston pa/ tshul rgyal ba/ ngag dbang pa man chad 'dod rgyal bzhin/

/༈ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung la/ jo bo rje/ dgon pa ba/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa nas grub she'i bar sgrol dkar jo bo lugs dang 'dra/ sgra pa saṅgha shrī/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhan chen kun rgyal ba/ lha chung ba/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ thub pa rdo rje gdan la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha/ sa skya gong ma bzhi/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs kyi dpal pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs 'od pa/ rje btsun grol mchogarje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ a bh+ya ka ra/ shu bha ka ra gub+ta/ legs spyod 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ go tam shrī/ kirti tsan+d+ra/ shud ke lots+tsha ba grags rgyal/ rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ bka' bcu pa gzhon seng*/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ ru pa bka' bzhi pa/ spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje/ paṇa chen rin po che man thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gnas bcu la/ dge bsnyen dharma hā la/ jo bo rje/ rnam rdzun paṇ+ḍi ta/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ pu to ba/ shar ba pa/ 'chang ka pa/ se spyil bu pa/ lha spyil bu pa/ snye mo lhas pa/ grub thob hūṃ 'bar/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ ze'u grags brtson/ ze'u grags she /mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ spang ston grub pa shes rab/ mkhan chen dpal ldan don grub/ rwa ston yon tan dpal bzang*/ rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog/mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /yang lo pa spyan snga nas brgyud pa stag lung rin po che'i drung du yang mnos so/

/༈ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i shag thub la/ thub pa'i dbang po/ jo bo rje/ dgon pa ba/ sne zur ba/ glang thang pa/ zhang gzhung pa/ mus sman pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims/ skyo man chad gnas bcu bzhin/ /༈ sman bla'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ khri srong lde btsan/ mu ni btsan po/ sad na legs/ khri ral/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ 'od srungs/ dpal 'khor btsan/ skyid lde nyi ma mgon/ bkra shis lde/ ye shes 'od/ byang chub 'od/ 'od lde/ rtse lde/ snar byang tshul/ zhu sher grags/ za ra ba dar ma rgyal mtshan/ gro mo che ba/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims/ bsod nams ye shes/ bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras chos rdzong pa/ mang mkhar ba tshul dpal/ sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchoga'ajam dbyangs sher rgyam/ rwa ston pa/ byang sems kun mchogarje grol mchogastag lung rin po khu dbon/ des bdag la'o/ /'di yang yo ba spyan snga phyogs nas brgyud pa ded kyang chog/༈ klu dbang rgyal po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang rgyal po/ jo bo/ 'brom/ pu to ba/ shar ba pa/ gtum ston pa/ rdo ston pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos bla/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims chen/ dpal ldings pa/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa/ bla ma rgya gar rgyal mtshan/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen rong po/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje rdo ring ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ bka' bcu pa gzhon seng yan chad dam tshig gsum bkod lha lnga dang 'dra/ de nas/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ spang ston grub she/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhan chen bzod pa dpal grub/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon lha chung ba ye shes rin chen/ mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje lhan skyes la/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ rā hu la shrī/ bi ma la shrī/

bi khyā ta de ba/ bud+dha shrī/ khro phu lots+tsha ba/ mkhan po bsod nams dbang phyugakhro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros/ spyang lung chen po/ paṇa chen rin po che/ byang sems shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mahā mā ya gtso rkyang la/ he ru ka mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ dharma pa/ bya da la/ a si ta gha na/ ra ti gup+ta/ shān+ti gup+ta/ grub chen bud+dha nā tha/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bde mchod lhan skyes la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dga' rab rdo rje/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri pa/ sa skya gong ma bzhi/ lung phu ba/ sems cher ba gzhon nu grub/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rgyal sras pa/ nyan po ba dpal rin/ ma ṇi ba legs rgyal/ 'phags mchog grags pa bsod nams/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ go cha'i dpa' bo drug dang*/ dpa' mo drug la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ til+li pa/ na ro pa/ pradzñā rak+ṣi ta/ su ma ti kirti/ mal lo blo gros grags/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ mang mkhar lo ts+tsha ba/ dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ dpal ldan bla ma/ byang chub seng ge /shar pa/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ blo bo mkhan chen/ rje btsun grol mchog/rjes sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bde mchog dkar po la/ bde mchogaphag mo/ kha che paṇa chen/ dpyal lo ts+tsha ba chos kyi dpal bzang po/ g.yag sde lo ts+tsha ba/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ byang sems bsod nams grags/ mkhan chen grags tshul ba/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang pa/ mkhan chen bsod rin/ mkhan chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel/ rab gsal zla ba mgon po/

rje btsun grol mchogarje rdo rings pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyi brgyud pa'ang de kho na'o/ /༈ bde mchog spyan ras gzigs la/ spyan ras gzigs/ mi tra dzo gi khro phu lots+tsha ba man chad gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ kyai rdor lhan skyes kyi brgyud pa'ang bde mchog lhan skyes dang 'dra'o/ /༈ dus 'khor lhan skyes ni gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes dang 'dra'o/ /༈ khro bo rdo rje shugs srung ma drug cur bcas pa'i rjes gnang la/ dus 'khor 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa bzhin ded kyang choga.a bha ya/ legs spyod/ ā nan+da/ rin chen srung ba/ bi bhu ti tsan+d+ra/ mar ston g.yang 'bar/ kun spangs chen po thugs brtson/ byang sems rgyal ye/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ jo nang kun mkhyen chen po/ 'ga' rong ba lha'i rgyal mtshan/ rje btson pa ba/ bdag chen rnam rgyal grags pa/ shangs ston kun dga' dpal ldan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje sher bkras pa/ rje grol mchogamakhan rin po che/

de nas rje tā ra nā tha/ rin chen rgya mtsho/ blo gros rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang phrin las/ kun bzang dbang po/ kun dga' rnam rgyal/ ta go'u bla ma 'phrin las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po gtsang dben sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ des khran klu sgrub rgya mtsho la'o£© des bdag la'o/ /༈ gshed dmar lhan skyes la/ gshin rje gshed/ bi rū pa/ bir ḍi pa/ blo gros bzang po/ dā rban ā tsar+ya/ blo bo lots+tsha ba/ thugs sras sa pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ blo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ mkhan chen shes rab seng ge slob dpon tshul rgyal ba/ spang ston grub she rje sher rgyam pa/ rwa ston pa/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchogarje btsun rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rab tu bsdus pa'i 'jigs byed la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rnal 'byor ma/ nag po spyod pa/ ban+dhe pa/ til+li ba/ nā ro pa/ pra dzñā rak+ṣi ta/ me dza gling ba/ rwa lo rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge /rwa 'bum seng*/ chos rje sga lo/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ chos dbyings rdo rje/ brtson 'grus seng ge /chos kyi bkra shis/ shes rab seng ge kun dga' seng ge chos kyi seng ge 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ bla ba steng pa phur pa skyabs/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ na ro mkha' spyod la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ ḍeṃ gi ba/ an dhar ba/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing*/ mal lo/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa' la rdo ring pa'am/ yang na paṇa chen/ spyang lung ba gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchogardo rje ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dpyal lugs phag mo zhal gnyis ma la/ rdo rje phag mo/ lcam lak+ṣ+miṃ ka ra/ birba pa/ a wa dhū tī pa/ ljong ngar ba/ bsod snyoms pa rgyal bas byin/ bsod snyoms pa sangs rgyas byin/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/

ha du dkar po/ zhes kyang grags pa ba ren+d+ra ru tse/ dpyal lo kun dga' rdo rje/ skyi dkon mchog 'bar/ rje rgyal tsha rin po che/ khro phu lo ts+tsha ba/ bla chen bsod dbang*/ khro phu bsod nams seng ge yang rtse ba/ bu ston chen po/ pan brag nag pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ spos khang pa/ de rjes mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na sogs brgyud pa'ang yod mod/ dpal ri ba chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab pa/ zha lu lots+tsha ba chos skyong bzang po/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ rje brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'di la grub thob za ra ston pa dang*/ gser sdengs ba yab sras nas brgyud pa dang*/ gtsang yag rdo rje nas brgyud pa'ang yod la/ yang na/ dpyal lo'i rjes su/ dpyal kun dga' grags pa/ dpyal chos bzang rong pa rga lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ bag ston pa/ thar pa bde rgyas pa don yod rdo rje/ spos khang pa man chad sngar bzhin nam/ yang na bag ston pa/ tshul rgyal ba/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta/ blo bo mkhan chen/ rje grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mai tri mkha' spyod la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ blo gros rin po che/ sha wa ri/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badz+ra/ dza ya s+ya na/ sum pa lots+tsha ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang*/ brag phug pa/ ri khrod blo brtan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rab gsal zla mgon/ rje btsun grol mchogardo rje ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ in+d+ra mkha' spyod la/ phag mo/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lak+ṣiṃ ka ra nas ha du dkar po'i bar dpyal lugs dang 'dra/ de nas bal po ye shes rdo rje/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod rtse/ rje btsun grags rgyal man mai tri dang 'dra/ /༈ phag mo don grub ma dang*/ dbu bcad ma gnyis kyang zhal gnyis ma dpyal lugs dang 'dra'o/

/༈ phag mo gnam zhabs la/ phag mo/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ pad+ma badz+ra/ bha ro phyag rdum/ rwa lots+tsha ba rdo rje grags pa nas/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros kyi bar 'jigs byed bsdus pa dang 'dra ba las/ rong pa rga lo'i tshab tu gru gu mkhar nag 'juga'ajam dbyangs blo gros/ rje tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ drung don grub legs pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phag mo kurma pa tī'i lugs la/ sha wa ri/ mai tri pa/ na ya ka pa/ da sha bā la shrī/ bi khyā ta de ba/ shākya shrī/ da na shī la/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ bla brang pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ shes rab dpal/ legs ldan 'od/ rje btsun dpal chen/ ye shes dpal bzang*/ blo bzang dpal 'byor/ rin chen chos rgyal ba/ rdo rings kun spangs pa/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rje btsun ma dpal 'dzin gyi lugs su grags pa la/ rdo rje phag mo/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ blo gros bzang po/ bi ma la shrī/ niska laṅga shrī/ bud+dha shrī/ khro phu lots+tsha ba man chad gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ go zlog lhan cig skyes ma la/ rdo rje phag mo/ sa ra ha/ sha wa ri pa/ bi khyā ta de ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ spo ma brag pa/ karma pag shi/ u rgyan pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ sha grags seng*/ rtogs ldan dar rgyas/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ chos dpal ye shes/ dpal 'byor don grub/ skyabs lce 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ tre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho/ chos sku nam mkha' rin chen/ rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phag mo khros nag la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ bir+wa pa/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ dam pa kun dga'/ rje mang mkhar ba/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung pa/ sku yal ba/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ u rgyan mgon po/ yon tan 'od zer/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ rin chen bzang po/ chos dpal bzang po/

bsod nams bkra shis/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phag dkar la ring brgyud ni/ phag mo/ koṅga dat+ta/ a bha ya/ legs spyod/ rin chen srung ba/ chag chos rje dpal/ go lung ba mdo sde dpal/ shongs ston rdor rgyal/ lo mchog/blo brtan gsum pa/ sa bzang ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ yon tan dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen dpal ldan tshul khrims/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rnal 'byor ma/ sha wa ri/ nags kyi rin chen/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang grags pa/ paṇa chen dpal ldan tshul khrims man chad gong bzhin nam/ rje lha dbang grags pa'i drung du yang thob/ /༈ spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa jo bo lugs la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ grub thob ra hū la/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rong ba phyag sor ba/ ba yu ba/ lce sgom nag po/ skyer sgang ba/ gnyan ston pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ shangs ston/ khyung po tshul mgon/ ri khrod ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom legs rgyal/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan rgyal sras rin po che nas ngor chen sogs dang*/ brag dkar sems dpa' nas brgyud pa zhig kyang rje rdo rings pa la thob bo/ /༈ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs la/ spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo rje man chad lha bzhi'i thub pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs la/ spyan ras gzigs/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu/ paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes bzang po/ bal po be nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub chen nyi phug pa/ spru pa rdo rje rgyal po/ zhang ston dgra 'jigs/ mkhan chen rtse 'dul ba/ mkhan chen ldog lhod ba/

byang sems chu bzang ba/ rin po ches shes rab 'bum pa/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ gnyag chen bsod dbang*/ gnyag dbon bsod nams bzang po/ 'phags mchog bsod nams dang*/ 'phags pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ ma ṇi pa grags pa bsod nams/ byang sems kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchogayang na/ rgyal sras pa/ kun spangs chos rin/ byang sems bsod nams rin chen/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ de gnyis char la rje rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ don zhags lha lnga ba ri lugs su grags pa la/ spyan ras gzigs/ shī la ā ka ra/ be ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ e ra ba ti/ rigs ngan rnal 'byor pa/ don yod rdo rje/ dharma ka pā la/ bsod snyoms pa chen po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri pa/ lho ba yab sras/ mkhan thang pa/ phag lung pa gsum po gang rigs/ de nas nyi phug pa/ brang po lung pa/ bla chen/ mchims chen/ bsod nams ye shes/ ka bzhi pa grags gzhon/ byang sems bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras rin po che man chad bcu gcig zhal dpal mo lugs dang 'dra/ /༈ don zhags ser po la/ brgyud pa ni thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra'o/ / gsung na yang*/ phal cher don zhags dkyus ma dang 'dra bar sems so/ /༈ don zhags kha che paṇa chen lugs ni/ don yod zhags pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ lo ts+tsha ba rab mchog dpal/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi grags gzhon/ byang sems bsod grags/ rgyal sras thogs med/ kun spangs chos rin/ byang sems bsod rin/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rin chen/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ kha sar pa ṇi lha lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ a nu pā ma rak+ṣi ta/ dpal 'dzin/ 'od byed 'byung gnas/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ ra wi shrī/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ mi dbang blo/ phyogs grol/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ legs skyes/ sangs rgyas dbyangs/ paṇa chen nags rin/ gong ma kun legs pa/ rin po che blo gros don mchogaspangs pa dkon mchog rgyal po/

mkhan rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ yid bzhin nor bu lha lnga la/ thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra ba las/ thog mar jo bo rje/ dgon pa ba/ ba ri ba zhes sbyar ro/ /༈ spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso la/ kha sar pa ṇi/ blo gros rin chen/ til+li ba/ rnyog med dpal/ mi tra dzo gi khro phu lots+tsha ba/ bsod dbang*/ sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba/ bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras lo ts+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab mchog grub/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ rje btsun grol mchogarje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mi tra dzo gi'i lugs kyi gsang sgrub la/ spyan ras gzigs/ mi tra dzo gi/ khro lo don mo ri pa/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ khri mda' zhabs rjen pa/ yon tan 'od zer/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ don grub rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ bsod nams bkra shis/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ spyan ras gzigs nam mkha' rgyal po la/ bka' ma'i brgyud pa man chad kyang brgyud yig ma rnyed/ gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs srong btsan sgam po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ khri srong lde btsan/ grub thob dngos grub/ mnga' bdag myang ral pa can/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ shākya bzang po/ dge ba 'bum/ lha ma ye shes mchogachu sgom pa/ mtha' bzhi bya bral/ tshul chen bsod nams seng ge bla ma bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ chu rag pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'phags mchog nor bzang*/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ sten sna ba ngag dbang grags pa/ byang sems sher dpal/ rje btsun grol mchogarje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo rje/ dgon pa ba/ sne zur ba/ snyug rum pa/ dwags po lha rje/

'bab rong pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba/ sangs rgyas yar byon man chad gsang sgrub kyi skabs dang 'dra/ /༈ de rjes spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal 'jigs pa brgyad skyob jo bo'i man ngag kyang jo bo yan chad kyi brgyud pa gsal kha med la/ de phyi chad yid bzhin 'khor lo dang 'dra bar bzhed do/ /༈ spyan ras gzigs rdo rje snying po la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ mi tra dzo gi khro phu lots+tsha ba man chad gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ 'phags pa seng ge sgra la/ spyan ras gzigs/ gser gling ba/ shrad+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin bzang*/ brag steng ba yon tshul/ yang tsan+d+ra go mi'i slob ma gcig la nā ro pas gsan/ de nas pham thing pa/ me dza gling pa/ a thul badz+ra/ de gnyis char la mal los gsan/ de nas sa chen/ gnyan phu chung ba/ rje btsun chen po/ sa paṇa/ shar pa sher 'byung*/ shar pa ye rin pa/ kun dga' byang chub/ mkhan po rgyal bzang*/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ sher rgya ma/ rwa ston/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchogade nas mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang*/ rje rdo ring pa gnyis char la bdag gis thos so/ /༈ rgyal ba rgya mtsho la/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti pu pa/ ras chung pa/ zangs ri ras pa/ rje dbu se/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ spom brag pa nas/ gu shrī dpal 'byor don grub kyi bar go bzlog lhan skyes ma dang 'dra/ de nas rje chos grags rgya mtsho/ gnyan pa bkra shis dpal 'byor/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje/ chos rje dkon mchog yan lagarje dbang phyug rdo rje/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi sgrol ma ni/ jo bo rjes sgrol ma nyid la gsan/ gzhan lha bzhi'i thub pa dang 'dra/ /༈ sgrol ljang kha che paṇa chen lugs la/ ring brgyud thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen sogs las brgyud pa yin mod kyi/

gtso bor sgrol ma nyid la paṇa chen gyis gsan/ de nas sa paṇa la brgyud pa lung ma gtogs ma thob/ khro phu lo ts+tsha ba nas brgyud pa ni/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa lhan skyes skabs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ sgrol dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs la/ sgrol ma/ paṇa chen/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa/ bsod nams grags/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ shair rgya ma/ rwa ston pa/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro ni/ sgrol ma/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen man chad thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra/ /༈ u rgyan sgrol ma la/ rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i lung skor ni/ sgrol ma/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje ldan ma/ grub thob pa ra he ta/ bin te bha dra/ saṅgha ma shrī sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ lots+tsha ba shākya rdo rje/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ 'phags pa rin po che/ byang stag lung pa maṅga la gu ru/ rat+na gu ru/ rat+na ka ra/ bkra shis dpal brtsegs/ byang chub rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang grags pa/ tshul khrims mchog grub/ rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rjes gnang gi 'chad 'gyur sgrol ma dmar mo dang 'dra ba las/ 'phags pa la sangs rgyas dbon gyis gsan pa'o/ /༈ sgrol ma yid bzhin nor bu la/ sgrol ma/ a bha ya/ su tsa ri ta/ ā nan+da ka ra gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ lots+tsha ba grags pa dpal bzang*/ mkhan chen byang chub dpa' ba man chad don zhags kha che paṇa chen lugs dang 'dra/ /༈ sgrol ma dmar mo sa lugs la/ sgrol ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ 'jigs med lha/ su na ya shrī/ gnyan lo/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ stag lung chos rje bkra shis bla ma man chad u rgyan sgrol ma dang 'dra ba'am/ yang sa chen/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba man chad gong du bshad pa'i phag mo khros nag dang 'dra bar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /༈ de nas sgrol ma nor sbyin ma/

sgrol ser gtso 'khor gsum pa/ rmi lam sgrol ma gsum ni/ sgrol ma/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i skabs bzhin/ /༈ sgrol ma lha lnga ni/ klu sgrub dang tsan+d+ra go mi so so nas brgyud pa slob dpon shān+ti pas gsan/ de nas jo bo rje man chad spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo dang 'dra'o/ /༈ phyag brgyad sgrol ma ni/ bka' gdams lha bzhi dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ka pa li tā ra dang*/ tsun+da tā ra gnyis ni/ sgrol ma/ te lo pa/ na ro pa/ dā byang chub sems dpa'/ 'jim lots+tsha ba/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa man chad phag mo nag mo dang 'dra/ /༈ phyag na rdo rje u tsa la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ pad+ma badz+ra/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ rā dza dharma/ zangs gling pa/ 'kham pa a seng*/ zhang ston dkon mchogaru smon mkhar ba/ skyi ston ru zhing*/ dkon mchog blo gros/ bla ma chos grags/ e pa 'khon ston/ lo mchog pa/ bla ma rgyal 'od/ slob dpon smra seng*/ byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta/ rwa ston pa/ rje btsun grol mchog/de nas rje rdo ring ba dang*/ mkhan chen rin po che gnyis char la bdag gis mnos so/ /༈ gzungs las 'byung ba'i gos sngon la/ mkha' 'gro ma/ a wa dhū tī pa/ jo bo rje/ gyar zhu ba/ de la bla ma sa skya ba chen pos gsan/ de nas gong ma bzhi/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla chen bsod blo/ theg chen chos rje/ bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ yig drug pa shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang 'di la/ phyag na rdo rje/ jo bo man chad bka' gdams lha bzhi ltar ded kyang chog go /༈ phyag na rdo rje ba ri lugs ni/ thub pa rdo rje gdan dang 'dra'o/ /༈ phyag na rdo rje gtum chen bsrung ba'i mkhar ni/ gsang bdagaslob dpon las kyi rdo rje/ shing lo pa/ thang lo pa/ kar+ṇa pa/

ba la tsan+d+ra/ ras chung pa/ bur sgom/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ sku yal ba/ yar byon pa/ sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ u rgyan mgon po/ rgyal ba'i mtshan can/ rat+na ka ra/ grags pa'i mtshan can/ mi g.yo mgon po/ kun spangs grags pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyugapad+ma rgyal po/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis khu dbon/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phyag na rdo rje gtum chung yang brgyud pa de nyid las 'ongs shing*/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis kyi drung du thob/ /༈ gtum po dmar po ni/ slob dpon pad+ma/ grwa pa mngon shes/ bur ba bsod rin/ sgom chen smon lam 'bar/ gung chung ston pa/ sha mi sgom chen/ dol pa badz+ra pā ṇi/ rgya byang chub sems dpa'/ brag kar sman bla/ dkon mchog gzhon nu/ mang mkhar tshul gzhon/ mkhas grub chos dpal bzang po/ bla ma sangs rin pa/ chos rje kun dga' seng ge nas sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i bar 'jigs byed bsdus pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ phyag rdor 'gro bzang ma la/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ bh+ri ka ra wa ta/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ g.yor po jo ston/ sbal ti dgra bcom pa/ mkhan chen shes rab seng ge bsam yas pa tshul khrims dbang phyugase ba can pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan chen ka bzhi pa blo gros bzang po/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rje dbon shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' grol mchogastag lung rin po che khu dbon gnyis char la dngos kyis nos/ yang na g.yor po jo ston/ spu ston bsod nams rin chen/ 'jid khu ba pad+ma bkra shis/ stag pa jo bzang*/ khro lo/ bsod nams dbang phyugabasod nams seng ge rin chen seng ge bu ston chos kyi rgyal po/ stag lung lots+tsha ba shākya bzang po/ bla chen mañdzu shrī/ ngag dbang grags pa nas paṇa chen rin po che'am/

yang na slob dpon tshul mchog pa/ rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ slob dpon rnam rgyal rin chen/ stag lung rin po che/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal la dngos kyis zhus/ mkhan chen rin po che la jo gdan tshogs pa nas brgyud pa'ang thob mod kyi/ brgyud rim zhu ba ma byung ngo*/ /༈ phyag rdor khang brtsegs ma ni/ slob dpon pad+ma/ grwa pa mngon shes/ phur pa bsod rin/ nye gnas ga dran nag po/ sgom chen smon 'bar nas sangs rin gyi bar gtum po dmar po dang 'dra/ de nas paṇa chen yid bzang rtse ba/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba rin chen rgyal mchogarje btsun grol mchogamakhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'byung 'dul la/ sangs rgyas/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ dkar po rnam gsum/ mchims chos seng*/ 'jam :bsang

（ gsar/ rga lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ bag ston pa/ tshul rgyal ba/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /nye brgyud me dbang ma ni/ gsang bdagadwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal/ paṇa chen rin po che/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rta mgrin jo bo lugs lhan skyes dang*/ rta mgrin chen mo khyung gshog can gnyis la/ thugs rje chen po/ jo bo rje/ yon ston sku mched/ grub thob rin chen smon lam/ rin chen lam pa/ lha chen ye shes 'od/ legs pa'i shes rab/ byang chub rin chen/ byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen bsam rin/ mkhan chen byang sems/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ byang phug pa kun legs/ sems dpa' bsod nams rin chen/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor la/ rta mgrin/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho/ wal pa chen po/ rgya lcags ri ba/ sgam po ba/ 'bab rong pa/ stag lung thang pa nas rje kun dga' bkra shis kyi bar phyag rdor gtum chung dang 'dra ba dang*/ rje sgam po ba dang*/ dus gsum mkhyen pa nas kar lugs kho na ded pa'ang stag lung rin po che dbon gyi drung du thob/ /༈ rta mgrin kha che paṇa chen lugs la/ paṇa chen yan chad gsal kha med/ paṇa chen nas/ khro phu lots+tsha ba/ de man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ spyan ras gzigs/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ skyer sgang pa man chad/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa jo bo lugs dang 'dra ste/ shangs chos kyi bla ma brgyud pa nyid ded pa'o/ /༈ lcags ral can la/ slob dpon pad+ma/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zhang skyi tsha 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar pa/ zhang lo mya ngan med/ lce blo ldan seng ge 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho/ bu ston chen po/ thog ston mthu chen/

thog ston rdo rje kun grub/ kun mkhyen don yod dpal ba/ yig drug sher dpal/ rje grol mchogayang na/ paṇa chen rin po che/ sems dpa' chen po/ brgyud pa gnyis kar bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs la/ dze tā ri nas/ gong ma lnga'i bar ba ri'i phyogs spyi dang 'dra ba las/ de nas zhang*/ brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ kha char byang chub sems dpa'/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /de'i chu bsrung gi brgyud pa ni/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ mkhan chen/ rje grol mchogarje rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mi g.yo ba sngon po bka' gdams lugs ni lha bzhi'i nang tshan yin te/ thub pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ mi g.yo ba dkar po la/ mi g.yo ba/ 'od byed 'byung gnas/ bi khyā ta/ shākya shrī/ dan shrī/ 'dul 'dzin byang sems/ lung gi dbang phyugayon tan khri/ rgyal tshab 'jigs med grags/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen g.yag pa/ kun mkhyen rong ston/ rje don yod dpal/ de la byang sems sher dpal lam/ yang na/ paṇa chen rin po che/ shangs ston/ rje don yod grub pa brgyud kyang rung*/ rje btsun grol mchog/rje rdo ring pa dang*/ mkhan chen rin po che gnyis char la bdag gis mnos/ /༈ mi g.yo phyag bzhi pa ni/ mi g.yo ba/ dan shrī/ 'jim lo/ mkhan btsun dge stag pa/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ sa paṇa khu dbon/ stag lung sangs rgyas dbon/ grags pa dpal man chad phyag rdor gtum chung dang 'dra'o/ /༈ mi g.yo zhabs bzhi pa la/ mi g.yo ba/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ kha che'i dge slong ya mā ri zhal gzigs/ dge tshul mi g.yo zhal gzigs/ mnga' ris dharmā shrī la/ dharmā dī bya/ dge bshes gtso bo/ /skyur a skyabs/ sa skya pa dkar po rnam gsum/ sa paṇa/ stag lung sangs rgyas dbon man chad gtum chung bzhin// ༈ mi g.yo spre'u brgyad ma la/

dze tā ri nas/ ba ri ba phyogs brgyud pa'i yi ge yang 'dug la/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ kan ka warma/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ zhang thang sag pa/ stag lung du byon pa'i sangs rgyas sgom pa/ sku yal ba/ yar byon pa man gtum chung dang 'dra'o/ /༈ tshe dpag med sprul sku la/ tshe dpag med/ grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ras chung ba/ bur sgom/ phag gru/ thang pa/ rin chen mgon po/ rin chen bla ma/ sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ ldong gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ye bzang pa/ rgyal bzang pa/ bsod nams rin chen/ don grub rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ mkhar drung*/ rje mtsho skyes pa/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ tshe dpag med ba ri lugs la/ dze tā ri nas 'phags pa'i bar ba ri'i chos skor spyi dang 'dra ba las/ de nas stag lung sangs rgyas dbon man chad gong bzhin/ /༈ tshe dpag med dkar po phyag bzhi pa yang tshe dpag med sprul sku dang 'dra'o/ /༈ tshe dpag med dkar po mi tra lugs ni/ mkha' 'gro ma de ba ḍā ki mi tra dzo gi /bud+dha shrī/ chag lo dgra bcom/ te'u pa :dar （《dzaṃ》 rang ） 'byung*/ chag nyi ma dpal/ bla brang pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ blo gros dpal/ bzang po dpal/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams dpal 'byor/ rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ chos rje nam sa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen dag pa/ rje btsun grol mchog mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rnam rgyal lha dgu la/ thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med mched/ bha bya kirti/ shi la ā ka ra ma ti/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ zhang*/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ kaṃ dgon pa/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje rdo ring pa'am/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'am/ bla ma dam pa'i rjes su/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ blo ba mkhan chen/ rje grol mchog brgyud kyang chogarje rdo ring pa dang*/

mkhan chen rin po che gnyis char la bdag gis thob bo/ /༈ 'chi med rdo rje lha mo la go cha'i dpa' bo yab yum 'dra ba las/ rje grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'jam dkar la/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ khro lo/ bsod nams dbang phyugasems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros/ spyang lung pa chen po/ paṇa chen rin po che/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun grol mchog de nyid kyi zhal slob mang po las thos mod kyi/ mkhan chen rin po che 'dir bgrang ngo*/ /༈ a ra pa tsa na dmar ser la/ dze tā ri nas sa paṇa bar ba ri lugs spyi dang 'dra/ de nas rong pa rga lo/ sras a ka ra/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchogarje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub la/ 'jam dbyangs/ rdo rje mtshon cha/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rngog lo chen po/ khyung rin chen grags/ rgya dmar ba/ phya pa/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge dan 'bag pa dar seng*/ gnyal zhigabazang rings dar ma tshul khrims/ gra thang pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yang rtse ba rin seng*/ bu ston chen po/ thugs sras lo ts+tsha ba/ bkra shis rin chen pa/ kun mkhyen dga' gdong pa/ paṇa chen chos rje/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun grol mchogarje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'jam dpal smra seng la/ sangs rgyas/ drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta/ bram ze rigs byed gzhon nu/ dbyangs can bzang po/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ dam pa kun dga'/ sku ga ri pa/ bde ston dge ba/ blo chen pa/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ blo bo mkhan chen/ rje grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/

/༈ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo la/ 'jam dpal/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba 'byung gnas/ ra hū la shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ bi khyā ta de ba/ shākya shrī/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra/ /༈ ni ri ti pa'i lugs kyi byams pa ni/ byams pa/ ni ri ti pa/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus bzhin/ /༈ sher phyin ser mo ni/ bi khyā ta de ba/ bud+dha shrī/ khro lo/ yang na/ jo bo/ 'brom/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ phag mo gru pa/ rje rgyal tsha/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus bzhin/ /༈ sher phyin dkar mo la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo'i rdo rje/ 'brog mi lots+tsha ba/ pu rings pa gsal rnying*/ 'khon sgye chu ba/ gong ma gsum/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog pa/ blo chen pa/ bag ston pa/ bram chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sher rdor ba/ shar/ ngor*/ kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ mkhan chen/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ yang na kun dga' dbang phyugapaṇa chen rin po che/ rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen kun dga' rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dbyangs can dkar mo phyag bzhi la/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo dang 'dra ba las/ shākya shrī tshab tu/ bud+dha shrī 'jug go /༈ dbyangs can dmar mo phyag gnyis ma la/ dbyangs can ma/ dza ya ā nan+ta/ khu mdo sde 'bar/ gtsang nag pa man chad gang blo ma'i bstod sgrub dang 'dra'o/ /༈ rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug gi 'phros/ 'od zer can ma/ me ru shi ṣa/ yi ge phyed bzhi pa/ spyan ma/ dam tshig gsum bkod de lnga po yang*/ mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs kyi chu bsrung gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o/ /༈ ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub ni/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka nas brgyud pa/ da na shī la la sa paṇa gyis gsan par grags/ de man chad ku ru kul+le dkyus dang 'dra zhing*/ de yan chad kyang 'dra bar kho bo sems so/

/༈ dpa' mo gser gyi snying thiganor rgyun ma dmar mo/ lha mo te nu ste dmar chung skor gsum la/ gnyan lots+tsha ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen yab sras/ yang sgom se po/ lung mang po/ yon tan khri/ drin chen seng ge bzang po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ bdag chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ lcang ra ba blo gros bzang po/ mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ thod pa rgyan la/ brgyud pa'i thog mar rnying ma'i bla ma 'ga' re ded dgos pa yod na'ang*/ rje btsun ma nyid la dngos su gnyan ston chen pos gsan/ de man chad shangs chos spyi dang 'dra/ /༈ gsang ba ye shes la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ dur khrod pa chen po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ la stod dmar po/ rgya sgom ras pa/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ lha dbang phyug dpal/ ri ba dkon mchog dpal/ rtogs ldan dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ don grub rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ mkhar drung*/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rnam 'joms ljang khu ba ri lugs la/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ a shwa ka shrī/ ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ bsod nams/ dbang phyugarin chen dpal/ byang chub gzhon nu/ byang seng ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ paṇa chen rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bkra shis/ 'bum ram pa dge 'dun nyi ma/ rje rdo ring pa'am yang na ngor chen/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun rdo ring ba dang mkhan chen rin po che gnyis char la bdag gis mnos so// ༈ rnam 'joms dkar po la/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ dzñā na shrī/ de wa pur+ṇa/ 'gar chos bzang*/ dmar chos rdor/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gung thang pa ye shes blo gros/ mkhas pa bde pa'i blo gros/ mtshar kha ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ ge rang rdo rje gzhon nu/ mkhan po nyi ma seng ge /ku thang pa bsod nams rgyal po/

mtshar kha 'bum ram pa/ rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bgegs mthar byed la/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes mar me mdzad/ /dpal sde dri med rin chen rdo rje dang*/ /rin chen grags pa ban dhe gnyan lo dang*/ kha'u mched dang sa skya gong ma lnga/ /a gnyan dam pa dga' ldan kun bsod dang*/ /dga' ldan bkras dpal 'kham pa rdo rje dpal/ /grags chen gangs khrod pa dang sa bzang pa/ /theg chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan mus srad pa/ /shes rab rin chen rje dbon shāka rgyal dang*/ /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan las mnos so/ /༈ sna tshogs yum dkar mo ni/ rdo rje shugs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ so sor 'brang ma phyag gnyis ma la/ rje btsun grags rgyal yan sher phyin dkar mo dang 'dra/ de nas sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ rgyal tsha chos dbang*/ rong ba sher seng*/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bram chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen man chad kyang sher phyin dkar mo'i brgyud pa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gtsug gtor gdugs dkar la/ sangs rgyas/ 'jams dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ ba ra ba/ skyu ra a skyabs/ sa chen/ grags rgyal/ stod lung go ser ba/ rgan lhas pa byang chub dpal/ shar pa ye rin/ 'phags 'od bu ston/ sgra tshad pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ blo bo mkhan chen/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ ri khrod ma rigs lnga la/ dze tā ri nas sa paṇa bar ba ri pa'i lugs spyi dang 'dra/ de nas shar pa sku mched/ bla ma rin ye/ blo chen pa/ bla ma bsam gtan grub/ 'bris lots+tsha ba dpal ldan byang chub/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ dpal rdor ba/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ bza' yum gyi brgyud pa'ang de kho na bzhin no/ /༈ rme brtsegs dud kha la/ ring brgyud/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ nye brgyud mkhas btsun dge stag pas zhal gzigs/ de nas rje btsun grags rgyal/

sa paṇa/ gra thang pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma blo gros dpal/ ye shes seng ge bsod nams shes rab/ mkhan po sher mgon/ hor ka bzhi pa seng rgyal/ sngags 'chang yon tan pa/ rong po blo bzang pa/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchogarje rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rme brtsegs ljang khu la/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho/ phyag sor ba/ byang 'dul/ chos kyi dbang phyugachos kyi byang chub/ chos kyi shes rab/ lo mchog pa/ mnyam med grags rgyal/ bla ma shākya/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen/ kha char sems dpa'/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje rdo ring pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ khro mo rme brtsegs ni/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ gru spang rtse/ gru rdo rje seng ge /brag nag pa seng rgyal/ mkhan po bsod seng*/ bla ma rgya gar rgyal mtshan/ chos rje seng ge ba/ gzhon nu blo gros/ gzhon nu dkon mchogagazhon nu don grub/ gzhon nu chos grub ste spyang lung pa bzhi rim can/ rje btsun grol mchogarje rdo ring ba/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ khro bo reg tshig la/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ lcags thang ba/ dge stag pa/ dmar chos rgyal man chad rnam 'joms dkar po dang 'dra/ /༈ bde mchog bya khyung gi brgyud pa ni/ phag mo gnam zhabs dang 'dra'o// ༈ dus 'khor khyung khra rgyud lugs ni/ rdo rje shugs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ khyung khra man ngag lugs la/ dus zhabs pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing ba/ mal lo/ gong ma lnga/ gung ba bkras bzang*/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/ dge bzang ba/ bla chen chos dpal ba/ rtsa brgyad rgyal seng*/ drung blo ba/ yig drug sher dpal/ rje grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ khyung ser la/ jo bo nas/ rong ston gyi bar klu dbang rgyal po dang 'dra/ de nas lha 'bri ston pa/ shes rab rdo rje/ mi nyag chos grags dpal bzang*/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/

/༈ 'jam dpal nag po'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa skya pa gong ma bzhi/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ mnyam med pa/ bla ma shākya/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ mon rdzong bsod nams nyi ma/ mon rdzong zla ba rgyal mtshan/ brag dmar ba kun dga' tshe 'phel/ 'bum ram pa dge 'dun nyi ma/ rje rdo ring pa dang*/ mkhan chen rin po che gang rigs/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ lha mo shra ma ṇa la/ ring brgyud jo bo rje sogs nas brgyud pa ni btsal bar bya la/ nye brgyud ni/ dwags po paṇa chen/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ sangs rgyas bsam 'grub/ karma 'phrin las pa/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ drung don grub legs pa/ des bdag la'o/ /ring brgyud phyis rnyed pa ba ri lugs ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ shar pa ye shes 'byung gnas/ shar pa kun seng*/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ gar thig bsod rgyal/ shes rab rdo rje/ grags pa rdo rje/ grags pa don grub/ grub chen ri khrod pa/ dwags po paṇa chen man chad gong bzhin/ /༈ seng gdong ma sngon mo la/ mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ zhang*/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ ngang tshul bzang po/ 'khrul zhig tshul rgyal/ rong po blo bzang*/ sku zhang mkhyen rab rje/ ston ra ba shākya don grub/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ seng gdong ma dmar mo la brgyud pa de nyid las 'ongs shing*/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha la/ 'jam dpal/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon pad+ma/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan/ chos rgyal rin chen gling pa/ bla ma dpal bzang pa/ bla ma chos dbyings pa/ ri khrod pa nam mkha' legs pa/ slob dpon phun tshogs pa/ slob dpon rgyal rin pa/ chos rje yon tan dpal/ rtogs ldan gzhon nu blo gros/

chos rje 'jam dbyangs blo gros/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims mtshan can/ des bdag la'o/ /'di la chag rin chen chos rgyal nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang sras mkhar ba gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i yig skor rnams kyi lung dang bcas pa zhig stag lung rin po che ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi drung du yang thob bo/ /༈ slob dpon pur+ṇa badz+ra las brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs nyi shu rtsa drug yod pa las/ phyag na rdo rje lhan skyes dang*/ mā ma kī'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon ku ta rā dza/ mkha' 'gro ma su kha dha ri/ slob dpon pad+ma ka ra/ pad+ma gho ṣa/ de rnams rgya gar gyi yul du byung ba'o/ /de nas sarba da dā/ sidha dh+wa dza/ dhi mī bha dra/ de rnams rig 'dzin grub pa'o/ /muk+ta gho ṣa/ go bi gho ṣa/ ko mu di bha dra/ shrī ta nu/ dharma ta shī la/ 'di'i dus su 'gro lding gi gling du chos kyi dag ter chen po mdzad/ slob dpon 'di 'das nas lo sum brgya lhag tsam lon skad/ de nas singha nā tha/ sa ro ru ha/ yu gri warma/ guṇa gup+ta/ bud+dha shā mi/ su ma ti ya sha bīr+ya bha dra'o/ /sarba da dā man chad 'gro lding gi yul kho nar byung ngo*/ /de'i slob ma de wa saṃ bha wa 'gro lding nas rgya gar lho phyogs su byon/ de la slob dpon pur+ṇa badz+ra ras gsan/ lhag ma nyer bzhi po ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ yul ra khang tsag mar 'khrungs pa'i shākya rak+ṣi ta/ bud+dha swa mi/ su dza ta/ sa dhu dzñā na/ saṃ pra kirti/ bram ze'i slob dpon be ta ban+tu/ bī ra mi tra/ de la pur+ṇa badz+ra gyis gsan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rta mgrin dkar po la/ yang na/ sau ri pa/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ bhu mi pā la shrī/ a sho ka shrī/ su dhi ya sha rā ti gup+ta/ lak+ṣ+mi gup+ta/ su dza tā bā di/ pur+ṇa badz+ra rnams so/ /shākya rak+ṣi ta des sgrub thabs brgya dang brgyad phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa'i nang nas/ nyer lnga po 'di dag dngos kyis 'khums/

/༈ nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi skor la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ klu sgrub/ nyi ma sbas pa/ tsan+d+ra gar+bha/ dze tā ri/ ngag dbang grags pa/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lots+tsha ba/ dkar po rnam gsum/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ kun mkhyen chos sku/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ slob dpon don grub rgyal mgon/ bla ma bkras rin pa/ ngor chen/ rin chen bkra shis pa/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rgyal tshab kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rjes sangs 'od pa/ rje btsun grol mchogarje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rnam thos sras ser chen nas dkar po'i bar rigs chen brgyad po 'di dag phyag rdor gos sngon can 'gro bzang lugs spal ti dgra bcom phyogs nas brgyud pa de dang brgyud pa gcigaser chen ni bu ston rin po nas brgyud pa dang chos lung tshogs pa nas brgyud pa gnyis kyang thob bo/ /༈ dkar po ni/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ mkhan chen bkras rnam pa/ mkhan chen rin po che rnams las brgyud kyang chog go /༈ ljang khu dzñā na lugs la/ te lo/ nā ro/ ka na ka shrī/ badz+ra ā ka ra/ bīr+ya tsan+d+ra/ ko ka li pa/ su ma ti badz+ra/ bud+dha kirti/ ā ka sha badz+ra/ dzñā na ta pa/ rje sangs rgyas dbon/ lha rin po che/ u rgyan mgon po/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rin chen/ grags pa bkra shis/ rin chen shes rab/ kun spangs chen po/ bsod nams rin chen/ pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa ni/ rigs chen brgyad dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ las chen kun dga' rgyal ba/ mkhan chen rin chen bkra shis/ mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dzaṃ bha la ser po gtso rkyang phyag gnyis pa la/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bha ka ra/ stobs bcu pa/

rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ bsod nams stobs/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa/ mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan pa/ rgyal grags pa/ rgyal phyag pa/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ 'jims chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs chos dbang*/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /bla ma dam pa gzhan 'ga' las 'di'i rjes gnang thob pa ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya mtsho sogs dang brgyud pa mthun par mdzad kyin snang ngo*/ /༈ gsang 'dus las 'byung ba'i dzaṃ bha la ni/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ bde ba chen po/ yi ge kar+ṇa pa/ dzñā na shrī mi tra/ bā ling tsar+ya/ gnyos lo/ rdo rje bla ma/ dpal seng*/ grags pa dpal/ sangs rgyas ras chen/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ sangs rgyas dbon man chad phag mo nag mo dang 'dra'o/ /༈ dpa' bo chig grub las 'byung ba'i dzaṃ bha la ni/ dze tā ri/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ nag tsho shes rab rgyal mtshan/ skyu ra a skyabs/ sa skya ba chen po man chad mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs dang 'dra'o/ /'ga' zhig 'di dang*/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i lag len gnyis kar sa skya pa dang*/ bka' gdams pa rnams lag len du byed mnyam yin yang*/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa ni ma yin gyi/ ba ri lots+tsha ba'i man ngags skya pa'i lag len de bka' gdams pas brkus nas/ jo bo rje la kha 'phangs pa'o zhes zer ba ni/ sa skya pa'i pho rus la bsams pa'i bab bcol te/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud sgyur pa po'i paṇ+ḍi ta yang jo bo rje kho na las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ jo bo rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lag len du 'byung ba ni/ chos bdag po'i tshul yin la/ de las brgyud nas rje btsun sa skya pa rnams las 'ongs pa ste/ brjod pa snga ma de ni/ dben ma mu cor gyi rgyal lo/ /zhes pa dang mtshungs so/ /༈ dzaṃ bha la nag po la/
