thams cad mkhyen pa nag po/ des rjes su bzung ba'i rgyal po'i mdun na 'don ka na ka shrī/ slob dpon nor sbyin/ paṇ+ḍi ta dbul po zangs gzhong can/ tshong dpon sa ya sur+ya/ pan chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lots+tsha ba/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal ba man chad dzam ser bzhin dang*/ yang na/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra bar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /༈ dzaṃ bha la dkar po la/ spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo rje/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge nag tsho tshul rgyal/ rong pa phyag gsor ba/ pu to ba/ shar wa pa/ gtum ston pa/ chu mig pa grags pa rgyal mtshan/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos bla/ mchims nam mkha' grags man chad klu dbang rgyal po dang 'dra'o/ /༈ dzaṃ lha dmar po srog sgrub la/ bde mchog lhan skyes dang 'dra'o/ /༈ dzaṃ dmar grwa pa mngon shes lugs la/ slob dpon pad+ma/ grwa pa mngon shes/ nye gnas gdan nag po/ bla ma mnga' ris pa/ go lung nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ go lung mdo sde dpal/ u rgyan pa/ tsha tsha mo shes rab rin chen/ byang sems gzhon nu tshul khrims/ lha mthong ba rin chen dpal/ myug pa chos grags/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na/ dge mo rin chen/ chags rin chen chos rgyal/ khra ri ba/ rje grol mchog/de la rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ rje rdo ring ba/ mkhan chen rin po che gsum gyis gsan/ de rnams kyis bdag la'o/ /༈ dzaṃ bha la ljang khu dus 'khor lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje shugs kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la/ bram ze gser mig/ku sha ni bha ro/ bal po ra ma pā la/ lo btsun chu/ nyang sgom rgod po/ phag mo gru pa/ stag lung thang pa/ rin chen mgon po/ rin chen bla ma/ dpon grags pa dpal man chad rnam sras ljang khu dang 'dra'o/ /༈ sras gar mkhan mchogasras rgyal ba khyu mchogalha mo dpal chen mo gsum ni/ ser chen brgyud pa khro phu ba'i lugs de dang phal cher mthun pa las/ rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/

rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gzungs las 'byung ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma yang dzaṃ bha la ser po gtso rkyang phyag gnyis pa dang 'dra/ /༈ nor rgyun ma ya ma ri'i lugs la/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi grub thob gcig la/ paṇ+ḍi ta ya ma ris zhus/ de la paṇ+ḍi ta aṃ bha tsār+ya/ de la shākya bsrung ba/ 'jims lots+tsha ba/ 'kham pa rdor rgyal/ rgyal tsha/ kun ldan ras pa/ khro lo man chad gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra/ ba lang rdzi dang*/ yid 'phrog nor rgyun ma yang khro lo man chad de dang 'dra la/ lots+tsha bas bud+dha shrī la zhus so/ /༈ gnod sbyin zha 'on rdo rje bdud 'dul ni/ phyag rdor khang brtsegs dang brgyud pa 'dra'o/ /༈ a pa ra dzi ta la/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ pra ha ti/ bā su bha ra/ jo bo rje/ rin chen bzang po/ bu rang khu ba'i dge slong puṇ+ya dha na/ dge slong puṇ+ya bo dhi/ rgya lcags ri ba/ rje sgam po pa/ phag gru pa/ stag lung thang pa man chad rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor dang 'dra/ /༈ tshogs bdag chags pa rdo rje dang*/ tshogs bdag dkar po phyag bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ra hu la/ jo bo rje/ rgya brtson seng*/ tshul khrims rgyal ba/ phyag sor ba/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba/ phag gru man chad rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor dang 'dra/ yang dkar po phyag bzhi pa 'di la/ jo bo rje/ khyung po rnal 'byor pa/ rmog lcog pa sogs shangs chos spyi dang 'dra bar byas kyang chog/༈ dmar po phyag bzhi pa yang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ a bha yā ka ra/ tsa mi/ rga lo/ 'kham pa a seng*/ phag gru man chad gong bzhin/ /༈ klu rgyal sog ma med dbyug gu ma spun gsum/ khol po kun+da li gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ jo bo rje/ a mes chen po/ sne zur ba/ rgya lcags ri ba/ dwags po lha rje/ dus gsum mkhyen pa/ 'gro mgon ras chen nas tre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bar go bzlog lhan cig skyes ma dang 'dra/ de nas rje btsun grol mchogastag lung rin po che rnam rgyal phun tshogs/

des bdag la'o/ /༈ myur mdzad ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ nag po bar chad kun sel/ mgon dkar/ mgon ser/ mgon dmar/ mgon ljang ste rigs lnga la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ shā wā ri/ mai tri ba/ yang rdo rje 'chang*/ a ta ya badz+ra/ ra hu la/ mkhas grub khyung po/ rmog lcog pa dang*/ zhang sgom chos seng*/ de gnyis las skyer sgang ba/ gnyan ston chen po/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston rin chen 'bum/ khyung po tshul mgon/ ras chen sangs rgyas seng ge shangs dkar ba/ skugs lung pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ sgrub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchogartsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'jag gdan rabs nas brgyud pa dang*/ mtshe'u gong ston nas brgyud pa mkhan chen rin po che la/ rje byams pa lhun grub kyis gsan/ de la bdag gis zhus/ yang paṇa chen rin po che nas brgyud pa rje rdo ring ba la'ang zhus te mgon po dkar nag gnyis kho na'o/ /༈ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs la/ he ru ka rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ nā gārdzun/ nā ga bo d+dhi/ shriṃ gi pa/ bo dhi bha dra/ rat+na ā ka ra gup+ta/ shup+ta ka ra/ dharmā ka ra/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ su dzā ta warma/ bi muk+ta de ba/ rā ti gup+ta/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa/ de la grub chen bud+dha nā tha dang*/ pur+ṇa badz+ra gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis kyis bdag la'o/ /༈ phyag bzhi pa nags rin lugs la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ klu byang*/ srung ba'i zhabs/ chos kyi sbas pa/ rin chen dpal/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mi'i seng ge /don yon rdo rje/ dge 'dun dpal/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ 'dren pa'i dpal/ chos dpal bzang po/ phyogs grol/ shākya mtsho/ legs skyes/ sangs rgyas dbyangs/ nags kyi rin chen/ gtsang chung pa chos grags/ chos rje kun dga' dpal 'byor/ rje nam mkha' rin chen/

rje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'di ni klu sgrub kyi gzhung chung lhad med de'i lugs yin/ /༈ mgon po phyag bzhi pa rga lo'i lugs mthing kha dang*/ lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kā/ las mgon bya rog gdong gsum ni/ thams cad du brgyud pa gcig cing*/ mgon dmar rkang gling can ni/ rga lo'i lho pa spre ston la gnang ba yin na'ang*/ de nas yar byon gyi bar brgyud pa gsal kha med/ de man chad 'dra'o/ /de la phag gru'i lugs ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub snying po/ ār+ya de ba/ rta dbyangs rdo rje gdan pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ tsa mi/ rga lo/ /phag gru/ thang pa/ rat+na nā tha/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ maṅga la gu ru/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ rat+na gu ru/ rat+na ka ra/ ka drug pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ 'bal rin chen seng ge bla ma smon lam dpal 'byor/ ngag dbang grags pa/ tshul khrims mchog grub/ rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis khu dbon gnyis char la bdag gis 'tshal lo/ /yang 'tshal lugs ltar na/ rga lo yan chan don gcig kyang 'dren lugs mi 'dra ste/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam legs smin/ klu'i bu thub pa mo/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ rta dbyangs/ dus 'khor ba/ yang na rnal 'byor ma/ dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ rga rab rdo rje/ dus 'khor ba/ a bha ya/ tsa mi/ rga lo/ zhang 'tshal pa/ lha phyug pa/ sangs rgyas 'tshal pa/ bla ma bsam rdzob pa/ bla ma dbon po/ kun mkhyen rgyal po/ legs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ skyes mchog thar pa ba/ grub chen rgyal 'bum/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ ngag dbang grags pa/ sku rags pa byang sems sher dpal la/ rje brag stod pas gsan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ zhang 'tshal pa/ gtsang pa rgya ras/ de nas rje kun dga' dpal 'byor gyi bar/ bar 'brug gi bla rabs rnams ded nas/ 'dar smyon he ru ka rje brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/

/༈ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur gyi brgyud pa ni/ rga lo/ phag gru/ slob dpon rtse lung pa/ 'bri khung 'jig rten gsum mgon/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin ldan/ zur phug pa/ 'bar ra ba/ gnyan ras pa/ rje kun dga' dpal 'byor nas gong bzhin/ /༈ mgon po gur lcam dral la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ shrad+dha ka ra warma/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo/ sa skya pa gong ma lnga/ a gnyan dam pa/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen rin po che/ spyang lung pa/ rje btsun grol mchoga'ajam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ chu mig bdag chen/ paṇa chen rin po che nas brgyud kyang chog/༈ lha brgyad la yang de dang 'dra ba'am/ paṇa chen rin po che/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ rje rdo ring pa byas kyang chog/yang rdo ring kun spangs rin po che nas brgyud kyang chog pa sogs sna tshogs yod do/ /yang mgon po lha brgyad la/ sa chen/ yar sgom se po/ rgya cha lung mang po/ yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ yar lung ba seng rgyal/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog man gong bzhin/ /༈ mgon phur zhabs ma la/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ slob dpon pad+ma/ 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong*/ bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ gong ma bzhi/ kha'u ba 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ bdag chen grags blo ba/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyugarje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje btsun grol mchogades rje rdo ring ba dang*/

brag stod pa gnyis char la/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gur yum can klu sgrub lugs la/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen yan phyag bzhi pa nags rin lugs dang 'dra/ de nas spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje/ spyan snga blo gros pa/ spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun grol mchogapha bla ma brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rgyud mgon rngog lugs la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ lho brag mar pa/ rngog chos sku rdo rje/ rngog mdo sde/ kun dga' dpal/ gzi brjid grags pa/ rin chen bzang po/ chos rgyal ba/ don grub dpal/ byang chub dpal/ bkra shis dpal grub/ byang chub dpal grub/ byang chub grags pa/ rngog blo gros dpal bzang po/ dge slong ye rdor ba/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ de bdag la'o/ /༈ mgon po stag zhon/ bde bka' ma/ gter ma ste gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ shān+ti gar+bha/ rom bu gu h+ya tsan+d+ra/ khrag 'thung nag po sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ bal po bā su dha ra/ snubs chen/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ brang dar kun grags/ sog ban 'bum grags/ skyo ban mthu chen/ lce mdo sde seng ge lce blo ldan seng ge lce btsun rin chen dpal/ lce dbang phyug rdo rje/ bla ma chos grags/ chos rje chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ rje rin chen seng ge mon rdzod zla ba rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ rje grol mchogarje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ legs ldan mched gsum la gdugs dkar dang 'dra ba las/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ pho rog mdo sde mgon po/ rgan molhas pa sogs so/ /༈ aṃ gho ra la/ klu sgrub/ me tog gling pa/ swa na bo dhi/ bā liṃ rnal 'byor/ ku chi pa/ dha na siṅk+ri ta/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ kun dga'/ pa tsha ba/ te ne/ zhig po nyi sang*/ 'khrul zhig dar seng*/ snye mdo bsod nams dpal/ dpal chen pa/ kun lhun pa/ chos rgyal pa/ sman gcig pa shes rab bzang po/ pha rgod kun rdor/ 'jigs med 'od 'phro/ rje grol mchogarje btsun lha dbang grags pa/

des bdag la'o/ /༈ rtsis mgon du grags pa legs ldan jo bo lugs la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ ra hū la/ jo bo/ 'brom/ spyan snga/ bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos 'byung*/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims/ skyo ston smon tshul/ byang chen pa bsod nams 'phel/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla chen bsod blo/ spyan snga sbyin pa dpal/ mkhan chen grags don pa/ rwa ston pa/ rje kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchogarje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gri gug lhan skyes kyang mkhan chen grags don pa yan chad de dang 'dra ba las/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhan chen gnam rtse ldeng ba/ gnas brtan lha chung ba/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ lho nub mgon po la/ sangs rgyas/ klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ dzñā na bo d+dhi/ bīr+ya ma ti/ ra hū la/ jo bo/ 'brom/ pu to ba/ gru gu kha che/ klog skya lha'i dbang phyugazhang ston rdo rje 'bar/ dbon po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rma ston pradzñā rang*/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ 'dul 'dzin dgon rgyal/ mkhan chen dkon mchog dar/ mkhan chen bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon brtson 'grus 'bar/ 'od 'jo ba nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mgon po bzhi sbrag kyang legs ldan rtsis mgon dang 'dra la/ 'di la lo pa phyogs nas brgyud pa zhig kyang thob bo/ /༈ gri gug ma kha che paṇa chen lugs la/ paṇa chen nyid yan chad ni btsal bar bya la/ khro lo man chad ni gsang 'dus lhan skyes dang 'dra'o/ /༈ gyi ljang lha bcu bdun ma la/ mchog srid/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dha ka ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ lo chen/ dge tshul pur+ṇa pa/ rgya lcags ri pa/ rdzing bu kha pa/ spen phug pa/ zhang ston ye shes/ bzod pa don grub/ bar thang pa yab sras/ dar ma shākya/ pur bsod dbang*/

lo mchog pa/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan/ lots+tsha tshul khrims brtan pa/ dmar ston pa/ yar dbon pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen sher zla ba/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ rje btsun grol mchogarje brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ gri gug lha dgu la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ te lo pa nas u rgyan mgon po'i bar rnam sras dzñā na lugs dang 'dra/ yon tan rgyal mtshan/ yon tan 'od zer/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros rin chen/ bsam gtan rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ mkhar drung*/ rje mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis khu dbon/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ ber nag zangs gri can dang*/ gcer bu zangs gri can ni/ sa skya gong ma lnga yan chad gur lcam dral dang 'dra/ de nas lo mchog pa/ spang lo/ bo dong 'jam ral/ blo brtan bzhi pa/ dwags po rnam rgyal/ dwags po don grub/ dwags po rab 'byams pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rje btsun grol mchogamakhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ yang na rje grol mchog mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/ rje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /'di ni rjes gnang gi brgyud pa yin la/ sgrub skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ gur lha brgyad dang 'dra'o/ /༈ tshogs bdag mgon po la/ gsang bdagalas kyi rdo rje/ dha na saṅk+ri tā/ jo bo rje/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ dge ba'i dpal/ rin chen rgyal po/ snye phu ba rgyal mtshan bzang po/ zhang rngo rngog pa/ sngags 'chang thugs rje ting 'dzin/ slob dpon kha 'ug pa bsod nams dpal/ rdzogs chen nam mkha' rdo rje/ rtogs ldan hral po/ rab 'byams pa rgyal mtshan bzang po/ spyan snga ba bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen shākya bzang po/ spya snga bkra shis rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal bzang*/ rje mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ trak+shad gnyos lugs phyag bzhi pa la/

rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze mchog sred/ mkha' 'gro bde ster ma/ bā liṃ ā tsar+ya/ gnyos lo yon tan grags/ sras rdo rje bla ma/ gnyos dpal lo/ gnyos grags pa dpal/ gnyos sangs rgyas ras chen/ lha rin chen dbang rgyal/ mkhan chen byang chub dar/ gnyos gzi brjid rgyal po/ gnyan ston dkon mchog rin chen/ nam mkha' dpal/ 'khrul zhig kun rin/ 'jam dbyangs rdo rje bla ma/ bsod nams grub rgyal/ grags pa 'od zer/ grags pa dbang phyugalha bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rje grol mchogarje btsun brag stod pa chen po/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na/ mkhan chen byang dar/ lha bsod nams rgyal po/ lha rin chen dbang rgyal gsum po gang rigs la kun mkhyen saṅgha bha dras zhus/ de nas blo gros brtan pa/ yon tan rgyal mtshan/ yon tan snying po/ byang sems bsod rin/ brag dkar sems dpa'/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ / 'di'i dbang bzhi ni brgyud pa snga ma kho na 'ded la/ rjes gnang rgyas shos kyi brgyud pa phyi ma kho na dang*/ rjes gnang 'bring po dang gtor dbang ni gnyis kar la 'ded do/ /༈ trak+ṣar dwags po lugs ni/ dha na saṅk+ri ta/ dā na shī la/ khrag 'thung nag po/ ba su dha ra/ snubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ de nas bar na brgyud pa'i gsal kha med kyang/ de nyid kyi skye ba rgya zhang 'brom/ dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba/ rje sgam po pa/ ston chung dar ye/ thon mi ston seng*/ snyi ba jo sras/ lha sgom pa/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ mkhan chen chos rgyal mtshan/ dbon po bsod nams lhun grub/ sngags 'chang bkra shis seng ge ba yo chos bzang*/ stag rtse 'tshams pa/ bla ma don grub rgyal mtshan pa/ rje karma 'phrin las pa/ spyan lnga bkra shis rnam rgyal/ slob dpon bkra shis dpal bzang*/ rje mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o/ /'di dang brgyud pa cung mi gcig pa zhig rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal la yang thos so/

/༈ trak+shad seng zhon jo bo lugs ni/ zhang rdo rje 'bar yan chad lho nub mgon po dang 'dra/ mkhan po smon ston/ slob dpon rin rgyal/ gzhon nu tshul khrims/ chos kyi rdo rje/ ra sgreng ba bsod nams bzang po/ 'brom seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rje dge 'dun grub/ gsang bdag ye shes rtse mo/ lha btsun blo bzang rab brtan/ rje btsun grol mchogarje byams pa lhun grub/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ trak+shad gri gug ma dang*/ trak+shad rkang thang ma gnyis ni/ gnyos lugs kyi brgyud pa snga ma ji lta ba bzhin no/ /༈ trak+shad ma ning la/ srog bdud chen po/ slob dpon pad+ma/ tsa hu pa/ shān+tiṃ gar+bha/ tsar+ya pa/ nyi ma'i snying po/ a tsa ra ṭi sha rga rnal 'byor pa/ gshin rje kha chen/ gshin rje kha chung*/ yon po mkhan po/ rga bsod nams seng ge stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ sbas tshul mchogarje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis khu dbon/ des bdag la'o/ /'di la ā tsar+ya nag po lugs/ ri bo che ba'i rje mkhar drung yab sras nas brgyud pa sgrub skor dang bcas pa zhig thob kyang bar skabs kyi brgyud pa ma rnyed do/ /༈ 'brong zhal la/ dwags po lugs dang 'dra ba las/ rje dwags po/ skyes bu ye shes rdo rje/ dung mtsho ras pa/ rnam grol bzang po/ sangs rgyas rdo rje/ bu chung dpal bzang*/ nam mkha' rdo rje/ rgyal bzang ba/ bsod rgyam pa/ shākya bh+ra dra/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ stag lung rin po chen grog kha ba rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ dwags po lugs gter ma'i brgyud pa yang de nyid dang 'dra bar shes par bya mod kyi/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang snga ma las logs pa mi dgos so// ༈ shwa na'i zhal can la/ dha na saṅk+ri ta/ shān+ti gar+bha/ des gter du sbas pa spyi la rga rab kyis bton/ gnyos lots+tsha ba'i phyag tu phul/ de nas gnyos lugs kyi brgyud pa snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ rje grol mchogarje grog kha ba/

des bdag la'o/ /༈ zhal bzhi pa bsnyen sgrub las gsum la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lots+tsha ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa skya gong ma lnga/ zhang*/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ yar lung pa seng rgyal/ bsod nams rgyal mchog pa/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs rin po che dang*/ byang sems kun dga' mchog grub gnyis char las/ rje grol mchog gam/ yang bla ma dam pa/ theg chen pa/ bdag chen zha lu pa/ paṇa chen rin po che/ spyang lung pa/ rje grol mchogayang na/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan pa/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ chu mig bdag chen/ paṇa chen sogs te mthar 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// ༈ dkar po tshe 'phel sogs zhal bzhi pa rigs bzhi la/ las bzhi mgon por grags pa rnams dang*/ gdong brnyan can te rnam pa lnga la/ nag po chen po/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lots+tsha ba/ dbus phrug phur ba dang*/ shongs ma'i sngags pa tshe ring po/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar ba/ spyan snga sku mched/ mkhan chen sang ge dpal ba/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ tho btsun dbang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mdo sngags paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ rje grol mchoga'ajam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ sha za lce spyang gdong can gyi brgyud pa ni/ gri gug lha dgu ji lta ba bzhin no/ /༈ lha mo dud sol ma la/ rngog blo gros dpal bzang yan chad mgon po gur rgyud mgon ji lta ba bzhin las/ de rjes rje grol mchogarje btsun lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na rngog byang chub dpal ba/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ slob dpon tshul khrims mchog grub/ rje rnal rgyal bkra shis/ rje kun dga' bkra shis/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ des bdag la'o/

/༈ dmag zor ma la/ ār+ya dmar po/ zhang shes rab bla ma/ sras saṅga bha dra/ gtsang dar 'od po/ rdo rje rtse mo/ zhang spe'u ril pa nyi ma 'od/ bstan bzang pa rin snam/ bsam gling pa/ sangs rgyas 'byung gnas/ 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ byang sems rin chen mgon/ rgyal sras thogs med pa/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen grags rgyal/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ rje dbon mthu stobs rab brtan/ chos rje nam mkha' lhan grub/ ras pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /'di yang rje grol mchog nas brgyud kyang chog/༈ rang byung rgyal mor grag pa phur bsrung gi dang po re ma ti la gsang bdagapad+ma 'byung gnas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal/ ngam 'dre gsal le 'od/ lang lab byang chub rdo rje/ kyi nag gyang 'gyel/ kyi byang chub 'bum/ kyi ston blo gros/ 'bre ge rad/ lce rin chen rdo rje/ rwa chos dbyings man 'jigs byed bsdus pa dang 'dra/ ༈ rang byung rgyal mo gar lugs kyang sgrub skor gyi ngo bo ni 'di kho na yin/ rje gnang gi bya ba dang*/ brgyud pa ni tha dad do/ /༈ lha mo dung skyong ma/ bdud mo re ma tī/ klu mo phyag bzhi ma/ gnod sbyin re ma tī ste bzhi po ni/ bi ma la mi tra nas brgyud pa rnying ma bka' ma zhig yin na'ang sngon dus kyi brgyud pa ni ma rnyed do/ /'on kyang rwa rdo rje grags pas lo gsum lon pa'i tshe zhal gzigs/ lha mos zla ba gsum dngos su khyer nas mdo khams la sogs pa yul sna tshogs bskor/ phyis bsgrubs pas bran bzhin du 'khol ba'i phyir brgyud pa'i thog ma de nas brtsams nas/ 'jigs byed bsdus pa dang 'dra zhing*/ de'i chos skyong gi tshul du sbyor gyin yang snang ngo*/ /༈ rdo rje gshog rgod ma la bka' ma'i brgyud pa yod kyang ma thob/ gter ma'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mnga' bdag nyang ral/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/

gu ru chos dbang*/ sras pad+ma dbang chen/ grub thob rdo ras pa/ ston pa yon tan rdo rje/ chos rje shes rab pa/ he ru ka pa/ dzñā na bha dra/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bsam gtan rin chen/ chos dpal bzang po/ bsod nams bkra shis/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ rje rnam rgyal phun tshogs/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ e ka dza ṭi ni/ bde mchog mkha' lding dang brgyud pa 'dra'o/ /༈ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can ma la/ sangs rgyas/ sgrol ma/ jo bo yab sras/ rngog legs she /mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor ba dar ma rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ zhang dar rgyal/ stag kha ba byang chub bzang po/ 'brom nam mkha' rin chen/ 'brom gzhon nu blo gros/ lho pa kun mkhyen/ gra phu ba chen po/ bsod nams 'od zer/ bsod nams rin chen/ chos grags pa/ dpal 'byor bzang po/ sgra pa thugs rje dpal ba/ lots+tsha ba thugs rje bzang po/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub man/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang 'dra'o/ /༈ las gshin gyis rigs dang po dang gsum pa la 'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi brgyud pa bzhin ded kyang shin tu legs la/ 'on kyang da ltar gtso cher 'dren pa ni/ 'jigs byed/ mkha' 'gro ma/ nā ga bo dhi/ la li ta badz+ra/ dzñā na kīrti/ mi nyag sgo don/ lo sgom zhig po/ ku ma rā dzā/ zhang ston bsod rin/ thang stong shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje bzang po/ nyang stod ār+ya/ grub chen kun blo/ mkhan chen dge ba rgyal mtshan/ drung btsun rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje sangs rin/ rje lha mchog pa/ rje grol mchogamakhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /de yang gtso bor las gshin bcu gsum ma'i brgyud pa yin no/ /dmar po snga ma ni/ dge ba rgyal mtshan nas/ shes rab zla ba/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ dkon mchog grags pa/ stag lung rin po che rnam gnyis/ de bdag la'o/ /༈ dur khrod bdag po la/ rnal 'byor ma/

pad+ma badz+ra/ shrī badz+ra/ ra hu la/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dzñā na sid+dhi/ blo gros bzang po/ bai ro tsa na/ dpal chen rga lo/ sa skya pa chen po nas bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi bar gur lha brgyad dang 'dra/ de nas drung btsun dpal rgyal ba/ mus chen sangs rin/ rje grol mchogarje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ pu tra'i zur bka' la/ klu sgrub/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dharma pā la/ lo chen rin bzang man chad gur mgon lcam dral lam/ lha brgyad kyi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs de rnams gang ltar ded kyang chog go /༈ bran bdud la/ dkar po rnam gsum yan chad gur dang 'dra ba las/ de nas do ba ston tshul/ rgyal tsha long mang po/ yon tan khri/ seng ge bzang po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan blo gros/ dmar ston pa/ chos rje nam pa/ chag rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen rab mdzes pa/ rdo rings kun spangs pa/ rje grol mchogarje rdo rings pa/ mkhan chen rin po che/ des bdag la'o/ /yang rje brag stod pa la'ang thob/ 'di yang paṇa chen rin po che nas brgyud pa 'dod na gong ma lnga zhang brag phug pa bla ma dam pa sogs zhal bzhi pa dang 'dra'o/ /'dir ni bla ma gong ma gsung pa ltar bkod pa yin/ yang gcer bu zangs gri dang bran bdud 'di gyi ljang lugs yin par yang byed do/ /༈ dkar mo nyi zla dang*/ bdud rgyal thod pa'i 'phreng ba can la/ sa skya ba chen po yan chad mgon po phur zhabs can dang 'dra/ de nas glo bo rdo rje srin po/ glo bo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ glo bo lots+tsha ba shes rab rin chen/ 'phags pa/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo mchog pa/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ yangs pa can pa/ shākya kun dga'/ bla ma dam pa dge slong ye shes dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ rgyal chen bzhi'i bka' gtad la/

rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po/ bha wa bha dra/ skal ldan grags pa/ ka ma la rak+ṣi ta/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ de la stod lung bai ros gsan/ de nas bla ma zhang 'tshal pa/ shākya ye shes/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ sangs rgyas snying po/ gser khang steng pa/ sangs rgyas rin chen pa/ shākya 'bum/ shākya bsod nams/ dbon po chos bzang*/ grags pa don grub/ bsod nams grub/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ mkhan po byang chub bsod nams/ 'tshar kha'i 'bri khung mkhan chen/ sangs rgyas bzang po/ rje lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gtor dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ grub pa'i dbang phyug khyung po rnal 'byor/ dge bshes gha pa chos rgyal/ rtogs ldan zhang sgom chos seng*/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ slob dpon gnas rnying pa a'i seng ge gseng gling pa bkra shis dpal/ brag chen pa rdo rje dpal/ bya btang chu'i rnal 'byor/ zhu ston tshul khrims mgon po/ sum cu chos grags pa/ mnyam med pa chos sku shākya rin chen/ ngag dbang blo gros/ rgya sgom chen po/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchogardo rje 'chang lha dbang grags pa/ des bdag la'o/ /༈ tshe ring mched lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun mi la/

rje lha dbang grags pa/ 'jam mgon tā ra nā tha/ snang thang pa rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal/ grub chen ngag dbang 'phrin las/ chos rje kun bzang dbang po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ zur mang tshe dbang kun khyab/ mang thos karma rin chen/ karma 'od gsal 'gyur med/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos 'phel/ kun spang chos kyi 'phags pa/ ngag dbang chos 'dzin rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang chos 'byor dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang chen po sogs/ dwags po rin po che/ phag mo gru pa/ rje 'bri khung pa/ 'bri khung dbon rin po che/ gcung rin po che/ bla ma a rtse/ spyan snga rdor rgyal/ 'bri khung lots+tsha ba nor bu dpal ye shes/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen dga' ba sdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rgyal ba shākya mchog ldan/ dbu legs grub chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen don yod grub pa/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchogartsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po brag stod pa/ des bdag la'o/ / sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ sgrub thabs rnams kyi brgyud rim bshad pa'i skabs te nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //'dir smras pa/ srid zhi'i gnas na phun tshogs kun gyi phul/ /bla med byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i lam/ /rdo rje'i theg pa las gzhan yod min na/ /lam de'i rtsa ba lha'i rnal 'byor yin/ /srid lam 'khyams shing dub pa'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /kun gyi rtsa ba tha mal snang zhen te/ /de nyid sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs mang yang*/ /lha sku'i rnal 'byor kho na gtso bo yin/ /lhag pa'i lha kun ye shes ngo bor gcig/sku yi rnam 'gyur gcig pu kho nas ni/ /mos pa tha dad drangs bar mi nus pas/ /dkyil 'khor du ma sprul zhing bshad par mdzad/ /de phyir 'o skol rgyal ba'i rjes 'jug kyang*/ /gcig pu kho nas chog sems mi bya bar/

/thabs tshul du ma ma nyams skyong bar rigs/ /des ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bskang bar 'gyur/ /bdag nyid gcig pu kho nar 'bad byed kyang*/ /brgyud ldan lung gi bstan pa ma nyams na/ /mos pa sna tshogs rjes su bzung nus pas/ /de dag rnams la phan phyir 'di bris so/ /bdag lta shin tu ma bsdams mi mkhas la/ /gnas lugs mthong ba'i ye shes med mod kyi/ /rgya bod kun gyi chos rgyus che rab tsam/ /man ngag mang du thos nas 'di nyid sbyar/ /tshul 'dir gzhan dag 'jug pa dka' mod kyi/ /rang gi thos pa'i bag chags gso ba dang*/ /lhag pa'i lha rnams dgyes pa bskyed phyir yin/ /skal mnyam 'gal la cung zad phan kyang srid/ /de ltar man ngag bdud rtsis brlan pa'i sgrub thabs chu gter mtha' yas las/ /rje bo dam pa'i drin las thob pa'i zhal lung ri dbang sgril bar brtson/ /rnam dpyod nor rgyas srub thag gis bskul sgrub thabs nyin byed snang ba 'di/ /'jig rten khams 'dir nyin dang nyin la rtag par yang yang 'char gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis mtha' dag 'gro ba rnams/ /lhag pa'i lha 'di rnams kyi dngos thob nas/ /zag med dag pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas las/ /bde chen dga' ston mchog la rtag rol shog/ de ltar na rgyud sde bzhi las gsungs pa'i yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ de yang dang por sgrub thabs kha cig bris nas ring zhig lon pa na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos kyang sgrub thabs thor bu mang po dag byed par bskul bas rkyen byas te/ rang lo sum cu rtsa gnyis pa la 'go brtsams/ bar skabs su le lo dang rnam g.yeng gis dus yun ring po lus pa las/ slar yang grogs 'gas nye bar bskul te/ cha tshang bar bgyis pa ni/ rang lo so bzhi pa dang por shar ba phur pa spre'u'i lo mchu'i zla ba'i shes rab phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa la/

dpal nag rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang du sbyar ba'o// //dge legs 'phel/ /zhu dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrubs thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 306 -- PAGE 1 -
